1. Talk to Event Ring Maker {{navi|prontera|154|185}} in [[Prontera]]. She will make a Valentine Gift Box using 1 {{item|id=7175 Wrapping Paper}}, 1 {{item|id=7174 Wrapping Lace}}, 1 Box, and 1000 [[Zeny]].
*Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Lace, and Box can be purchased from Packs Trader in Prontera (147, 171).

2. Give your ring to a character of the opposite gender. 

3. To turn in your ring, talk to Valentine Vote Manager {{navi|prontera|157|185}}.  The two characters (one of each gender) with the most "votes" will receive a special 1-year Valentine's Emblem accessory at the conclusion of the event.  The top 10 vote-getters on each server will also have their names entered into the iRO website's Hall of Honor.

== Helping Santa Deliver Christmas on time ==
# Talk to '''Frantic Child''' near the Christmas tree in [[Lutie]] (142, 133) and ask about Santa needing help.
# Now go to '''Santa Claus''' in Lutie (198, 253) and agree to help.
# Talk to '''Santa's Helper''' directly to the right and have her warp you to Lutie Field.
# Talk to the '''Holiday Helper''' and hunt 1 {{monster|id=1247 Antonio}}.
# Return to the Holiday Helper and have him warp you back to Santa.
# Talk to Santa and he will tell you to go find his mother near the benches in Lutie.
# Speak with '''Grandma Claus''' in Lutie (86, 159) and she will ask you to gather 1 {{item|id=519 Milk}}, 5 {{item|id=538 Well-baked Cookie}}, 1 {{item|id=7213 Needle Packet}} and 50 {{item|id=6535 Piece of Red Fabric}}.
# After collecting all of the items return to Grandma and she will tell you to let Santa know the bag is complete.
# Talk to Santa Claus again and he thanks you for saving Christmas and Rewards you with 5 {{item|id=538 Well-baked Cookie}}.
# Now return to the Frantic Child and she thanks you and rewards you with 1 Named {{item|id=5742 Rudolf Santa Hat}}.

== Raccoons gone amok! ==
#Talk to the Shopkeeper in [[Lutie]] (172,131) and she will ask for 10 of each items: Stolen Candies, Stolen Cookies, and Bag of Selling Goods.
#After bringing her the items, talk to the Raccoon Hooray Clerk located inside the same house.
#The Raccoon Hooray Clerk will ask you to go talk to the Raccoon Hooray Captain in [[Prontera]].
#Go to [[Prontera]] (149,176) and talk to the Raccoon Hooray Captain. He will ask to for at least 50 Christmas Cookies.
#After bringing giving the Captain 50 cookies, he will still ask you to get some more. Refuse his request and claim your reward.
#Talk to the Captain again and he will request you to bring him 5 of his Racoon family members who are located in [[Lutie]].
#Go to [[Lutie]] and find these 5 raccoons.
#Talk to Raccoon Hooray's No. 2 (130,156), 5 (182,149), 12 (117,77), 20 inside(122,159), 25 inside(142,237). Each of these raccoons will ask for something. It could either be a Stolen Candy, Stolen Cookie, or Christmas Cookie.
#After talking to the 5 Raccoons, go back to Raccoon Hooray Captain in [[Prontera]] to get your reward.

{{Not Implemented}} {{Repeatable|cooldown=20 hour}} {{Quest Info | levelreq = 50 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = 1 {{item |id=2241 Grampa Beard}}

10 Enraged Kapha | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 100,000 (Non-VIP)
200,000 [[VIP]] | jobexpreward = 50,000 (Non-VIP)
100,000 [[VIP]] | itemreward = {{item|id=5277 Air Pirate Bandana}} | qreward = | external = http://www.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=205&p=1 | window = Yes }} #Talk to the '''Coastal Guard''' ('''/navi prontera 60/342''') in [[Prontera]]. #:[[File:CoastalGuardian.png|250px]] #After listening to him, ask about the monsters becoming more active and he will send you to his guild mate in Alberta. #Find the '''Guard Lieutenant''' ('''/navi alberta 30/235''') in [[Alberta]] . #*He asks you to kill 20 Iara and 10 Kaphas around town. #*Note that these are special version and must be hunted in the town. They mainly spawn by the Harbor, but may wander up into town if left alone. #:[[File:GuardLieutenant.png|250px]] #After exterminating the monsters, return to the Guard Lieutenant. #*He thanks you for making the city slightly-less-under-attack and directs you to take the [[Sunken Ship]] ferry to get to Alberta Island. #Speak to the '''Guard General''' ('''/navi alb2trea 30/56''') at Alberta Island. #*There are two options here. I chose to be cheeky and make a Wisecrack, but I am not sure if that changes how to continue. #:[[File:GuardGeneral.png|250px]] #The General will not listen to you and tells you to wait with the other Civilians, so go talk to the '''Familiar Lady''' ('''/navi alb2trea 29/94'''). #:[[File:FamiliarLady.png|250px]] #After learning that she is actually Izlude Irene, the pirate you helped before, ask her if Pirates were behind the attack. She confirms that they were not. Tell her that you will help, and she directs you to Wyse the Unlikely in Einbroch, the leader of the Azure Knaves gang. #Find '''Air Pirate Captain, Wyse''' ('''/navi einbroch 103/129''') on top of the airship at Einbroch . He tells you to find Aneka in front of the Weapon Shop. #:[[File:Wyse.png|250px]] #Talk to '''Pirate Aneka''' ('''/navi einbroch 224/212'''). She asks for help in smuggling some weapons and a "fortified beverage" and instructs you to either have the Cloak Skill or have the classic Lighthalzen Guard disguise of {{Item |id=2243 Geek Glasses}} and a {{Item |id=2241G rampa Beard}}. #:[[File:PirateAneka.png|250px]] #Once you're ready to go, talk to Aneka again. She gives you the supplies (no item) and tells you to talk to '''Quartermaster, Fiona''', who is next to Wyse on top of the airship. #*Note that it seems that you do not actually need to wear the items. I was able to get past while only having them in my inventory. You can also choose a different route to avoid the NPCs entirely. #:[[File:Quartermaster-Fiona.png|250px]] #Once you have handed the supplies over to Quartermaster, Fiona, talk to Wyse again. He offers to fly you to Einbech so that you can steal some blueprints for a drill being constructed to mine minerals from the ocean floor. #Walk into the building to your right and talk to the '''H-N Receptionist''' ('''/navi ein_in01 164/153''') behind the counter. #*Ask about the '''''Disturbances in Ocean''''' and she asks you to leave, but you decide to look around anyways. #:[[File:HNReceptionist.png|250px]] #Talk to the '''H-N Researcher''' ('''/navi ein_in01 174/138'''), who has lost the plans for the drill, but you learn they kept a spare inside the drill itself. You can find the machine outside, on the streets of Einbech. #:[[File:Researcher.png|250px]] #Find the '''Drillomatic''' ('''/navi einbech 163/140''') at Einbech . #*To talk to it, you actually need to '''''run through it'''''. You will then be prompted to fill in a password, which works much like the game in the Thanatos Tower Quest. #*If you'd like help finding the number, try [http://choobs.org/number.php this site]. #:[[File:Drillomatic.png|250px]] #Once you have cracked the code, you will be prompted to read the plans or to take them and run. I chose to take them and ran. Not sure if this makes a difference or not. #Return the plans to Wyse, who takes you aboard his airship, the Moldy Crowe. #Once inside, talk to Wyse again, who asks you to talk to Aneka near the table. #:[[File:Wyse-Airship.png|250px]][[File:Aneka-Airship.png|250px]] #Aneka wants to drop you right into the center of the action, and asks you to talk to the Gunner out on the top deck. #Head outside and speak to the '''Air Pirate Gunner''' to your south, who needs help with his aim. #*You'll need to play a mini-game to help him out. #*If you put the Phen on your right, the commands will line up with where the Gunner shoots. #*Your goal is to direct him to where the Phen is three times. #*[https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=44&v=ApxwWhs9RbY Youtube guide] #:[[File:Gunner.png|250px]] #Once you have blasted the Phen, you are dropped near the Mining Operation in Byalan. #Speak to the '''Drilling Supervisor''', who tells you that most of the workers fled after the attacks started. They few that remain have disguised themselves as Galapagos, and she summons one for you to escort to the drill so that it can be stopped. #*This Galapago works like a Mercenary and will expire in 30 minutes #*Enter the portal. #*The goal is the southeast corner of the map, but beware of the mobs and MVP on this map. #*Low level characters may have difficulty. #:[[File:DrillingSupervisor.png|250px]] #The '''Pengineer''' will disable the machine, but it is about to explode! You are warped back to Alberta Island #:[[File:MalfuncDrill.png|250px]] #peak to the '''Pirate Medic''' who tells you that you were found floating in the middle of the ocean atop your Pengineer... Who happens to be okay as well. #:[[File:PirateMedic.png|250px]] #Talk to Izlude Irene again, she will gives you your rewards #:[[File:FamiliarLady.png|250px]] #*{{item List|id=5277|item=Air Pirate Bandana|simple=yes}} #*100,000 Base EXP ([[VIP]]) and 100,000 Job EXP([[VIP]]). ==Log== *First implement on September 11 ~ November 16, 2012 *Re-implement: **[[2015 Talk Like a Pirate Event|May 20 ~ July 1, 2015]] (Changed quest reward) **August 25 ~ October 6, 2016

title: 2013 Easter Event
wikitext:
{{Quest Info | levelreq = 45 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = 50 {{monster|id=1109 Deviruchi}}
50 {{monster|id=1504 Dullahan}}
50 {{monster|id=1379 Nightmare Terror}}
or 50 {{monster|id=1291 Wraith Dead}} | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = Varies | jobexpreward = Varies | itemreward = {{Item List| id=5852|item=Easter Egg Shell|simple=yes|num=1}} | qreward = | external = http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=254 | window = yes }} === This event was implemented for the 2013 Easter holiday month, the 2015 Labor Day holiday month, and the 2021 Easter holiday month. It is currently active for 2024. === == Lifting the curse == # Talk with '''Hunter Lina''' in Prontera. She will explain her problem. Offer to help her. #*Talk to her again and she will give you a short-term buff. #:[[File:Lina-Easter2013.png|250px]] #Do something about '''Lina''''s curse by killing 50 of any of the 4 monster choices. #:For most players, {{monster | id=1291 Wraith Dead}} monsters are impractical since they are mostly in the Geffen War of Emperium castle dungeons. Thus, most players must choose between {{monster | id=1109 Deviruchi}} in Geffen dungeon, {{monster | id =1504 Dullahans}} in Nifflheim, or {{monster | id=1379 Nightmare Terrors}} in level 2 of the Magma dungeon (Nogg Road). Magma dungeon is a popular leveling area. Check with Grandpa at the front counter in Eden since deviruchi are sometimes available in the mobby low-level Grandpa turn-in quests. The least mobby of these places is Nifflheim but be warned that the monsters are above level 99. If you have a party, you can choose to fight every Nifflheim monster, but if you are solo, then using flywings to avoid fighting non-dullahan monsters is a useful tactic. If you simply want the easiest dungeon and don't want to level while getting your requisite 50 monsters, then go to Geffen dungeon. # After killing the requisite number of cursed monsters, talk with '''Lina''' and listen to the BGM music related to the curse's manifestation. #*If you have the background music turned off, use the /bgm command to toggle your BGM back on. BGM is also an option via the setup program in your ragnarok online folder. #*If you still cannot hear audio, verify that the checkbox for "No Sound" is not selected via the setup program in the Ragnarok folder. #*If you selected "No Sound", then you will have to close the client window and run the client again (popularly known as "relogging"). #*Simply going to the character select screen will not be enough to restore your sound if you had "No Sound" selected. #After listening to '''Lina''''s BGM sample, go to one of five town maps that is related to the BGM. These town choices are: Geffen, Juno, Lutie, Rachel, and Hugel. #:If you don't remember which town '''Lina''''s BGM sample corresponds to, you'll have to visit each town until it sounds familiar to you. OR you use a little detective work instead by opening the "BGM" folder in your Ragnarok Online folder. This folder contains MP3 versions of all the BGM used by your RO client. Play the MP3 files listed below with your favourite MP3 player. If the tune sounds familiar to you, then you'll know which town you need to visit to check for Lina's curse manifestation. #:*file "13.mp3" is the "Theme of Geffen" #:*file "70.mp3" is the "Theme of Juno" #:*file "59.mp3" is the "Theme of Lutie" #:*file "94.mp3" is the "Theme of Rael" corresponding to the city of Rachel #:*file "93.mp3" is the "Latinnova" corresponding to the city of Hugel #Find and click on the curse's manifestation as shown below. Many different quests use a grayish clickable spot and this quest does the same. #:
[[File:Geffen-Easter2013.png|250px]]
'''Geffen'''		[[File:Juno-Easter2013.png|250px]]
'''Juno'''		[[File:Hugel-Easter2013.jpg|250px]]
'''Hugel'''
[[File:Lutie-Easter2013.png|250px]]
'''Lutie'''		[[File:Rachel-Easter2013.png|250px]]
'''Rachel'''
#Return to '''Lina''', who rewards you with {{Item List| id=5852|item=Easter Egg Shell|simple=yes|num=1}}, [[Base EXP]], and [[Job EXP]]. #*She will also give you some stat buffs (DEX, VIT, LUK) which last 20 minutes. Because of this, you might choose to do your final turn-in to '''Lina''' right before you go leveling or off in a party. #*Any future visit will have her buff you with a short-lived [[Blessing]] and [[Increase AGI]]. #*Her egg-shaped NPC friend (next to '''Lina''') will start selling eggs in sets of 5, for 2,000 zeny. #*This NPC can also create something egg-related provided you bring the materials of: #**{{Item List|id=574|item=Egg|simple=yes|num=1}} #**{{Item List|id=1001|item=Star Dust|simple=yes|num=1}} #**{{Item List|id=909|item=Jellopy|simple=yes|num=20}} #**300,000 zeny. #*Randomly receive any of the items below: #**{{Item List| id=5852|item=Easter Egg Shell|simple=yes|num=1}} #**{{Item List|id=607|item=Yggdrasil Berry|simple=yes|num=1}} & {{Item List|id=1001|item=Star Dust|simple=yes|num=1}} #**{{Item List|id=608|item=Yggdrasil Seed|simple=yes|num=2}} & {{Item List|id=574|item=Egg|simple=yes|num=5}} #**{{Item List | id=12093|item=Special Toast|simple=yes|num=2}} #**{{Item List|id=12019|item=Holy Eggs|simple=yes|num=5}} #**1 pet egg (possible pets include Deviruchi, Peco Peco, Picky, Poporing, and Savage Babe) == Notes == *The Easter Egg Shell has the following properties: [[Def | def]]: -7, [[Mdef | mdef]]: -7, recovers 1% of your [[HP]] every 10 seconds, [[flee]] + 2 if [[Refinement System | refined]] to +7 or higher, recovers 1% of your [[SP]] every 10 seconds if refined to +9 or higher. *Holy Eggs enable a single use of level 2 [[Resurrection]] which is superior to that of a {{item | id=610 Yggdrasil Leaf}}. The Holy Egg is the best resurrection item in the game (usable by a 3rd party). Also known as Saint Egg when given as a prize in the 2023 Easter Event. [[Category: Temporary Event Quests]]

== Spotlight Quest Description == 

This quest is part of this month's Veins Spotlight (see official announcement) which begins on <font color="red">July 3rd</font>.  When the spotlight on Veins ends, this quest will cease being available.  Completion of the quest includes the Star Spangled Bandana in celebration of the USA's 4th of July holiday.


== Doing the Quest ==

#Talk to Kataniya (Medium NPC) located at the north end of the Veins town map at (223,346).  This location is next to the town's northern entry/exit warp.  Keep talking until she reveals information about the Lady in White and the investigation over her disappearance.  She tells you to check with the Guard Captain.  To see your current coordinates, use the /where command.
#Go to the Guard Captain located at the town's prison's basement.  The prison entrance is at the mid-western edge of town at (88,170).  The Captain wants you to collect evidence for the investigation so you will need to visit at least five different crime scenes to obtain five clues.  There's actually more than five crime scenes with clues, but you don't need to find clues in any particular order nor even get all the clues.  Now, if I was writing the quest, I would give a bigger experience reward if all the clues had been discovered instead of the minimum required amount.  
#*Beware of idling in the Prison basement or you can be attacked by a prisoners' doppleganger.  These dopple monsters are transparent similar to a biolab monster.  They seem to appear when someone turns in the clues to receive a headgear.  Only one exists at any one time, so even if several people turn in at the same time, only one monster will be there.  It is not necessary to kill the monster.
#*These dopple monsters have short detection ranges.  So, you can talk to the captain from the top of the stairs and the dopple monsters will never "see" you.  Their attack is fairly weak and it is not necessary to kill them.
#*Actually, only 3 of the clues are needed. If you obtain the Love Letter, the Wedding Dress, and the Corpse clues listed below you have enough to finish the quest.
#After talking to the Guard Captain, go upstairs to the northwest corner of the room (upper left).  This is the next closest clue in the investigation.  There is a Magistrate there and a statue of a knight holding a pikeaxe (spear with an axe blade).  Click on the spot near the statue's feet to collect the clue "Clue:Napkin" describing a napkin with bright red lipstick stains on it.
#Leave the prison and go northwards up the left side of the town for the next clue.  At (112,278) you will see an entrance to a wooden building with its doors ajar.  This is Vein's Inn.  Go inside.  Proceed straight ahead approximately 10 squares and you will be next to a sofa and table with a nearby towner.  Click on the surface of the table to collect the clue "Clue:Ribbon" which describes the ribbon being in the style for a woman.
#Now go upstairs.  You are heading to the next closest clue.  At the top of the stairs, you will see the Inn Master.  This inn is like others in that you can save here and recover your HP/SP.  At the top of the stairs, you see a few steps going upwards to the balcony area.  Proceed to the balcony area and keep going until you reach the exit from the balcony.  You are now outside.  Go downwards on the walkway and you see a building with spinning fans.  Go inside and go to your left to see the stairs going down.  Before going down, know that this is one of two spots where you might encounter a banshee.  Go down the stairs.  You will find three separate sleeping quarters.  In the first sleeping quarters, there is a Fighter NPC.  Stand in the square immediately to the right of this NPC or stand on top of the bed.  Now you will be able to see and click on the pillow for the bed in the 2nd bedroom.  Click on the Love Letter and read it to collect the clue "Clue:Love Letter".  If the banshee cooldown has expired, then a new banshee will appear in that middle room  Since you are in the first room, you can avoid encountering that banshee.  Note carefully that the letter is written by a man to the missing Lady in White and it mentions meeting her at the highest point in town.  You will be heading to this highest romantic point next!
#Go back outside.  Once again, you are next to the wall of spinning fans.  Head east on the walkway and you will pass by an entrance.  Keep going east up the 4 wooden steps and continue east.  You will see a ladder going up.  Go up the ladder and then go west under the rock overhang to the next ladder.  Go up this ladder and you will see a Towner (197,219) next to a withered old tree.  Go east along this path and then head south when at the intersection (226,216).  By going south you will end up at an overhanging high point with several large cactus.  Click on the spot for the wedding dress clue in order to get "Clue:Wedding Dress" added to your quest list.  If the banshee is already out and blocking your approach, use the alternate cactus method below.
#*The alternate method to visit the cactus is to go back outside and then use flywings to get onto the eastern path.  Then head to NPC Ledrion (274,188) who is dressed in black and wears a monocle.  Go up the stone stairs and then up the short wooden stairs (4 steps) to the wooden ladder.  Go up the ladder and up the stone steps to stand in front of a dark metal door.  Rotate your view until the cactus on the top of the cliff are visible and you can click on the clue.  This way, if the banshee appears, it cannot get to you.
#Go north from the cactus back to where Kataniya (Medium NPC) and then head south along the east side's path to the intersection at (290,210) where you see a sword-wielding Vigilante and a Kid.  There are two different paths going east from that intersection; take the southern path going east which is the cul-de-sac at the middle-right of your minimap..  As you go east on this path, you will pass a Towner and one more Kid.  Just before you pass underneath a walkway and building, look up at the sides and you will see animated flames from the memory of a past love as well as the corpse.  Click on the corpse to collect the clue "Clue:Corpse". 
#The message "You feel as if you have all the clues you need." appears when you have gotten the minimum number of the clues (regardless of the order you got the clues) needed by the Guard Captain.  At that point, once you have the required clues, you can return to the Guard Captain.  On your way back, you will pass by the locations of the spare clues as described below.  You can collect them or ignore them.
#*A spare clue is the Party Invitation which can be collected at (161.175) which is just outside the entrance to the weapon/armor shop.  The point that you click upon is just behind the wooden post next to the table with bananas and "Clue:Party Invitation" will appear in your quest list.
#*Another spare clue is inside the weapon/armor shop.  Go inside the shop to the counter in front of the weapon seller.  You will see two swords there. Click on the closest sword to see that the sword has been recently cleaned and the name "H.H. Holmes" has been nearly filed off.  After you do this, you should see "Clue:Sword" appear in your quest list.
#Head west to the prison in order to report your findings to the Guard Captain.  Report your investigation findings as:
#*Female
#*Sword
#*No
#*Mitch
#Mitch's Doppelganger spawns and you receive EXP and a Star Spangled Bandana.

== Notes == 

#While the airship does take you from Izlude to Rachel (with a free transfer in Juno), the kafra at Juno's town square can warp you directly to Rachel and from Rachel's Cool Event NPC you can get a warp to Veins.   
#As usual for any Spotlight area, if you completed all of the spotlight area's quests during that spotlight, you get an additional exp award.  Talk to the NPC Victoria Quest at coordinates (214, 129) in the Vein town's square because you will get exp even if you have done all that area's quests before the spotlight.
#Remember to zoom your camera view outwards (mouse wheel) when inside Veins for easier navigating.  Veins allows you to zoom out more so than in many other towns.
#There are more clues available than you are required to find.  This allows players to do the quest in their own way and knowledge of the town.  Once you have found enough clues, you will see a message saying that you feel you have found enough clues.
#Stats on the Star Spangled Bandana:  DEF=7.  Required Level=30.  Weight=20.  Jobs=All jobs.  Account bound.
#Features of the Star Spangled Bandana:  All Stats +1. Enables the use of Level 1 [Bash].  If upgraded to +7 or higher, Increases damage for all races by 10%.  This headgear is Account Bound.

== A Case With Egg-stra Bunnyfits! ==
1. Speak to the '''Easter Bunny''' at [[Prontera]] (150,191) and ask him more about what's wrong.

2. Head to the building at the bottom left of [[Prontera]] (46,67)

3. Once you are inside, talk to the detective and he will tell you how you can help.

4. He will tell you one of 12 locations to check.

'''Locations:'''
* 1 map West of [[Prontera]] town - (prt_fild05) 201,42
* 1 map West and 1 map North of [[Prontera]] town - (mjolnir_09) 126,98

* 1 map South and 4 maps West of [[Prontera]] town - (Gef_fild10) 43,351
* 1 map South of [[Al De Baran]] town - This one isn't in the correct spot either, no clue where they put it.
* 2 maps South of [[Morroc]] town - (moc_fild18) 112,89

5. After speaking with the correct '''Rabbit Hole''' you can return to the detective.

6.When you are finished speaking to the '''Detective''' he will ask you to re-visit the Easter Bunny.

7. Talk to the '''Easter Bunny''' again and he will tell you of an ex-friend.

8. Return to the '''Detective''' and he will tell you to go visit [[Turtle Island]] to look for this other Bunny.

Note: If you have not done so you will need to do [[Turtle Island Entrance Quest]] to get to turtle island.

9. Upon arriving at [[Turtle Island]], since the quest is broken, all you have to do is speak with the '''Strange Nest''' at (169,75) on the island.

10. You don't need to kill the rabbits that appear. Now we return to the '''Detective''' again.

11. After he congratulates you, return to the '''Easter Bunny''' and he will thank you and reward you.

Reward: 1 Spring Rabbit Egg (Eclipse Pet)
Now you can access the repeatable mini-quest to help the children.

In other words, if the character did not finish the 2011 quest, this quest can't be started. * Step 4 cannot be completed. The windows at the marked locations do not respond when clicked on. But there is a way around this problem now. In case you are having this problem please refer to Note above Step 5. 1. Talk with '''Mysterious Man''' (Agent York) {{navi|payon|213|119}}, who explains that O'Riley has been kidnapped. [[File:MysteriousMan2015.png]] 2. Collect 30 {{Item | id=7915 Shred of Evidence}} by killing the snake monsters named below in the [http://blog.gravityus.com/wp-content/uploads/2011/03/viper-territory.jpg V.I.P.E.R territory]: * [[Hugel]]: city and and all hu_fild maps * [[Einbroch]]: city and all ein_fild maps * Einbech: city * [[Juno]]: all yuno_fild maps The snake monsters use the same sprites as the linked monsters. {| class="wikitablec" ! Maximum HP |- | {{Monster | id=1025 Rocky balBOA}} || 15 || 10 |- | {{Monster | id=1030 Sneaky Snake}} || 23 || 15 |- | {{Monster | id=1037 Klepto Anacondaq}} || 43 || 18 |- | {{Monster | id=1029 Plundering Isis}} || 47 || 25 |} '''Note''': The [[Drop System#Level Factor | drop penalty]] applies to these monsters. (needs confirmation) 3. Return to Payon and talk to '''Mysterious Man''', who explains that V.I.P.E.R has set up an imitation Green Ale factory in the map next to Einbroch. 4. Investigate the buildings situated at the following locations on {{Map | id=ein_fild09 Einbroch Field 9}} for signs of O'Riley: {| class="wikitablec" border=0 |- |rowspan=3|[[Image:Map of the VIPER factories.png]] |{{navi|ein_fild09|93|239}} |- |{{navi|ein_fild09|183|57}} |- |{{navi|ein_fild09|266|328}} |} Note: In case, one or no windows show a dialog box. That is a small glitch. To make it work, go back to '''Mysterious Man''' in Payon and restart the quest from there. You would have to give another 30 {{Item | id=7915 Shred of Evidence}} but this time it will work. 5. Walk onto the ship in the southwest of {{Map | id=cmd_fild07 Comodo Field 7}} and talk with O'Riley {{navi|cmd_fild07|73|118}}, who rewards you with a {{Item | id=18565 St. Patrick's Hat [1]}} before fleeing from a Snakepentor that suddenly appears. '''Note''': *The Snakepentors are duplicates of {{Monster | id=1418 Evil Snake Lord}}, which are weaker than the original but '''can still easily kill even high-level characters'''. You don't need to kill a Snakepentor to complete the quest. *If you see someone near or on the ship talking to O'Riley then stay away from the location for a few minutes or lure the Snakepentor out and away and use Flywings to stay alive and enter the ship from another angle away from the monster. 3 Hits of Snakepentor will deal about 8k damage. *If O'Riley is not on the ship, walk along the gangplank and he will reappear. 6. After rescuing O'Riley, Agent York will offer to exchange gold and silver coins dropped by V.I.P.E.R. agents for {{Item | id=12135 Green Ale}}: *3 Green Ale for 1 {{Item | id=7517 Gold Coin}} *1 Green Ale for 1 {{Item | id=7916 Silver Coin}} Note: In case you are not able to exchange some Gold Coins, don't worry as GMs has introduced a convertor that will change those Gold Coins to usable Silver Coins. To do so reach the Mysterious Man a.k.a Agent York, get right next to him, then walk over him. It will trigger a dialog which will convert it for you. Now keep enough space with you in you inventory as Silver Coins offered are heavier than those Gold Coins (each coin is 4 weigh). So keep an eye to exchange only in small amounts. *The chocolates you obtain from the Cooking Class and Cooking Table don't count!
*You can obtain those chocolates by doing Story of the Lonely People quest (see below) and by finishing at least 4 recipes from Cooking Class quest. You will get a cooking book as a reward, which you can use to get the chocolates.

== Cooking Class ==
{{Repeatable|cooldown= 24 hour}}
{{Quest Info

Check Kiel Hyre Academy to meet the famous Chef Orleans! He will teach you his secret recipes to make chocolate desserts (one a day). 
 
1) Talk to NPC Class Receptionist found in different towns (the character must at least Level 20 to do the quest)
* Prontera Town 149 63
* Payon Town 180 96
* Geffen Town 122 104
* Alberta Town 92 57
* Rachel Town 134 144
* Lighthalzen Town 219 205
* Eden Group 1st Floor 38 19

2) The NPC Receptionist will warp you to Kiel Hyre Academy in Yuno. Enter the Academy Portal. If you click the Dessert Class Guide Post it will tell you to go down the stairs.

3) Talk to NPC Diva Lindt. Choose the class you wish to attend. You can only attend each class once and one class per day.
#Handmade Chocolate: 5 Chocolate, 1 Milk OR 5 White Chocolate, 1 Milk
#Strawberry Chocolate: 2 Strawberry, 1 Chocolate, 1 White Chocolate
#Chocolate Tart: 3 Milk, 1 Egg, 1 Flour, 3 Chocolate
#Chocolate Drink: 30 Cacao Beans, 3 Chocolate, 3 Milk 
#Fierce Cacao 99%: 99 Cacao Beans, 1 Milk 
''Important Note'' Chocolate Drink and Fierce99 Cocoa are bugged. You must have at least 1 {{item |id=7182 Cacao}} in your inventory to prevent this bug. The Cacao won't be consumed.

4) Check your Quest Log (alt+u) for the ingredients needed for your class.You can purchase recipe ingredients from NPC Serious Lee, and cooking utensils from NPC Cooking Utensils Merchant. You should bring Milk and Strawberries with you (or buy them from the Vending Merchant class that are over the place)
Serious Lee sells Chocolate, White Chocolate, Egg x5, Flour and Cacao Beans x10
NPC Cooking Utensils sells Outdoor and Home Cooking Kits

5) When you have all the ingredients, talk to NPC Arles Orleans. Choose “Attend Class”. Follow his instructions (actually, you just have to read) and upon completion he will reward you with the hand made chocolate you chose before and its recipe.
*See Cooking Table "quest" for more info

6) After attending all classes you will be rewarded with Febuary Sweets and the ability to make your own sweets even after the event.
 

== Cooking Table (Recipe) ==
Beside the Class area are cooking tables wherein you can cook handmade sweets using the recipe you receive from the cooking class. This allows you to get more sweets, instead of having to wait 24h to assist another class.

* Choose the recipe you want to practice again.
* Make sure you have the needed ingredients.
* Practice what you learned from the cooking Class.
* You receive your own hand made chocolate.

== Chocolat Montblanc's Quests ==

To start the next two quests, talk to Chocolat Montblanc in ''prontera 120 52''

Montblanc will also refine your Cocoa into Cacao Beans (''Needs testing'')

Poor kitty... #Return to '''Jakk''' {{navi|niflheim|172|244}} and show him the bones. He will give you {{Item|id=9101 Portable cage for Scatleton}} and {{Item|id=10040 Red Bell Necklace}}. #*Note: To go back to Nifflheim, talk to the Bathory in Eden Kitchen. {{Item List|id=31125|item=Costume Queen Anz Revenge|simple=yes}} | qreward = | external = http://www.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=308&p=1 | window = Yes }} [[File:2018 TLPD Main.jpg]] The legend of The Gilded Galapagos has resurfaced in Rune Midgard, and you're about to join the fun! Long ago, a notorious pirate crew called The Gilded Galapagos held 5 legendary maps that were rumored to lead to treasures guarded by fearsome monsters of the deep. A few mysterious pirate ships have sailed into Alberta bringing news of these legendary maps and the treasures they hide. Will you rise to the occasion and complete the tasks needed to reach these treasures? Then set sail on this brand new adventure with you and your crew! =The Journey Begins= [[File:2018 TLPD The Journey Begins 1.jpg]] Start your pirate adventure by speaking to '''William Rotator''' {{navi|alberta|189|164}} down by the Alberta docks. He'll enlighten you with the tale of Shoelace Sean and his cursed ship The Soaring Phantom, as well as the legend of the Gilded Galapagos and their treasure maps. With the premise set, you're ready to begin your quest! [[File:2018 TLPD The Journey Begins 2.jpg]] Venture across Rune Midgard and collect pieces of ancient treasure maps that drop from monsters. There are 5 treasure maps in total, each one separated into 4 pieces: *{{Item List|id=25758|item=Drake's Map Piece|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=25756|item=Jellopy Map Piece|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=25753|item=Khalitzburg Map Piece|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=25754|item=Scaled Map Piece|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=25755|item=Undead Servant's Map Piece|simple=yes}} Once you collect all 4 pieces of at least one map, you may return to '''William Rotator''' to set sail on your next adventure! =Set Sail for Treasure Island= {{repeatable}} Location of the treasure chest. The MVP will spawn near these locations. ==Poringpocalypse== Ticket: {{Item List|id=25756|item=Jellopy Map Piece|simple=yes|num=4}}
MVP: King Poring (20 million HP)
Race: Demon
Property: Shadow
Reward: {{Item List|id=25745|item=Piece of Five|num=25|simple=yes}} ==The Dark Horde== Ticket: {{Item List|id=25753|item=Khalitzburg Map Piece|simple=yes|num=4}}
MVP: Dark Lord (40 million HP)
Race: Undead
Property: Undead
Reward: {{Item List|id=25745|item=Piece of Five|num=50|simple=yes}} ==The Bloody Roger== [[File:2018 TLPD The Bloody Roger.jpg]] Ticket: {{Item List|id=25755|item=Undead Servant's Map Piece|simple=yes|num=4}}
MVP: Dracula (60 million HP)
Race: Undead
Property: Undead
Reward: {{Item List|id=25745|item=Piece of Five|num=75|simple=yes}} ==Depth's Detail== [[File:2018 TLPD Depth's Detail.jpg]] Ticket: {{Item List|id=25754|item=Scaled Map Piece|simple=yes|num=4}}
MVP: Detardeurus (80 million HP)
Race: Dragon
Property: Shadow
Reward: {{Item List|id=25745|item=Piece of Five|num=150|simple=yes}} ==Drake's Revengers== [[File:2018 TLPD Drake's Revengers.jpg]] Ticket: {{Item List|id=25758|item=Drake's Map Piece|simple=yes|num=4}}
MVP: Drake(100 million HP)
Race: Undead
Property: Undead
Reward: {{Item List|id=25745|item=Piece of Five|num=200|simple=yes}} =Pieces of Five= [[File:2018 TLPD Pieces of Five.jpg]] Each map leads to different locations that will give you various amounts of Pieces of Five upon defeating their final boss. You can bring your Pieces of Five to '''Jacques Peco''' back aboard the ship in Alberta and exchange them for various goods! {| class="wikitablec" style="font-size:smaller;" | colspan=3| '''Exchange Rate''' |- ! Pieces of Five ! Reward ! Note |- | 50 | {{Item List |id=14545|item=Battle Manual X3 Buff}} | 30mins Buffs |- | 50 | {{Item List |id=12412|item=HE Bubble Gum Buff}} | 15mins Buffs |- | 50 | {{Item List |id=547|item=Condensed White Potion|num=25}} | |- | 300 | {{Item List |id=17351|item=Stanley's Shadow Jewelry Box content}}{{Item List |id=24100|item=Unfreezing Shadow Earring }}{{Item List |id=24101|item=Unfreezing Shadow Pendant}} | Choosen randomly |- | 300 | {{Item List |id=17352|item=Stanley's Shadow Footgear Box content}}{{Item List |id=24082|item=Malicious Shadow Shoes }}{{Item List |id=24111|item=Spellflow Shadow Shoes }} | Choosen randomly |- | 300 | {{Item List |id=17353|item=Stanley's Shadow Shield Box content}}{{Item List |id=17361|item=Shadow Resistance Box content (only shield)}}{{Item List |id=24090|item=Stability Shadow Shield }}{{Item List |id=24083|item=Malicious Shadow Shield }}{{Item List |id=24113|item=Spellflow Shadow Shield }} | Choosen randomly |- | 500 | {{Item List |id=17355|item=Stanley's Shadow Armor Box content}}{{Item List |id=17361|item=Shadow Resistance Box content (only armor)}}{{Item List |id=24081|item=Malicious Shadow Armor}}{{Item List |id=24112|item=Spellflow Shadow Armor}} | Choosen randomly |- | 500 | {{Item List |id=17355|item=Stanley's Shadow Weapon Box content}}{{Item List |id=24099|item=Unfreezing Shadow Weapon }} | Choosen randomly |- | 1,000 | {{Item List |id=2776|item=Adventurer's Trusty Towel|slots=1}} | |} =Shoelace Sean= [[File:2018 TLPD Shoelace Sean.jpg]] '''Shoelace Sean''' is cursed to sail the seas, never to land, for another 3 centuries - though legend has it that the curse will be broken if all 5 treasures are claimed from the Gilded Galapagos' old treasure maps. Could it be true? Defeat all 5 bosses and collect their treasures to find out! Upon clearing all 5 instances, talk to '''Shoelace Sean''' and choose ''Your curse''. You can then claim a {{item|id=31125 Costume Queen Anz Revenge}} from the achievements tab. You also get a {{item|id=667 Green Gift Box}} per quest done. Arrrrr!!!

[[File:Booster_Event_Main.png]]

To start this event, go to [https://www.warpportal.com/ragnarok/boosterevent/2023/ Booster Promotion] and click on Create Character. Login to your Warpportal account and select which game account you want to participate in the event.
*Once you select the game account, choose the server and gender of the character. Once done, a new Human Novice will be created in the game account.
*Character names are randomly assigned and can be changed through the name change function by right-clicking on the character (only once).
*Character hair style and color cannot be selected.
*Character can only be created on servers where the account has a character created already. If you wish to start on a new server, please create a character there first.
*Extended classes are excluded from the instant job change process that this event provides.
*Each game account are limited to one application for Booster Promotion.

[[2021_Royal_Hunt#Rose_Trade|Various cards and equipment]] | external= http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=525 | window =yes }} = Overview = [[File:The_Royal_Hunt_Main.png|center]] The Royal Families of Rune-Midgarts cordially invite you to participate in their annual Royal Hunt! Every year as winter draws near, monsters descend from Mt. Mjolnir to prepare for hibernation. Along the way, they destroy villages and property, endangering everyone around. Thus, the Seven Royal Families have put together the Royal Hunt to call adventurers from across the land to participate in their hunting competition to help quell the monsters' numbers! = Main Quests = #Begin by speaking to the '''Hunt Guide''' at {{Navi|Prontera|162|76}} / {{Navi|geffen|141|57}} / {{Navi|payon|199|116}} / {{Navi|morocc|168|83}} / {{Navi|moc_para01|38|19}}. He'll tell you all about the history of the hunt, and will warp you to their camp grounds when you are ready. Subsequent teleport to the camp grounds will cost 200 zeny. #Speak with '''Commander Nadezhda''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|98|171}} to sign up for the Royal Hunt. They're only recruiting strong, capable adventurers, so he'll put you to the test before you can participate in any of the hunts. Hunt down 30 Insect Type Monsters and return to the Commander once your task is complete. '''Commander Nadezhda''' will give 10 Rose of Choice as a reward. #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerNadezhda.png|frameless|Officer Nadezhda wants to test your abilities]] = Daily Quests = {{Repeatable|reset=04:00AM}} ::Speak to '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|107|180}} to receive a series of monster-hunting quests. Each quest can be completed once per day (the quest cooldown can be removed if the player give her a {{Item |id=6417 Silvervine Fruit}}) and can be completed by hunting monsters in any map. You can have as many active quests going at the same time, and when you complete them, report back to '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung''' to receive rewards! :::[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerJang.png|frameless|Officer Jang can give you daily tasks to hunt monsters]] :::
Quest Reward
30 Insect monsters level 50+ {{Item List|id=23533|item=Rose of Choice|simple=yes|num=10}}
30 Brute monsters level 50+ {{Item List|id=23533|item=Rose of Choice|simple=yes|num=10}}
30 Fish monsters level 50+ {{Item List|id=23533|item=Rose of Choice|simple=yes|num=10}}

::'''Commander Nadezhda''' can teleport the player to the maps with the appropriate monster, if the player have a hunting quest. {{repeatable|cooldown=23 hour}}

===Making a Snow Bouquet===
#Get to Al De Baran just northeast of the Clock Tower on the inner ring and speak to '''Festival Manager''' {{Navi|aldebaran|174|164}} and agree to join the festival.
#Because no snow (apparently) falls in Al De Baran, you need to collect {{Item List|id=25425|item=Magical Snow Flower|num=10|simple=yes}} that are dropped by the event Siroma's found in the world.
#After giving the {{Item List|id=25425|item=Magical Snow Flower|num=10|simple=yes}}, you will receive a random item (see below)
#After completing the quest, the following quests below will be available.

===Staying Strong through the Winter===
#You can then talk to '''Snow flower illusionist'''  who will ask for {{Item List|id=25425|item=Magical Snow Flower|num=10|simple=yes}} and the nearby Snowmen want {{Item List|id=515|item=Carrot|num=1|simple=yes}}.
#Bring the required items to Snow flower illusionist and you will get one of the 4 different stat boosts. You will receive a random item below.

===Not everyone likes it===
#Head to {{Navi|aldebaran|109|166}} and talk to Keeper Eugene near Employee Rigel. They will have a long dialogue about how they hate the festival.
#After the dialogue, talk to Eugene again. He will ask you to bring {{Item List|id=712|item=Flower|num=10|simple=yes}} from the Geffen Flower Merchant. You will be unable to turn them in until the end of the quest.
#Find the Geffen Flower Merchant in {{Navi|geffen|161|81}}. Select "Buy Flowers" to buy {{Item List|id=712|item=Flower|simple=yes}} for 2z each.
#Talk to him again and select "Talk to Merchant." He does not want to see the festival canceled, and suggests to go to a place "where they used for be."
#Head to Lutie by talking to the Santa clause NPC, located either {{Navi|aldebaran|168|167}} or {{Navi|aldebaran|222|222}}. Select "Move to Lutie" to be teleported in a field. Head north and you will be in Lutie.
#Go to {{Navi|lutie|202|223}} to come across a sign. Click on it and wait for the event to finish (you should pick up a Snow Boy).
#Head north to go inside the Toy Factory Dungeon first floor {{Navi|xmas_dun01|127|153}} and click on the sign. An event should happen and you should be able to pick up an Empty Box.
#Head back to Keeper Eugune in Aldebaran and talk to them. They will interact with the Snow Boy and Empty Box.
#Talk to Employee Rigel and he'll have a change of heart after seeing his sister. You will receive {{Item List|id=31588|item=Costume Snow Flower|simple=yes}}.
#After completing the quest, a repeatable quest will open. Talk to Eugene and he will ask you to bring {{Item List|id=523|item=Holy Waters|num=5|simple=yes}} (Ask an Acolyte to do this for you with an Empty Bottle)
#After turning in the {{Item List|id=523|item=Holy Waters|num=5|simple=yes}}, you will receive a random item (see below). You can do the quest again in 24 hours.

===Staying Warm with Cotton===
#Talk to '''Coti''' just left of the north exit of town {{Navi|aldebaran|124|238}} and agree to bring {{Item List|id=23426|item=Warm Cotton|num=10|simple=yes}}.
#:You have a chance to get Warm Cotton automatically in your inventory by hunting any of these 5 monsters:
#:*{{monster|id=1243 Sasquatch}}
#:*{{monster|id=1242 Marin}}
#:*{{monster|id=1063 Lunatic}}
#:*{{monster|id=1254 Raggler}}
#:*{{monster|id=1076 Skeleton}}
#Once you return with 10, they will reward you with a random item. You will have to wait until [maybe 23 hours] pass to bring them more.
''Note:'' If you wish to hunt multiple Warm Cottons to save, you will have to have the quest active in order to do so.

===Holiday Word Play===
#'''Twinkle''' is at the north east of Al De Baran (near Mr. Claus that takes you to Lutie) {{Navi|aldebaran|217|212}} and wants you to collect Blue [Letter] Cards that spell out words.
#Bring Twinkle the cards for the word he's chosen for you on five different occasions and you will receive a random item below.
#:The cards are obtained by opening Snow Flower Card Envelope. The cards are also 1 weight and ''character bound.'' The envelopes are tradable, however. The possible cards are the following letters:
#::A, E, F, I, L, N, O, R, S, T, V, W, D, B, K
#:Possible words include:
#*FLOWER
#*SNOW
#*FESTIVAL
#*ALDEBARAN
#*SPARKLE



*If you want to ''remove'' your cards, talk to '''Festival Claviger''' {{Navi|aldebaran|169|173}} and they will remove all of them.

===List of Possible Rewards===
*1 Kachua Secret Key
*{{Item List|id=31588|item=Costume Snow Flower|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=31390|item=Costume Let It Snow|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=23548|item=Ice Candy|num=10|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=616|item=Old Card Album|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=607|item=Yggdrasilberry|num=3|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=608|item=Yggdrasil Seed|num=3|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=23549|item=Snow Cookie|num=5|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=23550|item=Winter Cookie|num=5|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=23551|item=Pestie Cookie|num=5|simple=yes}}
*{{Item List|id=23552|item=Flora Cookie|num=5|simple=yes}}

[[2022_Royal_Hunt#Rose_Trade|Various cards and equipment]] | external= | window =yes }} [[File:The_Royal_Hunt_Main.png|center]] = Overview = The Royal Families of Rune-Midgarts cordially invite you to participate in their annual Royal Hunt! Every year as winter draws near, monsters descend from Mt. Mjolnir to prepare for hibernation. Along the way, they destroy villages and property, endangering everyone around. Thus, the Seven Royal Families have put together the Royal Hunt to call adventurers from across the land to participate in their hunting competition to help quell the monsters' numbers! = Main Quests = #Begin by speaking to the '''Hunt Guide''' at {{Navi|Prontera|162|76}} / {{Navi|geffen|141|57}} / {{Navi|payon|199|116}} / {{Navi|morocc|168|83}} / {{Navi|moc_para01|38|19}}. He'll tell you all about the history of the hunt, and will warp you to their camp grounds when you are ready. Subsequent teleport to the camp grounds will cost 200 zeny. #Speak with '''Commander Nadezhda''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|98|171}} to sign up for the Royal Hunt. They're only recruiting strong, capable adventurers, so he'll put you to the test before you can participate in any of the hunts. The first test is hunt 30 Animal Type Monster of any level. #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerNadezhda.png|frameless|Officer Nadezhda wants to test your abilities]] #Once you complete the hunt, return to '''Commander Nadezhda''' and will tell you for the second test you need to talk whit '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' . Will give you 10 Rose of Choice as a reward. #Speak with '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|97|180}}, he will tell you the second test consist in hunt 30 Animal Type Monster and 30 Insect Type Monster over level 50. #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerLaFinch.png|frameless|Officer La Finch]] #Once you complete the Animal and Insect hunt, return to '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' and will tell you for the last test you need to talk whit '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung''' . Will give you 10 Rose of Choice as a reward. #Speak with '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|107|180}}, he will tell you the last test consist in hunt 30 Fish Type Monster and 30 Dragon Type Monster over level 50. #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerJang.png|frameless|Officer La Finch]] #Once you complete the Fish and Dragon hunt, return to '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung''' will give you 10 Rose of Choice and Costume Pierced Apple as a reward. #Speak with '''Commander Nadezhda''' to unlock the Teleportation Device. = Daily Quests = {{Repeatable|reset=04:00AM}} Speak to '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|97|180}} to receive a series of monster-hunting quests. Each quest can be completed once per day and can be completed by hunting monsters in any map. You can have as many active quests going at the same time, and when you complete them, report back to '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' to receive rewards!

To get there during the event, the player can interact with any Noodle Festa Promotion NPC at: [[File:Noodlefestapromotion.png|center]] # [[Eden Group]], first floor, just east of the entrance at {{navi|moc_para01|40|20}}; # Center of [[Prontera]], southeast of the central square at {{navi|prontera|164|173}}; :[[File:Festapromotionprontera.png]] # South [[Geffen]], near fountain at {{navi|geffen|129|57}}; :[[File:Festapromotiongeffen.png]] # South [[Payon]], just east of Kafra at {{navi|payon|193|108}}; or :[[File:Festapromotionpayon.png]] # South [[Morocc]], southeast of bottom Kafra at {{navi|morocc|168|87}}. :[[File:Festapromotionmorocc.png]] * By always selecting the first option, the player will be warped to [[Malangdo]] for free at first. ** Latter on, the player can be teleported back to [[Malangdo]] for Noodle Festa Promotion at the cost of 1 {{item |id=25367 Promotional Fan}}, obtained through festival daily quests. ::[[File:Eventguide.png]] * North of where the player has been warped to, in [[Malangdo]], there is the Event Guide NPC, at {{navi|malangdo|214|95}}. Talking to him and selecting always the first option will start a navigation to Event Registration NPC, at {{navi|malangdo|140|165}} (not mandatory, the player may just move to Event Registration); ::[[File:Eventregistration.png]] * Talk to Event Registration NPC and select the first option, "Register". A text box will open so the player can insert the character name, but no matter what you type the quest will proceed and it won't influence in the progress, after which the player will be rewarded 1 {{item |id=25367 Promotional Fan}} and will receive the quest The Gatekeeper of Nyail Cave; ::[[File:Festamanager.png]] * A navigation will start leading shortly west to Festa Manager NPC, to which it's required to talk to, at {{navi|malangdo|133|170}}, who, by selecting always the first option, will send the player to Nyail Cave, the festival dungeon, and change The Gatekeeper of Nyail Cave quest to The Beginning of the Festival quest; * The player must kill or steal the following monsters: # Small Whirlpool, until obtaining 1 {{item |id=25365 Spaghetti}}; # Dandy Star, until obtaining 1 {{item |id=25664 Ribbon Noodle}}; # Nyailo, until obtaining 1 {{item |id=23362 Meatball}}; ** Spaghetti and Ribbon Noodle cannot be stored, traded, mailed or dropped, only sold for 0z. * The player must then move northwest of Nyail Cave at {{navi|lasa_sea|20|143}} to return to [[Malangdo]], and once again interact to Festa Manager NPC at {{navi|malangdo|133|170}} to conclude the quest; * Festa Manager will reward the player with 5 {{item |id=25367 Promotional Fan}}, 10 {{item |id=25366 Noodle Festival Coin}}, access to daily quests and access to Nyail Cave. ** The Beginning of the Festival quest will be deleted and the four daily quests will be added to quest window: Noodle Artisan, Watermelon Dessert, Sea Worm Hunt and Cool Ice Cream. ** For in-game navigation to daily events, the player may either open quest window (alt+U) and click the blue link at quest description, or talk to Event Registration NPC at {{navi|malangdo|140|165}}, select Event Guide, select desired daily quest and click the blue link displayed in NPC dialog, both of which options will start a navigation to the related NPC. * To reaccess Nyail Cave during event, the player has to talk to Festa Manager NPC at {{navi|malangdo|133|170}} and select the first dialog option. *{{item |id=25366 Noodle Festival Coin}} and the non-consumable quest items of this Festival cannot be stored, traded, mailed or dropped, but can be sold for 0z; *'''Note''': Although a few Small Whirlpool and Dandy Star can be found in many maps, it is recommended to farm all items inside Nyail Cave because the amount of quest monsters there is much higher; leaving it though the map portal will take the player back to Malangdo, where the player may proceed with quests; and all other quest monsters related to this event can also be found in this dungeon; *'''Note''': All referred quest monsters receive 1 damage per hit, deal low damage, can be stolen and don't reward any experience on kill. They are also affected by poison and bleeding, which may make killing them faster, but burning is not recommended as this status may prevent the monster to drop its loots. All quest monsters have 10 HP and dont cast any skill, except for Nyailo, who has 1000 HP and casts [[Decrease AGI]], [[NPC WIDECURSE]], [[Silence]] and [[Grampus Morph]] a.k.a. Reverse Orcish; *'''Note''': Teleporting is allowed in Nyail Cave; *'''Note''': There are [[Undersea Tunnel]] monsters in Nyail Cave, including agressive ones with [[Water Ball]] skill, which may make it challenging for low level characters, to whom it is recommended to keep teleporting to safe spots to kill quest monsters and be aware of spawning agressive monsters nearby. To reaccess Nyail Cave during event, the player has to talk to Festa Manager NPC at {{navi|malangdo|133|170}} and select the first dialog option. *{{Item_List_2 |id=25366|item=Noodle Festival Coin|simple=yes}} and the non-consumable quest items of this Festival cannot be stored, traded, mailed or dropped, but can be sold for 0z; *'''Note''': Although a few quest monsters can be found in many maps, it is recommended to farm all items inside Nyail Cave because the amount of quest monsters there is much higher; leaving Nyail Cave through the map portal northwest at {{navi|lasa_sea|20|143}} will take the player back to Malangdo, where the player may proceed with quests, making it easier than farming elsewhere and coming back; and all other quest monsters related to this event can also be found in this dungeon; *'''Note''': All referred quest monsters receive 1 damage per hit, deal low damage, can be stolen and don't reward any experience on kill. They are also affected by poison, burning and bleeding, which may make killing them faster, but burning is not recommended as this status may prevent the monster to drop its loots. It is also not recommended to let quest monsters be killed by homunculus, mercenaries or summons, as this my prevent the character from receiving quest items. All quest monsters have 10 HP and dont cast any skill, except for Nyailo, who has 1000 HP; *'''Note''': Teleporting is allowed in Nyail Cave; *'''Note''': There are [[Undersea Tunnel]] monsters in Nyail Cave, including agressive ones with [[Water Ball]] skill, which may make it challenging for low level characters, to whom it is recommended to keep teleporting to safe spots to kill quest monsters and be aware of spawning agressive monsters nearby. Among those monsters there is Kukre, a looter monster that may fastly get dropped items and make them disappear completely if previously the monster aquired a few other items. The new Wandering Duck event monster is also a looter who deserves attention for the same reason. :* 15 {{Item |id=1019 Trunk}}

3. Talk to him with the items in your inventory to receive a {{item |id=5305 Pirate Dagger}} (lower headgear giving +15% [[exp]]).

::'''NOTE: players must be above base level 60 to continue past this point'''

4. After receiving a dagger, Talk to him again to hear of his woe's with the Kraken and Turtle Island.  He mentions that he entered a strange swamp from the map with the throne room.

5. Immediately south of the throne room on the {{map |id= tur_dun04 Turtle Palace}} map, Players will be taken to the swamp where Capitan Wesley had stored his treasure. (south west ({{map |id= tur_dun04 tur_dun04}} 71, 50) for 80+ and south east (tur_dun04 132, 62) for 60+)

6. At various points around the swamp, players will find pieces of a map, pieces of a key, pieces of a shovel, and finally the Pirates Treasure box. The points must be done in order as follows

7. After obtaining his treasure box, return to Capitan Wesley in [[Hugel]].  He will insist that the player keep the treasure box, however since the key for it is broken he needs a few materials to make a new one

:* 10 {{Item |id=999 Steel}}
:* 2 {{Item |id=985 Elunium}}
:* 2 {{Item |id=984 Oridecon}}
:* 2 {{Item |id=746 Glass Bead}}
:* 10 {{Item |id=7317 Rusty Screw}}
:* 100,000 [[zeny]]

8. After bringing the materials, the player will participate in a "battle" with the lock on the treasure box similar to the battle with Sudri in the [[God Items Quest#Seal of Mjolnir|Seal of Mjolnir Quest]], with the important exception that it is rather difficult to lose.

:* Note: if the pick is close to breaking, the player should select the option "Dry Hands" to restore 15 durability to the pick. Dry Hands then Apply Pressure to the Lock repeatedly works well, although it may begin to fail or become too random near the end.

9. After successfully bringing the lock's durability to zero, the box will open and players will receive a {{item |id=5804 Pirates Eye Bandage}} (middle headgear giving +15% exp).

title: ATK
wikitext:
== Overview == [[File:ATK Calculation.png|thumb]] ATK is the total physical damage output before factoring in [[Attacks]] or [[Skill|Skills]]. It is broken into five parts: [[ATK#StatusATK|StatusATK]], [[ATK#WeaponATK|WeaponATK]], [[ATK#ExtraATK|ExtraATK]], [[ATK#MasteryATK|MasteryATK]], and [[ATK#BuffATK|BuffATK]].
'''Calculation Note''': Decimals do not actually exist in the game, so every calculation is immediately rounded down (floored). For readability, floor() is not written in the formulas. To see an example, check the [[ATK#Flooring_Example|Flooring Example]] == StatusATK == This is derived from the player's [[Levels#Base Level|Base Level]], [[Stats#STR|Str]], [[Stats#DEX|Dex]], and [[Stats#LUK|Luk]]. This is always considered as Neutral property unless the player uses [[Mild Wind]]. === Formula === 
StatusATK = (BaseLevel ÷ 4) + Str + (Dex ÷ 5) + (Luk ÷ 3)
''When using a [[Bow]], [[Gun]], [[Instrument]] or [[Whip]].'' 
StatusATK = (BaseLevel ÷ 4) + (Str ÷ 5) + Dex + (Luk ÷ 3)
== WeaponATK == This is derived from a player's equiped [[Weapons|Weapon]] and [[Stats#STR|Str]] or [[Stats#DEX|Dex]] depending on your weapon type. Variance, StatBonus, and OverUpgradeBonus is not shown in the Status Window. === Formula === 
WeaponATK = (BaseWeaponDamage + Variance + StatBonus + RefinementBonus + OverUpgradeBonus) × SizePenalty
*''Variance'' :
Variance = ± 0.05 × WeaponLevel × BaseWeaponDamage
:Example: A level 4 weapon have a 0.05 * 4 = 20% variance. This means a level 4 weapon can do 20% less or 20% more than its base damage value. For a weapon with 100 base damage, this translate to 20% * 100 = 20 damage variance. So for each hit, the player will actually deal a random damage between 80 and 120. [[Power Maximize]] will set the damage variance to the highest, so each hit will deal 120 damage. *''StatBonus'' :
StatBonus = BaseWeaponDamage × Str ÷ 200
:This bonus is {{Tooltip|pseudo-elemental|Even if elemental, Ghost property treats damage as Neutral}} *''StatBonus when using a [[Bow]], [[Gun]], [[Instrument]] or [[Whip]].'' :
StatBonus = BaseWeaponDamage × Dex ÷ 200
:This bonus is {{Tooltip|pseudo-elemental|Even if elemental, Ghost property treats damage as Neutral}} *''RefinementBonus and OverUpgradeBonus'' :* See [[Refinement_System#Weapons|Refinement Effects]]. *''SizePenalty'' :* See [[Size|Size Table]]. == ExtraATK == This refers to sum of EquipATK, ConsumableATK, AmmunitionATK, and PseudoBuffATK. While [[Cannon Ball|Cannon Balls]] are considered [[Ammunition]], they are not added to AmmunitionATK. === Formula === 
ExtraATK = (EquipATK + ConsumableATK + AmmunitionATK + PseudoBuffATK)
== P.ATK == P.ATK is a final multiplier that applies to all the ATK calculation above. == MasteryATK == This is a special kind of ATK that has no elemental properties. This ATK mostly comes from [[:Category:Passive Skills|Passive Skills]] such as [[Beast Bane]], [[Katar Mastery]], [[Madogear License]], [[Gatling Fever]], and [[Weaponry Research]]; also, any weapons [[Forging|Forged]] with {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}} will also provide additional MasteryATK. == BuffATK == This is a special kind of ATK that has no elemental properties. This ATK mostly comes from [[:Category:Skills|Skills]] such as [[Camouflage]]. Note that even though some buffs like [[Impositio Manus]], [[Odin's Power]], and [[Shield Spell]] are buffs, they strangely behave as [[ATK#ExtraATK|ExtraATK]] instead. ==Multipliers== These refer to increasing/decreasing specific terms by a percentage. Additional ATK gained is not shown in the Status Window. === Group A === This multiplier has no elemental properties. This multiplier is applicable only to [[ATK#WeaponATK|WeaponATK]] and [[ATK#ExtraATK|ExtraATK]]. '''Formula Usage''': 
(WeaponATK + ExtraATK) × ATKMultiplier
*Only ATKMultiplier fits this tier. It is written as ATK% in item descriptions and in some items after EP 15.2. **This wiki will refer to it as ATK% for item descriptions. *This multiplier '''does not''' stack with multipliers in Group B. **Check [[ATK#Example_Calculations|Example Calculations]] for an example. === Group B === These multipliers are applicable only to [[ATK#WeaponATK|WeaponATK]] and [[ATK#ExtraATK|ExtraATK]]. '''Formula Usage''': 
(WeaponATK + ExtraATK) × (1 + RaceMultiplier) × (1 + SizeMultiplier) × (1 + TargetPropertyMultiplier) × (EDPMultiplier) × (1 + ClassMultiplier) × (1 + MonsterMultiplier)
*SizeReduction, RaceReduction, ClassReduction, PropertyReduction are applied in this particular order. *'''Note''': Sadly iRO's item descriptions that say ATK% do not clarify if it's ATKMultiplier or ClassMultiplier. However, they are properly labeled in jRO, twRO, bRO, thRO and kRO. == Finalizing == This refers to putting the final touches to the ATK calculation to produce a value ready for [[Attacks]] or [[Skill|Skills]].
=== Formula === 
ATK = {(StatusATK × 2) + [(GroupA) + (GroupB)] × (ElementalAdvantage) × (Elemental_Resist_Reduction_Bonus*)} × (1 + P.ATK ÷ 100) + MasteryATK + BuffATK
''Mild Wind'' 
ATK = {(StatusATK × ElementalAdvantage × 2) + [(GroupA) + (GroupB)] × (ElementalAdvantage) × (Elemental_Resist_Reduction_Bonus*)} × (1 + P.ATK ÷ 100) + MasteryATK + BuffATK
* *[[Venom_Impression|Venom Impression]], [[Comet]], etc == Notes == * EquipATK, See {{item|id=4043 Andre Card}} or {{item|id=9017 Orc Warrior Egg}}. * ConsumableATK, See {{item|id=12646 Poring Pretzel}}. * AmmunitionATK, See [[Ammunition]]. * PseudoBuffATK, See [[Striking]] or [[Occult Impaction]] effect items like {{item|id=13017 Ice Pick}} and {{item|id=4399 Memory of Thanatos Card}}. * ATKMultiplier, See [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/29061 Mettle Enchant] or [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/31017 Vicious Cookie Card] * RaceMultiplier, See {{item|id=4035 Hydra Card}}. * SizeMultiplier, See {{item|id=4092 Skeleton Worker Card}}. * TargetPropertyMultiplier, See {{item|id=4049 Vadon Card}}. * MonsterMultiplier, See {{item|id=4291 Kobold Leader Card}}. * ClassMultiplier, See {{item|id=2644 The Sign}} or {{item|id=4140 Abysmal Knight Card}}. * PropertyMultiplier, See [[Element|Property]]. * RaceReduction, See {{item|id=4058 Thara Frog Card}}. * SizeReduction, See {{item|id=4254 Ogretooth Card}}. * PropertyReduction, See {{item|id=4133 Raydric Card}}. * TargetPropertyReduction, See {{item|id=4442 Tatacho Card}}. * CometAmpMultiplier, See [[Comet]].
The next step in damage calculation method is to calculate the ATK value with various Damage multipliers like skill, critical, enemy defense, etc. To see how [[ATK]] interacts with those, check out the [[Attacks]] page. === Calculating nonClass ATK% === Thank you @Mayo for giving Step by Step guide. Step 1 Calculate your Actual Damage Exactly a. Recommended unequipping your weapon (so no damage variance) and most equips (makes calculation easier). Make sure you have some Equip Attack from somewhere (Crown Cinnamoroll Backpack is good for this). b. Attack dummy. Make sure the damage you see is exactly as calculated (taking into account that dummies in Prontera have a soft def of 50) Step 2 Equip anything with Size Multiplier (Other Multipliers are fine, as long as its not classATK%) a. Recommended Tyrant of Earth/Old Camoflage Scarf/Anything with just size %. Calculate damage with the multiplier and make sure dummy shows the same damage as calculations. Step 3 Equip the item you're trying to figure out a. Calculate new damage based on the equipped item's stats, using Class Attack %. Attack Dummy and check if dummy shows the same number as damage calculations. If yes, good, item is Class Attack %. If damage is higher, something has gone wrong, recalculate damage based on item stats. If damage is lower, item is likely ATK% b. Double check. Recalculate damage using ATK%. Check if numbers match damage to Dummy. If yes, bad luck, item is ATK%, if not, calculation was wrong, Do it again. Alternative: Do the same thing but in [https://newcalc.irowiki.org/ newcalc], and let newcalc handle all the calculations for you. Then cross reference by smacking dummy. == Example Calculations == === Flooring Example === 
[(BaseLevel ÷ 4) + Str + (Dex ÷ 5)]
is actually calculated as 
floor[floor(floor(BaseLevel ÷ 4) + Str) + floor(Dex ÷ 5)]
=== Multipliers Example === Setup: * No weapon equipped * {{Item List|id=15376|item=Illusion Armor Type A|slots=1|simple=y}} *: ExtraATK +100 * https://static.divine-pride.net/images/items/item/20963.png [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/20963 +8 Temporal Str Manteau [1]] *: ExtraATK +40 *: ATKMultiplier +(4+7)% *: SizeMultiplier +10% * {{Item List|id=2963|item=Physical Enhancer Ring|slots=1|simple=y}} x2 *: ClassMultiplier +(5*2)% * [[Holy]] element skill vs [[Undead]] 4 *: PropertyMultiplier +100% *'''Note''': For the sake of simplicity, floor() is not included in this example. = [(WeaponATK + ExtraATK) x ATKMultiplier] + [(WeaponATK + ExtraATK) x (1 + SizeMultiplier) x (1 + ClassMultiplier) x (1 + PropertyMultiplier)]
= [(0 + 100 + 40) x 11%] + [(0 + 100 + 40) x (1 + 10%) x (1 + 10%) + (1 + 100%)]
= [140 x 11%] + [140 x 110% x 110% x 200%]
= [15.4] + [338.8]
= 354.2 ≈ 354 === Multipliers Example 2 === This is a very simplified example to show how multipliers work. Note that Earth Drive Damage +% is a (better) Damage Multiplier and not an ATK Multiplier.
Setup: * {{Item List|simple=y|id=1449|item=+10 Gelerdria [3]}} * https://static.divine-pride.net/images/items/item/28922.png +12 [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/28922 Illusion Sacred Mission [1]] - [[Earth Drive]] Damage +84% * https://db.irowiki.org/image/item/24060.png +10 [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/24302 Royal Guard Shield Shadow] - [[Earth Drive]] Damage +70%
If 1 weapon card is added to the setup, which is stronger: {{Item List|simple=y|id=4690|item=True Randel Lawrence Card}} (Earth Drive Damage +60%) or https://db.irowiki.org/image/item/4001.png [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/27361/ Polluted Wander Man Card] (Size Damage +30%) ?
With True Randel Lawrence Card: (1 + 84% + 70% + 60%) = 314%
With Polluted Wander Man Card: (1 + 84% + 70%) x (1 + 30%) ≈ 330%
Therefore, adding 1 Polluted Wander Man Card would result in higher damage. == History == * {{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=ATK&oldid=70966 This page}} has the previous formula before Size Penalty applied to [[ATK#ExtraATK|ExtraATK]]. * {{Plainlink |url=https://irowiki.org/w/index.php?title=ATK&oldid=66761 This page}} has the previous formula before [[ATK#Tier_1|ATKMultiplier]] was discovered. {{clear}} {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category: Mechanics]]

title: Acolyte
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobName=Acolyte |jobBase=Novice |jobType=First (Primary) | jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Prontera]] Church |skills=14 |skillPoints=90 |questSkills=1 |str=3|agi=2|vit=3|int=3|dex=3|luk=4}} [[Image: AcolyteATK.jpeg‎|thumb]] Living their life serving the Church, Acolytes are thoughtful protectors and healers of all that is good in the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]]. Though they are still new to holy magic, their [[Heal]] and buffing skills ensure the party can keep fighting and their [[Holy Light]] keep [[Undead]] monsters at bay. Growing up in the Capital City, [[Prontera]], and seeing the plights that plague their fellow man, they have learned how to use their skills to protect fellow adventurers from evil and that, sometimes, they must use force when diplomacy fails. Acolytes are not able to equip any bladed weapons to fight but their dedication to all that is good allows them to fully support themselves and others with holy powers bestowed from the Gods. Acolytes are more evenly rounded in stat bonuses but will either focus on [[INT]] for [[MATK]] & [[SP]] or [[STR]] for [[ATK]], depending on the path they chose to go down for the Church. ==Job Changing== Once you are a Job Level 10 [[Novice]], you have 2 methods of changing into an Acolyte: #Go to the Church in northeast [[Prontera]] {{navi|prontera|234|314}}. After entering the Church, enter the first portal room on the right. Talk to the ''Cleric'' located at the end of the hall in the north part of the room at {{navi|prt_church|184|41}} and he will change your job to Acolyte, rewarding you with a {{Item List |id=1545 |item=Novice Mace|slots=3 |simple=yes}}. #*Pursuing this method also unlocks the [[Holy Light]] Skill for free right as you change. #Alternatively, go to the Acolyte Classroom on the 2nd Floor of [[Training Grounds|Criatura Academy]] and speak to the NPC, ''Acolyte Leader Alice'', located at {{navi|iz_ac02|156|169}}. She will warn you that you will not receive the bonus Job Skills listed above if you use this method and thus it is not recommended. ==Builds== === I. Heal & Holy Light / Support Acolyte === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build focuses on an [[INT]]/[[MATK]]-focused stat layout. You will either need to play Support with a party, aiding them in battle through [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], and [[Increase Agi]] as they kills monsters... or you can play Solo by killing primarily [[Undead]] monsters by [[Heal]] "bombing" them (using Shift+Left-Click or typing /noshift) and/or using [[Holy Light]] (this will work on non-[[Undead]] monsters, offering more flexibility). This build should be used if preparing to become a [[Priest]] as your 2nd Job. *'''Alternative gameplay:''' Due to lack of parties and focus on solo-play, using the [[Mercenary System]] to do the killing for you is also a viable option for leveling to your 2nd Job. You can purchase {{Item List |id=12806 |item=Scaraba Scroll |simple=yes}} contracts from players or get a free Mercenary from ''Clearchus'' in Eden Group HQ {{navi|moc_para01|53|30}} if under the [[VIP]] Buff.
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on your preference but the idea is to focus on increasing [[INT]] and [[DEX]] status as they increase your [[MATK]] and reduce [[Variable Cast Time]]. Investing in [[VIT]] early can also help with survivability. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 1
*AGI: 1
*VIT: 20
*INT: 50
*DEX: 24
*LUK: 1

=== II. Auto-Attack / Battle Acolyte === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build focuses on an [[STR]]/[[ATK]]-focused stat layout. The goal is to quickly whack monsters using [[Mace]]-type weapons, one-by-one, after buffing yourself. This build is best if you are a low budget player looking to kill monsters on your own while using your support skills (i.e., [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], and [[Increase Agi]]) to keep yourself alive and buffed, especially since you can always [[Stat Reset]] yourself when ready to choose your 2nd Job if you wish to go more magic-focused. However, this is the build you will want to use in preparation of becoming a [[Monk]]. *'''Alternative gameplay:''' Due to lack of AOE skills for this class, it it recommended to get any slotted [[Accessory]] carded with a {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card|simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] on mobs of monsters to level. However, this will not be an option for a brand new player obviously.
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on your preference but the idea is to focus on maintaining high [[STR]] for [[ATK]] and [[AGI]] for high [[ASPD]], while maintaining some [[INT]] for a decent SP pool to support yourself and [[DEX]] to be able to hit monsters. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 30
*AGI: 40
*VIT: 1
*INT: 16
*DEX: 20
*LUK: 1
== Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three suggestions to efficiently level a new character: #Get gear and experience for your new character by following this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] from the forums (this guide is also listed down below in the [[Acolyte#Equipment| Acolyte equipment]] section with additional details). #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. Use any AoE skill available for your class (e.g., [[Magnum Break]], [[Fire Ball]], [[Cart Revolution]], etc.). You may use {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card |simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] if your class does not have an AoE skill. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Willows''' until level 21 and '''Bigfoot''' until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]], kill '''Orcs''', '''Orc Ladies''', and '''Orc Babies''' until level 55 and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Orcs''' and '''Old Ladies''' until level 60. '''You can stack the quests for Orc and Orc Lady kill counts by having both quests active!''' === Affordable HP Recovery === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for AOE leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. Two popular and cheap healing items are Nepeta Cataria and Fresh Fish due to their cheap cost and low weight: *{{Item List |id=11602 |item=Nepeta Cataria |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cat Paw Shrimp Merchant''' in [[Izlude]] {{navi|izlude|117|165}} or [[Prontera]] {{navi|prontera|137|223}} (or in [[Lasagna]] {{navi|lasagna|166|117}} if starting as a [[Doram]]) for only 15z each (11z with max [[Discount]]). *{{Item List |id=579 |item=Fresh Fish |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cooking Merchant''' {{navi|payon|167|134}} in [[Payon]] or '''Chef's Assistant''' {{navi|alberta|167|134}} at the docks of [[Alberta]], as well as other cities, for only 250z each (190z with max [[Discount]]). For a list of Healing Items, a comparison, and a list of a couple popular Healing Items, please see the main article: [[Healing Items]]. === STATS DESCRIPTION === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.
*DEX - decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), increases [[Stats | HIT]], [[MATK]], [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons, and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "melee-type" weapons. *LUK - increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]], [[Stats | CRIT]], [[Stats | HIT]], [[Flee]], [[Perfect Dodge]], [[Forging]], [[Potion Creation]], [[Cooking]], and provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Curse]], [[Frozen]], [[Poison]], [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], [[Stone Curse]], and [[Stun]]. Enchanter Mounds Quest === After creating a [[Novice]] character, follow the section of this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] titled "Enchanter Mounds Quest" which involves [[NPC]] Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}}. This quest will allow you to enchant the {{Item List |id=2302 |item=Cotton Shirt |simple=yes}} that you get the moment you created your [[Novice]] character with the enchantments Max HP+100 and Max SP+50, provided that you complete the step that requires you to speak with [[NPC]] Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}}. This cotton shirt proves itself useful once you change your class and can no longer equip most of the novice gear provided to you when you register at the academy. It is recommended to card this cotton shirt with cards that increase [[HP]] and/or [[SP]] such as {{Item List |id=31016 |item=Decorated Evil Tree Card |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=4003 |item=Pupa Card |simple=yes}}. After providing Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}} with a review of the service they provided during the enchanting quest, you can talk to Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}} to enchant the novice weapon you receive after you change your class from [[Novice]] to [[Acolyte]]. The two enchantments provided are random and if you aren’t happy with the result you can enchant it again endlessly. You will likely use this enchanted weapon until you can do the level 26 [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] which is the first part of that questline which rewards a weapon. Keep in mind Enchanter Almond J won’t enchant the Novice Main Gauche that you get for registering at the academy despite it being a novice weapon. === II. Eden Group Equipments Quests === Starting at level 12 you can complete the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] to obtain free equipment for your class. This equipment is sufficient to get you to level 99. === III. General Weapon Recommendations === Acolytes can use [[Rods]].
