title: Dancer
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job|jobName=Dancer|jobBase=Archer|jobType=2-2|jobLevel = 50||Race=[[Human]]|changesAt=[[Comodo]]|skills=18|skillPoints=91|questSkills=1 |str=2|agi=7|vit=3|int=5|dex=5|luk=8}} [[file:Dancer.jpg|240px|right]] Rhythm and balance are qualities cultivated by all [[Archer]]s, however, only the truly talented are allowed to learn the secret steps of the Dancers. These scantily clad seductresses gain the power to influence the minds of allies and enemies alike. It is said that time [[Slow_Grace|slows down]] when a Dancer starts to move her hips to the sound of some mysterious tune; that those watching may [[Charming_Wink|lose control]] of their bodies and find their magic reserves either [[Gypsy's_Kiss|greatly improved]] or [[Hip_Shaker|gone altogether]]. Where their male counterparts, the [[Bard]]s, are more bent on support, Dancers specialize at disruptive maneuvers which make them an invaluable asset in the War of Emperium or in parties against powerful monsters. Supporting with a Bard or Dancer requires a different approach than other classes. Music-based buffs are mostly percental values, as opposed to the absolute values of [[Priest]] buffs, and require careful strategy and positioning. Despite their supportive role, one should not forget that Dancers are also capable of dealing good quantities of damage. One of their main advantages over [[Hunter]]s is their immense [[SP]] pool which allows them to continually use offensive skills instead of normal attacks, ensuring a consistent damage output. In general, there are two types of support skills for both Bards and [[Dancer]]s; Solo [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Category:Performance_Skills Performance Skills] (which can be performed without a partner of the opposite gender) and paired [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Ensemble_Skill Ensemble Skills] (where the player needs the other class to perform together). == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Dancer Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into a Dancer from an [[Archer]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks in [[Comodo]]: * Item Collection * Written Test * Dance Test After completing these tests, return to ''Bijou'', who gave the quiz portion of the test, to be changed into a Dancer. She will reward you with either a {{Item List |id=1953 |item=Line |slots=3|simple=yes}}, if you are Job Level 50, or a {{Item List |id=1950 |item=Rope |slots=3 |simple=yes}} for any [[Job Level]] lower than 50. === Job Change Quest Skip === Note that you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip] == Builds == === I. Arrow Shower === Base Level 99 base stat distribution suggestion: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 90 * INT: 50 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 Although Bards gain access to new [[Whip]] and Dance skills, the [[Archer]] skill [[Arrow Shower]] is still the most reliable AOE and only becomes more powerful with better gear and stats. With a proper set up and the right Elemental Arrows or Elemental Converters, this build can level very effectively and quickly to Base Level 99 by continuing the same strategy as before. [[DEX]] is still your main damage and [[HIT]] stat, while [[VIT]] keeps you alive when mobbing larger groups of monsters and [[INT]] is recommended for [[SP]] regen and pool size. === II. Slinging Arrow & Gypsy's Kiss === Base Level 99 base stat distribution suggestion: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 90 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This build focuses on using [[Gypsy's Kiss]], still a defining skill of the Dancer Class, to mitigate some of the [[SP]] costs of [[Slinging Arrow]] and increase your [[SP]] pool even higher to fire continuous arrows from your instrument at one monster at a time. While this is a slower method of leveling than [[Arrow Shower]], it does allow the Dancer to wear a [[Shield]] for more damage reduction as well as focus on more [[SP]] for more skill usage. Using [[Dazzler]] may help with keeping monsters at bay if you start to get surrounded. [[DEX]] is still your main damage and [[HIT]] stat as well as primary reduction for [[VCT]], while [[INT]] allows for a larger [[SP]] pool as help with [[VCT]] reduction as well. [[VIT]] is added for [[HP]] and survivability. Note that if you are able to insta-cast [[Slinging Arrow]] before hitting 90 [[INT]] (from other gear), feel free to swap the final stats for [[INT]] & [[VIT]]. == Tips & Tactics == === Weapon Choices === As a Dancer, you can choose from [[Whip]]s, [[Dagger]]s, and [[Bow]]s as weapons, whereas [[Bard]]s can use [[Instrument]]s instead of [[Whips]]s. * When armed with a [[Whips|Whip]]: ** Bow skills ([[Double Strafe]], [[Arrow Shower]], [[Arrow Repel]]) cannot be used. ** Auto-attack can only be performed in melee range but damage depends on the Dancer's [[DEX]], not [[STR]], just like it does for [[bow|Bows]]. ** [[:Category: Performance Skills|Performance Skills]], as well as [[Amp]] and [[Encore]], can be used. ** Whip skill [[Slinging Arrow]] can be used. ** [[Dazzler]] and [[Charming Wink]] are usable regardless of weapons. === Orc Archer Bow & Steel Arrows === {{Item List|id=1734|item=Orc Archer Bow|simple=yes}} + {{Item List|id=1753|item=Steel Arrow|simple=yes}} This combination will give you a 50% Ranged Physical damage increase, which greatly increases [[Double Strafe]] and [[Arrow Shower]] damage output without needing any refining or cards. The only downside is the lack of Card Slots but the 50% will carry this weapon for a long time. {{Item List|id=12006|item=Steel Arrow Quivers|simple=yes}} or individual arrows for this combo cannot be bought from an NPC, but {{Skill List|skill=Arrow Crafting}} can be used on many common items to make your own or they can be purchased from other players' Vend Shops. === Reducing SP Consumption === {{Skill List|skill=Amp}} and {{Skill List|skill=Encore}} can be used to dramatically reduce the cost of [[SP]] consumption if you are using Performances/Ensembles regularly. === EXP Boosting === {{Skill List|skill=Mental Sensing}} is an awesome [[Ensemble Skill]] that boosts all EXP gained from monsters by up to 60%. However, you will need to find a [[Bard]] who also has this skill to use it. So, unless the player is planning on leveling with a partner frequently, this skill won't see much use but should still be obtained due a 4th Class [[Trouvere]] Skill that allows you to use it solo. === Dagger / Bow Amping === A popular technique used among Dancers to stop a song immediately. By switching to a [[Dagger]]-type weapon while performing a song, the song is immediately interrupted. Although it is also possible to cancel a song by equipping a [[Bow]], changing to a [[Dagger]] has the advantage of keeping the Dancer's [[Shield]] equipped. Do note though, that switching to a [[Dagger]] will unequip any [[Arrows]]. This does not occur when switching to a [[Bow]]. This is called "Amping" due to a previous version of the {{Skill List|skill=Amp}} Skill being the way you would stop a Performance Dance before the 2020 Skill Update. === Song Flashing === A tactic used to make full use of the Dancer's support and combat capabilities. The Dancer casts a [[:Category: Performance Skills|Performance Dance]] for an instant, then dagger/bow switches to a damage or status dealing configuration to participate in combat. This works because a song's effect stays on players for about 20 seconds after a person leaves the song's AoE. One can also Flash by moving around a large formation of players with a single song up. Song Flashing is somewhat complicated and can be confusing to keep in action. If a song is replayed before the 20 seconds is over, the buff does not restart. For example, if another player receives a song buff, then the Dancer cancels it at 18 seconds and restarts it at 19 seconds, the effect will only last for one more second instead of an additional 20 seconds (to total 39 seconds). The effect will only be refreshed for 20 more seconds if it is cast again 21+ seconds after the initial Flash. This is extremely hard to keep track of without external timers or resources. === Arrows, Quivers, and Hotkeys === Placing both your arrows and quivers on the hotkey bar will allow players to monitor how many arrows they have left, open new quivers with a single key-press, and equip arrows if you accidentally run out. This can be a life saver in emergency situations. === Affordable HP Recovery === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for AOE leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. Two popular and cheap healing items are Nepeta Cataria and Fresh Fish due to their cheap cost and low weight: *{{Item List |id=11602 |item=Nepeta Cataria |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cat Paw Shrimp Merchant''' in [[Izlude]] {{navi|izlude|117|165}} or [[Prontera]] {{navi|prontera|137|223}} (or in [[Lasagna]] {{navi|lasagna|166|117}} if starting as a [[Doram]]) for only 15z each (11z with max [[Discount]]). *{{Item List |id=579 |item=Fresh Fish |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cooking Merchant''' {{navi|payon|167|134}} in [[Payon]] or '''Chef's Assistant''' {{navi|alberta|167|134}} at the docks of [[Alberta]], as well as other cities, for only 250z each (190z with max [[Discount]]). For a list of Healing Items, a comparison, and a list of a couple popular Healing Items, please see the main article: [[Healing Items]]. == Equipment == === Eden Group Equipments Quests === :''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'' Eden Group Equipment is free and a great place to start for gear to use. The Bow is a good weapon and generally a good choice for a Bard due to the high ATK. A Bard does require an instrument to play songs, but any regular instrument will work for this. === General Equipment Recommendations === :''Main article: [[Equipment]]'' The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well. === Third Class Compatible Equipment === :''Main article: [[Maestro#Equipment|Maestro Equipment]]'' It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only. === Weapons === After considering what requirement skills have (some skills can only be used with certain weapon types), the Weapon Search tool within the iRO Wiki DB site is very helpful. Generally, for physical classes (both melee and ranged), something with high [[ATK]] is best. For magic classes, something with high [[MATK]] is best. Link to the iRO Wiki DB Weapon Search: http://db.irowiki.org/db/weapon-search/ There are 3 types of weapons that Dancers can use. [[Dagger]]s, [[Bow]]s and [[Instrument]]s. Daggers serve a limited usefulness, a common Knife is usually carried for its use in the dagger-stopping method to cancel songs. Instruments are needed to perform the songs and duets that the Dancer class can do. Bows are used for killing / leveling purposes. == Class Data == '''NOTE''': The iRO Bard Skill Section below may be outdated due to numerous changes. Do not be surprised if some of the skill descriptions differ from the other reputable website contents or current in-game descriptions. === Skills === ''See [[Archer#Skills|Archer Skills]] for first class skills.'' ==== Solo Skills ==== {| class="wikitablec sortable" |- ! Skill !! Description !! Levels !! Type |- | {{Skill List|skill=Amp}} || Reduces SP cost of performances, ensembles, and dances by 20% for 3 minutes. Can be used in conjunction with Encore. || 1 |class="skill-info-active"| Active |- | {{Skill List|skill=Dance Lessons}} || Increases damage and [[CRIT]] rate with Whips. Increases [[Movement Speed]] while dancing. Also increases [[Max SP]]. || 10 |class="skill-info-passive"| Passive |- | {{Skill List|skill=Dazzler}} || Inflicts [[Stun]] effect on monsters and party members within caster's view by chance. || 5 |class="skill-info-active"| Active |- | {{Skill List|skill=Encore}} || Recast the last Performance Skill that was cast at half of the [[SP]] cost. || 1 |class="skill-info-active"| Active |- | {{Skill List|skill=Focus Ballet}} || Provides a buff that improves [[HIT]]. || 10 |class="skill-info-active"| Active |- | {{Skill List|skill=Gypsy's Kiss}} || Provides a buff that increase [[Max SP|Max SP]] and reduces the [[SP]] cost of skills.|| 10 |class="skill-info-active"| Active |- | {{Skill List|skill=Hip Shaker}} || Deplete [[SP]] of all targets within the 9x9 area of effect.

title: Dancer Job Change Guide
wikitext: {{Articles Needing DB Links}} {{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = 40 | classreq = Archer | partyreq = | itemreq = Varies | nitemreq = | zenyreq = Varies | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Jobchange to [[Dancer]] }} 1. Whenever the player considers herself ready to become a Dancer, head to [[Comodo]]. Near the Kafra employee, there will be a male [[NPC]] named Bor Robin {{navi|comodo|193|151}} who will grant entrance into the Dancer Quest area. 2. Upon heading inside, talk to Aile {{navi|job_duncer|43|93}} to the left side of the stage. She will ask the player to bring one of the following set of items: # 1 {{item |id=2401 Sandals [0]}}, 10 {{item |id=1020 Black Hair}}, 20 {{item |id=909 Jellopy}}, 5 {{item |id=503 Yellow Potion}}, 2 {{item |id=965 Clam Shell}}, 10,000 zeny # 1 {{item |id=2403 Shoes [0]}}, 20 {{item |id=938 Sticky Mucus}}, 3 {{item |id=909 Jellopy}}, 5 {{item |id=501 Red Potion}}, 10,000 zeny # 1 {{item |id=2405 Boots [0]}}, 5 {{item |id=1055 Earthworm Peeling}}, 10,000 zeny *'''Note''': The NPC will not actually take these items. 3. Once finished signing up, it's time to head to the right side of the stage and talk to Bijou {{navi|job_duncer|95|93}} to take the quiz. 4. The quiz involves a simple Q & A session. Getting 80% correct is required to pass this part of the exam. For reference, the following are the questions that are asked for this section of the exam. (The wording however, may differ) {|class="wikitablec" |- ! Question Set A !! Answer Set A |- | What is the effect of the skill Dance Lesson? || Increases the effect of dancing skills. -or- Increase damage of Whip weapons. |- | What dance uses shoes that are designed to make sound as the dancer rolls their feet and taps the ground to create a rhythm? || Tap Dance |- | Which of the following is not a characteristic of a Dancer? || Uses Two-handed Swords |- | Which town has the most Dancers? || Comodo |- | Of the following, who dances most beautifully? || Bijou |- | What is the Dancer better at than the other job classes? || Dancing |- | Who is the manager of the Comodo Casino? || Moo |- | What item cannot be equipped by a Dancer? || Two-handed Sword |- | Do you think you can say this quiz is frustrating and annoying? || any answer |- | Which of the following is not a Jazz musician? || Elder Willow |- !Question Set B !! Answer Set B |- | What is the effect of the combined skill, Mental Sensing? || Increases experience |- | Which is considered bad etiquette on the dance floor after a dance? || Criticize your partner |- | Which is not an appropriate response when someone makes a mistake while you are dancing together? || Point out the mistake |- | In which town can you change jobs to a Dancer? || Comodo |- | How many dungeons are directly connected to Comodo? || 3 |- | Which of the following is not a Cute Pet monster? || Argiope |- | Who is the most graceful dancer? || Bijou |- | What is the exact name of the Kafra in Comodo? || Western Branch (Might Bug and Disconnect, select a wrong answer - LX 3/17/2024) |- | What is my name? || Bijou |- | What is the effect of Lullaby? || Casts the Sleep effect on the area |- ! Question Set C !! Answer Set C |- | The Dancer's dance, Lady Luck, increaces which of the following? || Critical Attack Rate |- | Of the following, which can you not consider to be a dance?|| Lightning Bolt |- | Which of the following best describes a Dancer? || A person who dances |- | Which of the following cannot be associated with Comodo? || A lot of thieves |- | What is the name of the region North West of Pharos Lighthouse? || Comodo Beach (Yes, it's Kokomo beach, but that's not an option, correct answer is Comodo Beach) |- | Who is the most beautiful dancer? || Bijou |- | Of the following, who can perform together with a Dancer? || Bard |- | Which of the following is not a specialty of Comodo? || Shining Stone |- | Who is the manager of the Comodo Casino? || Moo |- | Who accepts the Dancer job change applications? || Aile |} 5. After passing the quiz, Bijou will send the player to Dance on the stage. At this point one should make sure to equip a Bow and some arrows and then head behind the stage to meet another NPC {{navi|job_duncer|33|153}} with a "Waiting Room" chat window above her head. Entering the chatroom will put the player on queue for the trial. 6. The exam is a simple test of movement and quick responses. Hotkeying [[Arrow Shower]] or [[Double Strafe]] and [[Improve Concentration]] is suggested. *'''Note''': there's a poring at the end that has to be killed with a bow. Using [[Improve Concentration]] is optional, even though the NPC will ask for it. The Dancing pattern is as follows. # Up # Down # Left # Right # Center # Hold (just remain on the center tile) # [[Improve Concentration]] # Left # Down '''(Skip this step and go right directly)''' # Right # Hold (just remain on the right tile) # Left, Center, Right, Up # Right # Left, Center, Down, Up # Left, Center, Down, Up # Down # Left # Center # [[Arrow Shower]] or [[Double Strafe]] '''NOTE 1''': For those future dancers who are having problems with this part of the test, an effective way to pass this exam is to only perform the first and last steps for sequences with more than two steps, rather than hitting all the tiles. For example, instead of doing "Left Center Right Up" one simply goes from "Left" to "Up". '''NOTE 2''': For users with high ping/lag, this test may be extremely difficult to complete. If you are unable to do it, some users have reported submitting a Ticket to WarpPortal explaining your situation sometimes results in them passing it for you. 7. Return to the NPC who gave the quiz for the job change to Dancer. She will reward you with either a {{item |id=1953 Line [3]}} for Job 50, or a {{item |id=1950 Rope [3]}} for any job level lower than 50. {{Navbox Dancer}} [[Category: Dancer]] [[Category: Job Change Guide]]

1. Near the center of Comodo (204, 172) you'll find a lady 'Canell' that you need to talk to. You will need to have a {{item|id=747 Crystal Mirror}} with you. She will take the Crystal Mirror. 

2. In north Prontera (183, 333), you'll need to find and talk to the NPC Aelle. She will ask you to bring her the following items: 1 {{item|id=970 Alcohol}}, 1 {{item|id=736 China}}, 1 {{item|id=512 Apple}}, 3 {{item|id=513 Banana}}, 5 {{item|id=538 Well Baked Cookies}}. After giving her those items, she will be drunk, and wants nothing to do with you. She will get angry and send you somewhere in town (seems to be random) every time you try to talk to her. 

3. Return to Canell in Comodo, and she will teach you [[Charming Wink]].

title: Dandelion's Request
wikitext:
{{Not Implemented}} '''Note: If your character still has a Letter of Recommendation in their inventory, talk to Valdes (que_job01) at the Morroc Bar {{navi|morocc|45|107}}, and he will remove it.''' {{Quest Info | levelreq = 60 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | partyreq = 5 Players (Thanatos Portion) | itemreq = 1 {{item|id=994 Flame Heart}}, 1 {{item|id=997 Great Nature}}, 1 {{item|id=996 Rough Wind}}, 1 {{item|id=995 Mystic Frozen}} | zenyreq = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 1,280,000 | jobexpreward = | itemreward = A) {{item|id=12107 Wrapped Mask}}
B) {{item|id=12106 Jewelry Box}} | qreward = }} 1. Find the respective [[NPC]], according to job class, to receive the {{item|id=7416 Letter of Recommendation}}. * '''[[Swordsman]] / [[Novice]]:''' [[Izlude]] Guild Official, at the 8 o'clock area {{navi|izlude|103|106}} * '''[[Acolyte]]:''' Nun, at the entrance of the [[Prontera]] Church {{navi|prontera|237|313}} * '''[[Merchant]] / [[Soul Linker]]:''' [[Alberta]] Guild Official, at the 6 o'clock area {{navi|alberta|129|59}} * '''[[Magician]]:''' [[Geffen]] Academy Official, at the entrance of Geffen Tower {{navi|geffen|123|109}} * '''[[Thief]] / [[TaeKwon Master]]:''' [[Morroc]] Girl, at the 6 o'clock area {{navi|morocc|155|56}} ** '''[[Assassin]] class doesn't receive a physical letter * '''[[Archer]] / [[TaeKwon Kid]]:''' [[Payon]] Guild Official, at the entrance of Archer Village {{navi|payon|231|323}} * '''[[Gunslinger]] / [[Ninja]]:''' Messenger, northeast corner of the top deck of the domestic airship {{navi|airship|251|64}} 2. Bring the Letter of Recommendation to a building at [[Morroc]] 8 o'clock and be greeted by the Sharp-Looking Kid {{navi|morocc|43|108}}. 3. Find the Bar Master (que_job01 82 95) to ask about the mission. 4. Proceed to the inner room and enter the room to the left of Tao. (*Players are given 4 minutes to remain in the room) 5. Talk to Valdes (que_job01 16 21) and select the desired mission: A. Tracking and Prevent, or B. Protect the Target * Note: You can only do '''either''' A or B once per character. You cannot do both. '''Mission A - Tracking and Prevent''' 1A. Receive Written Request (A) and find Kidd (que_job01 91 83) at the bar. 2A. Talk to Dandelion Member until you are asked to track down Raiyan Moore. 3A. Proceed to Juno 3 o'clock to find the Reading Girl, Yunia (yuno_in04 180 106) in the Juno Library to ask about Raiyan Moore. 4A. Go upstairs and find the Workbook (yuno_in04 175 129), Kidd will appear to investigate. 5A. Return to Morocc, find Kidd and Dandelion Member. Players will be asked to search for traces of Raiyan at the Sphinx. 6A. Investigate the 7 o'clock area of the Sphinx ({{map|id=moc_fild19 moc_fild19}} 21 33) and find the Upturned Spot. 7A. Return to Kidd and you will be requested to destroy the elements at the 4 directions of Morroc: a. West of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild19 moc_fild19}} 21 33), 7 o'clock direction, 1 {{item|id=997 Great Nature}} required. b. South of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild12 moc_fild12}} 280 36), 5 o'clock direction, 1 {{item|id=994 Flame Heart}} required. c. East of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild10 moc_fild10}}281 148), center location, 1 {{item|id=996 Rough Wind}} required. d. North of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild07 moc_fild07}} 192 166), center location, 1 {{item|id=995 Mystic Frozen}} required. Report back to Kidd after completing the assignment. 8A. Proceed to the Inn {{navi|morocc|199|64}} and find the Assistant, Sephit, to gather information. 9A. Return to Kidd and will be assigned to investigate the Tower of Thanatos. Players will need to proceed until they reach the second mechanism (tha_t04, upper right side of the map), obtain the yellow key, and read the text of the mechanism. * Note: If you have already started the Thanatos Tower Quest and still have the red and yellow keys, you will need to sell them to an NPC and get them again. * Note: You only have to obtain the yellow key to go on with the quest. Characters that are unable to use lvl 4 weapons (such as TK-Kids) are able solve the quest. * Important: Make sure you accept a work contract on the first floor reception desk, she will tell you to talk to the NPC on the 2nd floor if you've done it correctly. * You will need 5 people total with work permits to be near the NPC on the 2nd floor to go to the 3rd floor. * The machine on the 4th floor is in the NE corner. * After you guess the security code, you MUST read the screen text to get the details on Satan Morroc's history, then choose to open the drawer (will all be done in one conversation set) If you open the drawer to get the key you will have to sell the key and resolve the machine. * You can do this part completely out of order prior to even beginning the Dandelion quest. 10A. Return to Kidd and then Valdes. After the conversation, proceed to the empty room and you will hear some creepy sounds. 11A. Talk to Kidd and Dandelion Member and you will be asked to search around Morroc. 12A. Proceed to the Morroc Castle and find the Man {{navi|moc_castle|40|20}}. (Players will be sent to the next location after the conversation with the NPC) NOTE: It seems that only one player can finish this part of the quest at a time. If someone is in the passageway, the NPC will not warp you. 13A. Explore the passage and defeat all the monsters at the end of the path. 14A. Talk to Dandelion Member (que_job02 66 85) and proceed to look for Kidd and Lin. (Hint: Don't backtrack!) 15A. Talk to Kidd and Lin, and Mr. R will summon monsters. 16A. After defeating the monsters, return to Morroc with Kidd. 17A. Find Valdes and you will be rewarded with a {{item|id=12107 Wrapped Mask}} and 1,280,000 base experience. 18A. Quest completed! '''Mission B - Protect the Target''' 1B. Proceed to the room on the right of Tao to find NPC Lin (que_job01 84 17) and Mr R (que_job01 79 15). 2B. Proceed to Juno 3 o'clock to find the Reading Girl, Yunia (yuno_in04 180 106) in the Juno Library to gather information. 3B. Return to Lin and Mr R will request to restore the elements at the 4 directions of Morroc. 4B. Upon exiting, Lin (que_job01 6 79) will appear to show her doubt about Mr R. 5B. Proceed to the designated spots to restore the Elements: a. West of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild19 moc_fild19}} 21 33), 7 o'clock direction, 1 {{item|id=996 Rough Wind}} required. b. South of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild12 moc_fild12}} 280 36), 5 o'clock direction, 1 {{item|id=997 Great Nature}} required. c. East of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild10 moc_fild10}} 281 148), center location, 1 {{item|id=995 Mystic Frozen}} required. d. North of Morroc ({{map|id=moc_fild07 moc_fild07}}192 166), center location, 1 {{item|id=994 Flame Heart}} required. Report back to Lin after completing the assignment. 6B. Proceed to the Inn {{navi|morocc|199|64}} and find the Assistant, Sephit to gather information about the Tower of Thanatos. 7B. Inform Lin and you will be requested not to inform Mr R regarding this. 8B. Talk to Mr R and you will be assigned to investigate the Tower of Thanatos. Players will need to proceed until they reach the second mechanism (tha_t04, upper right side of the map), obtain the yellow key, and read the text of the mechanism. * Note: If you have already started the Thanatos Tower Quest and still have the red and yellow keys, you will need to sell them to an NPC and get them again. * Note: You only have to obtain the yellow key to go on with the quest. Characters that are unable to use lvl 4 weapons (such as TK-Kids) are able solve the quest. * Important: Make sure you accept a work contract on the first floor reception desk, she will tell you to talk to the NPC on the 2nd floor if you've done it correctly. * You will need 5 people total with work permits to be near the NPC on the 2nd floor to go to the 3rd floor. * The machine on the 4th floor is in the NE corner. * After you guess the security code, you MUST read the screen text to get the details on Satan Morroc's history, then choose to open the drawer (will all be done in one conversation set) If you open the drawer to get the key you will have to sell the key and resolve the machine. * You can do this part completely out of order prior to even beginning the Dandelion quest. 9B. Return to Morroc. Meet Lin at the entrance. Proceed to Mr R's room but will find it to be empty, but overhear the conversation from Lin. 10B. Find Lin and Valdes and will hear the sound of ritual chanting. 11B. Proceed to the Morroc Castle and find the Man {{navi|moc_castle|40|20}}. (Players will be sent to the next location after the conversation with the NPC) NOTE: It seems that only one player can finish this part of the quest at a time. If someone is in the passageway, the NPC will not warp you. 12B. Explore the passage and defeat all of the monsters. 13B. Talk to Dandelion Member (que_job02 66 85) and proceed to look for Lin. You will have to walk past the platform into the darkness. Just move your cursor around to see where you can walk. You will eventually see R attempting to resurrect Satan Morroc. 14B. Talk to Kidd, Lin and Dandelion Member, and Mr R will summon monsters. 15B. After defeating the monsters, return to Morroc to find Lin, Kidd and Valdes to receive a {{item|id=12106 Jewelry Box}} and 1,280,000 base experience as reward. 16B. Quest completed! title: Demi Human
wikitext:
'''Demi-Human''' are a race of [[Monster]]. Any of the modifiers that affect Demi-Humans generally will also affect the Human [[Player]] race.

The Demi-Human race is used for creatures that are humanlike in appearance or feature humanlike characteristics, making them fairly easy to identify, even for less experienced players. A little common sense often lets you easily pinpoint a monster as Demi-Human.

'''1.''' To start the quest, you have to use the Dimensional Device located on [[Rune Midgard Allied Forces Post]] within the [[New World]] or simply go to the [[Eden Group]] Headquarters and talk with the '''Cat Hand agent''' {{navi|moc_para01|18|30}} to access the New World and then the Dimensional Gorge. From there proceed to the second map and speak to '''Historian Shep''' {{Navi|dali02|134|119}}. Now talk to the NPC right next to him '''Magic Scholar Artie''' and once the instance is ready, click on ''Dimensional Device'' and select ''Enter''. :[[File:DG_HistorianShep.png|250px]] [[File:DG_MagicScholarArtie.png|250px]]

'''2.''' Inside the instance, '''talk to Officer Heim''' after the small dialog between the NPCs. Now move towards the west (around coordinates 33/112) and you will see 7 injured soldiers. '''Talk to Healer Fama''' and she will give you a {{Item List 2|id=7641 |item=Cure Box |simple=yes}}: use it on each of the injured soldiers by talking to them (you need 1 cure box for each NPC, so keep talking to Healer Fama to receive more boxes).

'''3.''' After healing all the soldiers, move back towards Healer Fama, and Lucille will appear. '''Talk to Lucille''' and keep walking to the east where you will see '''Assassin Dewey'''. Talk to him and choose "Move Now" to be warped to the next room.

'''4.''' In this corridor [[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2939/evil-shadow Evil Shadow]] will appear and your mission is to '''kill 7 of each type''' (there are 3 types and a popup will appear informing when you killed them all). Once you are done, '''talk to Assassin Louie''' at the end of the corridor to be teleported to the next room.

'''5.''' '''Talk to Lucile''' in the center of the room and she will explain she can't move and need your help so she can activate her restoration system and a long cast bar will appear above you, but at this moment you are going to be interrupted by more Evil Shadow. Kill them all and talk to Lucile and help her again. Now '''speak to Assassin Huey''' and choose ''"Move immediately"'' to proceed to the next area.

'''6.''' Now you are on top of the Thanatos Tower where you can see Thanatos battling Satan Morocc. '''Talk to Lucille and 5 [[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2938/magic-seal Magic Seals]] will spawn on the five edges of the map ''(check the picture below for reference)''. Your objective is to eliminate all Magic Seals before they reach the center of the map''' ''(and if this happens, they will respawn at the edges and start moving toward the center again. In this case, ignore the ones you've killed and keep your progression)''. During this stage, Evil Shadow and some [[Fire Wall]] will spawn as well, you can ignore them and focus on the seals. After killing all the Magic Seals, '''talk to Assassin Lucille''' to continue.

http://i75.photobucket.com/albums/i309/aditya_010790/thana_boss.png
'''''Note1:''' Seals have 10m HP but they spawn with only 1-2m HP left. They are not boss flagged, which means they can be inflicted with status, polymorphed, and pushed back.''
'''''Note2:''' Each time the Magic Seal moves forward, it's basically a new seal. All status ailments will be cured, and things like element changing will be reverted to its original element (tested using earth element changing trap: after moving the Seals will become neutral element again) but maintaining previous HP.''
'''''Note3:''' When a Seal is about to move forward, it will temporarily disappear - giving you the false impression it was destroyed - to reappear a few cells forward. Make sure you actually killed it and not that it just moved forward (when a Seal is destroyed a green message will appear on the screen).

'''7.''' In this next room kill all the Evil Shadows and then talk to '''Young Girl''' and a portal will appear behind her ''(close to the wall/bookshelf. Sometimes the portal sprite does not appear, but it is there, just invisible)''. Go inside, keep killing all the Evil Shadows that appear, and move through the portal by the stairs at the end of the room. After a small dialog, kill the last group of monsters and move to the next room.

'''8.''' Now you're in a large room with a giant cauldron in the middle. Kill all the mobs around the area and '''meet up with Loki and Morocc Lord Knight around the middle of the room. Talk to them''' and you will be transported to the boss's room.

'''9.''' '''Talk to Loki and he will join with you as a mercenary''' (only the party leader will get Loki's Shadow mercenary). Proceed to the center and defeat [[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2942/evil-believer Evil Believer]]. Once defeated, you will be warped to the treasure room where you can receive Evil Slayer weapons (similar to Giant Faceworm Snake Skin, these weapons are already upgraded and enchanted). Now talk to Loki one last time to exit the instance.
'''''Note4:''''' ''it seems that on iRO this isn't necessary but If needed: in case the boss is receiving only "1 damage" per hit, use'' '''''CTRL + R''''' ''to open the'' ''''Mercenary Info Window'''' ''and see Loki's skills. Put Loki's skill'' '''Mind Blaster''' ''on your hotkeys and use it on the Evil Believer before you begin attacking it so he can receive proper damage. This skill has a 30sec cooldown.''

'''10.''' '''Talk to Historian Shep''' again to receive the exp and to start the cooldown timer.

==About Dewata==

[[Image: Dewata.jpg|center]]

A localized map modeled after Indonesia. 
The 7th product of the Global Project.
It can be accessed from [[Alberta]] via an NPC on the docks; there is a 10,000 Zeny fee. 

Dewata is a mysterious and beautiful island that has a community that has begun to accept and embrace the outside world and a tribal group that holds firm to ancient traditions and the ways of the warrior. Upon entering the island, adventurers are welcomed by a city embraced by nature with many friendly locals willing to talk and show off their culture and heritage. Beyond this city though lies the lands of the Jaty Tribe who are intent on preserving the old ways of their people.
If you can befriend the people of the Jaty Tribe and gain their trust, you will be able to explore further into the more dangerous areas of Dewata such as the area of the Karakatau Volcano where the deadly Comodo Lizards dwell. The legends and stories of Dewata await those who seek adventure in these foreign lands!

=== Pros ===
* Fastest to level due to a good AoE homunculus skills and you get it early (level 109), and the fire element is good in most places. Later on, Magma Flow provides good damage for manual attended leveling.
* [[Pyroclastic]] is the best Homunculus damage buff skill to the owner, and [[Granitic Armor]] can be useful in certain situations.
* [[Volcanic Ash]] is a good debuff homunculus skill to enemies as well.
* Regardless of your base homunculus, most of their stats will be capped sooner or later and removes their stats cons (example: Amistr has poor INT).
* Many useful skills and is probably the most popular Homunculus S.

=== Cons ===
* Need to be max level to maximize [[Pyroclastic]].
* [[Pyroclastic]] can backfire if you are targeting fire element monsters or any monster that has fire resistance. Also if you equip the wrong weapon, you can't switch weapon until it expires. This buff also can't be removed once it's cast and can't be dispelled.
* Very bad ASPD after mutation, making leveling painful until [[Lava Slide]] is unlocked. Can be alleviated slightly if pre-S homunculus was a Vanilmirth / Filir.

title: Dimensional Gap
wikitext:
{{Articles Needing DB Links}} ==Story== The Dimensional Gap, or Dimensional Crack, is an opening into the vacuum of time and space that separates dimensions. Such openings can only be created by beings of great power. Traveling through the Dimensional Gaps has been found to distort time as some have reported 2 weeks elapsing in Jotunheim while 3 hours lapsed in Midgard. Since Midgard and Muspelheim are separate realms, it's implied that Surt had used a Dimensional Gap when he invaded Midgard during the Thousand-Year War. After being chased out of Midgard, Surt may have utilized a Dimensional Gap again in order to invade the realm only to be stopped and imprisoned by Thanatos. Once freed from his prison, Surt used the Dimensional Gap again to escape Midgard, except this time the gap remained open so Midgardian adventurers were able to pursue him. Ending up in Jotunheim, Normans proceeded to establish a base camp and stabilize the Dimensional Gap that they came out of. With further research, they started using the Dimensional Gap as not only a portal between Midgard and Jotunheim, but also as a means to travel back in time through Midgard's history. ==Access== [[File:DimensionalDevicePoint.png|thumbnail]] Talk to the Dimensional Device {{navi|mid_camp|222|283}} in the [[New World]]. To access [[New World]], do the [[Cat_Hand_Services#New_World_Access_Quest|New World Access Quest]].
After completing the access quest once, the Dimensional Device at Eden Group {{navi|moc_para01|38|80}} will be unlocked and available for subsequent alternative access. :[[File:DimensionalDevice.png|250px]] == Quests == *[[Return of Rayan Moore]] *[[Timeless Item]] *[[Dimensional Travel]] == [[Instance]] Dungeons == ===1st Floor=== *[[Sara's Memory]] *[[Faceworm Nest]] *[[Geffen Magic Tournament]] ===2nd Floor=== *[[Geffen Night Arena]] *[[Ghost Palace]] *[[Sarah and Fenrir]] *[[Shadowed Dream]] *[[Devil's Tower]] *[[Airship Raid]] *[[Sky Fortress]] *[[Airship Crash]] *[[Tomb of Remorse]] [[File:Dali.jpg|500px|thumb|left|1st floor]] [[File:Dali2F.jpg|500px|thumb|left|2nd floor]] {{clear}} To view more instance dungeons, visit [[Instance]] page == Related Links == {{Navbox Towns}}

A Skill page comprises of: (omit any unnecessary for a skill) * The Skill Info template (copy this from another skill and do modifications, or from [[Template:Skill Info#Usage]] for a complete syntax) * A '''Description''' section containing the '''crucial elements of the skill'''. Any other relevant table follow. * '''Damage Calculation''' section with mechanics on how damage is derived. * '''Applications''' section with advice on how the skill usually fits into builds or how it can be used. * '''Notes''' section including miscellaneous information. title: Divorce
wikitext:
Requirements: 

*Must be [[Marriage System|Married]]
*2,500,000 [[Zeny ]]

[[File:DivorceDevirch.png|250px]]

In [[Nifflheim]] Town, enter the house at (167,161) and go to the top of the stairs. There is a Deviruchi. Talk to it and it will ask for 2,500,000 [[Zeny]]. If you choose to pay the amount you will become divorced from your spouse. However, this does not reset your adoption status. Therefore, if you ''have'' adopted another player:
*You may not readopt.
*Adoption skills will still affect you and the player you divorced from.

Doram
wikitext:
[[File:Doram_lore.png|120px|right]]
'''Doram''' (Alt: ''Doram'') is a playable cat character race. Doram players start out as [[Summoner|Summoners]], and begin their adventure in the town of [[Lasagna]]. If under [[Base Level]] 100, their skills are limited to those under the sets of skills headed by the Power of Sea, Power of Land, and Power of Life.  Once the Doram character advances to [[Base Level]] 100, new and advanced sets of skills become available under the Spirit of Sea, Spirit of Land, and Spirit of Life skill paths. Once a Doram [[Summoner]] is [[Base Level]] 200 / [[Job Level]] 70, they can advance to the next Class, the [[Spirit Handler]], to become even more ferocious in battle.

Dorams are considered their own [[Race]], and generally are also affected by [[Human]] and [[Brute]] specific modifiers, but are not affected by [[Demi-Human]] specific modifiers.

Dragon
wikitext:
'''Dragons''' are a race of [[monsters]]. The majority of them are found in and around {{map |id=abyss_01 Abyss Lake}}.

Cards concerning the Dragon race are:
* '''{{item |id=4471 Draco Egg Card}}''': Increases magical damage on Dragon race targets by 10%. 
* '''{{item |id=4385 Dragon Egg Card}}''': Adds a 0.5% chance of the '{{item |id=12048 Honey Herbal Tea}}' item dropping when killing a Dragon monsters.
* '''{{item |id=4180 Driller Card}}''': Gain 5 [[SP]] each time a Dragon monster is killed by Physical Melee Attack. Drain 5 [[SP]] as the weapon is unequipped.
* '''{{item |id=4176 Dullahan Card}}''': Inflict 10% more damage with [[Critical]] Attack. [[Critical]] + 7 on Dragon monsters.
* '''{{item |id=4118 Earth Petite Card}}''': Increase damage on Dragon monsters by 20%.
* '''{{item |id=4267 Explosion Card}}''': Recieve 10% more [[Experience]] Points from Dragon monsters. Receive 20% more damage from Dragon monsters.
* '''{{item |id=4120 Sky Petite Card}}''': Reduce damage from Dragon monsters by 30%.

Equipment concerning the Dragon race are:
* {{item |id=5451 Costume Gold Dragonhelm}}:
**Reduces damage taken from Dragon race enemies by 12%.
**Increases physical damage on Dragon race targets by 8%.
**Increases the experience given from Dragon race monsters by 5%.
* '''{{item |id=2527 Dragon Breath}}''': Reduces damage received from Dragon race by 15%
* '''{{item |id=13001 Dragon Killer}}''': Dagger that ignores the defense of Dragon monsters and increases [[Experience]] reward for defeating Dragon monsters by 10%.
* '''{{item |id=1166 Dragon Slayer}}''': [[Two-Handed Sword]] that increases damage inflicted on Dragon monsters by 15% and ignores the defense of Dragon monsters.
* '''{{item |id=1724 Dragon Wing}}''': [[Bow]] that ignores Dragon monsters' [[defense]]. Has 3% chance of gaining {{item |id=1765 Oridecon Arrow}} each time it kills a Dragon monster.
* '''{{item |id=1474 Gae Bolg}}''': [[Two-Handed Spear]] that ignores Dragon monsters' [[defense]] and inflicts 10% more damage on [[Boss]] monsters.
* '''{{item |id=1559 Legacy of Dragon}}''': Book that ignores Dragon monsters' [[defense]]. Gain 10 [[SP]] each time a Dragon monster is killed. [[INT]] + 3
* {{item |id=22058 Dragon Trainer Shoes}} / {{item |id=22097 Dragon Trainer Shoes [1]}}:
**Increases the experience given from Dragon race monsters by 5%.﻿
**Increases the experience given from Dragon race monsters by an additional 1% per upgrade level of the item.
*{{Item |id=400023 The Agony of Thanatos [1]}}:
**Increases physical and magical damage on Dragon race targets by 10%.
**Increases physical and magical damage on Dragon race targets by an additional 1% per 2 upgrade level.

*[[Equipment_Sets#Dragon_Breath_.26_Gae_Bolg_Set|Dragon Breath & Gae Bolg Set]]: Increases physical damage on Dragon race targets by an additional 5%.

Skills concerning the Dragon race include:
* '''[[Dragonology]]''': [[Sage]] skill that increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]] and damage reduction against the Dragon race.

They have traded in their young dragons for mature dragon mounts and are ready to do some serious damage with an arsenal of new and powerful attacks while also having the highest HP pool compared to other classes. Strong Two-handed Sword Melee skills, enhanced Spear skills, powered up Dragon skills, and new Servant Weapon skills make a Dragon Knight a formidable warrior on the battlefield. Their name is often abbreviated and referred to as "DK". == Job Change Guide == ''See '''[[Dragon Knight Job Change Guide]]''' for detailed information.'' This is one of the hardest job change quests for players without '''OCP/Kachua Gear'''. Read the guide before starting and be prepared to fail a few times. It takes about 10-15 minutes to finish the quest, depending on your abilities. First, you will need to go 2 maps West of Geffen to '''''' {{Navi|gef_fild08|54|101}} and speak with '''Oscar'''. He will ask you to participate in 3 Trials: *The Trial of the Protector *The Trial of Strength *The Trial of Patience Once these have been completed, you will be changed into a '''Dragon Knight'''! == Class Data == === Skills === ''See [[Knight#Skills|Knight Skills]] or [[Lord Knight#Skills|Lord Knight Skills]] for 2nd class Skills. This build is natural progression from [[Wind Cutter]], [[Ignition Break]] and [[Sonic Wave]]. The skill is commonly use together with [[Storm Slash]]. ===Effect=== Violently swing your weapon twice at target enemy, inflicting damage to them and all enemies around them. * When you use a [[Two-Handed Sword]] class weapon, this skill deals Melee damage. * When you use a [[Two-Handed Spear]] class weapon, this skill deals Ranged damage. * This skill can deal Critical Hits. title: Dragon Knight Job Change Guide
wikitext:
{{Quest Info | levelreq = 200 | joblevelreq = 70 | classreq = Rune Knight | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = {{Item_List_2|id=490087|item=Hourglass Necklace|simple=yes}}
| qreward = Job Change to [[Dragon Knight]] | external = | window = yes }} * '''Note''': ''This quest can be skipped, refer [[Fourth Class Job Change Quest Skip]] before talking to the job change npc''. == First Step - The trial of the Life Force == # Go to '''Geffen Field08''' {{Navi|gef_fild08|54|101}} and speak with '''Oscar'''. To start the job change quest, '''you must be the party leader'''.
[[File:Gef fild08.png|100px]] [[File:Oscar.png|50px]] # After teleporting into Abyss Lake, choose the option ''I'm ready!'' to start the trial. # Follow the road and speak with each Dragon Egg along the way. Select ''Start'' to help each Dragon Egg to recover. Each attempt at recovery will consume a percentage of HP and SP from your character until you are out of HP/SP or the Dragon Egg recovers. Each attempt made is random. You will need to recover '''7 Dragon Eggs'''. If you run out of HP and SP, you can use recovery items or activate the skill [[Relax]].
[[File:Dragon egg.png|Dragon egg.png]] == Second Step - The trial of being a Protector == # You will be teleported back to '''Oscar'''. Speak with him to start the second trial. # In this trial you will be forced to guide '''golden acidus''' through the fountain of life '''10 times'''.
[[File:Healing crystal.png|100px]] # At each fountain of life, a '''Bone Acidus''' will spawn and must be killed. Once killed, you will need to aggro the '''Golden Acidus''' and bring it to the fountain. '''Do not kill the Golden Acidus or you will have to start the trial from second part again.'''
[[File:Bone acidus.png|100px]] :: '''Important:''' Follow the order of fountains or else the next one won't spawn. If you fail too many times, you will no longer need to kill '''Bone Acidus''', but you will still need to bring the '''Golden Acidus''' with you. == Third Step - The trial of the Strength == # A new NPC, '''Letizia''', will appear. Speak with her to start the trial of the Strength.
[[File:Letizia.png|100px]] # In this trial you need to kill '''50 Letizia's Soldiers''' (Bone Ferus) in under 5 minutes.
[[File:Bone ferus.png|100px]] == Fourth step - The trial of the Patience == # After finishing the third trial, you are once again teleported to '''Letizia'''. Speak with her to start the final trial. # In this trial you will fight with '''Letizia''' in her dragon form (MVP '''Detardeurus''') and you need to get her HP to 91%. She will have a '''Green Aura''', so all incoming damage will be reduced by 90%. After a period of time has passed, the damage reduction will be removed.

title: Drop System
wikitext:
__TOC__ The Drop System is the manner in which items from monsters are randomly "dropped" when that monster is killed. Each monster has a maximum of 8 items in their "Drop Table" which they can drop. Each item has separate rate at which it is dropped. For example, a card may drop at a rate of .02% but a more common item such as an Apple may have a drop rate of 25%. Several factors affect the rate at which items are dropped: Base drop rate of the item from that monster, server drop rates, the level difference between the player and monster, and the use of any items or skills by the player that affect drop rates (Cards, Bubble Gum, etc.). == Priority == When a monster is killed, the person who did the most damage to that monster has priority over others to pick up any items that dropped from it. For a period of time, only that player can pick up the items. When in a [[Party]] using the item share option, items are distributed to all players in the party regardless of who picks them up, although the players doing the most damage to the monsters will get items more often than those who aren't. (Example: Player A picks up an item, but it is added to Player B's inventory). == Level Factor == {{Disabled}} When hunting monsters for loot, the player's level will have an impact on the drop rate of items from that monster. There is only a narrow range in which the item drop rate is the same as the server's drop rate setting. *'''Note:''' [[MVP]] reward items and their regular drops are speculated to be unaffected. {|class="wikitablec" |- ! Account Bound. *{{Item List 2|id=19143|item=Poring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19146|item=Marin Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19147|item=Drops Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19148|item=Santa Poring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19149|item=Poporing Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19150|item=Metalring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19151|item=Devilring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19152|item=Angelring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19153|item=Ghostring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=19154|item=Arch Angelring Balloon|simple=yes}}: 5% *{{Item List 2|id=5597|item=Bubble Gum in Mouth|simple=yes}}: 5% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=5394|item=Chewing Gum|simple=yes}}: when receiving Physical Damage gives 75% item drop chance increase effect for 1 minute (overrides any Bubble Gum consumable effects) ==== Armor ==== *{{Item List 2|id=450498|item=[S2] Issgard Armor-VG|slots=1|simple=yes}} 10%, Grade A +20% *{{Item List 2|id=450499|item=[S2] Issgard Robe-VG|slots=1|simple=yes}} 10%, Grade A +20% *{{Item List 2|id=450514|item=Crimson Suit|simple=yes|slots=1}}: 7%. *{{Item List 2|id=450466|item=22nd Anniversary Armor|simple=yes|slots=1}}: 5%. Account Bound. ==== Garment ==== *[[Norman Enchanter|Skill-enchanted]] {{Item List 2|id=20706|item=Amistr Bag|simple=yes}}: 1% per 2 upgrade levels of the item ==== Shoes ==== *{{Item List 2|id=22051|item=Lamor Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=22069|item=Lian Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=22061|item=Lumiere Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=22055|item=Sharel Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=22049|item=Sol Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% ([[VIP]] required) *{{Item List 2|id=22057|item=Flower Shoes|slots=1|simple=yes}}: 10% VIP ==== Shield ==== *{{Item List 2|id=460106|item=Kitten Shield|simple=yes|slots=1}}: 1% every 10 levels. ==== Accessory ==== *{{Item List 2|id=490681|item=Love Ring|simple=yes|slots=1}} + {{Item List 2|id=490720|item=Ring of Hatred|simple=yes|slots=1}}: 20% set effect. ==== Costume ==== *{{Item List 2|id=31420||item= Costume Shining Santa Poring|simple=yes}}: 15% (the effect is active only during the month of December) *{{Item List 2|id=480609|item=[S2] Costume Dimensional Sword|slots=1|simple=yes}} Season Limited 15% === Skills === *[[Ore Discovery]] == Calculation == {{iRO Only}} {{update}} === Formula === ''BaseDropRateMod'' 
[BaseDropRateMod] = floor[[BaseDropRate] * (100% + [VIP-DropRateBonus] + [GearDropRateBonus] + [ServerDropRateBonus] + [ItemDropRateBonus])]
''FinalDropRate'' 
[FinalDropRate] = [BaseDropRateMod] + 0.01%
=== Example === Card drop rate calculation, assuming a VIP player using HE Bubble Gum with no other bonus: [BaseDropRate] = 0.01% [VIP-DropRateBonus] = 50% [GearDropRateBonus] = 0% [ServerDropRateBonus] = 0% [ItemDropRateBonus] = 200% (HE Bubble Gum) The formula then yields: 
BaseDropRateMod = floor [0.01% * (100% + 50% + 0% + 0% + 200%)] = floor [0.035%] = 0.03%
FinalDropRate = 0.03% + 0.01% = 0.04%
=== Note === * There is a cap of 90% drop chance on items boosted by anything except database edits. That means if an item has a 50% chance to drop and it receives a 300% bonus, it will still be capped at 90% instead of 100%. == Past Occasions Using Drop System == *[[2011 St. Patrick's Day Event]]. {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category:General Information]]

title: Dual Wielding
wikitext:
== Overview == '''Dual Wielding''' or ''Dual Wield'' is a non-official term for having a weapon in each, both hands. This '''is different''' from Two Handed weapons like Katars. Only [[Assassin]], [[Kagerou]], and [[Oboro]] classes can dual wield.
For terminology, right (main) hand and left (off) hand will follow in game Equip window's slots:

[[File:Equip Window (Naked).png|300px]] [[File:Equip Window (Dual Wielding).png|300px]] ==== Notes ==== For switching weapons:
*If a one-handed weapon is in the right hand and nothing is in the left hand, then the next one-handed weapon equipped goes onto the left hand.
*:Otherwise, switching to another one-handed weapon (whether a katar or shield is equipped) will always replace the right hand. == Magic Skills == [[MATK]] from both right and lefthanded weapons, along with their refinement bonuses, stack & affect magic skills cast.
* Example: Two +7 {{Item List |id=13011 |item=Asura |simple=yes}} equipped gives a total of (50 x 2) + (14 x 2) = 128 MATK == Physical Skills == A lot from left hand weapon is not factored in when using physical damage type skills, like [[Meteor Assault]].
Below are picture examples of a '''left hand''' weapon. '''Green''' box part works, while '''red''' line does not work.
:[[File:Left Hand Weapon Working Properties Example-Marked.png]] [[File:Left Hand Weapon Working Properties Example 2-Marked.png]] === No Effect === *[[Righthand Mastery]] and [[Lefthand Mastery]] have no effect. *Weapon [[Element]] from left hand has no effect. Element is taken only from the right hand. *[[ATK#Weapon ATK|Weapon attack]] from the left hand is not factored in. **Such as the base weapon attack, refinement bonus attack, etc. === Has Effect === *Description that gives extra stats and ATK from left hand (and right) are factored in. *Line options and enchants are factored in. *Cards from left hand (and right) are factored in. == Physical Auto Attacks == Everything from right and left hand weapons affect auto attacks. *Skills and items that nullify size penalty like [[Weapon Perfection]] or only one {{Item|id=4137 Drake Card}} benefit both weapons. *[[Righthand Mastery]] and [[Lefthand Mastery]] have an effect. *Each hit is based on that weapon's respective element. *Attacking monsters that take only 1 damage, like a {{monster |id=1084 Black Mushroom}}, ignore the second hit. **Therefore, it's better to use only 1 weapon for faster [[ASPD]]. {{clear}} {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category: Mechanics]]

wikitext:
{{Update}} Repeatable Daily Quest with start point in Juno at {{navi|yuno |216|345}}
Temporary Link: http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=356 Sierra knows you worked with Rage and Philopontes and reveals he's part of Secret Wing. The Corporation, Rebellion, and government are working to investigate the Bio labs. They've found untranslated fragments Using Virtual Reality to replay what happened inside is the goal, and you are the only one strong enough to make it to the end of these memories. = Basic Information = Find '''Siera''' {{Navi|yuno|216|345}} to reserve the instance. There are two mode options to select from: #Expedition Mode #Battle Mode Expedition mode contains more information on the story and is easier, and Battle Mode is harder. = Instance Guide = Once inside, speak to Sierra to be warped to the Presidential Room. == Expedition Mode == [[File:1@gol1.png|thumb]] #Speak to all 6 ambassadors #*Seyren greets you and explains they were entering Arunafeltz secretly to look for "His Majesty" #*Margaretha is nervous and is looking out for Seyren #*Howard is carefree eating some snacks #*Cecil doesn't want to give up/leave her weapon #*Kathryne is also mad about having giving up her weapon, seeming to be branded as an assassin. Then rightly points out that Eremes didn't give up his. #*Eremes refuses to give up his weapon because he must protect Kathryne #After speaking with them, move up until a sleeping gas starts filling the room, and the Rekenbeker guards are surprised a few didn't yet fall asleep. '''Sierra''' intervenes in this memory and then returns you back to the situation room. #Because everyone was asleep, there's no memories before Rekenbeker split up the party. use the '''Synchronization Control''' to traverse the areas. ##Seyren is too sleepy to fight back, despite having his weapon. Eliminate the guards that spawn. ##Travel in the hallway to the north of you, then west, into the top left corner of the map with Seyren and his peco "Meg". Set Meg free, hoping that it will make it back to Seyren's father. ##The guards appear, and Seyren makes his last stand here. ##Be transported back to the situation room by Sierra #Speak to Sierra and be transported back to Seyren. He's found clues about Battle Core and Ymir's Heart Pieces. Go out searching for more info. #Find '''Eremes Guile''' who seems like he might be controlled. Knock some sense into him, and then him and Seyren talk. Eremes is also starting to cough up ''black'' blood. #Travel outside the room and south to the portal that opened up next to the door. #Overhear the guards being scared about Kathryn waking up and isn't experiencing Black Blood. Move south, then east, then into the room below. Speak to '''Seyren Windsor'''. Kathryn wakes up and seemingly remembers an event when she was 3 that Seyren was protecting her (?). Then.... she explodes/dies. #'''Eremes Guiles''' tells you to take Seyren to the next lab. He also then says he knows that the core implanted in him is going to kill him soon. He then dies. #'''Howard Alt-Eisen''' is standing in the hallway, after having broken out of the glass tube. Seyren recounts what's happened so far. Howard keeps up a positive front for Seyren, despite being worried for Cecil. ##In the room straight north of where Howard was, there's a ''Test Report'' on the table. It describes how a ghost appears/appeared 2 days after death, and it posits that the firmer shape it has is related to the clearer the test subject's mind is. ##In the room next to that report, is another ''Test Report''. Stage 2 is to expose them to "stimulating environments" so they can draw on the power of their implanted Battle Cores. Director Vorseff is the author. #Proceed to the lab room to the north where there's a ghost Swordsman. Vorseff talks about his research a bit, and then has the swordsman ghost attack. #After destroying the ghost, Cecil Damon appears. '''Howard Alt-Eisen''' is love-struck by Cecil's strength, which is the Battle Core that was implanted. Margaretha somehow learns Clementia and appears ... psychic-ly to the group. #Go outside the room and turn north. '''Seyren Windsor''' yells for his fiance Margaretha who ran north. Enter the portal that appears. #Margaretha is still unresponsive to the party. Cecil might be understanding what's happening. And Howard is feeling cold (foreshadowing?). Continue north. #Speak to '''Seyren Windsor''' as the party looks at the pile of 4 dead bodies, and ghosts hovering around. The party is shocked about the discovery that Seyren was already dead. Margaretha seemed to have been a stronger ghost (without the aura) earlier. Vorseff appears again and compliments Cecil's determination. He sends his best swordsman ghost after you to defeat. #After beating the boss, Vorseff runs off with a Butterfly wing. You're then prompted with a couple of story choices that Sierra warned you not to do. ##Unclear if the choices here determine the rewards you receive. ##*When revealing this simulation, receive 2 Bio Experiment Fragments. *The party recognized that you acted different and posthumously -- and virtually -- thank you for telling them you're from the future and you'll reveal the details of what transpired.

wikitext:
The '''Earth''' property is one of the ten [[Element|elemental properties]] in Ragnarok Online. Earth is the opposite of [[Fire]]. The Earth property is the strongest against the [[Wind]] property, and the weakest to the [[Fire]] property. [[Weapons]] can be [[Forging|forged]] with the Earth property by adding a {{item|id=997 Great Nature}} in the process. == Lifting the curse ==

1. Talk with Lina {{navi|prontera|202|297}} and offer to help free her from her curse.

2. Kill 50 Deviruchi, Wraith Dead, Dullahan, or Nightmare Terror.

3. Talk with Lina and listen to the music she plays. Search the city which corresponds to the music for the curse's manifestation — which can be seen as a mark on the ground — and click it.

The curse is manifested at the following locations:

*Geffen {{navi|geffen|207|114}}
*Juno {{navi|yuno|164|46}}
*Rachel {{navi|rachel|36|132}} (near the west gate)
*Lutie {{navi|xmas|144|51}}

4. Talk with Lina, who rewards you with 1 Easter Egg Shell and some [[Base EXP]] and [[Job EXP]].
*Note: 161/56 received 12,819,906 base/183,294 job (VIP)

== Egg transformation ==

The creature in the egg next to Lina exchanges 1  {{item | id=574 Egg}}, 1  {{item | id=1001 Star Dust}}, 20  {{item | id=909 Jellopies}}, and 300,000 zeny for one of the following sets of items, chosen randomly:

*1 Easter Egg Shell
*1 {{item | id=607 Yggdrasil Berry}} & 1 Star Dust
*2 {{item | id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}} & 5 Eggs
*2 {{item | id=12093 Special Toast}}
*5 Holy Egg
*1 pet egg (possible pets include Deviruchi, Peco Peco, Picky, Poporing, and Savage Babe)

Eggs can be purchased from the creature itself in sets of 5 for 2,000 zeny.

== Notes ==

*The Easter Egg Shell has the following properties: [[Def | def]]: -7, [[Mdef | mdef]]: -7, recovers 1% of your [[HP]] every 10 seconds, [[flee]] + 2 if [[Refinement System | refined]] to +7 or higher, recovers 1% of your [[SP]] every 10 seconds if refined to +9 or higher.
*Holy Eggs enable a single use of level 2 [[Resurrection]].
*After you have completed the quest, Lina will buff you if you talk to her.

=About Eclage Town=
==Overview==
'''Eclage''' is a town in the [[New World]].  It was created by the Laphine Fairies to serve as their main base of operations in their former fight against the giants of Jotunheim.  The same fairies also founded the fairy village of [[Splendide]] which is separated from Eclage by the Hazy Forest labyrinth.  As in Splendide, the fairies love nature, and constructed Eclage around a giant tree. 

==How to Get There==
There are three typical ways.  One is to save a warp outside a location convenient to Eclage.  The 2nd is to go to Mora Village and use the NPC outside of its east entrance to warp to Eclage's entrance.  The 3rd is to walk there through the Hazy Forest which everyone will say is the hardest and slowest method by far.

In order to get to Eclage. Exit through the east entrance in Mora and speak to the cat hands NPC there to warp you "Near Eclage" for either 15,000 zeny or cat cans (he also teleports near Splendine).  

See [[Eclage Entrance Quest]] to get access to the town.

=Points of Interest in Eclage=

==Building Locations==
Clinic {{Navi|ecl_in02|164|56}}:  You can save your respawn location to Eclage at the Clinic.  Note carefully that there is no Kafra or Cool Event Corporation NPC to warp you out, but there is an NPC outside of Eclage to warp out.  It is similar to a Rune=Midgarts inn in that you can also rest there to immediately recover your HP/SP.  The Clinic is accessed by taking an exit warp from inside the Palace.

Palace:  The Palace is at the north end of Eclage.  Because Eclage is built around a giant tree, accessing some locations within the Palace (such as the east and west wings) needs you to go outside the palace in order to move to another level of the great tree.

title: Eden Group
wikitext:
== Overview == [[File:moc_para.png|thumbnail]]
{| |align="center" valign="center" |[[File:Eden-Group.png]] |- |align="center" |'''Instructor Ur - Instructor Boya - Secretary Lime Evenor - Gramps''' |}
The Eden Group contains members that offer players a variety of useful services such as quests that give good experience and equipment, teleporting services, kafra storage, [[VIP]] specific benefits, and many more. Many of the NPCs on this wiki may be iRO exclusive. [[Image:Eden teleporter.png|right|Eden teleporter.png]] To access the Eden Group Headquarters, simply speak to an '''Eden Teleport Officer''' (they are white-haired Novice-esque females wearing green). They can be found near most [[Kafra]] and 1st class job change [[NPC]]s. Exiting the Eden Group afterward will ''normally'' return you to a location near the Eden Teleport Officer you spoke to. :'''Note''' : On some [[servers]], whenever you exit from Eden headquarters you will be warped to [[Prontera]]. Therefore, the Eden Teleporter can be used to warp to Prontera easily if you're in a far city like [[Juno]], [[Rachel]], [[Al De Baran]], [[Amatsu]], etc. == Join the Group == #Talk to '''Secretary Lime Evenor''' {{Navi|moc_para01|27|35}} to register and select Join the Eden Group. You can type anything as she will not actually check your spelling. #Talk to '''Instructor Boya''' again when you reached base level 12 to start the '''[[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'''. == Equipment Quests == These quests provide [[Base Level]] 12+ players free equipment sets that can last them up to level 100 third jobs. These are highly suggested for new players. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]''' == Costume Headgear Maker == '''Alora''' in 2nd Floor of Eden {{navi|moc_paraup|21|185}} can give you the costume version of a headgear if you bring her normal (slotted or unslotted) version of the headgears with an upgrade levels of +8 or higher. *{{Item List|id=19527 |item=Costume: Spiky Band|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19525 |item=Costume: Jack be Dandy|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19529 |item=Costume: Angel Wing|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19502 |item=Costume: Goggles|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19545 |item=Costume: Boy's Cap|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19629 |item=Costume: Tiara|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19630 |item=Costume: Crown|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19620 |item=Costume: Detective Hat|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19617 |item=Costume: Puppy Headband|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=19625 |item=Costume: Bunny Band|simple=yes}} * ''For more Costume Creation please check'' '''[[Eclage Costume Maker]]''' [[Category: General Information]] == Leveling Quests == Eden Group's mission boards located in Eden Group Headquarters, provide a fast and easy way to get [[EXP]] while playing. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Eden Group Leveling Quests]]''' == Weekly Turn-In Events == '''Gramps''' {{navi|moc_para01|29|30}} is a custom iRO NPC that offers Weekly Turn-In events. They are generally the best way to level characters level 70 and up, although one may choose to grind higher elsewhere first, or also grind in regular maps when the turn in quest is in cooldown. Each week, a hunting quest (also called a "Turn-In") is rotated. The Gramps NPC in the Eden Group HQ is offering the quest. They require the player to kill 400 monsters. The monsters involved will give their normal EXP. The player must be within a certain level range to obtain the quest, but he can get the reward at any level. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Weekly Turn-In Events]]''' == Merry Badger == '''Merry Badger''' {{navi|moc_para01|13|23}} will deal in {{Item|id=6495 '''Eden Merit Badges'''}}. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Eden Merit Badge|Merry Badger]]''' == Aperture == [[File:Eden Aperture Location.png]]
'''Aperture''' {{navi|moc_para01|14|30}} provides warps to different cities for a fee. *Non-VIP users can only choose [[Prontera]] for 1,800 zeny. *[[VIP]] users (mini or real) have the choices in the table below: {| class="wikitable collapsible sortable" style="text-align:center;" ! colspan=2| Aperture VIP Warps |- ! City Name !! Zeny Cost |- | [[Prontera]] || 600 |- | [[Izlude]] || 600 |- | [[Geffen]] || 1,200 |- | [[Payon]] || 1,200 |- | [[Morroc]] || 1,200 |- | [[Alberta]] || 1,800 |- | [[Aldebaran]] || 2,200 |- | [[Comodo]] || 2,200 |- | [[Umbala]] || 2,200 |- | [[Juno]] || 1,800 |- | [[Einbroch]] || 2,200 |- | [[Lighthalzen]] || 2,200 |- | [[Hugel]] || 2,200 |- | [[Rachel]] || 2,200 |- |} == Dungeon Teleporter == '''Dungeon Teleporter''' {{navi|moc_para01|13|28}} will teleport you to select dungeons for some zeny. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Dungeon Teleporter]]''' == Eve Natalia and Eat Gear == '''Eve Natalia''' and '''Eat Gear''' {{navi|moc_para01|52|38}} are iRO custom NPCs that offer [[Safe Certificate]]s in exchange for various equips. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Safe Certificate]]''' == More VIP Restricted NPCs == '''Primo d'Buffer''', '''VIP Services''', '''Clearchus''' are some of the NPCs that are accessible by only [[VIP]] members. Note that these NPCs may be iRO custom. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[VIP]]''' == Other First Floor NPCs == *'''Mesmerist''' {{navi|moc_para01|18|30}} gives a ONE time reset that resets BOTH [[Stats]] points and [[Skill Points]]. == VIP Turn-Ins == Special [[VIP]]-only quests are available from the '''Eden Group Chef''' [[NPC]] {{navi|moc_para01|182|48}} in the Kitchen. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[VIP Turn-Ins]]''' == Other Kitchen NPCs == *'''Bathory''' {{navi|moc_para01|174|32}} offers teleports to [[Niflheim]]. *'''Chef''' {{navi|moc_para01|179|43}} heals [[HP]] and [[SP]] for a meal fee. == Crystal Synthesis == The crystal synthesis quests provide players with enhanced gears, synthesized with energy crystals. They also provide three hours buffs which also reward crystals. Talk to '''Reno''' {{navi|moc_paraup|41|167}} in [[Eden Group|Eden Group Headquarters]] 2F to start with the quests. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Eden Group Crystal Synthesis]]''' == Grandma Boxter == '''Grandma Boxter''' {{navi|moc_paraup|26|173}} on Eden 2nd floor provides recycling of [[Safe Certificate]] and items gained from various [[Kafra Shop Box Archives#Overseas Care Packages|Overseas Care Packages]]. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Grandma Boxter]]''' == Kafra Mail Annex Station == '''Mail Annex Station''' on Eden 2nd floor {{navi|moc_paraup|48|181}} leads to a room with many resourceful NPCs, such as Tool Dealer, High Value Trader, Repairman, and more. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Kafra Mail Annex Station]]''' == Spooky Machine == '''Spooky Machine''', on Eden 2nd floor in the top-right room, {{navi|moc_paraup|185|119}} is a custom iRO event daily quest that lets characters refine a given quest item, {{item |id=7515 Cracked Buckler}} for various rewards. * ''For more detailed information please check'' '''[[Spooky Machine]]''' == Other Second Floor NPCs == * '''Code the Redeemer''' {{navi|moc_paraup|38|162}} gives out-of-game rewards on iRO. There is also one in Alberta, right of the spawn. *: [[File:Eden-Code the Redeemer.png|300px]] * '''Quivering Merchant''' {{navi|moc_paraup|41|162}} sells arrow quivers. [[Discount]] does not work in her shop. ** {{Item List|id=12004 |item=Quiver|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List|id=12005 |item=Iron Arrow Quiver|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List|id=12009 |item=Silver Arrow Quiver|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List|id=12008 |item=Fire Arrow Quiver|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List|id=12575 |item=Elven Arrow Quiver|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List|id=12576 |item=Hunting Arrow Quiver|simple=yes}} * '''Gum & Manual Exchanger''' {{navi|moc_paraup|47|183}} allows the exchange of Battle Manuals and Bubblegum for better versions. ** '''Exchange Rate:''' *** 2x {{Item List|id=12210 |item=Bubble Gum|simple=yes}} -> 1x {{Item List|id=12412 |item=HE Bubble Gum|simple=yes}} *** 2x {{Item List|id=12208 |item=Battle Manual|simple=yes}} -> 1x {{Item List|id=12411 |item=HE Battle Manual|simple=yes}} *** 4x {{Item List|id=12411 |item=HE Battle Manual|simple=yes}} -> 1x {{Item List|id=14545 |item=Battle Manual X3|simple=yes}} *** 3x {{Item List|id=12312 |item=Thick Battle Manual|simple=yes}} -> 2x {{Item List|id=14545 |item=Battle Manual X3|simple=yes}} *** 1x {{Item List|id=19619 |item=Costume Corsair|simple=yes}} -> 1x {{Item List|id=14545 |item=Battle Manual X3|simple=yes}}''(why?)'' == Para Market == * '''Para Market Tout''' {{navi|moc_para01|106|38}} to access the '''[[Para Market]]''' Hall. {{Navbox Eden}} [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Eden Group]] [[Category: Eden Group Quests]]

wikitext:
{{Quest Info | levelreq = 12 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | classreq2 = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = Varies (See Tables) | jobexpreward = Varies (See Tables) | itemreward = Varies (See Tables) | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} == Introduction == These quests provide [[Base Level]] 12+ players free equipment. At Base Level 60+, the quests give the final Eden equipment set. Base Level 100+ players are suggested to do the [[Royal Banquet]] questline for the next free set, [[Noblesse Equipment]]. == Equipment Notes == *It is advisable to '''keep old Eden equips''' until after passing that Base Level as a [[Transcendent]], unless you are of a class which cannot transcend. **It is not possible to re-do those quests after [[Transcendent|Transcending]]. **The equipment can be sold to [[NPC]]s. *After completing any of the below equipment quests, the equipment is retrieved by clicking the tiles at the foot of the blue double doors near {{Navi|moc_para01|47|39}}. Once inside, go to the end of the hall and turn right into the room with '''Administrator Michael''' {{Navi|moc_para01|112|95}}, to whom you must speak to retrieve your equipment rewards. *:[[File:Eden-group-map03.jpg|300px]] *It is ''not necessary'' to be on the suggested map for any of the hunting quests. For example, for the level 12-25 quest involving the Morocc Desert, players may find it simpler to find a map with more scorpions; similarly, while hunting Orc Babies for the level 40 quest, the East Orc Village may be preferable. However, as it ''is'' necessary to return to the NPC after each step, mileage will vary. *Remember that pressing '''CTRL''' + '''~''' will bring up a world map, and clicking the poring icon on the bottom right will show the most common enemy in each zone. **Using the navigation to search up the monster is even more effective. *Finally, note that which quest you are given depends upon your level at the time of acceptance. The second quest in each set is more likely to be given if you're of a higher level. == Instructor Boya & Administrator Michael == [[Image:BoyaMichael.png|Eden Group's Instructor Boya and Administrator Michael]] * Talk to '''Instructor Boya''' behind the center of the counter in the Eden Group Headquarters to start any of these training missions. * The quests from level 12 to 39 have two possibles mission set, while the quests from level 40 to 69 have three possibles mission set (You get '''one''' of the available mission set, not all). * '''Any training missions from Boya gonna gives you''' the {{item |id=5583 Eden Group Hat}} and the {{item |id=2560 Eden Group Manteau}} if you don't have it already (i.e If you missed the first quest). #Report to Instructor Boya at the Eden Group Office. #Go to the back room, talk with '''Administrator Michael''' {{Navi|moc_para01|112|95}} and get your rewards. === Level 12 - 25 === {| class="wikitablec" !
