title: Fish
wikitext:
Fish are a race of monster. The majority of them are of the [[Water]] element and reside in {{Map |id=iz_dun00 Byalan Dungeon}}.

==Card==
Cards which concern the Fish race are:
* {{Item |id=4347 Armeyer Dinze Card}}: Adds a 0.5% chance of the '{{Item |id=12053 Clam Soup}}' item dropping when killing a Fish race monster
* {{Item |id=4307 Beetle King Card}}: Gain 5 SP each time a Fish monster is killed by Physical Melee Attack. Drain 5 SP as the weapon is unequipped.
* {{Item |id=4080 Flora Card}}: Increase damage on Fish monsters by 20%.
* {{Item |id=4164 Gullinbursti Card}}: Receive 10% more experience points each time a Fish monster is killed. Receive 20% more damage from Fish monsters.
* {{Item |id=4195 Leaf Cat Card}}: Add the chance of gaining '{{Item |id=991 Crystal Blue}}' item each time a Fish or Shellfish monster is killed. Add 10% more tolerance against [[Water]] Property Attack.
* {{Item |id=4469 Naga Card}}: Increases magical damage on Fish race targets by 10%.
* {{Item |id=27121 Piranha Card}}:
**Increases physical and magical damage on Fish race targets by 10%.
**If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases physical and magical damage on Fish race targets by an additional 5%.
* {{Item |id=4523 Pot Dofle Card}}: Reduces damage taken from Fish race enemies by 10%.
* {{Item |id=4083 Rafflesia Card}}: Reduce damage from Fish monsters by 30%.
* {{Item |id=4192 Rotar Zairo Card}}: Inflict 10% more damage with Critical Attack. Critical +7 on Fish monsters.
* {{item |id=4422 Roween Card}}: Increases physical damage versus [[Water]] property monsters by 10%. [[Flee]] + 5. [[Perfect Dodge]] + 3. Adds [[CRIT]] + 15 when fighting Fish race monsters.
* {{Item |id=4326 Sea-Otter Card}}: Add the chance of gaining '{{Item |id=551 Sushi}}' or '{{Item |id=544 Raw Fish}}' item each time a Fish monster is killed. Sushi and Raw Fish items restore 50% more HP.
* {{Item |id=4228 Sleeper Card}}: Add the chance of gaining '{{Item |id=12031 Box of Drowsiness}}' item each time a Fish or Shellfish monster is killed.
* {{Item |id=4587 Tiyanak Card}}: Crit + 12 on Fish race targets.

* {{Item |id=5065 Blue Fish}}: Increase damage on Fish monsters by 10%.

We'll have to fix that right quick! == Fishing Rod == Talk to '''Fishy Man''' {{navi|alberta|208|72}} in Alberta and ask him for a fishing rod. [[File:Fishing-Welsley.png|250px]] *He will ask you to bring some items for him to make you one. *You can choose between a regular Fishing Rod and a Small Fishing Rod. :*{{item|id=998 Iron}} :*{{item|id=1025 Cobweb}} :*{{item|id=1068 Barren Trunk}} == Bait == You can fish without any bait, but using a bait will increase the chances of catching Rare Fish. 1. Find Shuda in [[Ayothaya]] {{navi|ayothaya|233|105}}, she's sad because her bridegroom is lost, you must help her find the ring that her bridegroom dropped in the sea. 

2. Walk right a bit, and you'll see a man who can rent you a fishing tool for finding the ring in the sea for 50z (you need 1 {{item|id=528 Monster Feed}} per try when fishing). 

3. Try it until you find the {{item|id=7288 Engagement Ring}}, and then go back to Shuda. She'll ask you to find her bridegroom (Anon). 

4. You can find clue about where Anon is from an old man {{navi|ayothaya|193|171}}
He'll tell you that Anon has gone to the Ayothaya Dungeon.

Note: You need to have fully completed the [[Ayothaya Dungeon Entrance Quest]] to continue (including retrieval of the Old Blue Box).
 
5. Now you must find 9 of Anon's footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon. 

6. There are four footprint spots (when you pass it, a dialog box will appear) in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 1, and five footprints in Ayothaya Dungeon Level 2. It may take multiple tries until a dialog box appears.(If the first footprint does not trigger, try talking to the Old Man again until he mentions the tourism in Ayothaya.)

title: Forging
wikitext: {{renewal}} {| class="messagebox cleanup metadata" style="color:red;" | '''For materials lists, see [[Weapon Materials]].''' |} == General == [[Blacksmith]]s can forge [[weapons]] from different materials. The materials used decide the weapon to be created as well as any additional properties, such as [[element]], the weapon will have. Forged weapons do not have [[Card System|Card Slots]]. [[Rod]]s, [[Bow]]s, [[Instrument]]s, [[Book]]s and [[Katar]]s cannot be forged, nor can [[Weapons#Weapon Level|Level 4 weapons]]. When forging a weapon there are 3 available slots for modifying items. Items such as {{item |id=994 Flame Heart}}, {{item |id=995 Mystic Frozen}}, {{item |id=996 Rough Wind}} and {{item |id=997 Great Nature}} can be used to imbue the weapon with the [[Fire]], [[Water]], [[Wind]] and [[Earth]] properties, respectively. A weapon may only have one element at a time and using more than one elemental stone will cause the forge to fail. Slots may also be fitted with {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}}. One, two, and three {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}} will (respectively) add +5, +10, and +40 [[ATK#Mastery ATK|Mastery ATK]] to all attacks from the weapon. == Process == # Make sure that all of the necessary items are in your inventory (not your [[Pushcart|cart]]). Then use the necessary hammer for the weapon level you wish to create. Once you click OK (or press Enter) the hammer will be consumed even if you quit. # A list of weapons you can forge will appear. Select the weapon you wish to create and continue. # A second window will appear detailing which items will be used up by the forging attempt. There are also 3 slots to place an Elemental Stone and/or {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}}. # Drag and drop the extra materials from your inventory to the slots to add them to the weapon. Even if the forging attempt fails the items on the list as well as those in the slots will be consumed. # If the forge is successful the newly created weapon will appear in your inventory. == Success Rates == {| |- style="vertical-align: top;" | {| class="wikitablec" |+ Smith [Weapon] skill ! Level !! Base Success Rate |- ! 1 | 10% |- ! 2 | 20% |- ! 3 | 30% |} | {| class="wikitablec" |+ Anvils ! Anvil !! Success Rate Bonus |- ! {{Item List |id=986 |item=Anvil}} | 0% |- ! {{Item List |id=987 |item=Oridecon Anvil}} | style="color:darkblue;" | +3% |- ! {{Item List |id=988 |item=Golden Anvil}} | style="color:darkblue;" | +5% |- ! {{Item List |id=989 |item=Emperium Anvil}} | style="color:darkblue;" | +10% |} | {| class="wikitablec" |+ Weapon Level ! Level !! Success Rate Penalty |- ! 1 | 0% |- ! 2 | style="color:darkred;" | -20% |- ! 3 | style="color:darkred;" | -30% |} |} * Success Rate is decided by Forging Equipment, [[Skills]], [[Stats#DEX|DEX]], [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] and [[Levels#Job Level|Job Level]]. * Forging Equipment includes {{item |id=986 Anvil}}, {{item |id=987 Oridecon Anvil}}, {{item |id=988 Golden Anvil}}, {{item |id=989 Emperium Anvil}}, {{item |id=613 Iron Hammer}}, {{item |id=614 Golden Hammer}} and {{item |id=615 Oridecon Hammer}}. ** Hammers are used to begin the forging process. {{item |id=613 Iron Hammers}} are used to forge Level 1 [[Weapons]], {{item |id=614 Golden Hammers}} are used to forge Level 2 [[Weapons]] and {{item |id=615 Oridecon Hammers}} are used to forge Level 3 [[Weapons]]. ** Anvils are kept in the main inventory and increase Success Rate. '''You cannot forge weapons with Weapon Level higher than your Smith [Weapon] skill level.''' * In addition to the Success Rate from the Smith [Weapon] skill, [[Weaponry Research]] and [[Oridecon Research]] also affect the Success Rates of forging different weapons as well as which weapons are available to forge. * Each point of [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] and [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] is believed to add 0.1% chance to successfully forging a weapon. For example, a [[Blacksmith]] with [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] 19 and [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] 1 would gain an additional 2% chance to forge a weapon, after taking other factors into account. * Each [[Levels#Job Level|Job Level]] is believed to add 0.2% to the overall Success Rate. * Using forging slots decreases the success rate of the forge attempt. An elemental stone takes off 20% and each {{item |id=1000 Star Crumb}} takes off 15%. == Ranking System == For Forgers there is a system in which players are ranked based on who can make the most weapons. * '''Rank Point +1''': For upgrading a Level 1 weapon that the player has forged to +10. * '''Rank Point +10''': For successfully creating a Level 3 weapon that contains 3 stones (either 2 {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}} and an Elemental Stone, or three Star Crumbs). * '''Rank Point +25''': For upgrading a Level 2 weapon that you have forged to +10. * '''Rank Point +1000''': For upgrading a Level 3 weapon that you have forged to +10. [[Blacksmith]] ranks can be checked via usage of /Blacksmith command ingame. A weapon created by ranked [[Blacksmith]] will deal an extra +10 [[ATK#Mastery ATK|Mastery ATK]] damage. == Item Look & Feel == * When a weapon is forged successfully, its name will have the forger's name attached. :Yeef's Sword * Normally the forger's name will appear in blue. However, if the character that forged the weapon has been deleted, the forger's name is lost, and the weapons becomes Nameless. :Nameless's Sword * When imbued with an [[element]], the name of the element will appear before the weapon's name and after the forger's name. :Yeef's Fire Sword * When imbued with one or more Star Crumbs, the term 'Very' will appear before the forger's name for each {{item |id=1000 Star Crumb}} used followed by 'Strong'. :Very Very Very Strong Yeef's Sword * When imbued with both an [[element]] and {{item |id=1000 Star Crumbs}}, the weapon's name will follow the naming conventions in the following order: Star Crumbs, Forger's Name, [[Element]], Weapon Name. :Very Very Strong Yeef's Fire Sword {{Navbox Crafting}} [[Category: Blacksmith]] [[Category: General Information]] [[Category: Mechanics]]

title: Formless
wikitext:
Formless are a race of monster. In game it is sometimes referred to as ''Neutral Monster'', without adding the word ''Property''. So it is NOT to be confused with ''[[Neutral|Neutral Elemental Property]]''. Formless race is mostly used for monsters that can't fit into any other race. Examples are machines/robots like Alarm, Clock, Venatu, Dimik and Apocalypse. Animated objects like Myst Case or Cruiser also fall in this category.

title: Free for All
wikitext:
FFA is an acronym and stands for '''Free for all''', meaning anyone can attack that monster regardless of who summoned it, who is attacking it, or who is being attacked by it. FFA is a designation applied to certain types of monsters. [[Monster]]s that fall under this designation include: 

*[[MVP]]s 
*Dead Branch/Bloody Branch summoned monsters 
*Town Invasion Monsters 
*[[Hocus-pocus]] summoned Monsters 
*Other player summoned Monsters, such as through [[Cultivate Plant]] - however this can be considered very rude

The FFA designation does not apply to "mini-bosses" or any other type of monster. Attacking any non-FFA monsters is considered [[Kill Steal]]ing, and may result in being banned. Some monsters that spawn in towns are not considered FFA, such as the event Lucky Dragons in 2006. The Wild Roses that appear in towns however, are generally considered FFA.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
wikitext:
{{Update}}
== General F.A.Q. ==

'''Q: What is Ragnarok Online?'''

:Ragnarok Online (RO) is a Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game (MMORPG). See the [[Introduction to Ragnarok Online]] for details. 

'''Q: Where can I get the game?'''

:International Ragnarok Online currently has an [http://renewal.playragnarok.com/downloads/clientdownload.aspx official website] where the program is available for download.  We also host the clients [[Clients and Patches|here]] at iRO Wiki.

'''Q: How can I sign up?'''

:[https://www.warpportal.com/account/registration.aspx Register] at the Warp Portal website. Also see: [[Introduction_to_Ragnarok_Online#Account_Creation|Account Creation]] 

'''Q: Can I play on OS X or Linux?'''

:No — the client is only compatible with Windows. Windows can be installed on a Mac using [https://support.apple.com/kb/HT201468 Boot Camp].
:*It was previously possible to natively run the iRO client on Linux and macOS using Wine/CrossOver. As of February 2020, this is no longer the case because the iRO client now incorporates Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC), which is designed to detect Wine/CrossOver.
:*It is not viable to run the iRO client on a virtual machine because EAC is also designed to detect whether it is running on a virtual machine. Even if EAC is unable to detect the virtual machine, the client's connection to the server will be occasionally interrupted, presumably due to EAC's interference.

'''Q: Is there a monthly fee?'''

:Any unblocked account can create 15 characters free of charge. A VIP subscription is available for additional benefits. Also see: [[Introduction_to_Ragnarok_Online#Payment_Method|Payment Method]], [[IRO Servers Comparison]]

'''Q: What if I don't have a credit/debit card?'''

:There are many other payment options as well, such as the following:

:#Pay-by-Cash which can accept payment by mail through cash, check, or money order. Keep in mind this method will take longer to process.
:#PayPal where the basic cost will also stay the same. 
:#Ultimate Game Cards/Gravity Game Cards/GoCash Cards

:And more...

'''Q: What is Sakray?'''

:Sakray is a test server. It tests game updates, and is wiped occasionally (deleting all of your characters/items).

== In-Game F.A.Q. ==

'''Q: How do I make a character?'''

:Simply select an empty box (you are given 15) and click on the Make button. 

'''Q: What stats should I put for my starting character?'''

:[[Stats]] vary based on which [[Classes|job]] you intend to become.  Individual class pages, as well as other fansite resources are good tools to use when planning a character's build (their stats and [[skills]]).

'''Q: How do I move and attack?'''

:See [[Basic Game Control]] for details. 

'''Q: My [[Novice]]'s [[Job Level]] has stopped at level 10, why is that?'''

:At this point in the game, basic training is complete. Novices can become one of many classes that are available in the game. See: [[Classes]] 

'''Q: What class is the best?'''

:Each class is different in its own way. Some are more useful in [[PVM]] while others are used more for [[PVP]] and [[WoE]]. Some are useful in almost all situations; these are generally the most popular classes. 

'''Q: I'm level xx, where should I level?'''

:There are no generally "good" areas to level. However, politely asking an experienced player is a good starting point. Leveling areas are dependent on class, skills, stats, and gear. For information for some classes and builds, see [[Leveling Spots]].

'''Q: Why did a monster attack me even though I didn't attack it?'''

:That is an aggressive monster and will attack even when unprovoked. There are many types of monsters. See [[Monster]]s for more detail. 

'''Q: How do I make a guild?'''

:See [[Guild System]] for details.

'''Q: What is a Game Master and how do I tell who one is?'''

:See [[Game Master]] for details.

'''Q: Can I transfer my characters to another server?'''

: Transfers between servers are not available.

'''Q: Can I get a Stat or Skill Reset?'''

:Yes, there are some free methods and some methods that requires items (for higher characters). See [[stat reset]] and [[Skills#Skill_Reset|skill reset]] for more information.

'''Q: Can I change my character's name without remaking it?'''

:Using the [http://renewal.playragnarok.com/gameguide/valueaddedservice.aspx Value Added Service], you can rename any character provided the new name isn't in use by anyone else on that server.

'''Q: Can I change my character's gender?'''

:Gender is determined when you make a new character. It is possible to have male and female characters on the same account.

'''Q: Can I move characters between my accounts?'''

:Using the Value Added Service, you can transfer characters between different game accounts under the same Warp Portal account. Characters being moved to an account of the opposite gender will be gender-changed, including [[Dancer]]/[[Bard]] types.

If there are terms you do not understand, please check the [[Glossary]].

== Etiquette & Rules ==

'''Q: I see characters that move by themselves without responding. What are they, and what should I do?'''

:There is a possibility that this is a ''bot''; a program used by players to automate leveling or other activities. Note that sometimes these people are simply busy or are not in a state to talk. If you suspect a bot, send a support ticket to the GMs with the [http://support.warpportal.com/Main/Default.aspx ill-mannered report] option. See [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/82727-how-to-report-bots-effectively/ Reporting Bots Guideline] for more efficient and correct ways to report.

'''Q: How should I deal with annoying players?'''

:First of all, there is the ''/notalkmsg'' command to completely block off all public chat from being written in your chat box. If he is sending private messages, you can block him with the ''/ex <character name>'' command. The best solution for trolls is to simply ignore them.

'''Q: Someone is persistently asking for money/items. How should I respond?'''

:Refuse politely at first, but if the problem escalates you can report them. There is the ''/notrade'' command to automatically refuse deals, if they are constantly requesting for deals.

'''Q: What is the best way to attract people's attention?'''

:Give greetings, and talk to them politely. Respect other people's needs to do other activities. For requesting heals or buffs, ask once or twice. There are many reasons people do not respond. In general, be nice and avoid being demanding. As with all etiquette online, avoid talking in all caps, swearing, or demanding.

== Troubleshooting F.A.Q. ==

'''Q: Why do I get "Failed to get 'xxx.rgz' or 'xxx.gpf'" when patching?'''

:This is either caused by a busy patch server or a previously failed patch. Wait a few minutes and then try again.  If your connection is unreliable or slow (56kbps), an alternative method is to download the individual patch files using a download manager.  The client will use these [[Clients_and_Patches|individual patch files]] instead.

'''Q: Why do I experience lag when playing?'''

:A good connection between client and server depends on the internet service provider (ISP). With a good ISP, lag is minimal. Sometimes, it is the server that is bogged down. In this case, others will experience the lag as well. Frequently, lag problems are caused by problems with servers between the user and the Ragnarok Online server. Use of programs such as Tracert can help in determining what the source of the lag is. With some combinations of hardware and ISP, heavy uploads from other users on the connection will cause unacceptable lag - this would show up on a Tracert as high ping times at the first or second hop. In this case, performance can be improved by ensuring that nobody using the connection is using any peer-to-peer file sharing programs. Another possible cause of lag is the user's computer - this can be due to insufficient hardware for acceptable performance, other programs running in the background, or malware problems. In these cases performance can be improved by closing any other open programs, ensuring the computer is free of any malware, and playing with some of the graphics options (lightmap, fog, effects) disabled. 

'''Q: My character is stuck. How do I become unstuck?'''

:If your character loads completely, and you are stuck in a location you cannot move from, using a {{item |id=601 Fly Wing}} or {{item |id=602 Butterfly Wing}} will fix the problem. Depending on the location, if you are a [[Taekwon Kid|Taekwon]] class, using [[Leap]] will also work. Occasionally a character will become bugged and will not load completely (ex, items are not shown). Relogging will sometimes fix the problem, as will restarting and/or waiting several minutes. If the problem persists, re-install the program and re-patch. If that fails, contact a GM through the website. 

'''Q: What is a Time Gap Error?'''

:It is an error caused by packet loss or extreme network latency (lag). It can sometimes be caused by incorrect network or BIOS settings, but most often is is simply a result of lag. It often occurs in the event of a prolonged "lag spike". 

'''Q: What does the "cannot init D3D or GRF file has a problem!" error mean?'''

:It is an error dealing with graphics. Run the RO setup program, and verify that a graphics mode has been selected in the first option box. If there are no options available, compatible graphics drivers are not installed. Please verify that hardware requirements are fulfilled and drivers are up-to-date. Also, please be sure to have the latest version of DirectX installed. Running Windows in 16-bit color mode may also solve this problem. 

'''Q: Help! I keep getting a "Failed to connect to server." message!'''

:This problem is usually caused by a faulty connection between client and game server. First, make sure the internet is accessible, and that any software firewalls are configured to allow RO to access the internet. If the problem persists, the server may be down, or there may be problems with a server between the user and the Ragnarok Online server. Try again later and check the server status with sites such as [http://www.mercuryserver.de/sv-chk/?service=switchLang&lang=en this]. As a last resort, contact a GM through the website.

<!--'''Q: The patch server is down, can I play without patching?'''
:Yes, it is possible. To start the game and bypass the patcher, you need to start the game with an argument. Either from the command line  or a shortcut, append to ragexe.exe "-1rag1" for the main servers or "-1sak1" for Sakray. Command line example: ''C:\Programs\Ragnarok Online>ragexe.exe -1rag1''. Shortcut example : ''"C:\Programs\Ragnarok Online\ragexe.exe" -1rag1'' (with the quotes). However, without the latest patch, the game client stability is not at its best.-->

title: Game Master
wikitext: '''NOTICE: IF YOU WERE LINKED TO THIS PAGE FROM INSIDE THE GAME IT WAS PROBABLY A [https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/178356-item-scams-and-you/ SCAM]. SUBMIT A [https://support.warpportal.com/Main/Default.aspx SUPPORT TICKET] TO WARPPORTAL.''' __TOC__ '''Game Masters''', commonly known as '''GMs''', are employees of the company that operate the server whose job is to assist players and enforce the rules. == Special Commands == GMs have access to special commands which allow them to perform their job duties in the game. For a list and description of these tasks, see [[Basic_Game_Control#GM_Commands | GM Commands]]. == Identification == === In-game === *The names and public message text of GM characters are displayed in yellow text. *Private messages from GMs are displayed both in the log panel and at the top of the screen, like global messages. *GM names are nearly always in the format 'iRO GM n', where 'n' is a zero-prefixed number, such as '01'. Characters that do not exactly follow this format and are not wearing GM clothing should assumed to be fraudulent. *GMs will never ask for any of your account details in-game; they will always request that you submit account-related queries through the WarpPortal Support Center. *GMs will never ask for your password under any circumstances. *GMs characters have a unique appearance. Males wear a white garment with gold trim, which extends down to the character's feet. Females wear a white miniskirt with gold trim. *GMs will never ask for items or zeny from players for any reason, but they may give items to players as prizes during special events or as compensation for items lost due to circumstances outside of a player's control. If you encounter a character who claims to be a GM but does not meet the aforementioned criteria, you should immediately report it by submitting a ticket to the WarpPortal Support Center. === Official Forums === Community Managers can be identified by their forum rank title below their avatar image, their rank should read "Community Manager". *GMs can be identified by a red username. Other Gravity employees have purple or silver colored names. **When viewing the Moderation Team group listing, they are listed there as part of the group. Which can be viewed [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?app=forums&module=extras§ion=stats&do=leaders here.] Please note that you should NEVER give out or post your Ragnarok Online account login information on the forums. If you need account assistance, please contact the GM Team via the Support Ticket Service. The GM and Community Management Teams will NEVER ask for your Ragnarok Online account password. Do NOT give out your Ragnarok Online account password to anyone you do not trust. [[Category: General Information]]

==About Geffen==
Geffen is the city of magic. It is home to the [[Mage]] and [[Wizard]] guilds. Its most prominent feature is the looming Geffen tower, in the middle of town. 

=== Story===
Geffen is located on the west side of the {{map |id=mjolnir_01 Mt. Mjolnir}} range. Word has it that the city was built by great Wizards of the past as they believed and in magic. The Wizard Magic Academy is located at the center and the Mage Guild is located on the outskirts of the city. It is an ideal place to gather all different sorts of magic equipment. Even until now, the city`s lights are always on as there are many who research and develop more magic. It is also near the {{map |id=glast01 Glast Heim}} Castle where it is said to have housed gods a long time ago.

==Dungeons==

=== {{map|id=gef_dun00 Geffen Tower Dungeon}} === 
A medium-sized dungeon of four maps lies below Geffen. It can be accessed by going down the stairs in Geffen Tower, in the center of the city.

=== Geffenia ===
Geffenia is a subterranean dungeon sealed by the magic of the Geffen Tower and Geffen Fountain. This new dungeon is composed of 4 maps, each with its own beautiful and enchanting scenery. Within it resides a vast array of powerful monsters, some of which are found only there. In order to gain access to the dungeon, one must first acquire {{item|id=7025 Lucifer's Lament}}, a gem that can be obtained through the [[Sign Quest]]. 

=== [[Glast Heim]] ===
Known as the Forbidden City, Glast Heim is located (-7,2) on the world map, one world map square north and three squares west of Geffen. Consisting of a massive sixteen maps, it is the largest dungeon in the game. Based off the Norse Mythology: Glaðsheimr.  If Cool Corp. has won the [[Kafra#Dungeon_Teleport_Elections|Dungeon Teleport Election]], then Cool Corp. employees can teleport you to the entrance for a ???z fee.

Map DB Link: {{map|id=glast_01 Glast Heim}}

See '''[[Glast Heim]]''' for more information.

=== [[Mt. Mjolnir Dead Pit]] ===

The Mt. Mjolnir Dead Pit is an abandoned mine dungeon located to the northeast of Geffen.  The entrance to the Dead Pit is located in the northwest corner of {{map |id=mjolnir_02 Mt. Mjolnir 02}}.  Kafra teleportation services to this dungeon are provided from [[Geffen]] and [[Al De Baran]] for 1,700z.

See '''[[Mt. Mjolnir Dead Pit]]''' for more information.

=== {{map|id=orcsdun01 Orc Dungeon}} ===
A small dungeon several maps South of Geffen that is rabidly infested with undead Orcs. It is located in the Northwest corner of (-4,-1) on the world map. There is also a second entrance (which leads to {{map|id=orcsdun02 Level B2}} of the Orc Dungeon) slightly North-East of the center of the same map.  The Geffen [[Kafra]] employees will teleport you there for 1700z.

=== [[Illusion of Vampire]] ===
A revamped version of Geffen dungeon, collect Illusion Stone and craft Illusion Gears.

#Go back to Minty Errende, and type in the name of the person who changed the lyrics (Kino Kitty). He'll ask for your help again, choose "I can, so stop crying." He'll then tell you that someone in [[Juno]] can help you find Kino Kitty.
#Go to [[Juno]] {{Navi|yuno|93|180}} west of the central circle and enter the building there. Speak to "Representative" and he'll tell you that '''Kino Kitty''' is in [[Morroc]].
#:[[File:Geffen bard representative.png]]
#Go to [[Morocc]] and Kino Kitty is at {{Navi|morocc|134|110}}, standing next to a little girl. Talk to him, and choose "Sorry for interrupting," then "I'm looking for Kino Kitty." He'll tell you that you need a old book of edda for the original lyrics, and that the bookstore is in Juno.
#:[[File:Geffen bard kino.png]]
#Go back to Minty Errende in Geffen, and he'll give you a Seal of Friendship mark on your LEFT hand, and then tell you to go to Mr. Sketzi's bookstore in Juno.
#Go to Juno and Mr Sketzi's bookstore is at {{Navi|yuno|264|87}} a little west of the southeast kafra. Talk to the man behind the counter, and show him your LEFT hand. He'll then let you read the books in the shop. You can have two choices now: read the old book and go to Minty Errende or visit Kino Kitty after talking to Mr Sketzi.
#:[[File:Geffen bard old man.png]]

'''Option A : Read the book.'''

1. Look for the Old Book in the corner and read it. You might want to repeat attempt to read it several times.
Upon success, it will tell you the 8th line is "At Eight, we're both in love." Your character will make a note of this.

* Note: You may need to drop the {{item|id=611 Magnifier}}/s in your inventory so that you can read the Old Book. 

2. Go back to Minty Errende in Geffen, and he'll go through his song and give you EXP in exchange for completing the quest.


'''Option B : Visit Kino Kitty.'''

1. After Mr Sketzi let you to see the book, just go back to Morroc and talk to Kino Kitty. He will replace Mint Errende's friendship mark with his own and then ask you to deliever letter for Errende.

2. Upon visiting Minty Errende again, you will learn the letter contains correct lyrics. After that Minty will sing the song for you and give you EXP reward.

title: Geneticist
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job | jobBase = Biochemist | jobType = 3-2 |jobLevel = 70 | Race = [[Human]] | changesAt = [[Lighthalzen]] | skills = 19 | skillPoints = 108 | questSkills = 0 | str = 4 | agi = 6 | vit = 7 | int = 12 | dex = 8 | luk = 3 }} [[Image:Genetic.png|240px|right]] Geneticists are a rather complex class that require a lot of hard work and dedication to master, but pays off greatly in the end with the ability to solo [[MVP]]s with ease and excel in performance at [[PvP]]. Geneticists are essentially the best [[MVP]] class in the game in terms of versatility and damage per second, but they're also the most expensive class to maintain. Everything about the Geneticist has improved from its former [[Biochemist]] self, including good [[Area of Effect|Area]] skills and the ability to hit [[Ghost]] property monsters with [[Cart Cannon]], much better plant summons, the ability to make even more powerful potions and bombs, and a new evolution of [[Homunculus S|Homunculus]] that will grant powerful support abilities to its owner. [[Mastersmith]]s already brought cart skills beyond the level of a [[Merchant]] class with [[Cart Boost]] and [[High Speed Cart Ram]], but Geneticists go even further. Improving the [[Mastersmith]]'s [[Cart Boost]] by giving it attack boost, even better [[Movement Speed]] boost and adding new skills that allow Geneticists to battle using their cart as a weapon. the Geneticist has become a powerful class capable of destroying any object in its way. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Geneticist Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into a Geneticist from an [[Biochemist]] requires the player to complete 2 tasks: * Gaining knowledge about plants * Learning more about carts After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Geneticist. The test mostly takes place inside of the Geneticist's Lab in [[Lighthalzen]]. === Job Change Quest Skip === Note that you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip] == Alternate Job Sprite == At Base Level 170, you can change your Job Sprite to the alternative jRO version by following the instructions found [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Clothes_Dye#Second_Costume_Ticket here]. Do not be surprised if some of the descriptions differ from the other reputable website contents or current in-game descriptions and/or functions of this system. Here is a quick breakdown of the homunculus and their uses: *'''[[Lif]]''': more of a novelty character. Its skills are fairly worthless and offer nothing to the player other than a walking speed boost that will be replaced anyways as a [[Geneticist]] with [[Cart Boost (Geneticist)|Cart Boost]]. Its attack is low, has no burst attacks, and its healing skill, [[Healing Hands]], does not heal much and is generally not worth using. It is strongly advised '''NOT''' to use it as a base, as it generally has no practical use. *'''[[Amistr]]''': generally the '''best base''' for a [[Homunculus S]]. Its [[Amistr Bulwark]] skill is very valuable for [[MVP]]ing later on as it boosts [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] and even offer some defense that can be useful for [[PvP]]. [[Castling]] can be very useful to rapidly move around and escape dire situations. Its high base HP can help Homunculus S reach over 200 thousand HP due to scaling. *'''[[Filir]]''': can get high flee which doesn't get reduced by mob amount. The big downside is the lack of [[Stats#VIT|VIT]], which carries over to [[Homunculus S]]. Offensive skills are mostly useless cause not enough hit at the effective levels, Its loyal evolved skill, [[S.B.R.44]], is usually skipped as it is not terribly useful (could be used by spending homunculus tablets, although not recommended). *'''[[Vanilmirth]]''': Best for brewing and '''possibly''' leveling before 3rd class. It offers the high [[Stats#VIT|VIT]] and [[Max HP]], has a decent offensive skill. Its [[Caprice]] skill can be unreliable, as it picks a random [[element|property]] to use, but one of the only ways to hit higher level monsters. It is a solid choice though for all players to use as a base, and many players skip the loyal evolved skill, [[Self-Destruction]], as it is not used very often. It is also desirable as a base for a [[Homunculus S]], for players who plan on becoming pure brewers, because [[Instruction Change]] increases the brewing success rate. {{Navbox Alchemist}} {{Navbox Classes |state=collapsed}}

title: Getting Started
wikitext:
Plunging headfirst into Ragnarok Online is fun, but newer players will benefit from having some knowledge of what will occur during the game. Remember, though, that Ragnarok, like all MMORPGs, are dynamic and things constantly change.

== Creating A Character ==
{{Update}}
Before you can start playing, you need to set up a '''character''' (the person you will play as). Once you have logged in, you will be presented with a Server choice window. After this, you will see a number of empty boxes. Over time you can fill these boxes with various characters. 

You will now need to choose your character's race, appearance, and name. Select a hairstyle and color (the clothes you wear will be determined later by your class), and fill in a name.

Once you enter Ragnarok Online's world, you will be able to give your character his or her basic '''[[Stats]]''' (in non-iRO servers, you might have to make this step in the Character Selection screen).
*It is recommended that you look at the various '''[[Classes]]''' and select the one you like.
*You can play as any class you want, but first, select the first class or expanded class type.
*As you progress in the game, your level will rise and eventually you can then change into more advanced classes.

[[File:StatWindow.png]]

There are 6 stats: [[STR]], [[AGI]], [[VIT]], [[INT]], [[DEX]], and [[LUK]]. You'll notice that you can only achieve a certain set of stats right now; you can raise them later in the game.
*Check out your desired class's information and find out which stats you need first.
*For example, if you would like to be a [[Swordsman]], it would be usually among STR, DEX, and VIT or AGI.
*However, since you can't get all of them, just try getting a mix. Don't worry, it's normal to have a few messy stats.

Now create your character and follow the walkthrough provided in [[Izlude]] Town and Criatura Academy!

== Introduction to the World of Ragnarok ==

The world is divided up into a vast variety of regions. There are '''Towns''' where you are safe and can chat with other players; there are '''Fields''', the regions right out of towns where you can encounter wild monsters; finally there are '''Dungeons''', where more challenging travels await.

=== Finding Where You are ===

Use the '''/where''' command in the chatbox to find out where you are. You will get a map name and coordinates. If you're completely lost and have some friends, you can give them your location and they'll find you.

Tip: Remember, you have a [[World Map]] to help you find your way if you get lost.

=== Traveling ===

Getting from place to place is a common task you will need to do. There are many ways to get around. Using a '''Kafra Employee''' is the most common way to move around cities. [[Prontera#Travel_NPCs|Prontera]], [[Juno#Travel_NPCs|Juno]], and [[Eden_Group#Aperture|Eden]] provide enough choices and flexibility to be the key areas to travel.

==== Returning to your Save Point ====

Each character will have a '''save point'''. This is the place where you will return to if all goes wrong (for example, you get killed). To set your save point, find a '''Kafra''' in one of the cities (you can ask around if you don't know where).

If you get lost in your journeys and just want to get home, you can return to your save point by dying, using an Eden Group Mark or Butterfly Wing item, or relogging (going to the "select character" screen and back) on certain maps.

==Cards==
The following cards concern the Ghost property. See each item description for further details.
===Weapon===
*{{item|id=4202 Mao Guai Card}}: Increases damage on Ghost property entities by 20%.
===Headgear===
*{{item|id=4598 Lichtern Yellow Card}}: Increases Ghost property magic damage by 5%. When upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases Ghost property magic damage by an additional 5%.
===Armor===
*{{item|id=4047 Ghostring Card}}: Endows the armor with the Level 1 Ghost property.
*{{item|id=4457 '''Naght Seiger Card'''}}: Increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 30%.

===Garment===
*{{item|id=4113 Marionette Card}}: Decreases Ghost property damage by 30%.
*{{item|id=4102 Whisper Card}}: Increases damage from Ghost property attacks by 50%.
*{{item|id=4576 '''Gioia Card'''}}: Increases {{Tooltip|Ghost element magical attack|As well as Wind element magic attack}} by 100%. Increases damage taken from Ghost property attacks by 30%.
*{{item|id=4580 '''Kades Card'''}}: Increases damage taken from Ghost property attacks by 100%.

===Accessory===
*{{item|id=4577 Elvira Card}}: Increases {{Tooltip|Ghost element magic attack|As well as Wind element magic attack}} by 20%.

==Equipment==
The following equipment concern the Ghost property. See each item description for further details.
===Headgear===
*{{Item|id=420003 CD in Mouth Type K}}: Increases damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 5%.
*{{Item |id=400054 Great Magician's Ceremonial Crown [1]}}: If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 15%.
*{{item|id=15165 Pure White Marching Hat [1]}}: When performing a physical attack or skill, there is a (2 * hat upgrade level)% chance of endowing the user's weapon with Ghost property for 60 seconds.

===Weapon===
*{{Item|id=26164 Electric Fox-OS [2]}}: If upgrade level is +9 or higher, increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 15%.
*{{item|id=1138 Mysteltainn}}: Increases physical damage on Ghost property targets by 15%.
===Garment===
*{{Item|id=20845 Malach's Skin}} [1]: Reduces damage taken from Ghost property attacks by 5%.
===Shoes===
*{{Item|id=22197 Illusion Leg Type B [1]}} : If upgrade level is +7 or higher, increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 5%.
===Accessory===
*{{Item|id=28507 Magician's Gloves [1]}}]: Increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 5%.
*{{Item|id=490079 Soul Expansion Ring [1]}}: If [[Stasis]] is level 5, increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 10%.
*{{Item |id=28575 Verus Core [1]}}: Increases physical damage on Ghost property targets by 5%.

===Equipment Sets===
*[[Equipment_Sets#Consultation_Robe_.26_Morrigane.27s_Manteau_Set|Consultation Robe & Morrigane's Manteau Set]]: The users property becomes Level 1 Ghost.
*[[Equipment_Sets#Flying_Galapago_.26_Condor_Card_Set|Flying Galapago & Condor Card Set]] - Reduces damage taken from Ghost property attacks by 5%.
*[[Equipment_Sets#Illusion_Engine_Wing_Type_B_.26_Illusion_Leg_Type_B_Set|Illusion Engine Wing Type B & Illusion Leg Type B Set]]: Increases the damage of Ghost property magical attacks on targets by 10%.

==Notes==
Wearing ghost elemental armor will reduce damage from player neutral attacks and skills (such as [[Acid Bomb]], [[Gates of Hell]], [[Guillotine Fist]], [[Slug Shot]], [[God's Hammer]], and [[Dragon Tail]]). However, it WILL NOT reduce neutral autoattacks because monsters 'neutral' attack are considered as nonelemental and only reduce-able by Raydric Card, Deviling Card, Noxious Card, Vali Manteau and other gears/cards that modify neutral property damage.

'''Time Limit''': 1 hour
'''Map Name''': 1@spa To start this quest, you have to use the Dimensional Device located on [[Rune Midgard Allied Forces Post]] within the [[New World]]. It will warp you into the [[Dimensional Gap]]. Enter the second map of Dimensional Gap. The portal is located at {{navi|dali|64|128}}, near the Sapha. #Talk to '''Unpleasent Royal Guard''' {{navi|dali02|43|129}} in Dimensional Gap to start the quest: #::[[File:DG_UnpleasentRoyalGuard.png|250px]] #When instance is ready, click on Interdimensional Device and select Enter. #Talk to '''King''' to start. You will see '''Lurid Royal Guard''' is appointed as '''Princess Tiara''''s bodyguard for her marriage with a prince. Somehow you see monsters attack the palace. Kill all of those monsters to open portal to second stage (north end of room). #:Monsters: Bloody Murderer, Ragged Zombie. #Talk to '''Lurid Royal Guard''' (132, 122). Somehow the monsters are still attacking the palace. Clear the monsters to open portal to 3rd stage (117, 137). #:Monsters: Dark Frame, Flame Skull, Wind Ghost. #You will be inside a prison. Talk to '''King''' (32, 54) to advance the quest. '''Lurid Royal Guard''' is accused as the culprit behind the monsters attack. Cursed Spirit Thanatos will grant him the way out. Kill every monster on every jail chamber until announcement that the exit portal appears (54, 28). Quickly go to southeast corner portal as a big mob of undeads come at you. No need to kill them, but this is a good place to farm Gray Shard since this is the stage where most number of mobs appear. (The announcement and mobspawn will happened one additional time after the first clearup, so you can farm in total the monsters to open exit and two attackwaves.) #:Monsters: Skeleton Prisoner, Zombie Prisoner, Ghoul. #Kill the monsters. After enough monster killed, you will see king and his soldier fall on the ground. Talk to '''Lurid Royal Guard''', you will see that the '''Visiting Prince''' is the real culprit. He will transform into Torturous Redeemer. Kill it and make sure to grab Gray Shard from it since it drops 2. Kill the last monster to open next portal (southwest corner). #:Monsters: Khalitzburg, Bloody Murderer. #You will be inside the prison again. Talk to '''Princess Tiara''' (216, 43), and you will find out that she is dying. Kill monsters in every jail chamber until another Torturous Redeemer come. No need to kill it since '''Sakray''' will do the job ('''Note:''' Killing the Redeemer fast enough however gives you additional gray shards.). Talk to '''Sakray''' (196, 44). Now '''Sakray''' already changed, granted new power from Thanatos Spirit. #:Monsters: Dullahan, Skogul, Skeleton Prisoner #This marks the end of the instance. An exit portal will appear in south east (210, 28). Before you go, you can talk to '''King''' (205, 29) to trade Gray Shards for Thanatos weapons and Gray equipment. Each weapon requires 200 Gray Shards and each Gray equipment requires 100 Gray Shards. {{Articles Needing DB Links}} 

''Shadows of Terror: Glast Heim''

===Story===
The Ruins of what was once the capital of Rune Kingdom, whose warriors were so powerful that other nations thought of them as Super Entities.
Legends say that the king of that kingdom was seeking more power from the sacred tomes hidden deep inside of the Ancient Tower of Geffenia, so he sent Assassins to steal it from there. Little did he know that by reading the tomes he unleashed evil powers over his kingdom; so powerful that it damned every soul into infinite torment.
The king name was lost, now he is only known as the Dark Lord, and what is left from Glast Heim citizens are now fearsome monsters feasting on the flesh and souls of wanderers.
Lately some adventurers reported hearing explosions from inside the Ruins, no body knows what happened exactly.

Any regular player can complete the Seal of Sleipnir, Megingjard, Brisingamen, and Mjolnir, and collect the rewards for it. These quests are simply named after the God Items. *Many players will refer to the quests simply by the order they are in for simplicity (Sleipnir = Seal 1, Megingjard = Seal 2, Brisingamen = Seal 3, Mjolnir = Seal 4) ==Reset== It is possible for a character can reset their Seal status and progress. Note that this resets '''all''' of the seals' progress and resets all of them as "not complete". If the character has finished part of one seal but has not completed it, they would have to start from the beginning again after using the reset. Certain players may wish to complete all four seals and collect all the rewards before resetting the status of it. Other players may choose to only complete certain quests and reset right after, usually to repeatedly complete a faster quest like Seal 1 or to repeatedly get the EXP reward of Seal 2. A reset requires one Magical Stone (Reset Stone). To perform the reset, go to [[Nifflheim]] Town, enter the house at {{Navi|niflheim|167|161}} and go to the top of the stairs. There is an NPC there with a Deviruchi sprite, which is also the same NPC that performs a [[Divorce]]. Talk to the NPC, and confirm the dialogue to reset the seals. ==Quest Progress== This quest is composed of four smaller quests; in each quest, when 50 players complete it, the seal of the next quest will "opened", and all players on the server have access to that next subquest. When 100 players complete it, a seal is "closed" and that particular subquest cannot cannot be started/completed. Basically, each quest needs to be completed 50 times for the general quest to progress; the remaining 50 times before the quest is closed is simply for those who would like the rewards. When all four seals have closed, a God Item can be created. When that is accomplished everything returns to zero. Serverwide broadcasts notify players when a seal is opened or closed. == Seal of Sleipnir (Seal #1) == ''Main Article: [[Seal of Sleipnir]]'' *Note: Players must be lvl 70 and above to complete this quest. At least 50 players need to complete this quest before the [[Seal of Megingjard]] will become available. After 100 players have completed this quest, it will close. == Seal of Megingjard (Seal #2)== ''Main Article: [[Seal of Megingjard]]'' *Note: Players must be lvl 60 and above to complete this quest. At least 50 players need to complete this quest before the [[Seal of Brisingamen]] will become available. After 100 players have completed this quest, it will close. == Seal of Brisingamen (Seal #3) == ''Main Article: [[Seal of Brisingamen]]'' *Note: Players must be lvl 70 and above to complete this quest. At least 50 players need to complete this quest before the [[Seal of Mjolnir]] will become available. After 100 players have completed this quest, it will close. == Seal of Mjolnir (Seal #4) == ''Main Article: [[Seal of Mjolnir]]'' *Note: After 100 players have completed this quest, it will close. *Note: This quest can only be completed if the [[Seal of Brisingamen]] has opened. == Making the God Items (Guild Leaders Only) == *Note: You must be a Guild Leader with Guild Dungeon access to complete this quest. 1. When the 4 Seals are all released, a Server Message says "All the Seals have been Released" or "The [Some Seal] Seal along with all the Seals have been released." 2. There is a Dwarf NPC in each Guild Dungeon named '''Granburti'''. Talk to him. 3. Choose option 3 about Weapon Creation and then he will assume which item you would like to make based on the items in your inventory. 3. You're teleported to a long blue hall with a door at the end and a waiting room chat-sign. Enter the chat to be taken to the final room. 4. You have 10 minutes to walk about 30 paces, find the NPC in the center and talk to him. Make sure you have all the items on you, or you cannot make the god item. Making the god item involves saying yes on a menu and just having the items in your inventory, no typing, quest, or input-item menu involved. 5. Receive item, log out. Seals reset. You can also stay for the entire duration of 10 minutes inside the room after creating the item, you merely get kicked out to north Prontera near the [[Kafra]]. *Note: If you happen to get to the waiting room and someone is already in there, you can go in to see the Dwarf in the center of the next room after the person already inside leaves. If they made a God Item, you cannot. If they didn't, you get 10 minutes to try. *Note 2: Leaders won't be allowed inside the creation room if they do not have all the items needed to make an item. *Note 3: If you're making a Megingjard, you must first assemble your pieces into a Gleipnir. To do so, speak to the first NPC of the Seal of Megingjard quest, '''Rebarev Doug''' in Prontera castle {{navi|prt_castle|180|269}}. He will be surprised to see your set and offer to put it together for you. == God Item Trading == '''Godly Item Confiscator''' {{Navi|prontera|160|326}} == God Item Ingredients == {| == Castle Investment ==
Your castle needs to have an economy 65(iRO), and 30 defense, in order to be able to start Okolnir.

*Need confirmation for other servers

== Overview ==
This quest involves making your way though the Okolnir Dungeon. The dungeon is a trial set out by the Valkyries where a team of up to 20 players must attempt to clear a series of difficult challenges. There is a time limit of one hour to complete the quest. Should your group fail and run out of time, there is a 13 hour delay (from the time the instance is destroyed) before you can make another attempt. Within the dungeon there is no death penalty, but most monsters are not worth experience or do not have drops.

== Quest ==

'''Step 1: The Garden Labyrinth''' 

When you first enter, the players in your party will be scattered randomly throughout a large hedge maze. This maze has barricades in the form of colored flowers, which prevent you from passing. Every minute or two these flowers shift color and position, effectively re-organizing the maze. These flowers can be killed using certain skills, however killing them will not make the space they used to occupy passable, so there is essentially no way to bypass them.

When you spawn, you will appear next to a first class apparition of yourself (similar to Biolaboratory Floor 2 monsters). This monster will have your base job and name. When all of the monsters die, a series of 99 transcendent ghosts will spawn randomly within the maze (same as the Biolaboratory Floor 3 level 99 monsters). When all these ghosts die, the plant barriers will vanish and you will be allowed to leave the maze. 

'''Step 2: Passage through the Sky''' 

You will have to follow a winding passage through the sky to reach your next objective. Aggressive Garden Watchers will attack you here. In order to open access to the following area, you must find and kill the non-aggressive Garden Keepers along the way. They will drop a {{Item List |id=7839 |item= Crystal Key |simple=yes}} at 90% chance. The keys are account bound once picked-up; therefore, they cannot be dropped or traded. Meaning all the members have to pick up their own key in order to advance. Everyone doing the quest needs to get 1 key to enter the next area; however, only 1 member is needed to enter and activate the next step. 
'''Note:''' It is suggested to wait for everyone in the party to have a key before entering the portal.

'''Step 3: Battle Versus {{monster|id=1930 Piamette}}''' 

You enter a large room, with Piamette sitting near the center. Piamette cannot be attacked at this time. Randomly, 6 of your teammates will be captured and placed petrified in cages around the outskirts of the room. The remaining players will be attacked by a large number of Violies, Alices, and Ancient Mimics. When all the monsters are dead, 6 barricades will appear near the cages. By destroying the barricades, your teammates will be freed. Be warned, as there is a very high spawn rate of constants near the barricades. 

At this point, Piamette will become angry with you and attack your party. You must defeat her in order to move on. 

'''Step 4: Temple''' 

After leaving Piamette's room you will be greeted by the NPC of the Valkyrie Wish Maiden. You must clear your way through a temple filled with Frus, Skogul, and Garden Watchers. There are extremely large numbers of monsters here; it is estimated that there are nearly 150-250 Frus and Skogul in a relatively small area. You must kill all the monsters here and make it to the top of the temple. 

'''Step 5: Battle Versus Valkyrie Wish Maiden''' 

Having made it to the top of the temple, the monster Valkyrie Wish Maiden will appear. You must defeat the Valkyrie Wish Maiden at this time to finish the quest.

=== Valkyrie's Gift ===
Following the successful completion of the quest, the Wish Maiden will reward the item-maker with Valkyrie's Gift. The item can be used to summon various monsters in [[Juno]] or [[Rachel]] for an hour.

==Overview==
[[File:Grade_Location.png|thumb|right|200px|Grading location in Prontera]]
Lv 5 Weapon and Lv 2 Armor can be enhanced by increasing its '''grade''', which will give various bonuses. Higher grade equipment retains all the bonuses from the lower grade, and will also give bigger bonus from [[Refinement_System#Effects_Gained|refinement]]. Talk to '''S'ratos''' {{Navi|grademk|34|184}} to do grading and crafting grade materials.
*Grading equipment successfully will reset its refine rate to +0.
*All enchantment and cards will be preserved during grading process.

== Ether Dust Costs ==

* Total Ether Dust needed just for grading from No Grade to Grade D is 75. Each attempt for No Grade to Grade D costs 75 Ether Dust (15 Ether Stones).
* Total Ether Dust needed just for grading from No Grade to Grade C is 225. Each attempt for Grade D to Grade C costs 150 Ether Dust (30 Ether Stones).
* Total Ether Dust needed just for grading from No Grade to Grade B is 475. Each attempt for Grade C to Grade B costs 250 Ether Dust (50 Ether Stones).
* Total Ether Dust needed just for grading from No Grade to Grade A is 1225. Each attempt for Grade B to Grade A costs 750 Ether Dust (150 Ether Stones).

These 3 tiers are often referred to as "Low TI", "Mid TI", and "High TI". [[Bounty_Board_Quests#Hugel|Hugel (120-140)]] || - |} ===Notes=== '''For a list of turn-ins prior to this week, see the [[Weekly Turn-In Events/Archive]] page.''' '''The current week's turn-in quests can usually be found in the pinned maintenance notes here:''' '''[http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/forum/227-renewal-server-events/ Renewal Patch Notes]''' * ''Each quest '''is repeatable''' so long as the player remains within the level limits.'' * ''As long as the player has a "'''Hunting Timer'''" or "'''Monster Hunting'''" quest, they can still enter the appropriate map, even if out of level bounds.'' * ''Kills from a party member increases a player's count if they can '''see that party member on their screen'''.'' * ''[[Mercenary System|Mercenary]] and [[Homunculus System|Homunculus]] kills '''will''' increase kill counts. '''The player just has to see the Mercenary or Homunculus doing so.''' * '' [[VIP]] accounts can combine the [[EXP]] reward to go only towards [[Base EXP]] or [[Job EXP]]. * ''Once a VIP character has completed a quest for their level limit, it can be reset immediately (with a {{item|id=6320 Magical Stone}}), with a 3-hour cooldown for future resets. Players without VIP must complete both quests. * ''Turn ins are on event maps which you can be sent to by the '''Gramps''' NPC. * ''Completing each turn-in will also reward the player with 65,000 Zeny (130,000 zeny for completing both).'' ** ''VIP players are awarded 2-3 Bullions per quest instead which can be sold in the [[Kafra Mail Annex Station]]. Low TI rewards Silver Bullion, Mid TI rewards Gold Bullion, while High TI rewards Platinum Bullion.'' == Delay Mechanics == A delay of '''16 hours''' exist for players doing Turn-In quests, to prevent excessive EXP gains. As a result, it's often beneficial for players to do Turn-Ins when available, and go to other maps in between delays. The delay can be removed using a {{Item|id=6320 {{tooltip|Magical Stone|Reset Stone}}}}, but this reset mechanism also has a delay of '''3 hours'''. Due to how these quests work, it's possible to complete multiple Turn-Ins in a short period of time, allowing players to use a single Battle Manual on more than one EXP gain. '''Hunting Timer''' quest logs are given when the player ''takes a Turn-In'' and dictates when the player can next retake this same monster Turn-In. * A duration of 16 hours (starting from when the quest is taken) applies. * This timer is erased instantly whenever it has expired by talking to Gramps (no chat option necessary). * Players ''cannot'' retake this monster's Turn-In whenever this quest log exists. '''Monster Hunting''' quests logs (replace "Monster" with the actual monster name) are given alongside the "Hunting Timer" quests. * Each monster kill is accumulated on this quest. * No duration is applied; it can last forever. * This can be erased by selecting "I want to stop hunting" when talking to Gramps (this gives no reward), or by finishing the quest by picking "Reward Me!" * Players ''cannot'' retake this monster's Turn-In whenever this quest log exists. '''Reset Stone Timer''' quest logs are applied after a player uses a {{Item|id=6320 {{tooltip|Magical Stone|Reset Stone}}}} by selecting "Can you erase my timer?" at Gramps - but only if they're not under another Reset Stone delay. * The reset process cannot be done as long as another "Reset Stone Timer" exists. * A duration of 3 hours (starting from the last reset process) applies. * Like the "Hunting Timer", this will be erased instantly once it has expired by talking to Gramps. * The reset process ''will erase all previous "Reset Stone Timer" and "Hunting Timer" quests'', and then apply a new "Reset Stone Timer". === Consecutive Turn-In Strategies === A player can easily do two turn-ins rapidly by doing the following in order: # Take the Turn-In quest, gaining "Hunting Timer" and "Monster Hunting" quest logs. # Kill 400 of each monster, completing the "Monster Hunting" kill counts. # Wait for the previous "Reset Stone Timer" to expire. The player can now do a reset. # Activate a Battle Manual. # Request rewards and gain [[EXP]]. This removes the "Monster Hunting" quests. # Do a reset. This removes the "Hunting Timer" quests (while imposing another 3-hour delay). # Take the Turn-In quest again. # Kill 400 of each monster within the Battle Manual's duration. # Request rewards immediately once the kill count is complete. # 3 to 6 hours later, reset again to proceed to step 1. This allows the Battle Manual to span two Turn-In rewards, potentially giving very large sums of [[EXP]]. It '''does not actually bypass any delay'''; a 6-hour cooldown exists between each run. It's also possible to rapidly do 3 turn-ins by using the way reset stones only erase "Hunting Timer" quests, regardless of the state of any "Monster Hunting" quests: # Take the Turn-In quest, gaining "Hunting Timer" and "Monster Hunting" quest logs. # Kill 400 of each monster (anytime between now and before using the Battle Manual). # Wait for the previous "Reset Stone Timer" to expire. # Do a reset. This removes the "Hunting Timer" quests, while the in-progress "Monster Hunting" quests are untouched. # At this point, a "Reset Stone Timer" exists, but the player can already retake. # Wait for 3 hours so the "Reset Stone Timer" expires. # At this point, the player already has ongoing "Monster Hunting" quests, can immediately retake (due to the lack of "Hunting Timer" quest logs), and can do another reset. # Complete the kill count. # Activate a Battle Manual. # Request rewards and gain [[EXP]]. # Without resetting, immediately retake the Turn-In quest again. This is possible since the earlier reset removed the "Hunting Timer" quests. # Complete the kill count. # Request rewards and gain [[EXP]] a second time. # Do a reset. # Complete the kill count. # Request rewards and gain [[EXP]] a third time; hopefully, the Battle Manual is still active. # 3 hours later, reset again to proceed to step 1. This process, while trickier, can yield much better experience if the player can finish all two kill count quests within one Battle Manual. This method still imposes a 9-hour delay between runs, although the player needs to come online to do resets in between. {{Navbox Eden}} {{Navbox iRO Custom}} {{Navbox Leveling}}

title: Group A Songs
Group B Songs
Grouping
wikitext:
As in any other MMORPG, leveling alone can become tiresome. RO allows players to group together in different ways. Refer to the main article links for in-depth information on a particular method of grouping. 

== Parties ==
:''Main Article: [[Party]]''

For quick groupings with one or more people, players can create a party and invite others in, or be invited themselves to another party. 

Through partying, players can choose to share EXP and items equally with all other players in the party on the same map. However, all players in the party must be within 15 levels of each other for share to work. EXP given by monsters is the same as normal even in a party, however when multiple players engage a monster (either take or receive damage from it), the EXP from that monster increases. This is known as EXP Tap.

Partying is also a great way to take down difficult bosses or progress through dungeons: "Together we stand, divided we fall." Many players look for parties before leaving for hunts; try checking cities and other areas where people gather. For support classes, such as many [[Acolyte]]s, parties are a good way to obtain EXP, since they usually cannot directly hunt themselves.

== Guilds ==
:''Main Article: [[Guild System]]''

When players have many friends that play regularly together, it can be beneficial for them to start a guild. Guilds are larger than parties, and allow up to 56 characters to join (Max Level of the [[Guild Extension]] skill). Guilds do not allow members to share EXP directly, but they do allow members to easily see when other members are online and easily communicate through the exclusive guild chat channel. 

The biggest reason to create or join a guild for most players is to participate in [[War of Emperium]], or Siege Mode. For this end, players can also contribute a portion of their [[Base EXP]] to their guild to gain guild levels which allows special guild skills to be obtained. 

== Clans ==
:''Main Article: [[Clan System]]''

== Friends List ==
This list lets players keep in touch with friends you meet during their adventures.  To access it, use the Alt+H shortcut through the keyboard (This shortcut can be changed from option --> shortcuts). Adding a person to the list lets you know when they log on and log off, and also lets players quickly communicate and make parties with each other.  The friends list is saved server-side, so no matter which PC a player uses, they'll always know whether their friends are on.  The list currently holds a maximum of 40 people/character's list.  With 15 characters, a maximum of 600 friends can be stored. Because people tend to make multiple characters, and their friends also make multiple characters, the friends list is a bit inefficient or ineffective due to this.

{{Community Guides}} ==Overview== This guide will show how to install and customize AI. ==Install Instructions== Kisaro's fork of AzzyAI will be used as an example since it's updated with 4th jobs: [https://github.com/Kisaro/AzzyAI GitHub Link]
Follow the instructions on his [https://github.com/Kisaro/AzzyAI#install GitHub page] . After finishing it, your USER_AI folder should look something like below. : [[File:AI Customization-AI folder result.png]] ==Homunculus== ===General Suggestions=== *To use this custom AI, go in game and type /hoai until chatbox says Homunculus has been customized. *To configure AI settings, go into your computer's RO folder -> AI folder -> USER_AI folder and run '''AzzyAIConfig.exe''' *:[[File:AzzyAIConfig_exe_pic.png]] **Note: After applying changes, relogging game character is enough to have changes take effect. {{clear}} ===Passive Behavior=== This will make your homunculus not attack unless you tell it to. #On your computer, open '''AzzyAIConfig.exe'''. #On the Homunculus tab, change '''SuperPassive''' to '''True'''. #:[[File:AICustomization-SuperPassive-True.png]] #After all done, at the bottom press '''Apply Settings'''. #Go to character select, then back online to see if changes take effect. {{clear}} ===Aggressive Behavior=== This will make your homunculus attack anything it sees. #On your computer, open '''AzzyAIConfig.exe'''. #On the Homunculus tab, make sure '''SuperPassive''' is set to '''False'''. #On Homunculus Tactics tab set Basic Behavior to '''Attack (high)''' , then press '''Apply Settings''' at the bottom. #Go to character select, then back online to see if changes take effect. {{clear}} ==Mercenary== *To make mercenary automatically attack non-moving enemies like Ant Egg: *#On your computer, open '''AzzyAIConfig.exe'''. *#On the Mercenary tab, set '''AutoDetectPlant''' to '''False'''. *#:[[File:AICustomization-AutoDetectPlant-False.png]] *#After all done, at the bottom press '''Apply Settings'''. *#Go to character select, then back online to see if changes take effect. {{clear}} {{Navbox Community Guides}} {{clear}}

title: Guide:Beginner Tips
wikitext:
This is a guide for new players compiled from members of the community. Feel free to suggest changes on the [[Talk:Guide:Beginner_Tips|Talk Page!]]
This is a general purpose guide focused on the early stages of character progression, it is encouraged for new and returning players to keep the spirit of adventure and independent thought amidst the age of Artificial Intelligence. == Useful Articles == *[[Introduction to Ragnarok Online]] *[[Classes|A list of all Job Classes and how Job Progression works]] *[[Getting Started|More useful tips for new players]] *[[Basic Game Control|In-game commands and controls]] *[[IRO Servers Comparison|Account perks for purchasing VIP]] *[[Glossary|A list of commonly used acronyms and abbreviations]] *[[Frequently Asked Questions]] == Character Creation == * Currently there are 9 Character Slots available for use. :[[File:Character_Select.png|500px]] *Select an empty slot to create a character, here you have a choice to pick a race between {{tooltip | '''Human''' | The Human player race was originally defined as Player, before the introduction of the Doram player race.}} or {{tooltip | '''Doram''' | A playable cat character race. Doram players start out as Summoners, and begin their adventure in the town of Lasagna.}}. :[[File:Character_Creation.png|500px]] * Afterwards select your character's Gender, Hairstyle, Hair Color, and your Character's Name == Starting Area == :[[File:Starting_Area.png|463px]] Depending on the race you selected, you will spawn on different starting areas. Humans will be on a ship while Dorams will start in [[Lasagna]]. Here, you will be introduced to an optional tutorial which you can skip. * Dorams who starts the tutorial cannot leave Lasagna until completing the entire tutorial questline. * Leaving Lasagna to [[Izlude]] costs 200 [[Zeny]]. == Heading to Izlude == Izlude is a satellite town which all new characters begin their adventure, now if you're wondering how to get here when skipping the starting area, we will be using the [[Navigation|Navigation System]]. * One way is to use the /navi command which will be used throughout the guides found here in '''iROWiki''', now click on this {{Navi|izlude|196|209}} and open the chat box in-game by pressing Enter and lastly paste the copied command to the chat box (Ctrl+V) and hit Enter to send. ** If you don't see anything to click on, refresh the page. :[[File:Navi_Command.png|587px]] * Arrows will appear, indicating where to go (Note: This is not a perfect system and may sometimes not work or lead you to dead ends). **Humans will already have arrows to direct them outside the ship, apply the command after leaving the ship. **Dorams will need 200z on hand for the transport fee, hunt monsters and sell their drops here {{Navi|lasagna|166|116}}. * Another Way to use the Navigation System is to open the Navigation Window. :[[File:Navigation_Tool.png|500px]] * This opens the Navigation Window, here you can search for Maps, Monsters and NPC locations using the search function. :[[File:Navigation_Window.png|540px]] == Criatura Academy == 1. Criatura Acedemy is located at the Northern part of Izlude and '''Humans''' are required to register before setting off on their adventure, head to {{Navi|iz_ac01|101|38}} and speak with '''Academy receptionist''' to register. * '''Dorams''' can skip to [[Guide:Beginner Tips#Eden Group|here]]. :[[File:Academy_receptionist.png|147px]] 2. Registration will grant you free equipment and potions: * {{Item List |id=2352|item=Tattered Novice Ninja Suit|simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=2510|item=Somber Novice Hood |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=2414|item=Novice Slippers |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=5055|item=Novice False Eggshell |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=1243|item=Novice Main-Gauche |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=2112|item=Novice Guard |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=18730|item=Criatura Academy Hat |slots=1 |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=569|item=Novice Potion |simple=yes |num=300}} * {{Item List |id=6593|item=Criatura Hair Cupon |simple=yes}}
** Beginners without any knowledge about the game are free to speak to NPCs around izlude and the Academy with the Quest Marker to learn more about the basic features of the game. 3. Talk to Sprakki by the counter for her introductions, then talk to her again for the introduction quest for the [[Kafra|Kafra Services]]. *'''Alt+U''' is the shortcut command to view the Quest Window 4. Move to {{Navi|izlude|127|147}} and talk to the Kafra Employee who will explain the services they provide, afterwards will have you deliver a box to '''Morris''' at the Izlude Merchant's Building {{Navi|izlude_in|69|116}} :[[File:Morris.png|142px]] 5. Find '''Ur''' at {{Navi|prt_fild08|319|229}}
6. Talk to the '''Kid''' at {{Navi|prt_fild08|225|230}} * Hunt 2 Lunatics * Obtain 1 Clover ** Make sure to pick up as much loot as possible to sell for Zeny (at least 500z) 7. Return to the '''Kid''' and after some dialogue, talk to '''Rumin''' who gives you a Red Herb.
8. Return to '''Ur''' who will explain about the basic classes.
9. Go back to Izlude and talk to Morris.
10. Return to the Criatura Academy and find the Healer {{Navi|iz_ac01|60|43}} to show the Combination Kit.
* At this point, you should have reached Job Level 10, else do some tutorials or hunt monsters. :[[File:Job10.png|212px]] Open your Skill Window (Alt+S) and click on Basic Skill until it reaches +9, then click on Apply and Press Ok. == First Job Change == [[Novices]] who reach Job Level 10 and have Basic Skill Lv.9 can now pick a [[Classes|Class]] to pursue. The Classes fall into two categories, '''Main Classes''' and '''Expanded Classes''': * [[Swordman]], [[Mage]], [[Archer]], [[Acolyte]], [[Merchant]], and [[Thief]] are '''Main Classes'''. * [[Gunslinger]], [[Ninja]], [[TaeKwon Kid]], and [[Super Novice]] are '''Expanded Classes'''. *[[Summoner]] (Doram) are considered an '''Expanded Class''' but operate somewhat differently than the other classes in terms of Job progression. You also receive a '''Job Change Map''' through the [[RODEX]] (the in-game mail system) to give you in-game coordinates to the Job Change locations. You can keep this in your inventory even after changing if you chose a Main Class whom will eventually undergo [[Rebirth]]. Expanded Classes can discard the Job Change Map after Job Change. :[[File:Job_Map.png|271px]] === Main First Class Job Change Locations === You have 2 options for changing to your First Job Class: #Talking to the relevant instructor on the 2nd Floor of the Academy #Traveling/being warped to the relevant Guild and talking to the Guild Leader there It's better for new players to know where the actual guilds are early on for when they [[Rebirth]], but also changing at their designated guilds provides them with extra skills they would need to otherwise do Job Quests for. Here are the Guild locations for each Main Class: *[[Swordman]] Guild is found in western [[Izlude]] {{Navi|izlude_in|74|168}}. *[[Mage]] Guild is found in northwestern [[Geffen]] {{Navi|geffen_in|164|124}}. *[[Thief]] Guild is found inside the [[Pyramid]], 1 map northwest of [[Morroc]] {{Navi|moc_prydb1|45|130}}. *[[Archer]] Guild is found at the [[Archer Village]], 1 map north of [[Payon]] {{Navi|payon_in02|64|71}}. :*Mage, Thief, and Archer Classes can take the Kafra Teleport Service in central [[Izlude]]: :[[File:Kafra_Warp.png|468px]] :* Alternatively Thief and Archer can use the [[Dungeon Teleporter]] in [[Eden Group]] to reach the Thieves Guild inside the '''Pyramids''' and Archer Guild near the '''Payon Cave'''. *[[Merchant]] Guild is found in southwestern [[Alberta]] {{Navi|alberta_in|56|43}}. :*Requires 500z to sail to '''Alberta''' from dock in northeastern [[Izlude]]. *[[Acolyte]]s will proceed to the Church {{Navi|prt_church|184|38}} in northeastern [[Prontera]] by walking 1 map west and 1 map north from [[Izlude]]. === Expanded First Class Job Change Locations === Use the Job Change Map you receive at Job Level 10 to pinpoint the location of the Job Change [[NPC]] of the Class you chose. The instructors on the 2nd floor of the Academy will be able to warp you to the proper location for free: *[[Gunslinger]]s can speak to '''Lusa''' {{Navi|iz_ac02|142|84}} who can send you to the Gunslinger's Guild in [[Einbroch]]. *[[Ninja]]s can speak to the '''Ninja Guide''' {{Navi|iz_ac02|140|138}} who can send you to [[Amatsu]]. *[[TaeKwon Kid]]s can speak to '''Arang''' {{Navi|iz_ac02|71|85}} who can send you to [[Payon]]. *[[Super Novice]]s requires you to be a Base Level 45 [[Novice]] before finding '''Tzerero''' {{Navi|aldebaran|116|63}} in [[Al De Baran]]. Once you have been sent to your respective location, you can use the [https://irowiki.org/wiki/First_Expanded_Job_Change_GuidesFirst Expanded Job Change Guides] to learn more on how to complete the quest. == Sprakki's Call == After completing your first job change, you are explicitly told to return to Sprakki back at the academy. '''NOTE''': ''Skipping this will prevent you from changing jobs after Rebirth so might as well do it now.'' :[[File:Sprakki_Call.png|351px]] Return to '''Sprakki''' {{Navi|iz_ac01|102|43}} at the Criatura Academy who introduces you to '''Lime Evenor''' == Eden Group == Talk to '''Lime Evenor''' who registers you to the [[Eden Group]] and provides you with equipment and the '''Eden Group Mark'''. *Dorams will register by by finding Lime Evenor here {{Navi|moc_para01|27|30}}. :[[File:Lime_Evenor.png|145px]]
At this point, you are now free to start your own adventure and the first agenda on your list would be '''Leveling'''. * ''For those interested, talking to Sprakki continues the questline related to Leno '''BUT''' must wait until reaching '''Level 21''' to progress.'' == Leveling == Several ways to level up includes hunting monsters and fulfilling requests such as: * [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] * [[Bounty Board Quests]] * [[Juno Monster Society|(Level 70) Juno Monster Society]] * [[Gramps Turn-In Monsters|(Level 70) Gramps Turn-In ]] * [[Overlook Water Dungeon Quests|(Level 30~85) Overlook Water Dungeon]] == Useful Tools == * [[World Map]] * [[Navigation]] * [[Party]] * [[Dungeon Teleporter]] * [[Commerce]] * [[RODEX]] * [[Mercenary System]] * [[Beginner Stat & Skill Reset Hypnotist|(Level 1-99) Beginner Stat & Skill Resetter]] * [[Stats#Stat_Reset|(Level 100+) Stat Reset Options]] * [[Skills#Skill_Reset|(Level 100+) Skill Reset Options]] * [[Eden_Merit_Badge#Redeemable_Item_List|Eden Group's Merry Badger]] == Equipment == * [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] * [[Refinement System]] == Earning Zeny == Farming Zeny in the earlier levels (1~99) is not a necessity besides for the purpose of transport fees, HP and SP restoration items and other relevant items needed for leveling progression. Nevertheless, besides selling monster drops to Merchant NPCs, another important tip to earning Zeny is to first know the market and your character.
However, it is very important to know what the players need, what you can farm and to know whether or not it is worth the trouble. *[[Quest Items]] has a catalogue of items used either crafting or for quests, but does not guarantee a sale. For example, {{Item List |id=507 |item=Red Herbs |simple=yes}} can be farmed 1 map east of [[Payon]] and will often have Player-run [[Buying Store]]s offering more than the [[NPC]] selling price to take them off your hands. Overall, it is better to balance out Zeny farming and leveling during the early levels (1~99), better opportunities to earn zeny starts at Base Level 100 and beyond.
