title: Guide:How to Build a Class
wikitext:
{{Community Guides}} == Introduction == This Community Guide is created to help and advise New/Returning/Old Players on how to research a new Class/Skill/Build in iRO. The aim is to provide guidance and the initial direction or even end game builds. This guide will be updated with newer items from time to time. Also requesting any other member to add their suggestions below or reach out to me to further improve the guide. == Where to Start? == To start off, you need to decide which type of class you like to play. The game is unfortunately not very kind to Tank, Healer, or Full Support Builds. So, only go for these builds if you have friends with DPS classes helping. Consequently, it makes this guide DPS based. I might add other playstyles later-on. === Attack Type Classification === The classes of Ragnarok Online can be divided broadly into Magical and Physical Attack types. Decide whether you want to be a Melee, Ranged, or a Caster. This will decide further what kind of gears will be needed. ==== Magical Classes ==== The Magical classes are based on Spells of different iRO [[Element | Elements]]. Unlike other games, Element of an attack or Monster plays an important role in the amount of damage you will deal. There is no “One Element Hits All”, we are not in Lord of the Rings. This will make you use at least two different types of elemental spells (One Main Attack, other for resistant enemies) or ignore resistant monsters. Usually, all Caster classes will have one way or the other to incorporate more than one Element in the build. ==== Physical Classes ==== Physical Classes can be further divided into Ranged or Melee. Also, unlike Magical Skills, it is easier to change property of most of the Physical Skills, with an Elemental Converter, Ammunition, or Weapons. Additionally, HP and SP leech is easier with Physical skills than Magical ones. The benefit of Ranged Attacks is that Monsters that reflect Physical Damage, do not get triggered by them. == What to Pick? == === iRO Class === Once you have decided on what type of Attack you want to use, next comes the actual [[Classes | Class]] you want to use. This is an important step because some classes are Cheaper and Easier to build than the others. But almost all classes can clear the current Content of the game, MVP hunting, Leveling, or Partying. In my opinion, the Class that currently fall short is Dorams. Though easier to build, but their damage caps way early. But they have one of the Strongest Tank and Healer builds. === Class Skill === As informed at the start, this guide focuses on DPS classes for now. The next step after selecting the Class is to study them and decide on the Skill you want to use. Look at the 3rd Job classes or Expanded 2nd Jobs. Different Classes have different weapon options and the [[Weapons | Weapon]] types decide which skill can be used. Not all skills are high DPS or very useful in iRO server. I would recommend using the iRO Wiki discord (Link available below), to decide which is the current Meta skill(s) of your class. == How to Look? == After choosing the Skill, comes your real research. Go on google.com and search the following: “iro ” === Google === [[File:Google_Search.png]] The first two results should be from the following two sites: [https://irowiki.org iRO Wiki] and [https://divine-pride.net Divine Pride]. [[File:Skyblow_Results.png|500px]] Open both these links because they will help on your research and deciding your gears. === iRO Wiki === The first thing that you need to see is the description of the Skill. Read the Damage formula and pick out which stats are directly involved in the Skill damage Calculation. These would help decide your [[Stats]]. [[File:Skyblow_Description.png]] The next thing to check is the Different parameters related with the skill. These are the Variable Cast Time (VCT), Fixed Cast Time (FCT), Cooldown, and After Cast Delay (ACD). You would need different equipment or shadow gears to reduce these values. The [[Skills]] page has more information on how to reduce them. (I will add a separate section for them later) [[File:Cast_Details.png]] The last thing to notice is the External part of the page. This will give an idea about which gears affect the skill and how. This list might be incomplete and hence will need the link from the Divine Pride website to further complete it. [[File:IRO_Related_Gears.png]] === Divine Pride === The items tab on the Divine Pride link will help you out find the remaining or future items that are related to the skill. Items with the name Unknown or in Different Language are not available in iRO server yet. For any items that are unclear, you can check in with the Discord community for clarification or Check them in game using Shopping Board. [[File:IRO_Related_Gears_2.png|700px]] == Common Gears == This Section will focus on gears that will be common across classes and skills, to get an idea about what will work for you if you have no skill specific gears to use. === Physical Attacks === ==== Attack/Damage ==== There are Five major stat based builds that directly increase your Flat ATK or ATK values and they have associated Middle and Lower headgear combinations. Depending upon the chosen skill, you can select the headgear and Stat combination, though LUK build with is getting more and more famous. Options: * {{Item |id=19444 Star Eyepatch |slots=1}} & {{Item |id=4143 Orc Hero Card}} set & {{Item |id=420006 Vassalage Necklace}}: This set needs 120 VIT to get the optimal ATK boost (130 is possible, but not stats efficient). This set gives one of the lowest ATK boosts from the gears but provides high Hard Defense and HP, making a tankier build. Extra LUK helps boost the VIT values even more. The Vassalage Necklace will boost Damage even further with STR and LUK. * {{Item |id=18823 Imperial Feather}} & {{Item |id=19246 Royal Guard Necklace}} set: This set needs 120 AGI to get the maximum ATK boost from the set. This set gives one of the lowest ATK boosts from the gears, but the flee from AGI stat helps reduce the potion costs during leveling, while also giving some status effect immunity. It is also rather easy to achieve 193 ASPD. * {{Item |id=19138 Seraphim Coronet}}: This build needs 120 INT to get the maximum ATK boost from the middle headgear. This setup gives the best Flat ATK boost from the gears. The extra SP helps to reduce the SP item consumption. This can be combined with {{Item |id=18754 Blood Sucker}}, {{Item |id=19112 Tengu Scroll}}, or {{Item |id=420006 Vassalage Necklace}} for HP leech or further Damage Boost. This build also works best if Variable Cast time for your skill is an issue. * {{Item |id=19437 Little Garden}} & {{Item |id=420006 Vassalage Necklace}}: This build needs 125 STR/LUK to get the maximum ATK boost from the headgears. This setup gives lowest Flat ATK boost, out of all the available options but is the best option for Crit based skills and using it with other Gears ({{Item |id=32258 Ring of Jupiter}}). * {{Item |id=2202 Sunglasses[1]}} or {{Item |id=2201 Sunglasses}} or {{Item |id=2204 Glasses[1]}} or {{Item |id=2203 Glasses}} & {{Item |id=28502 Mob Scarf}}: This build needs STR/LUK to get the maximum ATK boost from the headgears. This setup does not give a Flat ATK boost, but it is one of the cheapest set available for new players. It helps with crit skills as well and can be used with {{Item |id=32258 Ring of Jupiter}}. === Magical Attacks === ==== Attack/Damage ==== Below are the major gears that directly increase your Flat MATK or MATK values. Depending upon the chosen skill, you can select the right combination. Options: * {{Item_List_2|id=19380|item=Floating Ball|simple=y}}: This is one of the best Magical damage middle headgear. Flat MATk boost and Magical damage boost on Boss Monsters. * {{Item_List_2|id=19499|item=Fortunetelling Sealed|simple=y}}: This is a cheap Magical damage lower headgear. Only 100 INT and 100 DEX will affect the MATK rate. * {{Item |id=2202 Sunglasses[1]}} or {{Item |id=2201 Sunglasses}} or {{Item |id=2204 Glasses[1]}} or {{Item |id=2203 Glasses}} & {{Item |id=28502 Mob Scarf}}: This build needs INT/DEX to get the maximum MATK boost from the headgears. This setup is one of the cheapest set available for new players. == Further Help == For any further or specific information, the [https://discord.com/invite/uegKTZw iRO Wiki Discord] group will be able to help. == Additional Comments == '''''
Note: Please add any new information below this line and I will add it to the main section
''''' {{Navbox Community Guides}}

title: Guide:How to Make Zeny
wikitext:
{{Community Guides}} '''''
Note: The purpose of this guide to help new or returning players catch up on the all the tip and tricks to make zeny in this game. Please do not suggest any Bad Practices or Bannable Tricks!
''''' = Introduction = This Community Guide is created to help and advise New/Returning/Old Players on how to farm and make zeny in iRO. The aim is to provide guidance and the initial direction or even end-game farming. This guide will be updated with newer tips from time to time. Also requesting any other member of the community to add their suggestions below or reach out to me to further improve the guide. = Where to Start? = To start off, it is advised to create a separate game account on the same Warp Portal account and level a [[Blacksmith]] to Base level 70 with maximum level [[Greed]], [[Overcharge]], [[Discount]], [[Pushcart]], [[Enlarge Weight Limit]], and [[Vending]]. The reason will be explained in the Tips and Tricks section. = Tips & Tricks = == Current Popular Farming (11/24) == '''
Ether Dusts from Lvl 200+ maps (The extra drop rate has made this a bit less viable)
''' '''
Faceworm Nest instance for the Giant Faceworm Snake Skins (Might get outdated; Currently lack of farmers has boosted the price)
''' == Blacksmith Related Tips == * Buy a {{Item List |id=14645|item=Beelzebub Wing|simple=yes}} (from Eden Merit badges) or cheap {{Item List 2|id=23280|item=Beginners Fly wings|simple=yes}}. Enter Gramps Low TI and Greed everything that is on floor. Most of these can be sold to NPCs and some of them can be sold/vended in [[Prontera]] Shops. * Sell any Junk found to the NPC Shop or the High Value Trader with the [[Overcharge]] Skill. * Buy all NPC items using [[Discount]]. This will save zeny. == Farming Tips == * '''Farm cards that are from the current content. There are some universal cards that will be a good price even in later years''' * Farm Ether Dust from 200+ maps. This is used for Grading Armors and Weapons. * Farm Cards like Marc, Phen, Marine Sphere, Rockridge Cramp, Restless Dead Card, Marduk, Earth Deleter, Mavka, Anubis, Headless Mule, Polluted Wanderman, Sweet Nightmare, and Hunter Fly. * Farm Hair style items like glossy hair, short daengie, and daengie. * Farm Eden Leveling Items like Sticky Webfoot, Maneater Blossoms. * Farm SP Items like Strawberries, Ygg Berry, Ygg Seeds, Mora Mandarin. * Farm Crafting materials like Zenorc Fangs, Mushroom Spores, Poison Spores, Mermaid Heart, Karvodailnirol for poison bottles, Skeleton Bones or Orcish Voucher for Alcohol. * Farm Herbs like White, Yellow, Blue, Red. * Farm GX New Poison materials like Anolian skin, Sticky poison, Poisonous toad skin, Decayed nail. * Farm Maneater Roots, Mandragora flowerpot, Prickly fruit for plant bottles. * Farm Savage meat, Cold ice, Blood of wolf, Beef head, ice crystal, Ice piece, Drosera tentacle, Petite tail for +20 food == [[Quest]] Tips == * Grind [[The Royal Banquet]] quests for Royal Guard Shield. * Grind [[Arc_Quests|Episode Quests]] for [[Grace Equipment]], [[Imperial Equipment]], and [[Noblesse Equipment]] to turn them into [[Safe Certificate]]. * Run [[Daily Quests]] for Episode [[17.2]] to collect Barmeals and other Mats. * Run Mora Dailies for the Peuz Set. Not very Profitable but still doable. == [[Instance]] Tips == ==Easy== * [[Sara's Memory]] is a good instance to farm for starter zeny. Selling the food items dropped can be sold to make up to 1 million zeny. Note: Doyen's food cannot be sold to NPC. * [[Airship Raid]] is a nice daily instance to do for {{Item List |id=6091|item=Darkred Scale Piece|simple=yes}} you can use [[Steal]] on the Wyvern to get it, item is used for [[Item_Reform#Abyss_Lake_Roaring_Armor-LT_Reform|Item Reform]] so it can be sold for a good amount. * [[Faceworm Nest]] can be used to farm Karvodailnirol for [[Create Deadly Poison]] and Giant Faceworm Snake Skin for [[Eden Merit Badge]] that sells quite well. * [[Room of Consciousness]] (16.1 Bijou) instance is one of the quickest and easiest to do. Bijou Card is in high demand as well. * [[Old Glast Heim]] treasure room rewards items to sell to npc, amethyst and aquamarine for grading, coagulated spells for temporal boots. * [[VIP Summoner]] has the option to hunt MVPs with VIP activated. * [[Ghost Palace]] is a good instance to get some beginner level equips that gives nice HP and SP leech. They can now be reformed to become their powerful versions. Or make abrasive enchant item to sell on the market. ==Medium== * [[Nidhoggur's Nest]] 3 day cooldown instance for a huge value MVP card and {{Item List |id=6091|item=Darkred Scale Piece|simple=yes}} for item reform. Fight itself aint that hard but requires lots of quests to unlock. * [[Geffen Magic Tournament]] can serve as source of Yggdrasil Seeds and Berries, and Geffen Magic Coins (People buy coins for having 30k set to skip rounds). * [[Nightmare Old Glast Heim]] treasure room rewards about the same as normal mode but with the addition of contaminated spells that can be exchanged for white knight and khalitzburg knight cards. * [[Illusion_Daily_Quests#2nd_OS_Search|2nd OS Search]] for Miguel MVP Card. It is a good card for Critical builds. * [[Horror Toy Factory]] is a fun and interesting instance. You can use the Bloody Coins to get Celine Ribbon or Red Lantern for farming crafting mats. Celine Kimi is also a good MVP card to be used in WoE ==Hard== * [[Central Laboratory]] works like having up to 3 Bloody Branches daily. It spawns 3 MVP/Miniboss and can be done daily. * [[Wolfchev's Laboratory]] (Biolab) is another quick 3 day cooldown instance but it needs some gearing, can easily die if fight lasts for long. * [[EDDA Somatology Laboratory - Expeditionary Journey|Edda Lab]] can be farmed to get Bio Research Dosuments and Edda weapons, some of which are in high demand. MVP has a dps check and will full heal if fight takes too long. * [[Challenge Mode Old Glast Heim]] have MVP cards, good magic cards from mobs and materials to enchant temporal circlet headgears. * [[Temple of Demon God]] Despair god Card basically. ==Extremely Hard== * [[Villa of Deception]] is a high end instance for adulters/vivatus fides weapons and MVP cards. * [[Constellation Tower]] random mvp or miniboss every 5th floor, fight betelgeuse for meteorite fragments to enchant [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=1841&p=1 Abyss/Violent LT armors] ==Does not exist in iRO currently== * [[Endless Tower]] has a lot of MVP options and some of the floor items are worth a lot to sell to other players. == Event Tips == * Please do all the free seasonal events that Gravity comes out with. They have tradable items like costumes, consumables, and gears that other player would like. ** [[2019_St._Patrick's_Day_Event|St. Patrick's Day]], [[Trick or Treat]], and [[20th Anniversary Event|20th Anniversary]] events are still on which can help people save zeny on Battle Manual and Bubble Gum buffs, or earn by selling the consumables. == NPC Tips == * [[Spooky Machine]] is good way for getting free items. == Cash Shop Tips == '''''
Note: Please read this section carefully. This is a "Point of No Return"! It would not be advised to proceed with this but since it is a very legit or legal way to make quick zeny, I am adding this here.
''''' '''''
Note: Please make sure you can actually spend KP in game and are not region blocked!!! Asking around in iRo Wiki discord would be a good start. Some of the EU accounts have been able to go around it by Default or sending a support ticket.
''''' '''''
Note: Cash to Warpportal Energy (WPE) Conversion, Warpportal Energy (WPE) to Kafra Point (KP) Conversion, or Kafra Point (KP)  to Cash shop item conversion is final! Do not convert unless you are not sure!!!
''''' * Kachua Enriched Ore boxes are one of the most favorite items to be sold. People will mention what boxes they need. These are also available seasonally. Make doubly sure what item you are selling and if it can be traded or not. * The most quickest sell is {{Item_List_2|id=23216|item=[10Day] Premium Subscription|simple=y}}. But unfortuantely this is also the least profitable item. So only trade in this if you are desparate. * Costume Eggs are also a good sell. These eggs cannot be traded, but you need to open them and then trade the costumes inside. Please make sure the costumes inside are tradeable, some are not. * Some Overseas Care Packages are tradeable through Guild storage. Caution and make sure that you know if they are not before promising something. * Utility Items like Gym Pass/Heavy Lifter, Omni Dye, Neuralizer, Name Change tickets, Silvervine Boxes and other stuff might also be in demand. * Opening "iRO Loot boxes" like [[Overseas Care Package]], [[Kachua]], or [[Costume Stone Enchants]] is another way. THIS IS GAMBLING, PLEASE PROCEED WITH CAUTION!!! = Level Based Farming = This section is based on Base level. This will cover farming for either low, mid or high damage potential. == Low Level == Level range from 1 - 99, before and after rebirth; Farming while you level your character. * Level 1 - 20: Payon Field loots ** Red Herbs, Strawberries * Level 20 - 40: Ant Hell loots ** The sheer quantity of dropped items can give good zeny * Level 20 - 40: Thara Frog ** Sticky Webfoot * Level 40 - 80: Overlook Dungeon ** Marc, Marine Sphere, or Phen cards * Level 40 - 60: Orc Village loots ** Orcish Vouchers, miscellaneous loots * Level 60-80: Geographer ** Maneater Blossoms * Level 60 - 70: Orc Dungeon loots ** Zenorc Fang, Orcish Voucher, and other miscellaneous loots * Level 70 - 99: Glast Heim Church loots ** Butterfly wings, White herbs, Fabric * Level 70 - 99: Gramps Low TI loots ** Monster specific, miscellaneous loots * Level 70 - 90: Harpy and Peco map (One south of Juno) loots ** Harpy miscellaneous loots; Wind of Verdure, Gold, Mastela Fruit * Level 90 - 99: Nogg 2 (Magma Dungeon 2) loots ** Miscellaneous loots == Middle Level == Level range from 100 - 200. Please check differet tricks and tips or damage requirements to be able to complete these instances; these ranges only indicate when the farming place will open and can be made profitable. Anything that can be farmed in previous level ranges can be farmed in these ranges as well. * Level 100 - 125: Room Of Consciousness, Royal Banquet Quests, Mora Dailies, VIP Summoner, Sara' Memory, Geffen Magic Tournament * Level 126 - 150: Faceworm Nest, Old Glast Heim, Central laboratory, Wolfchev's Laboratory * Level 151 - 175: Advanced Old Glast Heim, Challenge Old Glast Heim * Level 176 - 200: Villa of Deception Normal and Hard Mode == High Level == Level range from 200+. Please check differet tricks and tips, or damage requirements to be able to complete these instances; these ranges only indicate when the farming place will open and can be made profitable. Anything that can be farmed in previous level ranges can be farmed in these ranges as well. * Level 200 - 220: Ether Dusts, Tomb of Remorse, Geffen Night Arena, Airship Crash * Level 220 - 250: Ether Dusts = User Recommendations = == Captain Sunbear's Quick Recommendation === # 1-99: picking up loot and selling to buy shops or farming a few cards # 100-150: episodic content dailies and illusion dungeon dailies and instances and cards # 150-200: 17.2 cards and instances == The Sticky Webfoot Method == There are a number of ways to earn zeny. Most of them are already listed on the pages [[Making Zeny]] or [[Guide:Zeny Farming|Zeny Farming]] and present the information in a more condensed format than this guide. The easiest method that requires the least amount of set up for a newer player is obtaining and selling {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}}. Players need {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}} in order to complete quests to level up alts fast. You need zeny. Simple. So, the first step to finding {{Item List |id=918 |item=Sticky Webfoot|simple=yes}} or any other item in game is to utilize the wiki’s item/monster database. If you click the link I put in the previous sentence, it will bring up the wiki’s item database in your browser. That database page will show that {{monster |id=1012 Roda Frog}} drop them 90% of the time, it will also show that {{monster |id=1012 Roda Frogs}} are level 13 and that they can be located in {{map|id=prt_fild00 Prontera Field 00}}. So, with that in mind, I will make two suggestions. Suggestion one shows you how to find {{monster |id=1012 Roda Frogs}} on your own using the navigation window so that you can eventually find other monsters/maps/items on your own. Suggestion 2 is directions on how to click the information I provide, paste it into the game and then you can head to your target if you don't want to learn how to use the in-game navigation window. To learn the navigation window method: #Go in game and open your navigation window then type in Roda Frog and press Enter. This will show 5 entries. The first two entries are champion monsters which provide extra experience when defeated and are slightly tougher than regular mobs. The third entry is where normal Roda Frogs are located. #Click the third Roda Frog entry and it will show 4 entries under the Roda Frog image. #Click prt_fild00. gef_fild01 is another option with a lot of Roda Frogs but it is a bit further to get to if you’re starting in Geffen instead of Prontera. #Click the find button. This step will make the game show arrows on the ground for how to get to your destination quickly. #Get to the location and get farming. To learn the simpler method: #Click one of the following links to copy it to your computer’s clipboard {{Navi|prt_fild00|189|151}} or {{Navi|gef_fild01|370|116}} (this one is a bit further to get to if you’re starting in Geffen) #Paste it in chat in game and the game will show navigation arrows on the ground. #Get to the location and get farming. If you're having troubles with the navigation system, I provided one example of how the navigation system is unreliable in the [[Guide:Beginner_Tips#Places_to_go_2|leveling tips]] section above. The navigation system is useful to locate what field a monster is located in, but sometimes you have to find your own way to your destination. Once you have those {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}} other players will buy them from you at their stalls for 800-1500 zeny depending on the market. If you’re not in a rush to sell them I recommend seeing what prices are offered in [[Geffen]], [[Payon]] or the main trading area [[Prontera]] for them. Or, you can set up your own stall and try to sell them for roughly 2,500 zeny. I recommend switching to an alt to check the prices people are offering at those cities' [[Shopping Board]]. == Finding Alternatives to the Sticky Webfoot Method === The most important thing to ask yourself when researching what to buy and sell in any Massively Multiplayer Online game is "Why are people buying or selling something?" And the answer is usually more detailed than "Because someone needs it." If you want to find items that players need for turn-in quests that are similar to {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}}, check out the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] page for the sections on collecting missions. You could also check out what items are needed for the [[Mora Daily Quests]] page. These quests reward [[Mora_Village#Mora_Coins|Mora Coins]] for [[Mora_Village#Mora_Equips|Mora Equipment]]. Another page with items that people might buy from you is the [[Catalyst Items]] page which lists items required for certain skills. If you don't want to look items up and just want a quick recommendation of what else to farm then {{item |id=578 Strawberries}} from either {{monster |id=1014 Spores}} (which are level 18) in {{Navi|pay_fild08|30|74}} or {{monster |id=1057 Yoyo}} (which are level 38) in {{Navi|prt_fild03|30|249}} are good options. I’ve seen {{item |id=578 Strawberries}} being sold for 2000 by other players at the cheapest but they only have a 6% drop rate from {{monster |id=1014 Spores}} and 10% on {{monster |id=1057 Yoyos}} compared to the 90% drop rate of {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}} from {{monster |id=1012 Roda Frogs}}. The reason why {{item |id=578 Strawberries}} and other [[Healing_Items#List_of_SP_restoring_items|SP recovery items]] are in demand is because [[NPC]] vendors don’t sell [[Healing_Items#List_of_SP_restoring_items|SP recovery items]]. If you decide to farm {{monster |id=1057 Yoyo}} mobs for {{item |id=578 Strawberries}}, keep in mind that while {{monster |id=1057 Yoyos}} are passive, they will assist other {{monster |id=1057 Yoyo}} once a fight starts. And combined with the fact that they are looters, you likely wont be looting anything yourself until almost everything around you is dead because the {{monster |id=1031 Poporing}} in the area are also looters. If you decide to go over 50% carry capacity to grab all the loot while farming strawberries in this area (due to how far away Prontera is), I recommend eating the bananas you pick up in order to restore your [[HP]]. That way you can continue to ignore the penalty towards [[HP]] regeneration. If you decide to farm {{monster |id=1014 Spores}} keep in mind that while it costs 120 zeny to get to [[Payon]], it will cost 2000 zeny to get back to [[Prontera]] and there isn't a [[Payon]] to [[Izlude]] teleport service. I don't recommend using the navigation window to try and find your way back to [[Izlude]] or [[Prontera]]. It will recommend teleporting to outside the dungeon [[Glast Heim]] and there are level 100 {{monster |id=1253 Gargoyles}} on that map. Not that many but still enough to kill your character if you follow its directions. Higher level mobs like {{monster |id=1278 Stalactic Golems}} are going to drop things like {{item |id=7054 Brigan}} worth 373 zeny and {{item |id=7004 Mud Lumps}} worth 438 zeny for a total of roughly 811 zeny per kill worth of vendor items fairly consistently and occasionally drop things like {{item |id=985 Elunium}} 1.64% of the time (I have seen stalls offer to buy {{item |id=985 Elunium}} for 10,000 zeny each). So, while it is potentially less zeny per kill depending on what you kill at higher levels, you’re gaining exp while farming and occasionally getting a high value item when killing those higher level mobs compared to just farming {{item |id=918 Sticky Webfoot}}. The only downside is that there are level 98 {{monster |id=1255 Nereids}} in {{map|id=beach_dun2 Beach Dungeon 2}} where the level 68 {{monster |id=1278 Stalactic Golems}} can be found in abundance. They're not too tough as one part of the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] takes place in that dungeon and those quests don't tend to put you in too much danger, but they are tougher than the golems. If you find that you can't fight the {{monster |id=1255 Nereids}} but you still want to farm there, you could avoid them with {{item |id=601 fly wings}} and see where those place you in the dungeon. == How to Avoid Spending Zeny == Now, instead of talking about how to get zeny, lets talk about how to not spend your hard earned zeny. More specifically, how to avoid spending all your zeny on hp recovery items. I am going to preface this section by saying this, you will find better healing options at higher levels in either the “useful recovery items” section of your class’ wiki page or on the [[Healing Items]] wiki page. Of the many healing items out there {{item |id=579 Fresh Fish}} and {{item |id=517 Meat}} seem like the best options for recovering hp for lower level characters. {{Item List |id=579|item=Fresh Fish|simple=yes}} has the best weight to healing ratio of the two options. It is the best choice for those longer leveling sessions or using on weaker characters. However, {{item |id=579 Fresh Fish}} can be quite expensive in my opinion if you’re burning through them. You can buy them from a cooking merchant for 250 zeny. It heals for 100 ~ 150 and has a weight of 2. I don’t think the cooking merchants have been added to the wiki’s database yet. So, if you want to find a cooking merchant in game you will need to use the in-game navigation window. {{Item List |id=517|item=Meat|simple=yes}} is the cheapest but also the heaviest of the two options. If you’re healing with {{item |id=517 Meat}} purchased from a meat merchant it will cost 50 to heal 70 ~ 100 and have a weight of 15. Meat merchants are found in [[Izlude]], [[Lighthalzen]], [[Morroc]] and [[Prontera]]. This means you will need an alt in one of those cities to buy meat, store it, then retrieve it from storage on the character you want to continue playing if you’re near a city without a meat merchant. Or you could just buy a large batch of {{item |id=517 Meat}} and throw it in storage. The [[Healing Items]] wiki page also mentions that you could [[RODEX|RODex]] {{item |id=517 Meat}} to yourself. Another suggestion I have for saving money is to look into what events are active. As of writing this guide, there are cookies that drop when you beat up Aldebaran Mystcases and Aldebaran Siromas. Those cookies heal 5% hp and give boosts like +10% atk, increased attack speed and +30 hit for 10 minutes. It might be enough to turn a 3 hit mob into a 2 hit mob or prevent the enemy from getting an extra attack in on you. The only downside is that the mobs which drop those cookies take 10 hits to kill which can be a pain at lower levels with less agility to make your swings faster. So, in order to make the event buffs last longer, I hold off on using them until my hp is low enough that I can use 1 of each cookie which will heal 20% of my hp. I can’t stress how important the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] line of quests are to get gear appropriate for your level and to reduce the damage you’re taking. And the best part is that you don’t have to hand over zeny to npcs to get gear to level up to 99. Also, [[Eden_Group_Equipments_Quests#Blacksmith_Thorn_Enchants|Blacksmith Thorn]] will enchant your Eden Group Armor, Eden Group Manteau II, or Eden Group Boots IV with 2 random enchantments provided you give him some items. He requests you bring him 20 {{item |id=1002 iron ore}} and 10 {{item |id=998 iron}} at levels 60-79 or that you bring him 20 {{item |id=7319 used iron plates}} at levels 80+. This can be repeated once per day with 0 chance of failure regardless of whether its already enchanted or not. [[Eden_Group_Equipments_Quests#Weapons_Expert_BK|Weapons Expert BK]] will enchant an Eden Group Weapon III a total of 3 times and the weapon enchantments are permanent. He requires you to have completed the level 70+, 80+ and 90+ [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] for each enchantment. Completing a 90+ [[Eden Group Equipments Quests|Eden Group Equipments Quest]] should provide access to all 3 enchantments. Keep in mind if you’re using a single handed weapon, you should look into whether your class can equip a shield like a {{item |id=2101 Guard}} or {{item |id=2103 Buckler}} in your offhand. For example, when you switch from [[Novice]] to a [[Thief]], the game doesn’t provide you with a free shield to indicate that you can use certain shields. And using a shield will raise your defense by 20-40 which will make your healing items last considerably longer. It is also a good idea to keep track of how close you are to leveling up your base level to save zeny spent on hp and sp restoring items. I like to run around with at most half hp and sp when I get close to leveling up my base level because those hp and sp bars will refill to full upon leveling up. Minimizing expenses also includes reducing how often you put things into storage to avoid the 500 zeny fee. I’m only mentioning that fee in case you aren’t aware of the storage costs, find yourself accessing storage excessively, then wondering where your zeny went. {{Navbox Community Guides}}

title: Guide:Secure Trading
wikitext:
{{Community Guides}} == Introduction == This guide is used to help people to securely do in game trades for items worth more than 1 billion or that requires multiple trades. == Trading Tips == * Maximum Limits: ** '''Holding Zeny:''' ''2 billion'' (''2,147,483,647'') [Limit to 2b for safety]
** '''Trading Zeny''': ''1 billion'' (''999,999,999'') * Please make Private pubs with a Password for the deal. So that a random third party does not join. * Make sure the Discord account you are dealing with is not a fake one and a legit account * Double confirm the deal, characters who will trade in discord and game. * Do not forget to record a replay, screenshot and anything else you can. Make sure to use the in game tools, but can also use third party apps in addition and not standalone. * Do not forget to follow these steps even if it is your friend or family. Their account could be hacked and a scammer might be dealing you. * If you are buying or selling KP items, please be very clear with the items you are buying and for what value. Please do not intentionally negate a deal after the person has bought the boxes. * '''''Please do not share your passwords with anyone, no matter how good of a friend.''''' == Trading Steps == '''''
Note: I will use Trader as a generic word for Buyer or Seller. I will specify, if necessary. Please use the in-game screenshot or video recording. Do not use any other tool or your image/video proofs might not be accepted.
''''' # Discuss the deal with the potential trader beforehand in the discord or iRO chat. #* What item(s) traded for how much zeny or item(s). #* Which characters will do the trades? #* Which character will get how much zeny? #* Which character will be the final deal and has the item? # Meet at the place where you want trade. '''''Eden and Eden Kitchen are now compromised places to meet.''''' # Open a '''Pub or Community Chat''' with the ''Alt + C'' command. # Make the pub private with a password so that someone else does not interfere in your trade. # Make sure that the pub owner stays till the end of the deal (usually the char that will trade the last 1b for item). Ask for a trusted friend to do this if you have connection or alt issues. # '''''Try to use alts for all your deals. Do not involve Main account if possible. It is just a precaution.''''' # Once the trader enters the pub (give them the password), '''reconfirm the deal again and include all the items and zeny involved'''. # Ask to view the item through show equipment feature or empty trade window. Do this step because people can fake screenshot or in game item tags. # After the deal and items are confirmed in pub, start dealing the zeny. Try to keep the items and/or last 1b in the final trade. '''Make sure to screenshot all trades.''' #* Ask them to confirm the zeny or items received in pub or chat. # Confirm the characters you are trading to before dealing with them. Sometimes, scammers might deal you instead of the trader’s character. # After every transaction of 1 billion, confirm how much was given, in the pub. # For the final trade, make sure you are receiving the right item. There are many similar looking items and costumes that can be used to scam you. # Confirm the final transaction in the pub, and screenshot all the conversation. '''''Do not save only as text. Image proof is required.''''' # Go to the [https://support.warpportal.com/Main/ support site] and open an '''"Item-Related Issues"''' ticket for item verification; zeny verification is not required. Add all the screenshots or video recording. ''If you feel the trade might have been a scam get your trade legitimized too.'' #*Screenshot will be located on Ragnarok Online\ScreenShot folder in jpg format. #*Replay will be located on Ragnarok Online\Replay folder in rrf format. == Ticket Template == === Text === [[File:Ticket blank form.PNG|thumb|Blank Support Ticket]] [[File:Ticket Type.png|thumb|Ticket Type]] [[File:Server Selection.png|thumb|Server Selection]] '''Subject:''' Legitimizing the trade and item verification for ''(Enter the items that you want verified)''
'''Body:'''
Hi Support Team,

I wanted to get my item: '''''(Enter the items that you want verified)''''',
verified that I traded for '''''(Enter the items and/or that you gave)''''' in game. I gave him my '''''(Item you gave for socketing/carding the MVP)''''' to card in first. Attaching my trade screenshots and details below:

My details are:
Game: Ragnarok Online
Server: Chaos
Character Nickname (item holder): '''''(Name of the in-game charcter)'''''

'''''
Note: There is no need to send the below information due to the Fake GM scams. The GM team should be able to identify and pull the information using the character name and the ticket details. If they ask for this make sure that they have the Employee Post tag.
''''' Account Name: '''''(Game Account name used during client login)'''''
Registered Name: '''''(Name in the Warp Portal Account)'''''
Registered Birthdate: '''''(Date of Birth in the Warp Portal Account)'''''
Registered Country: '''''(Country in the Warp Portal Account)'''''
 == In Case of a Scam == '''''
Note: I have not been scammed yet and gone through the ticketing process, so I can only assume the evidence they would require. I will add more details after reaching out to people who have gone through this process.
''''' In case of an in game scam, please reach out to GMs using the support ticket. Providing all the details like the screenshots or videos of the in-game conversations will help resolve it in your favor. Informations that will be required and help your case: '''''

Everything has to be in game, No Discord conversations or proof will help you.

''''' * Screenshots of the conversation regarding the deal. Either in Whisper Chat or a Pub. Please make sure the character name is visible * Trade screenshots if any occurred. Please make sure that the are using the in game screenshot feature. External tools might not be accepted. * In game Replay recorder can be used as an additional proof. External Video or Screen recorders might not be accepted. But if you did take them, submit as proof. == Common Red Flags == === Support Site === * Make sure the GM Replying to you has the Employee Post Tag on them. Any replies without the tag means that they could be scammers. [[File:ZynOdY2.png|GM Tag]] === In Game === * The GMs will never ask for password no matter what official accounts or website they use. They will never threaten you with a ban or other dire consequences since that can be grounds for lawsuit. * The GMs will never hide their sprite or their presence. You can request them to show their character. If you feel suspicious, ask them to show themselves. * Sometimes some scammers will enter your Pub chat and fake messages like they are from the GM using the whitespaces like "Spacebar" or "Newline" and demand to meet at a place or do something. '''''Be very careful that GMs are not allowed to hide their presence from the players'''''. There might be no way to detect this, but if you do not see the GM account in the list of participants in the pub, it is fake. Most of the times ignoring them will make them go away. === Discord === * Check if they have a Discord account with some verification on various Discord servers. When in doubt, ask around. == Additional Comments == '''''
Note: Please add any new information below this line and I will add it to the main section
''''' {{Navbox Community Guides}}

title: Guild Dungeon Investment System
Guild Relay Quest
wikitext:
{{Articles Needing DB Links}} {{Quest Info | levelreq = N/A | joblevelreq = | classreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | zenyreq = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = }} Implemented with Episode 11.3, this quest involves new NPCs in WoE 1 castles. Different player classes are required to complete the quest, with some of the tasks including gaining a level and gathering items. The NPC Names are different in each castle. '''If you do this Quest...'''
Please confirm your reward at the bottom, so that we can have an accurate guide. (Rewards are still unconfirmed) == Starting the Quest == Guild Leader must start the relay quest by speaking to the NPC inside the castle. [Jody] Who will give them a Relay Ticket, and tell the leader to give it to a Knight or Lord Knight. == First Part == '''Step 1: Knight'''
When the ticket is given to a Knight or Lord Knight in the same guild, they are to talk to [Ron Haware], located in the guild castle. He will tell the Knight to hunt 3 lots of 30 items. Example set: 30 Tongues, 30 Dark Masks, 30 Shoulder Protectors
Example set 2: 30 Mole Whisker, 30 Worn Out Page, 30 Round Shell Once you return the items to the NPC, he will give you a [Spirit of Charge] ticket which is to be given to a Blacksmith/Mastersmith. '''Step 2: Blacksmith'''
When the ticket is given to a Blacksmith/Mastersmith in the same guild, they are to talk to [Ren Haware]. He will tell the Smith to just wait. So you have to wait for [30] Minutes (Time unconfirmed, I waited 30 mins and it was enough) and then go back and talk to him. Once you return, he gives you [Spirit of Association] which is to be given to an Alchemist/Biochemist. (Able to progress past the waiting part of the quest at the hour. The waiting part could work in time blocks of half an hour or 1 hour etc.) '''Step 3: Alchemist'''
When the ticket is given to an Alchemist/Biochemist in the same guild, they are to talk to [Ren Haware]. His instruction now is to gain 2 Base Levels. Once you return, he gives you [Spirit of Coordination] which is to be given to a Hunter/Sniper. If the Alchemist/Biochemist's level is high enough, there is no need to gain 2 levels. The NPC will give you the [Spirit of Coordination]. '''Step 4: Hunter'''
When the ticket is given to a Hunter/Sniper in the same guild, they are to talk to [Ren Haware]. Now he requests the hunter to donate their Falcon to the guild. If you Donate it, then your Falcon will be removed and you will need to pay to get a new one... Once this is done, he gives you [Spirit of Advance] which is to be given back to the guild leader to trade in for the first reward. '''Reward'''
After the guild leader speaks to [Jody] and gets the reward, if you talk to him again he says you look pale and should rest for a little while. Come back in [x] Hours to start the second part of the quest. (Time to wait unconfirmed at this stage.. > 30 minutes... but < 12 Hours.) == Second Part == After the guild leader goes back and speaks to [Jody], they will be given a new ticket. This time it is the [Spirit of Trust], and is to be given to a Sage/Scholar. '''Step 1: Sage'''
When the ticket is given to a Sage or Scholar in the same guild, they are to talk to [Vers]. He will tell the Sage to develop a bond with their fellow guildmates and learn things about them. Honestly i don't know what to do in this part yet. I waited for 2.5 hours, and people were talking in guild etc.. and I went back to him and it was good enough. (I'll update this when i redo the quest). Once you return to the NPC, he will give you a [Spirit of Union] which is to be given to a Bard/Minstrel or Dancer/Gypsy. '''Step 2: Bard/Dancer'''
When the ticket is given to a Bard/Minstrel or Dancer/Gypsy in the same guild, they are to talk to [Vers]. He will tell them to hunt 3 sets of 30 items again. Once you have them, return to the NPC and he will give you a [Spirit of Combination] which is to be given to an Assassin / Assassin Cross. '''Step 3: Assassin'''
When the ticket is given to an Assassin/Assassin Cross in the same guild, they are to talk to [Vers]. They actually don't have to do anything. They will be given a [Spirit of Solidarity] which is to be given to a Wizard / High Wizard. '''Step 4: Wizard'''
When the ticket is given to a Wizard / High Wizard in the same guild, they are to talk to [Vers]. He instructs the Wizard to gain 1 Base Level, and then return to him. Once you return to him, he will give you a [Spirit of Friendship] that is to be handed to the guild leader. '''Reward'''
The guild leader can then take the [Spirit of Friendship] to [Jody] who will reward with 1 random set of items. The next part cannot be started for a few hours again. This time it is a much longer wait. (Over 12 Hours) == Third Part == After the guild leader goes back and speaks to [Jody], they will be given a new ticket. This time it is the [Spirit of Peace], and is to be given to a Rogue/Stalker. They need to speak to [Gen Garish]. '''Step 1: Rogue'''
This is quite an easy step. Take the [Spirit of Peace] to the NPC and he requests for you to make a party of X people including yourself. No more, no less. The party just has to contain a specific amount of people (known possible member counts are 6 and 10). They don't have to be near the NPC or even in the same guild, just in the party and online. For doing this you will be rewarded with a [Spirit of Determination] which is to be given to a Priest/High Priest. '''Step 2: Priest'''
Take the [Spirit of Determination] to [Gen Garish] and he instructs you to grow stronger by gaining a level. Return to him once you have gained the level and he will reward you with a [Spirit of Service] to be given to a Crusader/Paladin. If the Priest's/High Priest's level is high enough, there is no need to gain a level (98 normal Class is high enough, the minimum level that is "high enough" is unknown). '''Step 3: Crusader'''
When the ticket is given to a Crusader/Paladin in the same guild, they are to talk to [Gen Garish]. He will tell the Crusader to just wait. Once you return, he gives you [Spirit of Glory] which is to be given to an Monk/Champion. '''Step 4: Monk'''
When the [Spirit of Glory] is given to a Monk/Champion in the same guild, they are to talk to [Gen Garish] again. He will tell them to hunt 3 sets of 30 items again. Once you have them, return to the NPC and he will give you a [Spirit of Victory] that is to be handed to the guild leader to trade in for the last reward. '''Reward'''
The reward will be 1 random set of items. == Rewards == '''Part 1- Random of the following:'''
1) 2 EDP Bottles, 20 ygg seeds
2) 2 EDP Bottles, 10 ygg berries
3) 2 EDP Bottles, 5 gift box
4) 2 EDP Bottles, 3 obb ''(Confirmed)'' '''Part 2- Random of the Following:'''
1) 10 Ygg Berries, 5 Gift Box, 3 EDP Bottles
2) 10 Ygg Berries, 3 OBB, 3 EDP Bottles
3) 10 Ygg Berries, 3 OPB, 3 EDP Bottles
4) 4 Gift Box, 2 OBB, 3 EDP Bottles
5) 3 Gift Box, 2 OPB, 3 EDP Bottles
6) 2 OBB, 2 OPB, 3 EDP Bottles
7) 10 Ygg Berries, 3 Gift Box, 2 OBB, 1 OPB ''(Confirmed)'' '''Part 3- Random of the following:'''
1) 10 Ygg Seeds, 5 Ygg Berries, 4 Gift Box
2) 10 Ygg Seeds, 5 Ygg Berries, 3 OBB
3) 10 Ygg Seeds, 2 OPB, 5 Ygg Berries ''(Confirmed)''
4) 10 Ygg Seeds, 4 Gift box, 2 OBB, 1 OPB
5) Angel Wing Ears

title: Guild System
wikitext:
{{Renewal}}
== Overview ==
The guild system of Ragnarok Online was made to allow the formation of communities with guild members and to form the basis to prepare for the War of Emperium. 

=== Guild Creation ===
To make a guild, you will need an '{{item | id=714 Emperium}}.' (When you use an {{item | id=714 Emperium}} to create a guild, you will not be able to get one back if you decide to break the guild.) 

If you have obtained an {{item | id=714 Emperium}}, and have it on the character you want to make the guild on, create a guild by typing /guild "guild name". The character you made the guild on is now the "Guild Master." Once you have made a guild, the name cannot be changed (Unless there's something that goes against the TOS, in which case Gravity may either change the name and ask you to come up with a new one, or disband it). To change the guildmaster, simply hover the desired player in the Guildsmen Info tab, right click their name and select "Entrust guild master".

=== Guild Disband ===

Kick all guild members, then type /breakguild "my guild name" as the master of the guild.

=== Guild Window ===
The guild window is accessed in-game, by pressing alt+G. This window is the interface used to change anything related to the guild, (that can be changed) and to view information such as who is currently online, the amount of people on, and the amount of people the guild can hold vs. the amount of people currently in the guild.

[[Image:guildwindow.jpg]]

==== Guild Info Tab ====
General guild information, such as the current number of members, number of online members, leader, and guild level, is displayed here. Alliances are also listed here and the guild leader can remove alliances by right clicking an allied guild name. The tendency feature currently does not work.

==== Guildsmen Tab ====
All guild members are listed here. The leader is always first, with other members being ordered according to their title. Online members will be highlighted here. Members who have been taxed to provide the guild with experience can show the amount contributed as well. For the guild leader, titles of each member can be modified from this tab. Leaving the guild is also available by right clicking a member; guild members and members given the right to do so (via title) can kick anyone, while others can only kick themselves.

==== Position Tab ====
A total of 20 titles are available and can be set here by the guild leader. The order of titles here will influence the order of members in the Guildsmen tab. The permissions to invite players, kick members, or access guild storage is also given via titles.

==== Guild Skills ====
Available guild skills are displayed here. On obtaining a new guild level, the extra skill point is allocated via this tab. Using active guild skills is also done here.

==== Expel History ====
A list of recently kicked members are displayed here.

==== Guild Notice ====
The guild leader may write a two-line guild notice (one short and one long) that will be displayed to each member upon logging in or switching maps. Note that the second line is often overlapped by the chat box scroll bar, so a short and concise notice is preferable.

=== Guild Master ===
Guild masters can manage members' positions and set experience tax levels through Guild Titles. When being taxed in a guild, only your [[Base Experience]] is taxed. Your [[Job Experience]] will be unchanged by it. Taxes can only be set up to 50% of your Base Experience. Guild masters can also write messages, which are displayed when members log on/off, [[Teleport]]/flywing, or change maps. 

*Note: For people who do not wish to see messages, (such as when teleporting/changing maps often) the /li or /loginout command will disable these messages, as well as "Guildsman _____ has dis/connected" messages.

=== Guild Titles ===
Guild Titles are set by the Guild Master.  They are used to set Guild Tax levels, and special names which can be entered in after a character's name.  They also allow the Master to delegate various powers to other members such as inviting new members into the guild, kicking out members, or assigning who may access the guild's storage.

=== Emblems ===
Guilds can also have their own personalized "emblem." An emblem is a small picture which can make it easy to identify members, especially in WoE. Emblem Creation: 

*Select a design for the Emblem. 
*Emblems must be 24x24 pixels in either BMP format or GIF format (animated gif included) using 256 colors, the hot pink color (Red: 255 Green: 0 Blue: 255) will appear transparent ingame. 
*Create a folder named Emblem inside the Ragnarok Online folder (C:\Program Files\Gravity\Ragnarok Online) and copy the emblem file into the Emblem folder. If you do not already have this folder, you will have to make it.

=== Guild Size ===
The amount of members a guild can hold is 16 (including the Master) by default.  This limit can be increased via the [[Guild Extension]] skill up to a maximum of 56 members on iRO. Note that there are only 20 Guild Title slots, so grouping members into one or more "default" titles may be necessary with larger guilds.

== Guild Levels ==
Guilds, like characters, have levels. Guilds gain levels by members who donate their base experience through taxes. After a guild gains a level, one skill point is obtained, which can then be used on a variety of guild skills.

Usable |- ! {{Item List |id=645 |item=Concentration}} | style="color:green;" | ✔ |- ! {{Item List |id=656 |item=Awakening}} | style="color:green;" | ✔ |- ! {{Item List |id=657 |item=Berserk}} | style="color:red;" | ✘ |- ! {{Item List |id=678 |item=Poison Bottle}} | style="color:green;" | ✔ |} |} == Builds == ===PvM=== ====Critical==== This build focuses on single target critical hits ([[CRIT]]), and is not a leveling build because it does not have [[HIT]] for AoE skills. Critical hits deal about 40% more than regular attacks would, and would bypass enemy flee. This build relies a lot on [[LUK]]. Every three LUK gives one CRIT. When using katars, crit rate is doubled (not shown in stat window) so it is possible to achieve 100% crit rate with just 50 CRIT. It is advised to get a bit more, however, because the target's LUK will lower your effective crit rate. Effective crit rate using katars = 2xCRIT - (target's LUK/5). This build is mainly used for single target DPS on MVPs, but can also be applied for PvP/WoE as well. This build is PURE critical, and is only applicable to endgame uses. Leveling builds require [[HIT]] to use AoE leveling skills and 1 DEX is not adequate for AoE purposes. The player may opt to use this stats build for leveling using {{Skill List|id=2036|skill=Rolling Cutter|simple=yes}} or Meteor Assault when having access to equipment that grants Hit like {{item|id =20859 Phreeoni Wings}} or {{item|id =20949 Skin of Ladon}}, or tweak the stats build to include DEX which should be a priority first. Advantages: *Critical damage bypass flee. *Potentially very high single target damage. Disadvantages: *Need a lot of critical rate to ensure the skill always crits and doesn't miss, since the build will lack hit or Perfect Hit, with the equipment being optimized for having critical damage bonus. *Mainly does damage to a single target only, since the AoE skill of a GX is lacking critical damage capabilities. ===== Cross Impact ===== {{Skill List|id=2022|skill=Cross Impact|simple=yes}} build is mostly a PVM/MVP end-game but can be used for leveling, if geared properly. It depends heavily on Critical damage and rate, and [[Enchant Deadly Poison]]. Advantages: * Melee damage is boosted by {{Skill List|id=5001|skill=Dark Claw|simple=yes}}. * Despite {{Skill List|id=2022|skill=Cross Impact|simple=yes}} being melee, it can act as a gap closer to enemy. Disadvantages: * {{Skill List|id=5001|skill=Dark Claw|simple=yes}} or some sort of melee reflect immunity method must be used first against enemy that use melee damage reflecting skill. * Mainly single target damage. ====== Stats ====== * '''STR: 124/125''' (124/125 STR is preferred since it provides more ATK) * '''AGI: 90+''' (AGI is required for achieving 193 ASPD) * '''VIT: 90+ OR 125''' (VIT is used to provide the [[Stun]] resistance from total 100 VIT (Base + Extra)) * '''INT: 1''' * '''DEX: 1-90+''' (put DEX as necessary) * '''LUK: 125/126''' (125 (126 for defense bypass from PDM) LUK is important and used for crit rate, crit damage, and headgear combo) ====== Talent ====== * '''POW: 100''' * '''STA: 0''' * '''WIS: 0''' * '''SPL: 0''' * '''CON: 0''' * '''CRT: 97''' ====== Requirements ====== This build is centered around [[Enchant Deadly Poison]], Crit Damage and Rate, and {{Skill List|id=2022|skill=Cross Impact|simple=yes}} boosting equipment. ====== Miscellaneous ====== The other skills that will benefit the builds are: * [[Meteor Assault]]: For initial leveling and clearing out mobs. This build will work wonders with just switching to {{Item List |id=22134 |item=Enforcer Shoes |simple=yes}}, a 0.3 FCT Reduction Gear, and having the Pre-Requisite Skills for the shoes. * {{Skill List|id=2037|skill=Cross Ripper Slasher|simple=yes}}: Needed for {{Item List |id=470130|item=End of the World|slots=1|simple=yes}} or secondary build option. * {{Skill List|id=2036|skill=Rolling Cutter|simple=yes}}: Needed for {{Item List |id=470130|item=End of the World|slots=1|simple=yes}} or secondary build option. * {{Skill List|id=5001|skill=Dark Claw|simple=yes}}: Needed for {{Item List |id=480134|item=Avareco|slots=1 |simple=yes}} and a must have for all physical GX builds. * {{Skill List|id=2035|skill=Hallucination Walk|simple=yes}}: Optional for {{Item List |id=470130|item=End of the World|slots=1|simple=yes}} or having more survivability. * {{Skill List|id=2024|skill=New Poison Research|simple=yes}}: Needed to brew catalyst for {{Skill List|id=2027|skill=Poisonous Weapon|simple=yes}}, and also extends the duration of [[Enchant Deadly Poison]]. * {{Skill List|id=2027|skill=Poisonous Weapon|simple=yes}}: Adds extra 10% melee physical damage and other beneficial effect to user depending on the type of new poison used. ===== Soul Destroyer ===== Advantages: *Can kill enemy before they got into melee range. *Ranged build can be better in some situation like dealing with melee reflect enemy, or picking off enemy one by one. Disadvantages: *Ranged skill wont be able to benefit from {{Skill List|id=5001|skill=Dark Claw|simple=yes}}. *[[Soul Destroyer]] have a lot more restriction (casting time and cast delay) to be able to deal good sustained damage, compared to {{Skill List|id=2022|skill=Cross Impact|simple=yes}}. *Mainly single target damage. ====== Requirements ====== This build is centered around [[Enchant Deadly Poison]], crit damage, crit rate, casting time, and aftercast delay equipment.
====Non-Critical==== Advantages: *Good AoE damage. *Meteor Assault is not affected by [[Enchant Deadly Poison]], so the player can be more economical. Disadvantages: *Non-crit skill doesn't bypass flee, so gears that can give Hit or Perfect Hit bonus is usually required. *Lower single target damage. *Strictly melee damage. *Meteor Assault have some fixed and variable casting time, so gears to reduce it or make casting time uninterrupted is needed. ===== Meteor Assault ===== [[Meteor Assault]] build is both a leveling and PVM/MVP end-game if geared properly. It depends heavily on the {{item |id=22134 Enforcer Shoes}} and the skills listed in the shoes. ====== Stats ====== * '''STR: 120-125''' (120-125 STR is preferred since it provides more ATK and directly affects the [[Meteor Assault]] formula) * '''AGI: 90+ OR 120''' (AGI is required for achieving 193 ASPD, 120 for gear requirements) * '''VIT: 70-90 OR 120/125''' (VIT is used to provide the [[Stun]] resistance from total 100 VIT (Base + Extra), or 120/125 for gear requirements) * '''INT: 1 OR 120''' (120 for gear requirements) * '''DEX: 1 OR 90-100''' (less DEX can be used when using [[Perfect Hit]] gears) * '''LUK: ~90 OR 125/126''' (extra ATK or 125/126 for gear requirements) ====== Talent ====== * '''POW: 100''' * '''STA: 0''' * '''WIS: 0''' * '''SPL: 0''' * '''CON: 1+''' * '''CRT: 0''' ====== Requirements ====== This build's stats are centered around the Middle-Lower headgear set and [[HIT]]/[[Perfect Hit]] boosting gears used. ====== Fixed Cast Reduction ====== Options: * Headgear: Any Headgear that provides at least 0.3 seconds [[Fixed Cast Time]] reduction will help remove the cast bar for Meteor Assault. * Minor/Fixed Casting Stone: Garment-enchant stones open the option to use HP/SP Leech or defensive headgears. ====== Attack Boost ====== Options: * {{Item List 2|id=19444|item=Star Eyepatch|slots=1 |simple=y}} & {{Item |id=4143 Orc Hero Card}}set: This set needs 120 VIT to get the optimal ATK boost (130 is possible, but not stats efficient). This set gives one of the lowest ATK boosts from the gears but provides high Hard Defense and HP, making a tanky build. Extra LUK helps boost the VIT values more. * {{Item |id=18823 Imperial Feather}} & {{Item |id=19246 Royal Guard Necklace}} set: This set needs 120 AGI to get the maximum ATK boost from the set. This set gives one of the lowest ATK boosts from the gears, but the flee from AGI stat helps reduce the potion costs while leveling, while also giving some status effect immunity. It is also rather easy to achieve 193 ASPD. * {{Item |id=19138 Seraphim Coronet}}: This build needs 120 INT to get the maximum ATK boost from the middle headgear. This setup gives the best Flat ATK boost from the gears. The extra SP helps to reduce the SP item consumption. This can be combined with {{Item |id=18754 Blood Sucker}}, {{Item |id=19112 Tengu Scroll}}, or {{Item |id=420006 Vassalage Necklace}}. * {{Item |id=19437 Little Garden}} & {{Item |id=420006 Vassalage Necklace}}: This build needs 125 STR/LUK to get the maximum ATK boost from the headgears. This setup gives lowest Flat ATK boost for Guillotine Cross, out of all the available options but is the best option for Crit based skills and other Gears. ====== HIT/Perfect Hit ====== Options: * {{Item |id=20859 Phreeoni Wings |slots=1}} garment is overall the best in slot for PVM/MVP since it provides high HIT and can be used to make 1 DEX builds. It has a set with {{Item |id=4121 Phreeoni Card}} which gives additional HIT and Perfect Hit. * Another good option for garment is the {{Item List 2|id=480114|item=Striking Mikoshi|slots=1|simple=y}} with {{Item List 2 |id=19379 |item=Striking Hat |slots=1|simple=y}}, which provides about 75 Perfect Hit. * {{Item |id=28575 Verus Core |slots=1}} are good options for increasing Perfect Hit. The Meteor Assault can be used since Assassin Cross with {{Item |id=4077 Phen Card}} to level with Crimson Weapons. On reaching level 100, the [[Poison React]], [[Weapon Crush]], [[Weapon Blocking]], and [[Counter Slash]] skills will help boost the damage and insta-casting of Meteor Assault. Other gears that boost HP/SP Leech, Damage/ATK, or Defense can be used for leveling and PVM/MVP, depending upon each owner's preference. ===== Rolling Cutter/Cross Ripper Slasher Katars ===== [[Rolling Cutter]] is one of the leveling AoE skill for a Guillotine Cross, the advantage being higher AoE at 7x7 area. This build is a good balanced build that can use skills, [[CRIT]], perfect dodge, or anything depending on gears used. * '''STR: 90-125''' * '''AGI: 90-125''' * '''VIT: 80-100 OR 125''' * '''INT: 1 OR 120''' * '''DEX: ~60 OR 90-100 OR 120''' * '''LUK: ~60 OR 72/90/108/126 OR 120''' This build's stats are centered around the {{item |id=2576 Heroic Backpack [1]}} garment, which is overall the best garment for PVM/MVP and sometimes PVP/WoE too. Make sure [[STR]], [[AGI]], and [[VIT]] are above 90 as these are crucial stats for a GX (STR = [[atk|attack]] power, AGI = [[ASPD]]/[[flee]], VIT = survivability) and the backpack bonuses are great for it. If you prefer to use skills more than CRIT, go for 90 [[DEX]] and 60-70 [[LUK]]. If you prefer to CRIT more and want the backpack LUK bonus, then go for 90 LUK and 60-70 DEX. VIT is set to 94 so that there is 100 VIT in total after job bonuses, which will give stun immunity. 120 DEX when combined with ranged gear is also a viable option for long-ranged MVP-ing with Cross Ripper Slasher against some MVP that have melee attack reflect. With the adddition of {{item|id =28565 Perverse Demon Mask}}, the player may choose to put more points into LUK in order to gain defense bypassing effect from it. Since the bonuses is every 18 points of LUK, the player may choose to put either 72, 90, 108, or 126 in LUK, based on how much the player value defense bypass effect. If the player already have defense bypass effect from other gears, LUK amount may be reduced and invested into another stats. When using {{item|id =19138 Seraphim Coronet}}, stats point may be invested into INT stats instead to gain bonus damage from it. Rolling Cutter is the first skill to get and will be the main leveling skill. [[Cross Ripper Slasher]] is very strong with many counters built up with Rolling Cutter. For leveling purposes, CRS can be used to finish off the one monster that is not killed when mobbing. {{Skill List|id=2022|skill=Cross Impact|simple=yes}} is good for single target burst damage as well. [[Cloaking Exceed]] is useful and you will not be seen by insect/demon monsters. This build can also be used to level using [[Meteor Assault]] if the player is equipped with {{item |id=22134 Enforcer Shoes}}. The only mandatory equipment for this route of leveling is cards or gear that prevents cast interruption. Using this skill while dual-wielding, when carded correctly will usually yield better damage than using a katar. This build will have a good CRIT rate with certain gears like {{item |id=2620 Rogue's Treasures}}. Morrigane's set is also good choice for the early GX levels or Assassin/Assassin Cross levels. Please note that CRIT-ing monsters one at a time is not recommended for leveling purposes and using Rolling Cutter to mob is much faster. CRIT could be useful for MVP/WoE purposes though. MVPs that have [[NPC AGIUP|AGI-UP]] usually will dodge skills that depend on [[HIT]], so this is where CRIT comes in. Buffs like [[Gloria]] will bring the CRIT rate up over 50 usually, which means over 100 CRIT with the doubled CRIT rate from Katars. High Perfect Dodge (80+) can be easily achieved with the right gears, like Morrigane's set, two {{item |id=1223 Fortune Swords}}, and {{item |id=4257 Wild Rose Card}}. LUK will also help but do not get too much LUK at the beginning as the points are better spent on other stats first. If tanking a mob for your party to kill, switch from the two Fortune Swords to one Fortune Sword and a shield with the appropriate racial reduction card ({{item|id=4058 Thara Frog Card}}, {{item|id=4136 Khalitzburg Card}}, etc.). Switch back to two Fortune Swords to pull and mob the monsters together. A {{item |id=1264 Specialty Jur [4]}} with four {{item |id=4115 Hunter Fly Cards }}, {{item |id=1251 Jur [3]}} with three {{item |id=4115 Hunter Fly Cards }}, or {{item |id=28007 Crimson Katar [2]}} with two {{item |id=4115 Hunter Fly Cards }} is useful with Rolling Cutter for leeching HP back. The player can stack this with other leech gear to increase the chance of leeching HP/SP. At level 120, the player can switch to {{item |id=28000 Thanatos Katar [1]}} for better damage and built-in HP/SP leech. For DPS purposes, use a {{item |id=1287 Durga [1]}}, KVM Katar ({{item |id=1281 Glorious Bloody Roar }}/{{item |id=1282 Glorious Jamadhar}}), or {{item |id=28007 Crimson Katar [2]}}. KVM Katars are good for attacking even non-[[Demi Human]] monsters due to the 193 ASPD proc.
===PvP=== ==== PVP/WoE Daggers ==== This is more of an endgame [[PVP]]/[[WoE]] build and is '''not a leveling build.''' To optimize [[ASPD]], [[HIT]], and [[ATK]], focus on balancing the [[STR]], [[AGI]] and [[DEX]] stats. This is because it is indispensable to have quick attack speed along with adequate HIT so that attacks will not fail. [[VIT]] is also needed for survivability. * '''STR: 100-110''' * '''AGI: 100-110''' * '''VIT: 70-90''' * '''INT: 1 +4''' * '''DEX: 90-100''' * '''LUK: 1-20''' # ATK: 259 +0 (without Daggers) ATK: 499+112 (if using Glorious Damascus and with a refine of +8) # ASPD: 181 (without Daggers) ASPD: 185 (with [[Increase Agility]], [[Blessing]], Drosera Herb Salad, Siroma Ice Tea, Steamed Desert Scorpions, Hwergelmir's Tonic and Awakening Potion) # HIT: 303 (with [[Increase Agility]], [[Blessing]], Siroma Ice Tea, Hwergelmir's Tonic) # DEF: 0+79 # Flee: 341+2 (with [[Increase Agility]], [[Blessing]], Drosera Herb Salad, Steamed Desert Scorpions) # Critical: 2 # MDEF: 0+ 15 # MATK: 19+24 (with [[Blessing]]) # HP and SP may be different depending on the server ==== Dual-Dagger (DD) Critical Hit-Locker ==== This build focuses on dealing critical hits on a single target ([[CRIT]]) using two daggers. This build is mainly used for single target MVPing/PvM as it relies on auto-attacking (Ctrl+Click, or /nc). The main goals are: 1) Reach 193 ASPD (through AGI, gears, ASPD-modifying consumables, and buffs (such as [[Cantocandidus]])]; 2) Make your CRIT greater than 100 [from stats, gears, CRIT-modifying consumables, and buffs (such as Gloria)]; and 3) Deal enormous damage (through STR, overupgraded weapons, cards, etc.) Your stats should look more or less like this once you reach Base Lv. 150: * '''STR: 70~ * '''AGI: 110-120 * '''VIT: 70-94 * '''INT: 1 * '''DEX: 1-50''' (offhand might show as a "CRIT", but it's still based off of hit for some obscure reason) * '''LUK: 90-120 OR 126 And at Base Lv. 175, your stats should look more or less like this: * '''STR: 80-100 * '''AGI: 110-120 * '''VIT: 70-94 * '''INT: 1 * '''DEX: 40-80 * '''LUK: 90-120 OR 126 For most of the time, your main weapons are not katars (dual daggers, DUH!). Instead, you will be spamming [[Enchant Deadly Poison]] and auto-attacking lone targets most of the time. Make sure to max both [[Righthand Mastery]] and [[Lefthand Mastery]]. But then, you will be forced to switch to katars when facing groups of monsters. Thus, it is recommended to level up with maximum STR, AGI/VIT, and DEX (refer to the Rolling Cutter/Cross Ripper Slasher Katar Build above), and reset your stats to a DD-CRIT build once you either reach Base Lv. 185 or when you have gathered decent gears for a DD-crit build. But if you have gears that are optimized for Perfect Dodge, then you might as well act as a "Perfect-Dodge Tanker" in leveling-oriented parties and continue allocating your stat points as described above.
