There is no [[Levels#Job Level|Job Level]] equivalent. *They obtain additional EXP from [[spotlight|Spotlight]], increased server rates, Battle Manuals, or EXP increasing gear and cards. *Their [[FLEE|Flee rate]] and [[DEF|Defense]] is not reduced by the number of monsters. *Their [[Stats#HIT|Hit Rate]] is capped at 95%. Even if it has way more hit than required for a monster, it will always miss at a 5% chance. *All Homunculi have a base [[ASPD|Attack Speed]] of 1.4 seconds per attack (ASPD 130). Different stat growths lead to different attack speeds of each Homunculus. *Homunculus' stat growth is '''random''', nothing will affect which stats will grow and which stats will not. *Homunculus can hit [[Ghost]] property monsters. *Other players can't Heal homunculus, but [[Sanctuary]] heals them *Homunculus movement speed follows the owner's condition when he/she summons it, revive it, or moving map zones. If A Geneticist is under Cart boost the homunculus will also move fast, same when the player get Decrease Agility. ''Need confirmations from other players about buff. Some buffs can be casted on homunculus but it's not clear they're affected or not or have similar restriction like Mercenaries'' ===Known Bugs=== *The Homunculus stat window is now bugged, many of the stats do not represent real values. For instance, [[ATK]] is much lower than its actual value. *The [[Vanilmirth]]'s [[Instruction Change]] skill is bugged and only adds the [[STR]] and [[INT]] when it levels up. If the player leaves the map, [[Vaporize]], [[Call Homunculus|Summon]], or [[Homunculus Resurrection|resurrect the Homunculus]], the bonus will be lost. Teleporting does not cause the bonuses to be lost. *After [[Amistr]]'s [[Castling]] skill, monsters do not always change target. *If the Homunculus was vaporized or killed with a [[Status Effects|status effect]], it will bug up. (It will get immobilized, vanish and it will get the grim reaper, like the one while affected by [[Status Effects#Curse|Curse]]. Use [[Vaporize]] and [[Call Homunculus]] to fix this bug). *Homunculus can have permanent [[Movement Speed]] increase until one relogs, changes map, teleports, or [[Vaporize]]s. It is possible while using [[Call Homunculus]] and an item, skill or gear that increases [[Movement Speed]], such as {{item|id=12016 Speed Potion}}, [[Increase AGI]], [[Cart Boost (Geneticist)|Cart Boost]] or {{item|id=1363 Bloody Axe}} at the same time. *Both the Homunculus Hunger countdown clock (1 minute timer) and the starvation clock (20 seconds timer) will reset if one relogs, changes map, teleports, or uses [[Vaporize]] and [[Call Homunculus]] together. *On iRO, all Homunculus [[race]]s have been changed to [[Demi Human]] for balancing reasons. However, the alternate form of the [[Vanilmirth]] is still considered [[Formless]] and not Demi Human. Therefore, all Demi Human reductions do not apply versus alternate [[Vanilmirth]]s. In addition, the [[Battlegrounds]] equipment set penalties (damage received is tripled versus non Demi Human monsters) apply for the alternate [[Vanilmirth]] because it is not considered Demi Human. This does not apply to [[Homunculus S]], which have the same [[race]]s that they do on other RO's, because this balancing was seen as unnecessary, now that people do not use [[Battlegrounds]] sets. == Changelog == *{{Plainlink|url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/247513-february-3rd-renewal-maintenance/ February 3rd, 2020}} **Maximum levels increased from 150 to 175. **Experience table changed. **Homunculus will now always gain 10% of the final experience gained by the owner, irrespective of how much damage the homunculus dealt to the enemy. **Auto-feeding system implemented. **Homunculus can no longer attack monster automatically. To attack a monster, the owner must order it manually by Alt + Right Click. *{{Plainlink|url=https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/254825-december-17th-renewal-maintenance/ December 17th, 2021}} **Maximum levels increased from 175 to 185. *October 13th, 2022 **Homunculus duration reduced from permanent to 1,800 seconds. *{{Plainlink|url=http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/newslist.aspx#n3275 April 28th, 2023}} **Maximum levels increased from 185 to 200. ==See Also== *[[AI]] *[[Homunculus S]] *[[Mercenary System]] ===External Links=== *[http://www.drazzy.com/ai AzzyAI] *[http://ww4.enjoy.ne.jp/~to4/R/hom.html Homunculus Stat Calculator (Renewal)] *[http://img.photobucket.com/albums/v189/romonk/Homun/HomunculusStatProjection.jpg Detailed Stat Growth Chart] {{Navbox Homunculus}} {{Navbox Leveling}} [[Category: Homunculus]] [[Category: Alchemist]]

title: Horror Toy Factory
wikitext:
{{Repeatable|cooldown=16 hours}} {{Quest Info | levelreq =140 | partyreq =1+, need to be in a party | joblevelreq = | classreq = | itemreq = | questreq = | questcoreq = | itemreward = {{Item|id=7642 Bloody Coin}} which can be traded for several equipment and enchantment | jobexpreward = | window = yes }} '''Notes:'''
* You cannot re-enter this instance if you happen to exit this instance before the instance is completed (e.g. disconnected, died then respawn).
* It is suggested to bring Token of Siegfried in case you die on the middle of the instance.
* All monsters in this instance are [[Demon]] race; the boss is [[Undead]] race. === Instance Cooldown Quest Name === Trail of Toy Factory == Instance == To start this quest, go to Lutie. Talk to Catherine Jet Johnson {{navi|xmas|237|303}} to reserve the instance, then click on the transporter to enter the instance. === First Phase === #After the introduction, talk to the Myst Case NPC who will transform your sprite into a Cookie (Red). #*Keep in mind you need to keep exploring while transformed. #*Venturing/talking to other NPC's aside from the transformation Myst Case while not transformed will spawn multiple Nightmare Cruisers. #*There are multiple Myst Case NPCs around the corners of the room; it is advised to speak to them when your transformation duration is about to expire. #Kill Vicious Cookies and Evil Dwelling Boxes around the room. #*After enough are killed, there will be an announcement, and all remaining monsters will die. #Move to northwest portion of this room and talk to the Green Cookie. #*You must be a Red Cookie in order to speak with this NPC. #*If you are not a Red Cookie, the NPC will disappear for a short while before reappearing, and will not speak to you until you are a Red Cookie. #After the dialogue, talk to the new Myst Case NPC, who will transform you into a Myst Case. #*Player must be a Myst Case in order to proceed to the next location. #*Enter the portal to the right of the Green Cookie to move to the next phase. ===Second Phase=== #After speaking to Catherine, talk to the Myst Case NPC again to change your sprite into a Red Cookie. #*Similar to the first phase, you need to stay transformed while venturing; otherwise, Cruisers will spawn in large numbers around the room. #*If you somehow entered the portal you came from before finishing the second phase, you need to go back to first room and transform into a Myst Case again in order to go back to the second room. #There are 10 workers (Green Cookie NPCs) throughout this room. Talk to them and listen to their stories. #*You cannot move, cast skills, or use any consumables while the workers are talking, but monsters can still target you at this time. #After talking to all 10 workers, there will be another announcement and all remaining monsters will die. #*Proceed back through the portal you came from, and then enter the north portal to move to the next phase. ===Third Phase=== #Walk to the middle of the room to trigger a dialogue between Santa and Antonio. #*After Antonio disappears, enter the portal to the left. #Here, there are many mobs, but only Antonio needs to be killed. #*After Antonio is killed, there will be another announcement, and all remaining monsters will die. #*'''Note:''' Antonio may also spawn in the room where the dialogue with Santa took place as well, so be sure to check before proceeding through the left portal. #Go back to the center room, and then enter the right portal to move to the last phase. ===Boss Phase=== #Listen the conversation between Catherine and Celine Kimi. When it finishes, Celine Kimi and her phantom will spawn. #Information about Celine Kimi #*She is Large [[Size]], [[Ghost]] 1 Property and [[Undead (race)|Undead]] Race. #*She has a large spongy [[Max HP]] (20m ~ 66m, depends on party size, 20m if solo, 66m if party of 12), high [[DEF]], and high [[MDEF]], so it's best to have high [[ASPD]] AoE skills to take her down. #*She has the ability to cast [[Max Pain]] for 10 seconds at a time; while she is in this aura, all attacks will be redirected back in a screen wide physical AoE. #**It is best to avoid attacking her while the aura is up. #**The aura can be preemptively seen by Celine Kimi having long cast bar, and the use of the /hp emoticon. #*She also casts [[Pulse Strike]], [[Power Up]], [[Critical Wounds]], [[Wide Soul Drain]] (represented by a cast bar with /mp emoticon), [[Wide Stone Curse]], and [[Wide Sleep]]. #**While in Power Up, her attacks can hit for around 15k without any reducts, so be prepared.
#*If she was separated from her phantom, the phantom will heal Celine Kimi for a large amount. #**Make sure the Phantom is always close to her and that damage is done to both of them simultaneously.
#*If she is moved too far from the area where she spawns, the fight will be completely reset, so make sure you do not drag her too far away. #**It is recommended to stay next to the wall above where she spawns to keep her in place, as well as to prevent the knockback from Pulse Strike.
#*If her current HP is off by 1% compared to her Phantom's, the Phantom will heal Celine Kimi for 6% of her max HP. ===Finishing the Instance=== #After Celine Kimi is defeated, walk through the southwest portal to treasure room.
#There will be 10 treasure box NPCs which will drop items when clicked.

Because they work in different airships Tarlock asks you to deliver a letter to him and get his's reply. #Board the Domestic route airship (from [[Juno]] to [[Lighthalzen]] to [[Einbroch]] to [[Hugel]]) and find Airship Captain Ferlock {{navi|airplane|236|163}} (you can switch between the two routes at the Juno airport without having to pay the boarding fee a second time). Choose "Give him Tarlock's Letter". #:[[File:AirshipCaptainFerlock.png]] #:After reading the letter he tells you, that his brothers Tarlock borrowed from him a few things, however, he lost them. #:Ferlock tells you those items were 2 {{item|id=7340 Will of the Darkness}} and 2 {{item|id=576 Prickly Fruit}} and the monsters that drop it can be found on Tarlock's Airship. #:*Note: ''If you already have the required items in your inventory, you can skip step 4 and proceed straight to step 5.'' #Go back to International route airship and wait patiently on the deck. title: Hugel
wikitext:
== About Hugel == [[Image:Hugel.jpg|center]] Hugel is the Garden City. Located in the upper north east of the Swartzwald Republic, Hugel is home to the [[Hunter]] guild. Off the dock is the Odin Temple dungeon. There are many things to do in Hugel, including Bingo and Monster Racing.
To go here, use the '''Kafra Employee''' in [[Juno]] to teleport here. == Story == ''“No one asked anyone where they came from, what they did, and how they got here...”'' However, Hugel is now the eye of the storm. As pursuers who seek Odin Shrine’s relics, Gigantes, and Ymir’s Heart appeared, and the airship route opened, Hugel’s peace and isolation has come to the end. People in Hugel, especially ones who left their hometown for specific reasons, are now desperate to hide their secrets from the outsiders. So they started holding parties with others more often than used to be, in order to keep their secrets… ==Quest== Quests added with the Hugel update can be found [[Quests#Hugel Quests|here]]. ==Guide== [[Image:Hugelmap.jpg]] In the far north east of the Schwarzvald republic, lies a small rural coastal village by the name of Hugel. Hugel is a quiet, yet festive fishing village, hosting a variety of games and activities for tourists, as well as hosts the [[Hunter]] guild. Because of its geographic location, the city of Hugel grew much different than the other Schwarzvald cities, being seperated by both Thanatos Tower and Abyss Lake. Because of increasing attacks on travelers, going by Airship is possibly the safest way to enter Hugel. Adventurers visiting Hugel can enjoy many different things. If you have friends handy, the Bingo hall in the top left allows a group of 5 players to play, and every 10 minutes the monster races take place in the bottom left corner of town. Those interested in adventuring can take a short boat trip from the eastern docks to Angrboda island for 500z to where the remains of the great Odin's Temple stands. Those wishing to class change to [[Hunter]] may have found that the [[Hunter]]'s guild has been moved to Hugel. You can find the guild building in the top right corner of town. Its rumored that the Hunters guild isn't the only one to make a relocation; the [[Blacksmith]]s guild also recently moved to the forge in the southeast corner of [[Einbroch]] city. Supplies and storage services can be located near the center square in town. Visitors will be able to purchase Hugel's unique crop of fruit, the Mastella Fruit. A Cool Event Corp NPC will handle storage and saving services in Hugel, as [[Kafra]] is unable to staff such a far away place. ==Dungeons== ==={{map|id=hu_fild05 Abyss Lake}}=== Travelers can find Abyss Lake in the northern part Schwartzvald Republic near Thanatos Tower. The only lake in the Republic is a natural wonder whose beauty has warmed the coldest of hearts and inspired hundreds of [[Bard]] songs. The shimmering lake surface, the surrounding green fields, and the foggy mist form an astonishing vision through all four seasons of the year. The lake's clear, pristine waters seem to run endlessly into the earth, and no one is sure of the water's actual depth. A quint island lies in the center of Abyss Lake, covered with dark, earthen rocks that appear purposefully arranged, almost as if to obscure something... Although it is a beauteous spectacle, human visitors rarely come to Abyss Lake. The human inhabitants near Abyss Lake were all long since driven away by combined threat of strange creatures, believed to be guardians of nature summoned by the gods, and the dragons that have been summoned by Demon King Morroc. Even as people fled from Abyss Lake, Morroc's dragons grew more numerous and aggressive, immediately attacking travelers and airships that dared to come near. The Abyss Lake Dungeon consists of three floors, each floor becoming increasingly difficult. The final floor is a wide open space crowded with lots of monsters. Its recommended that if you wish to come to this place, that you have a sizable or very well coordinated party. On this final floor, the boss dragon Detale Deurus will appear to stop you from taking his treasures. See the [[Abyss Lake Entrance Guide]] for access. ==={{map|id=tha_t01 Thanatos Tower}}=== [[Image:Thanatos_Tower.jpg|center]] Aside from scarce historical documentation and spoken legends, very little is known about Thanatos Tower's Origin. The most widely accepted theory is that the tower was built to honor the legendary magic wielding swordsman Thanatos's victory over Demon King Morroc, an ancient demon that devistated the human world before the millennium war. According to the legends, Thanatos battled Demon King Morroc for 10 days and nights before he sealed it in the southern Rune-Midgard desert. Thanatos Tower is an awe inspiring sight today, but it was crumbling ruins when it was rediscovered by the [[Rekenber Corporation]]. Interested in extracting its secrets, Rekenber Corporation planned to reconstruct all thirteen of the tower's floors and conduct excavations that will continue the artifact research started by the great Sage Varmunt. So far, they have restored the tower's lowest floors and had opened them to the public, charging admission to tourists to fund their continuing renovation efforts. But one day, a strange flash of lightning, bright enough to be seen in [[Einbroch]], recently struck the top of Thanatos Tower. There are differing accounts of what had happened, but the disaster left only a few survivors, all claiming that Demons or Angels attacked them. Despite this tragedy, the Rekenber Corporation refuses to give up, and doggedly pursues its goals... The Tower of Thanatos lies north east of [[Juno]]. The most direct path to get to the tower would be to leave Juno from the south, go one map east, and 2 north. On the map here, left of center right across the gorge from the tower itself, will be a Rekenber representative who will assist you in getting to the tower. See [[Thanatos Tower Quest]] for access. As of January 30th, 2024 the Tower was revamped. See [[Thanatos Tower Revamp]] or the original announcement [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=360&p=2 here]. ==={{map|id=odin_tem01 Odin Temple}}=== [[Image:Odin's_Temple.jpg‎|center]] ''Long ago, there was a place where people had served God.'' ''He created human beings and gave them everything.'' ''So the people built a shrine and began to perform a religious service to appreciate him...'' The Odin Temple was built ages ago by an ancient civilization who worshipped the god of lightning. The temple was massive, almost spanning the size of the island. The people gave everything they could to make sure that the temple was perfect. However, their devotion and loyalty was all in vain. Civil war broke out as the various leaders vied for the favor of Odin. Soon enough, destruction and death came as the warring factions nearly wiped each other out. The survivors slowly abandoned the island in search of a better future elsewhere. Today, [[Scholar]]s and adventurers have made their way back into the island. The ghosts of the past as well as the present now stand guard to the greatest secrets of Odin including that of the current ruins of Odin's Temple as well as the remnants of the [[Ancient_Odin's_Temple_(Odin's_Temple_F4) |Ancient Odin's Temple]]. Talk to the NPC at Hugel (209,109), select "Sure!" to pay 800z to access the Odin Temple. {{Navbox Towns}}

== Reward NPCs ==

== Mini Game NPCs ==
=== Helen (113, 144) ===
For 1000z you can play a number guessing game with Helen. She will pick a number, and you have 6 tries to guess her number.  After each guess she will tell you if her number was higher or lower than your guess.
* Hint: Use a binary search, guess 50, then either 25 or 75, an so on.
* Hint: Always guess halfway between two points.

Example: 
:Always begin by guessing 50: Halfway between 1 - 100
:-If the number is smaller, guess 25, halfway between 1-50
:-If the number is larger guess 38, halfway between 25-50
:-If the number is larger guess 44, halfway between 38-50
:-If the number is smaller guess 42, halfway between 38 - 43 
:-If the number is smaller guess 40, halfway between 38-42


Tickets Won:
:1 Guess - 50
:2 Guesses - 25
:3 Guesses - 12
:4 Guesses - 6
:5 Guesses - 3
:6 Guesses - 1

=== Rem (83, 150) ===
For 750z, Rem will offer you the opportunity to write down his poems. He wishes for you to copy down the line given, except remove all spaces.  You must type in 3 lines correctly in a row in order to win '''3''' Festival Tickets. The lines are:

*Thequickbrownfoxjumpedoverthelazydog.
*Fortunateisthewonwhooneherheart.
*Alackerofcrackersisasuckerforyuckers.
*ImeanttosayKentwentandsenthislentbenttent.
*Forasmuchofasmoochyouareamooch.
*Asawisemanoncesaid,'Wherearemypants?'
*Thewayyoutreatnovicessaysmoreaboutwhoyouarethanyourleveldoes.
*Thechatterfromthehatterupontheladdercausesaclatter.
*Thepoetryofthemomentliesinyesterday'sthoughts.
*Neverkissamermanorelseyouwillgetharpies.

(Note: some web browsers will not work correctly when copying these lines, you may need to copy and paste the list into notepad and use them from there)

You will be teleported to the east edge of the map if you type too fast.

=== Troy (121, 116) ===
For 500z, Troy will challenge you to 5 rounds of Rock-Paper-Scissors.  Troy will count your wins and his wins (ties contribute to neither count).  After 5 rounds, if Troy has won more rounds than you, you do not get any tickets.  If Troy has won the same number of rounds as you, you will get 1 ticket.  If you have won more rounds than Troy, you will be given 2 tickets for each extra round you won. (for example, if you win 3 rounds, and Troy wins 1, you will be given 2*(3-1) = 4 tickets.)

* Note: If the option '''''whats going on?''''' appears, Troy will chose the same thing he chose last round (if the option appears 1st round, his choice will be bow)

=== Van (81, 123) ===
For 750z, Van will challenge you to a memory game, involving remembering an increasing number of monster names.  If you correctly pass all 7 rounds, you receive '''3''' Festival Tickets.

There are 7 rounds, and in each round, you must type what you entered last round, plus the new name that he tells you, without any spaces. There are four possible monsters:
*Drops
*Poring
*Poporing
*Marin

Example:
*Round one, you are told that the monster is Poring. You type "Poring" in the box.
*Round two, you are told that the monster is Marin. You type "PoringMarin" in the box.
*Round three, you are told that the monster is Poring. You type "PoringMarinPoring" in the box. 
*Etc. 

The shortcut Ctrl+Insert for copy works in RO. The shortcut for paste is Shift+Insert.

== Exchange NPCs ==
=== Dr. Leo (83, 82) ===
Dr. Leo doesn't say much, but he'll trade Festival Tickets for some items:
* 15 {{item |id=7167 Strange Steel Piece}} for 3 Festival Tickets

* 10 {{item |id=7210 Armor of Dullahan}} for 4 Festival Tickets

=== Ed (102, 128) ===
Ed is a fashion designer, and needs feathers to make a coat. Ed will exchange some Festival Tickets for any of:
* 20 {{item |id=916 Feather of Birds}} for 2 Festival Tickets
* 10 {{item |id=949 Feather}} for 2 Festival Tickets
* 20 {{item |id=7101 PecoPeco Feather}} for 4 Festival Tickets
* 15 {{item |id=7115 Harpy Feather}} for 4 Festival Tickets

=== Elena (78, 137) ===
Elena is an entomology student and needs your help collecting insect samples. She will trade you some Festival Tickets for any of the following:
* 30 {{item |id=928 Insect Feeler}} for 2 Festival Tickets
* 20 {{item |id=1031 Mantis Scythe}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 20 {{item |id=1042 Bug Leg}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 10 {{item |id=7064 Wing of Dragonfly}} for 4 Festival Tickets

=== Toma (106, 157) ===
Toma needs sand to house train her new kitten, Jellybean. She will exchange some Festival Tickets for any of:
* 20 {{item |id=1056 Grit}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 20 {{item |id=7124 Sand Clump}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 20 {{item |id=7264 Dry Sand}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 10 {{item |id=7043 Fine Sand}} for 4 Festival Tickets

=== Vangur (103, 149) ===
Vangur is an artist looking for rare shells. Vangur will exchange some Festival Tickets for any of:
* 20 {{item |id=935 Shell}} for 2 Festival Tickets
* 10 {{item |id=943 Solid Shell}} for 3 Festival Tickets
* 10 {{item |id=7009 Glitter Shell}} for 4 Festival Tickets

For a cost of 4,000z, VanRobenstien will save you from the boring airships by firing you out a cannon in the direction of [[Hugel]]. You will land in a random location within Hugel.

title: Hunter
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job|jobName=Hunter|jobBase=Archer|jobType=2-1|jobLevel = 50|Race=[[Human]]|changesAt=[[Hugel]]|skills=18|skillPoints=82|questSkills=1|str=4|agi=6|vit=2|int=4|dex=10|luk=4}} [[File:Hunter.jpg|240px|right]] Hunters are the 2nd Job Class of an [[Archer]] and are skillful at indirect combat, using their [[Bow]] to snipe from far away or by laying traps to incapacitate their target. These traps will also cause various status effects (i.e. [[Sandman]] inflicts the status [[Sleep]], for example) or cause elemental damage (i.e. [[Blast Mine]] or [[Land Mine]]) to a target. Additionally, Hunters are able to call upon an animal companion: the [[Falconry Mastery|Falcon]]. Falcons give Hunters the ability to deal damage to multiple monsters at once without using Arrows or Traps using their new skill, [[Blitz Beat]], and they also have the ability to reveal concealed enemies and destroy enemy traps, with [[Detect]] and [[Spring Trap]] respectively. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Hunter Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' *''If you are looking for the Ragnarok Transcendence Hunter Job Change, the quest follows the [https://irowiki.org/classic/Hunter_Job_Change_Guide Classic RO Job Change Quest].'' Changing into a Hunter from an [[Archer]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks given by the Hunter's Guild in [[Hugel]], including: * Taking a Personality Test * Random Item Collection * Monster Hunting Quest After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Hunter. If you are Job Level 50 when you change, you will receive a {{Item List |id=1718 |item=Hunter Bow |simple=yes}} as a reward. This is a very strong weapon when used with {{Item List |id=1774 |item=Hunting Arrow |simple=yes}}. === Job Change Quest Skip === Note that you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip] == Builds == === I. Arrow Shower === Base Level 99 base stat distribution suggestion: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 90 * INT: 50 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 Although Hunters gain access to new Falcon and Trap skills, the [[Archer]] skill [[Arrow Shower]] is still the most reliable AOE and only becomes more powerful with better gear and stats. With a proper set up and the right Elemental Arrows or Elemental Converters, this build can level very effectively and quickly to Base Level 99 by continuing the same strategy as before. [[DEX]] is still your main damage and [[HIT]] stat, while [[VIT]] keeps you alive when mobbing larger groups of monsters and [[INT]] is recommended for [[SP]] regen and pool size. === II. Claymore Trap/Blast Mine/Freezing Trap/Land Mine === Base Level 99 base stat distribution suggestion: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 90 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This build focuses on the new Traps available to Hunters -- [[Claymore Trap]], [[Blast Mine]], [[Freezing Trap]], and [[Land Mine]] -- to deal specific elemental damage to groups of monsters. If you consider a monster's elemental weakness, traps can usually deal enough to one-shot any monster weak to the element in the Hunter's level range. Hunters can simply lay down traps in a monster's path or lure monsters into pre-laid traps to one shot them using skillful movement or stopping them in their tracks with an [[Ankle Snare]]. Damage for these traps are not calculated based on ATK (nor MATK) and simply use the Hunter's [[DEX]] and [[INT]] stats. Therefore, it is possible to use a dagger and shield with this to maximize damage reductions. Other Hunter builds that are [[Bow]]-oriented can also use traps on the side while using associated skills as needed. [[DEX]] and [[INT]] are your primary damage stats for this build, while [[VIT]] keeps you alive when mobbing larger groups of monsters. === III. Blitz Beat & Auto-Attack === Base Level 99 base stat distribution suggestion: * STR: 1 * AGI: 90 * VIT: 1 * INT: 1 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 50 A [[Blitz Beat]] build can be recommended for newer players with less funds as it relies on using the Falcon to attack, whether via manual casting of the skill or auto-casting it when attacking with arrows. This means you can level a Hunter using no ammunition (if manual casting) and less healing items with your higher [[FLEE]] at the cost of slower leveling. The Passive Skill, [[Steel Crow]], increases damage of the main skill of this build and the trap, [[Ankle Snare]], can freeze enemies to pick off at a distance. This build is specialized in two means of leveling: * CTRL+R-Click (or /nc) killing monsters using a high [[ASPD]] to get the Falcon to proc an automatic [[Blitz Beat]] after running around and gathering mobs into a tight grouping. This method can offer higher DPS at the cost of using [[Arrows]] but requires higher [[LUK]] to increase the chance it goes off. * Manually casting [[Blitz Beat]] after running around and gathering mobs into a tight grouping. This method suffers from some minor cast times but guarantees the skill and uses no ammunition to use. [[DEX]] is still your main damage and [[HIT]] stat, while [[AGI]] is desired for higher [[ASPD]] and [[FLEE]] to dodge individual monsters. [[LUK]] is then recommended for upping the chance for [[Blitz Beat]] to proc when auto-attacking and adding more damage by allowing arrows to crit. == Tips & Tactics == ===Hunter Bow & Hunting Arrows=== *{{Item List |id=1718 |item=Hunter Bow |simple=yes}} *{{Item List |id=1774 |item=Hunting Arrow |simple=yes}} The Hunter Bow with Hunting Arrow combination is strongest for Hunters, especially if using Elemental Converters (or if [[Sage]] Endows are available) to maximize damage. When a Hunter Bow is combined with Hunting Arrows, players receive a +50% ranged damage bonus to all attacks. The unslotted Hunter Bow is a free gift from the Hunter guild to all hunters that job change at Job 50, but it can also be purchased in the [[Payon]] Weapon Shop for very cheap if you lose it. This combo can be made even stronger if using a {{Item List |id=1726 |item=Hunter Bow |slots=1 |simple=yes}} with a damage increasing card such as {{Item List |id=4094 |item=Archer Skeleton Card |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=4428 |item=Bow Guardian Card |simple=yes}}. {{Item List |id=12576 |item=Hunting Arrow Quivers |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Quivering Merchant''' {{navi|moc_paraup|41|162}} on the 2nd Floor of [[Eden Group]], the ''' Mora Village Tool Dealer''' {{navi|mora|100|118}} in [[Mora]] (locked behind a Level 100 Questline), or off other players through Merchant vend shops. === Arrows, Quivers, and Hotkeys === Placing both your arrows and quivers on the hotkey bar will allow players to monitor how many arrows they have left, open new quivers with a single key-press, and equip arrows if you accidentally run out. This can be a life saver in emergency situations. === Affordable HP Recovery === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for AOE leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. Two popular and cheap healing items are Nepeta Cataria and Fresh Fish due to their cheap cost and low weight: *{{Item List |id=11602 |item=Nepeta Cataria |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cat Paw Shrimp Merchant''' in [[Izlude]] {{navi|izlude|117|165}} or [[Prontera]] {{navi|prontera|137|223}} (or in [[Lasagna]] {{navi|lasagna|166|117}} if starting as a [[Doram]]) for only 15z each (11z with max [[Discount]]). *{{Item List |id=579 |item=Fresh Fish |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cooking Merchant''' {{navi|payon|167|134}} in [[Payon]] or '''Chef's Assistant''' {{navi|alberta|167|134}} at the docks of [[Alberta]], as well as other cities, for only 250z each (190z with max [[Discount]]). For a list of Healing Items, a comparison, and a list of a couple popular Healing Items, please see the main article: [[Healing Items]]. == Equipment == === Eden Group Equipments Quests === :''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'' Eden Group Equipment is free and a great place to start for gear to use. The Bow is a good weapon and generally a good choice for a Hunter and their future rebirth, especially if you do not decide to use/have lost the {{Item List |id=1718 |item=Hunter Bow |simple=yes}} received upon changing into Hunter. === General Equipment Recommendations === :''Main article: [[Equipment]]'' The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well. === Third Class Compatible Equipment === :''Main article: [[Ranger#Equipment|Ranger Equipment]]'' It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only. === Card Sets === The [[Card_Sets#Archer_Card_Set|Archer Card Set]] is a decent boost for early leveling, even possibly viable until 99. When this set is assembled, the following effects are bestowed alongside the bonuses each individual card offers: * [[AGI]] +5. * [[DEX]] +3. * Increases ranged damage by 20%. *[[Perfect Hit]] +20 *If used by an [[Archer]] job type **Adds a 1% chance of inflicting [[Coma]] on [[Brute]] race targets when doing a physical attack **Increases the [[experience]] given from [[Brute]] race monsters by 5%. == Class Data == === Skills === ''See [[Archer#Skills|Archer Skills]] for first class skills.'' {| class="wikitablec sortable" |- ! Go to the Hunter's Guild in [[Hugel]], located in the very northeast of the town. Talk with the '''Hunter Guildsman''', Sherin {{navi|hu_in01|386|373}}, and apply to become a [[Hunter]]. *Sherin tells you that candidates are required to pass three tests before they can become a hunter. :[[File:Hunter-Sherin.png|250px]] 2. The first test is a personality assessment. The following are the '''answers''' to the test: :#Wander around alone and search for a place. :#Walk with a friend. :#Hunt at a nearby field. :#Go back to town. :#Would it be possible to get a heal, please? :#Open a chat room and wait. :#Tell the person about a good place to hunt. :#Guide them to their destination. :#Watch, then attack when asked for help. :#Try to find the owner. 3. Talk with the '''Guild Receptionist''', Demon Hunter {{navi|hu_in01|382|382}} on the left. * He will tells you that the second test consists of gathering items to make arrows. *Gather the items he requests, then talk with him again. :[[File:Hunter-GuildRecep.png|250px]] *Demon Hunter will request one of the following sets of items, chosen randomly: {| |-style="vertical-align:top;" | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 1 |- | 5 {{item | id=920 Wolf Claw}}
5 {{item | id=1019 Trunk}}
3 {{item | id=509 White Herb}} |} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 2 |- | 9 {{item | id=955 Insect Peeling}}
9 {{item | id=935 Shell}}
9 {{item | id=508 Yellow Herb}}
|} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 3 |- | 3 {{item | id=1021 Dokebi Horn}}
3 {{item | id=7032 Piece of Egg Shell}}
10 {{item | id=914 Fluff}} |} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 4 |- | 3 {{item | id=937 Venom Canine}}
5 {{item | id=507 Red Herb}}
3 {{item | id=919 Animal Skin}} |} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 5 |- | 3 {{item | id=925 Bird's Bill}}
5 {{item | id=932 Skeleton Bone}}
3 {{item | id=511 Green Herb}} |} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 6 |- | 3 {{item | id=913 Tooth of Bat}}
1 {{item | id=938 Sticky Mucus}}
1 {{item | id=948 Bear's Footskin}} |} | {|class="wikitable" style="text-align:left;" !Set 7 |- | 2 {{item | id=1027 Porcupine Quill}}
1 {{item | id=942 Monkey Tail}}
1 {{item | id=1026 Acorn}} |} |} 4. Talk with Sherin again, who instructs you to meet another guild member in [[Payon]] to take the final test. *'''Tip''': Bring enough healing items to recover at least all of your [[HP]] once for the final test. *Two possible situations: :*'''Case 1:''' Inside a room at the Archer Guild {{navi|pay_arche|145|164}}, where you turned archer. :[[File:Hunter-TestNPC2.png|250px]] :*'''Case 2:''' Center of Payon, NOT the main Palace building but the building at the right side of the Palace {{navi|payon|185|233}}. She is in the first room. :*Enter the first room on your right, then talk with the guild member and ask to take the final test. :[[File:Hunter-TestNPC.png|250px]] *The guild member will give you 200 {{item | id=1751 Silver Arrows}} and transfer you to a waiting room. Walk forward and the examiner will explain the test to you. 5. The test area is a maze populated with {{monster | id=1002 Porings}}, {{monster | id=1015 Zombies}}, {{monster | id=1016 Archer Skeletons}}, and {{monster | id=1041 Mummies}}, and scattered with puddles of water. You are required to complete three objectives in order and within 3 minutes to pass the test: :#Kill any 4 of the monsters labelled '''Job Change Monster'''. :#Open the exit by activating a switch. :#Exit the maze. *All of the monsters will die once the required number of target monsters have been killed. *The six target monsters are comprised of: :*1 Poring, located in the '''North'''. :*3 Zombies, each located in the '''East''', '''West''', and '''Center''' respectively. :*1 Archer Skeleton, located in the '''East'''. :*1 Mummy, located in the '''South-West'''. *The switch is located at the center of the maze, and can be activated by clicking it. The exit is located in the north. :*'''Tip''': You can activate the switch from a distance; you don't need to stand next to it. *You will fail the test if any of the following happens: :*You kill any monster that is not labelled '''Job Change Monster'''. :*You walk in any of the puddles of water. :*You fail to complete the objectives within the allocated time. :*You are killed. *When you are ready to begin the test, enter the receptionist's chat room and wait until you are transferred to the test area. 6. You are awarded a {{item | id=1007 Necklace of Wisdom}} as proof of passing the final test. 7. Return to the Hunter Guild. Give the Necklace of Wisdom to Sherin and she will make you a hunter. *If you are Job Level 50 when you change, you will receive a {{Item List |id=1718 |item=Hunter Bow |simple=yes}} as a reward. This is a very strong weapon when used with {{Item List |id=1774 |item=Hunting Arrow |simple=yes}}. *Before leaving [[Hugel]], go south 1 map and kill enough monsters to learn [[Falconry Mastery]], then rent a falcon from the Falcon Breeder on the '''2nd Floor''' of the Hunter Guild to save time and zeny later on. :[[File:Hunter-Breeder.png|250px]] {{Navbox Hunter}} [[Category: Job Change Guide]] [[Category: Hunter]]

= Overview =
Hunting Board Quests are repeatable quests that reward the player with experience.
*Additional 50% [[EXP]] when turned in
*Each quest will require the player to hunt 150 of a specific [[monster]] found in the town's surrounding fields or dungeons.
*Players can pick up multiple quests at a time. When finished, return to the town's board NPC to receive the reward.
*Reward a small amount of Silvervine that counts towards the monthly cap per character
<!--*Reward a Valkyrie Scroll <ref>https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/230562-january-17th-ragnarok-restart-maintenance/</ref> every 72 hours when turn-in 5 or more quest at once.-->

'''Notes:'''
* ''Kills from party members increases a player's count if they can '''see the kill on their screen'''.''
* ''[[Mercenary System|Mercenary]] and [[Homunculus System|Homunculus]] kills '''will''' increase kill counts. '''The player just has to see it.'''
* ''[[VIP]] accounts can combine the [[EXP]] reward to go only towards [[Base EXP]] or [[Job EXP]].

title: Hyper Novice Job Change Guide
wikitext: {{Quest Info | levelreq = 200 | joblevelreq = 60(70 '''strongly recommended''', will never recover lost skill points otherwise. But you will have 70 before getting to 200 base lvl) | classreq = Super Novice | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = {{Item List 2|id=490087|item=Hourglass Necklace|simple=yes}} | qreward = Job Change to [[Hyper Novice]] | external = | window = yes }} * Start by talking to ''Grape'' in [[Aldebaran]] at {{Navi|aldebaran|110|69}}. ** '''Note''': At this point, you have to be in a party of your own. [[File:1 GrapeStart.png]] * He will acknowledge you and ask you to attempt the Hyper Novice Challenge. * Accept the Challenge to create the job change instance by choosing, "I accept the challenge". * Talk to him again and choose, "Challenge the Hyper Novice" to enter the instance. * Once you enter the instance, you can proceed to ignore ''Yellow'' and enter the room above. [[File:YellowInside.png]] * Walk into the portal on your north, you should see a room with 5 novices - ''Scarlet'', ''Red'', ''Purple'', ''Green'' and ''White''. [[File:RoomNorthFiveNovices.png]] * In order, talk to ''White'', ''Red'', ''Purple'', ''Blue'', ''Scarlet'', ''Black'' and lastly ''Yellow'' (''Green'' is optional). [[File:RoomNorthAllNovices.png]] * Yellow will ask you to exit the room and talk to the machine by the portal. * You will see an announcement confirming the devices have been activated. [[File:GrapeAnnouncement.png]] * Talk to the machine and you will be teleported to ''Library of Memories''. [[File:OutsideMachine.png]] * After being teleported, you will see all the novices standing in a circle around a mountain of books. [[File:LibraryofMemories.png]] * (optional)Talk to everyone in the circle and they will give you hints about their memories. [[File:Circle.png]] * You will have to find and talk to Fragments of Past located around the map. [[File:Fragment.png]] * Several NPCs will show up, talk to all those to complete the fragment before moving on to the next. [[File:NPCs.png]] === Fragments === * Right from where you first entered the Library of Memories, walk east to what looks like a lush green hill and climb up to find the first fragment. [[File:FirstFragment.png]] * Move up / north wards along the same level to find the second fragment. [[File:SecondFragment.png]] * Head north from where you are you should find the third fragment. [[File:SixthFragment.png]] * Start moving in a clockwise direction to come across the fourth fragment. [[File:SeventhFragment.png]] * Continue moving along the same direction to find the fifth fragment. [[File:EighthFragment.png]] * Continue along to find the sixth fragment. [[File:ThirdFragment.png]] * Continue along until you reach the seventh fragment. [[File:FourthFragment.png]] * Finally a few steps more ahead would be the eighth fragment. [[File:FifthFragment.png]] * Once you've done talking to all the fragments and their respective NPCs. Move along the same direction until you reach the wooden floor boards to get down, head the same direction until you see a ladder to get back to the center, talk to each person around the circle, and enter his or her name in the box which appears. ** Red is '''Nodor''' ** Yellow is '''Kachua''' ** Purple is '''Windsor''' ** Black is '''Jade''' ** Green is '''Grape''' ** White is '''Tzerero''' ** Blue is '''Deforte''' ** Scarlet is '''Holi''' * Once all the names have been entered, ''Grape'' will move to the top of the book tower and make an announcement. [[File:NameAnnouncement.png]] * Climb up the tower and talk to ''Grape'', and choose “I think I’ve seen it all”. [[File:GrapeOnTop.png]] *When asked the following: *Which one of the following statements is correct? **Choose “They all start from Novice” *Who is the owner of this memory? **Choose "Nodor" *Who is the Sly one? **Choose "Kachua" *Once correctly answered, you will be sent back. [[File:GrapeOutside.png]] * Talk to ''Grape'' again and you will be changed into [[Hyper Novice]]. [[File:HyNo.png]] {{Navbox SuperNovice}}

*There are two parts to the quest.  A party is recommended unless you are able to solo an MVP such as {{monster|id=1087 Orc Hero}} or a weaker {{monster|id=1190 Orc Lord}} without the nasty version of earthquake.  Also, if some party members are slow, you might choose to not talk to any more npcs until the others catch up.  That's because NPCs in this quest typically warp you to the next location without offering you a choice to go or not go. 
**One is the Prelude to the main quest.  This is the shorter and easier portion but has no headgear reward.  You will kill 100 {{monster|id=1189 Orc Archers}} and then one Orc Hero.  It has not yet been verified if the orc archers in level one are the same orc archers on regular encounter maps.
**The second part is the main quest itself.  This is considerably longer and takes place mostly on an instanced map of prontera.  


=== '''Prelude Quest''' === 
# Head to the Prontera Culverts and talk to the Sewer NPC outside, who will ask you for help.  If you haven't entered Culverts before, talk to the NPC Recruiter inside of Chivalry (the name of the knights guild) in located at the top left corner of Prontera.  This recruiter is at the front counter.  Register for the mission to clean out the culverts.  The npc gives you a free warp to the Culvert Guard NPC that guards culvert entrance.
# Talk the Sewer Guard NPC to start the quest before talking the culvert guard that is located in the small guard shack.
# Inside culverts, talk to the guard by the portal you entered. He will ask you to defeat 100 Orc Archers which are located on level one.  Kill them and return to the guard.
# The guard will tell you to go to the next level in the Culverts. In level 2, talk to the other guard there and he will ask you to find a pedestal on level 2 of the sewers.  The Pedestal can be found in the top right corner. Return to the guard who gave you this mission and head to level 3 of the sewers.
# Talk to the guards in level 3.  The guard captain asks you to defeat the big orc.  Naturally, this big orc turns out to be Orc Hero along with his summoned mob of high orcs.  The boss respawns instantly, and this Orc Hero is as hard as the real one.  What makes the task easier is that he typically appears in the center of the map in that overhead grid area.  Unlike being in a wide open space, you can take advantage of the walkway.  Once you defeat him, return to the guards and you will be rewarded with some experience.


=== '''Full Anniversary Quest''' ===
# Speak to Annie in Prontera, just south of the fountain. She is on the right hand side of the street. She will teleport you to an instance version of Prontera. 
# Head to Prontera Castle which is closed off. You will be asked to find an NPC in the lower left hand corner of Prontera {{navi|prt_evt|45|52}}. Head over and find the Fruit Gardener.
# Find the Mercenary in the bottom right hand corner of Prontera {{navi|prt_evt|245|47}} who will then hand you over a Mercenary and ask you to kill 50 Orc Archers while keeping the Mercenary alive.  Kill them and talk to the Mercenary leader again.  It is not required to keep the mercenary alive, but if you do so, you get an additional experience reward.  If you are not in a rush, and like role-playing, then by all means keep the mercenary alive by having your partied priest heal the merc.    
# Head to Prontera Church and speak to Father Thyme. He will buff you and ask you to collect five types of items around Prontera.  Hover your mouse in these locations until you find the clickable item source.  Any order will work, but the following order is suggested:
#* The first place to go is Chivalry (knights guild) because it results in the shortest walking pattern.  Once inside, search the barrels (near the door).
#* The second place to go is the Tool Shop by the prontera fountain.  At the back of the shop, search the crates at the bottom corner.
#* The third place to go is Bar south of the PvP Inn.  Search the barrels near the door.
#* The fourth place is the building near Fruit Lady NPC.  Search the cabinet near the end of the counter.
#* The fifth place is the City Hall (large building with 3 entrances: 75,91) where you get either clothing or hair changed.  Search the flower pot in the middle chamber.
# Once you have obtained Father Thyme's supplies, head back to the Church and deliver them to Thyme. You will receive buffs and told to head over to the Castle.
# At the bridge to the castle a dialogue will prompt and an easy version of Orc Lord will spawn. Defeat it to lower the barrier and head into the Castle.
# Go to the Throne Room and step onto the black swirling portal.  Be wary about the high orcs spawning.
# On the Newbie Island map, head north and speak to the Orc Lady. Once that is done, head north and speak to Annie near the tip of the island.
# Once you are teleported to Payon Dungeon, head to the bottom right corner of the map, and find a Diary on the floor (pay_d00_evt 122,28). Examine it and follow the dialogue.
# Once in Byalan Dungeon you will be required to find 2 clues. One is at coordinates (iz_d03_evt 183,127) and the second is near the top right corner of the map (iz_d03_evt 237,265).
# From there you have 2 possibilities (Biolabs or Glast Heim).  Both are required, so pick where you would like to go first:
#* The Biolabs access pass labyrinth has the item hidden in one of the tubes {{navi|lhz_cu_evt|71|80}}.  Walk through portals and hover your mouse on the tubes until you find it.
#* The Glast Heim's Diary is at coordinates {{navi|gl_ch_evt|114|188}} which is conveniently in that small center room.  You will see two tables in one of the room sections there.  Just northwest of those two tables is a bench and the diary is on the end of the bench. 
# Speak to Annie at the end of the Hall and enter the Chat room which will teleport you to an Instanced Airship once a set number of players are present (4-6 has been reported).  The airship is filled with high orcs and an easier version of Orc Hero. 
# Head into the airship. Inside head left completely and trigger the lever.
# Go down one more level and head left to defeat the Orc Hero with your party.
# Once the Orc Hero defeated, head to the right side of the ship, and speak to Annie who will reward you with a Poring Fedora Hat and some base and job experience.

Travel to the beach town to take part in the festivities. =Quest= #Talk to '''Ferus Faire Promoters''' stationed around Comodo and ask where the Faire is, you will be warped to the main entrance. #Walk to the right and talk to '''Squirrel''' at (comodo 192, 285) #They will direct you to find evidence by the entrance. Go back left to the party area and click on "Suspicious item" in the small barrels at (comodo 165,281). You will find a clue that hints at an open fire. #Head north up the stairs and click on the "Suspicious item" under the roasting pig (comodo 157, 318). You, '''Moose''', and '''Squirrel''' will find a clue that mentions a stage. #Head back to the south area just above you originally spawned on the map and click on the "Suspicious item" left of the large tree on the stage at the south and middle of the map(comodo 187,167). You will find a casino coin clue there, '''Moose''' and '''Squirrel''' suggest visiting the Casino. #Head southward into the casino's top entrance and look underneath the first seat to your right in the middle slot machine area (cmd_in02 181, 105), where you find a Star Crumb clue (normally dropped by Stalactic Golems, among other things, '''Moose''' and '''Squirrel''' suggest checking the dungeon. #Head northward use a Faire guide for a quick warp to the north half of the map) and enter the Beach Dungeon 2 at the top of the map. #Just slightly north from the entrance is a Suspicious Mailbox (beach_dun02 154,36), click it, and '''Moose''' and '''Squirrel''' will appear and talk about someone reaching their hand into it. #:(Note: It is recommended past this point outside of the boss instance that you at least be in a party or be high enough level to solo a single (or fast enough to outrun) Ferus or Bewler as the event maps do not allow for fly winging) #Volunteer to do the dirty work by clicking it again, and you will be sucked in and warped to a copy map of Rachel Sanctuary Holy Ground 1 right above a "Mysterious Presence" #Talk to the Mysterious Presence, and he says you will have to solve 3 riddles to continue. The riddles can be found by clicking on Mysterious (Flames?) in the top left and right "wing" corners, and the top-most corridor of the map and can be completed in any order, answering wrong will strike you with a lightning bolt that deals some damage to you: #:16,199: The Letter E #:163,199: Fear #:139 267: The Wind #After solving all 3 riddles, return to the middle of the map and talk the the Mysterious Presence again, then walk in the portal to the left. #You will be warped to a copy map of Pyramids Dungeon Floor 1, talk to the Mysterious Presence in this map and you will be told told to search the pyramids until you find and click on 3 Mysterious Boxes (coffins) #The boxes are located in the bottom left around 20,16, the middle around 168,91, and top left around 45,182. After clicking all 3, return to the center of the map and go in the portal at 45, 130 (As if entering the Thief Guild room if it were the normal map) #You will be warped to a hallway with the Mysterious Presence above you, talk to him, then walk north between the 2 auras on the ground and you will be prompted to pick if you are ready or not, pick "I'm ready!" to summon the bosses, a large Ferus "Ferocious" and a large Bewler "Furious." During the summoning, you will be instead warped back to Comodo by '''Doc Holiday''' and '''Marvy McChonChon''', who tell you that, had they not intervened, you would have died in that fight. #They mention talking to '''Grandma Boxter''' who's currently in Comodo. Travel to the right and enter the hut right next to the Guild Storage Cosplay convention and ask her about her husband. She tells you to find '''Gramps''', who is hiding, but not far away. #If you talk the the other human in the room and ask if it is Gramps (you may have to pick both choices or press him multiple times) he eventually reveals that everyone so far have been actors, but the dragon threat is very real. He tells you to find a party to work with and to go back to the slay the dragons. When you are ready, go outside and to the right, click on the well and lower the rope to queue up for the boss fight instance. Climb down to enter the instance. #After defeating both dragons, check the treasure box to get 75 Ferus Coins and report back to '''Gramps'''. He will reward you with some experience and your choice of [[IRO_16th_Anniversary_Event_-_Ferus_Faire_2019#Community_Created_Headgear|Community Created Headgear]]. #Return with the coins to '''Jacques Peco''' in exchange for some sweet sweet prizes! ==Prizes== {| class="wikitablec" ! title: IRO 23rd Anniversary Event
wikitext:
The iRO 23rd Anniversary begins June 16th 2026 and runs to [insert end date] here. Lots of events are happening. Hugel is the main base for this year. == Daily Quests == === Hunting 230 Monsters === #The '''Kafra Agent''' {{Navi|Hugel|117|135}} will request you to hunt 230 monsters of a certain minimum level, depending on your character's Base Level. #*[Table goes here] #Return and receive your reward: #*VIP: #**2,500,000 Base and Job EXP and 3x [Event] 23rd Anniversary Balloon #*Non-VIP: #**750,000 Base and Job EXP and 2x [Event] 23rd Anniversary Balloon
#*Basic Anniversary Pass: 10 Exp #*Premium Anniversary Pass: 20 Exp === Lovelean Monster Taming === #'''Lovelean''' {{Navi|Hugel|121|135}} wants your help catching the mischievous Cake Porings around Rune Midgard. She gives you an [Event] Lovelean's Poring Net to capture them. #Tame 10 Cake Porings and return to Lovelean. #Be rewarded with: #*VIP: #**2,000,000 Base and Job EXP and 3x [Event] 23rd Anniversary Balloon #*Non-VIP: #**500,000 Base and Job EXP and 2x [Event] 23rd Anniversary Balloon
#*Basic Anniversary Pass: 5 Exp #*Premium Anniversary Pass: 10 Exp === Leilah's Random Logistics === #'''Leilah''' {{Navi|Hugel|125|135}} seems frantic and frazzled and "asks" you to help. # Just outside Geffen dungeon, speak to '''Farah''' {{navi|gef_tower|146|36}}. She asks you to hunt some monsters. (Consult the table below)
#*'''Note''': If you are in a [[party]], and another player in that party kills the required monsters, the kill(s) will count for all party members who are on screen of the killer.
# Return to '''Farah''', she thanks you and asks you to return to '''Derik Ver'''.
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]]

# Speak to '''Korey''' ({{map |id=iz_dun02 iz_dun02}} 348, 333), he asks you to hunt some monsters. (Consult the table below)
# Return to '''Korey''', he thanks you and asks you to return to '''Derik Ver'''.
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]]
# '''Derik Ver''' then asks you to find '''Franklin''' deep inside the abyss lake.

# Return to '''Derik Ver''', he says more areas seem to be morphing.  He asks you to find '''Marie''' near the clocktower in [[Al De Baran]].
# Speak to '''Marie''' ({{map |id=c_tower1 c_tower1}} 196, 185), she asks you to hunt some monsters.
# Return to '''Marie''', she thanks you and asks you to do some further clearing.
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]]
# Return to '''Marie''', she again thanks you and asks you to do yet more clearing.
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]]
# Return to '''Marie''', she thanks you and asks you to return to '''Derik Ver'''.
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]]

# Speak to '''Mr. Brando''' ({{map |id=glast_01 glast_01}} 366, 308), he asks higher level players to exterminate some monsters then report to his wife.

#* Lower level players will be asked to deliver a message to Kipp in the Glast Heim Prison within 5 minutes
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]].
# After exterminating the monsters, find '''Kipp''' ({{map |id=gl_prison gl_prison}} 10, 59), He asks you to hunt a few more monsters.
#* Lower level players will be asked to deliver a message to Cherice in the Glast Heim Sewers within 10 minutes
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]]
# After exterminating the monsters, find '''Cherice''' ({{map |id=gl_sew02 gl_sew02}} 295, 299), She asks you to hunt a few more monsters.
#* Lower level players will be asked to deliver a message to Grandma Vira in the Glast Heim Churchyard within 6 minutes
#* Receive some [[Base Experience]] and [[Job Experience]]
# After exterminating the monsters, find '''Grandma Vira''' ({{map |id=gl_chyard gl_chyard}} 150, 146), She asks you to hunt a few more monsters.
#* Lower level players will be asked to find her husband's grave in the Glast Heim Churchyard within 3 minutes. '''Fido''' ({{map |id=gl_chyard gl_chyard}} 252, 75) will tell you that you have found it and tell you to return to Prontera.
# '''Grandma Vira''' or '''Fido''' thanks you and asks you to return to '''Derik Ver'''.

# Visit the [[Juno]] Library and learn about the Crown of Deceit that can work monsters up into a frenzy. In the northwestern room in the Juno Library (the two top left portals) talk to the books beside the dragon book-ends on the top of the bookshelves near (yuno_in04 107, 107).

{{Not Implemented}} __TOC__ == Hugel Warpers == Warper [[NPC]]s are offering free warps to [[Hugel]]. They can be found in the following cities: *[[Prontera]] (180, 125) *[[Juno]] (168, 178) *[[Payon]] (179, 87) There is also a warper [[NPC]] in [[Hugel]] (115, 133) that provides free warps back to [[Prontera]], [[Juno]], and [[Payon]]. == Rock, Paper, Scissors == For 10,000 [[zeny]], Troy in [[Hugel]] (121, 117) will challenge you to 5 rounds of Rock, Paper, Scissors. Troy will count your wins and his wins (ties contribute to neither count). After 5 rounds, if Troy has won more rounds than you, you do not get any Prize Medals. If Troy has tied you or won more rounds than you, you get no Prize Medals. If you have won more rounds than Troy, you will be given 1 Prize Medal for each round you won. If you win all 5 rounds, you will win 20 Prize Medals. ::'''Note''': This game can only be played once in a 20 hour period. ::'''Note''': Picking "What's going on?" will result in a win for Troy. == Raffling == Lucky Raphael ({{map |id=prontera prontera}} 113, 246) is selling raffle tickets behind the [[Prontera]] tool shop. Each raffle has different odds and prizes, but you will always be awarded a consolation prize if you lose. title: IRO 9th Anniversary Event
wikitext:
{{Not Implemented}} {{Quest Info | levelreq = 70 Characters below 99 have additional quest | joblevelreq = | classreq = | classreq2 = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = {{item |id=1950 Rope[3]}}, 10 {{item |id=520 Hinalle Leaflets}}, 3 {{item |id=6213 Explosive Powder}}, and Varies by class | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = 15 {{monster |id=1313 Mobster}} | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 1,750,000 (2,625,000 for VIP) | jobexpreward = 475,000 (712,500 for VIP) | itemreward = | qreward = 2 Ancient Relic, Costume: Adventurer's Hat for 99 and above, 2 Pet (Isis?) tames, and Yggdrassil Seed for those below 99 | external = http://www.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=178&p=4 | window = yes }} ==Entrance to the Midgard Exposition== #Talk to Eden Expo Promoter, in Eden near the Mission Boards in the back, for a free warp to Lighthalzen. #Head north from where you are warped, to the Hotel. #Talk to the Expo Receptionist behind the desk. Ask about the expo. #Go upstairs and down the long hallway to the last room. Talk to the speech bubble on the first bed (228, 148). You will have a dream.
[[File:9thAnniversaryBed.jpg|200px]] #Return to the Expo Receptionist downstairs. He will say to ignore the ominous dream and find the Expo Tram Guide in southern Lighthalzen. #Find the Expo Tram Guide at (70, 63) and teleport to Old Morroc.
[[File:9thAnniversaryTram.jpg|200px]] #Talk to the Automated Tour Guide 1 sign right below where you are warped. You are then directed to continue with the automated tour. #Head East to the northeast corner (269, 265) and talk to the Automated Tour Guide 2. #Head South to the southeast corner (249, 61) and speak to the Automated Tour Guide 3. #Head to the center area south of the center of the map (158, 102) and speak to the Automated Tour Guide 4. #Head to the West-Northwest (47, 193) and talk to the Automated Tour Guide 5. You will be "restamped for entry," receive: #*750,000/1,125,000 [[Base EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*200,000/300,000 [[Job EXP]] (Norm/VIP). #*1 Ancient Relic #*::::'''TIP - VIPs are allowed to channel all EXP into Base or Job for all rewards of this quest.''' ==Increasing Bazaar Prices== #Head north to the Bar and speak with the Expo Representative (58, 256). Say "sure" about working for hire. She sends you to investigate why the Bazaar is charging expensive prices and to speak with the Commerce Guild Rep. #Return to the center (A.T.G. 4 area) and speak with the Commerce Guild Rep (142, 103). Choose Diplomatic. #Find 3 pieces of evidence:
#::* (147, 104)
#::::[[File:9thAnniversary1stEvidence.jpg|200px]]
#::* (171, 105)
#::::[[File:9thAnniversary2ndEvidence.jpg|200px]]
#::* (112, 91)
#::::[[File:9thAnniversary3rdEvidence.jpg|200px]]
#Return to the Commerce Guild Rep with the evidence. Tell him '''he's lying''' (about the broken bottles being from a rowdy party). He admits that he is being bothered by some "two-penny" thugs in Lighthalzen but is being watched and to talk to him again later. #Speak to him again. He then asks you to go and kill 15 {{monster |id=1313 Mobster}} in Lighthalzen.
'''* TIP 1 - You have to find your own transportation back to Lighthalzen. Save, memo, kafra, walk, airship back there.
* TIP 2 - You can kill the Mobsters in Dimensional Gorge (From New World quest) as well for quicker killing.''' #Return to Commerce Guild Rep and he is allowed to break his contract. He then sends you to a building in Lighthalzen's slums. #Inside the building (344, 260), find Croque Monsieur, the daughter of the original mobster boss. After having killed her goons, she decides to break the contract with the Expo people. #::::[[File:9thAnniversaryMobHouse.jpg|200px|frameless]][[File:9thAnniversaryMobLeader.jpg|200px|frameless]] #Return to the Commerce Guild Rep (142, 103) and thanks you with: #*750,000/1,125,000 [[Base EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*200,000/300,000 [[Job EXP]] (Norm/VIP). #Go back to Expo Representative Frau Beau at the northwest (58, 256) to receive a class-based quest. ===Blacksmith/Hunter/Wizard/Swordsman/Gunslinger Hands-on Quest=== #Go to the Technologists in top right Morroc #They ask you to go to Einbroch and talk to their leader in the Einbroch hotel. The hotel is just right of your spawn point. #You find him upstairs. Splash water on him to make him talk, then go outside and look for his assistant once he's done talking. #In Einbroch, go left of the hotel and talk to Mark (177,171). #He sends you up Einbroch tower, talk to the Tesco's Assistant who requests the following items: #*30 {{item |id=7126 Large Jellopy}}, 20 {{item |id=1002 Iron Ore}} and 5 {{item |id=998 Iron}}. #*These items are not consumed. #*Wizards may need to talk to the assistant multiple times to get to the next step (it's done by a "spell" that can miss.) #Return to the assistant who tells you to go southwest of Einbroch and play with a control panel. #Go to the very southwest of the city (Einbroch:77,37). Talk to the control panel and follow the instructions. You want to make the voltage equal to 70 #*If the volt is at 50, reduce damper. #*If the voltage is above 100, vent the excess fluid. #*If the volt is at 70 leave it be. #Go back and talk to the assistant who tells you to give the battery to Tesco. #Go talk to Tesco in the hotel again. #Tesco tells you to find his courier near the broken bridge in Einbroch (34,190). #The courier will send you outside onto a map, you have to talk to 3 flags. #* The first flag is directly left of your spawn point. #* The second flag is at (161,351) #* The third flag is at (37,230) #After finding flag 3, proceed to the next map. Flag 4 is right near the pond on the next map (238,135). #Go back to the Expo Engineer in the Morroc Expo Area and receive: #*250,000/375,000 [[Base EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*75,000/112,500 [[Job EXP]] (Norm/VIP) ===Bard/Dancer/Alchemist/Priest/Sage Hands-On Quest=== #Speak to the Production Assistant Madame West (53, 198). #Find Lucas Spellman (146, 162). His ground-breaking invention of a video camera seems to have been broken. He asks you to find Kuro Akirasawa. #Head west to find Kuro Akirasawa (29, 193). It seems some actors are scared, and he asks you to convince them to come back and shoot.
#::::[[File:9thAnniversaryKuro.jpg|200px]] #Head south to find Sam J Ellson worried about curses. If you are a bard class, bring him {{item |id=523 Holy Water}} . Priests do not need anything.
#::::[[File:9thAnniversarySam.jpg|150px]] #Head east towards the water to find Adime (102, 166). He's worried about sabotaged stunt explosives. Head directly south (100, 112) to investigate.
#::::[[File:9thAnniversaryAdime.jpg|200px]][[File:9thAnniversaryStuntExplosive.jpg]] #After investigating, return to Adime and he will send you to find Cage Whickerman. #Speak with Cage Whickerman (163, 142). The script for the movie seems poor, so he asks you to help him out. Alchemist and Priest classes are asked to bring '''10 Apple'''
#Return to Kuro Akirasawa and be awarded with: #*250,000/375,000 [[Base EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*75,000/112,500 [[Job EXP]] (Norm/VIP) ===Thief/Monk/Ninja/Super Novice/Taekwon Kid Hands-On Quest=== #Speak to the Gem Collector at the Gem Exhibit (257,65) #As you speak with the Gem Collector regarding a particular missing gem, The Spider makes an introduction midway. Reply with (Sure?). #The Spider then acknowledges your interest on the matter and both of you warp to Comodo. #Talk to him, and he will say something about him requiring the help of a certain locksmith at Kokomo Beach. The locksmith is located right in the middle of a lonely island at the Beach. #*TIP If you play a '''Thief Class''' Char this NPC may tell you to go directly to the casino and find the location of the safe, thus skipping the tedious part of finding the locksmith (skip to 7.). #There's a hut at the center of a island (located at the bottom left of the map) and you will find the locksmith (you may have to rotate your map to see him). Talk to him and he'll give you a set of instructions. Report back to Spider. *Warning - this map is infested with ragged zombies. There are quite a few scattered around the map, they are ranged, and they hurt if you are not well geared.* #The Spider will say he has to wait from his fellow operatives regarding the lock. Talk to him again to proceed. #The hidden safe will be at the room with a make-shift bed near the lobby of the first floor of the Casino. You will not see a 'safe' so click the bed itself. #The Spider reappears with you and both of you unlock the safe. Repeat unlocking the safe until it breaks open. #Escape the Casino and meet up with him again at the place you met earlier at the waters. #Head back to the Gem Collector at the Expo to receive: #* #*250,000/375,000 [[Base EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*75,000/112,500 [[Job EXP]] (Norm/VIP) #*1 Ancient Relic ==Missing Expedition== #After completing your class quest, return to Frau Beau in top left Morroc. She asks you to investigate Morroc Castle, as an expedition went missing. [[File:9thAnniversaryLockedDoor.jpg|180px|right]] #Talk to the Guard right inside the Morroc Castle #Find the locked door, once inside, go East one portal, South two portals, and the door is this: #Now, go back to the West wing of the castle and search for "Injured Guard" in a little room. He'll ask you to bring him the following items: #* 10 {{item |id=520 Hinalle Leaflets}} #* 1 {{item |id=1950 Rope[3]}} #* 3 {{item |id=6213 Explosive Powder}} #Return to the injured guard on the left-hand side of the castle, he asks you to go down into the basement and blow up the barrier on the staircase. It's an NPC bubble near a staircase in the basement pictured to the right. #Return to the injured guard again, then go to the right-hand side of the castle to Mort's Office. #Click underneath the Marduk to find an NPC dialogue box. When asked, '''threaten''' him! (If you choose another option, return to Frau Beau at the northwest and repeat this step) #Go talk to Frau Beau in top left Morroc, then return to the Marduk.
Those under level 99 will have to do an additional quest (requires 20 {{item |id=1017 mole Whiskers}}, 5 {{item |id=7317 Rusty Screw}}, 1 {{item |id=726 Sapphire}}, 1 {{item |id=721 Emerald}}, and 1 {{item |id=723 Ruby}}.) #This completes the quest for the first week and gives you the Costume: Adventurer's Hat, and access to the Basement Instance. (implemented June 12, 2012) ==MVPing Amset-Ra== #Put together your favorite MVP party and go down to the Locked Basement. You have half an hour to finish the instance. #Find and "rescue" all the tourists around the maze. #After all the tourists have been found, kill 20 Cultists (Isis labeled Cultist). Some of the labeled Cultists (Pasana) are not included in the kill count. An announcement - "All the Cultists have been defeated go to Malcom Volmarr" - will appear after you are finished. #Talk to the Sapha Tourist at the top left of the maze (115, 187) once more. Amset-Ra will spawn right next to it. (Make sure only one party member talks to the NPC or two MVPs might spawn.) #After defeating Amset-Ra, talk to Uncle Mort to go back to the Expo. #Return to Frau Beau who will thank you for your help. #One may re-enter the Locked Basement after one day. * Quest is supposed to be repeatable, but can't be repeated currently (reported, might be fixed with maintenance). * Amset-Ra looks like Osiris, has 2,000,000 HP and is Race: Undead, Element: Undead. * One of the possible MVP-rewards is a Costume: Sphinx Hat (Upper AND Lower headgear, all classes, level req: 1, account bound). ==Earning Carnival Tickets== '''Fishing''' *Visit the Fisherman at {{navi|Morroc_mem|164|144}} *Click on the Fishhole around (159, 144) *It costs 100z to fish for a ticket (it says 100z but it takes 300z) *You will be awarded with 0-1 Carnival ticket / Marlin *There is a 1 hour cool-down for fishing. '''Fixing the Prize Machine''' *Talk to the prize machine (167, 111). *Talk to the manager near the prize machine *The first Mechanic is at (83, 182) *The Second Mechanic is behind the tech expo building (top right of map) *The Third Mechanic is near the bottom left of the gem expo building (bottom right of map) *Kick Machine *Talk to manager. Get 3 or 5 Tickets. *Completing this quest unlocks "Find the hiding Child". Once fixed, one can turn in the tickets for the following prizes: *Morroc Fruit Wine for 2 tickets. *Guarana Candy for 20 tickets. *Isis Pet Tame(2) for 30 tickets. *Red Envelope for 40 tickets. *Green Maiden Tame for 50 tickets. *White Lady Pet Tame(3) for 60 tickets. '''Slot Machine''' *Visit the Slot Machine at {{navi|Morroc_mem|149|111}} *Using the Slot Machine costs 10,000 zeny. *You may be rewarded 0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 25, or even 100 Carnival Tickets *There is a 1 hour cool-down on this machine. '''Claw Machine''' *Visit the Claw Machine at {{navi|Morroc_mem|172|86}} *Using the Claw Machine costs 100 zeny. *You will be rewarded with 0-1 Carnival Ticket. *There is a 1 hour cool-down on this machine. '''Find the hiding Child''' *Visit the HS Manager at {{navi|Morroc_mem|148|81}} *He tells you to find one of the hiding children. (Doesn't tell you which one) *You will be rewarded with 5 Carnival Ticket. *Thomas is at (234, 195) *Tom is at (250, 295) *Tim is at (23, 56) *Tommy is at (243, 73) *Timothy is at (181, 229) *Timmy is at (39, 234) ::::[[File:Kids.png|180px]] '''Mind Reading''' *{{navi|Morroc_mem|165|56}} *NPC picks a 3 digit nonrepeating number *You have 5 tries to get it right. *The npc will tell you, how many you have correct and how many you have in the right position. *You will be rewarded with 3 Carnival Ticket. *NPC is buggy at times and wont accept numbers. You can cancel the prompt (by picking 0) and try again for 300z. *There is a 1 hour cool-down. *You can use [http://choobs.org/number.php this site] to help you find the correct number (same as Heart Fragment Quest.) They are available on all servers unless otherwise noted. *''[[Overlook Water Dungeon Quests|Overlook Water Dungeon]]'' *{{map |id=gef_fild14 High Orcs Field Map}} *''[[VIP Summoner]]'' *[[VIP Turn-Ins]] *[[Malangdo Culvert]] == Mini-VIP Subscription == For a cost of '''2 x https://static.divine-pride.net/images/items/item/6320.png [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Eden_Merit_Badge#Redeem%20Item%20List Magical Stone'''] (also known as ''Reset Stone'') , players can temporarily gain many of the benefits that full [[VIP]] accounts receive '''on the single character that redeems the stones'''. Note that means that any of the benefits not listed below will not apply (such as Battle Manual X3 only giving 200% on Mini-VIP vs 300% with full VIP). *The "subscription" lasts for 72 hours after redeeming the stones (maintenance periods do run down the clock). *This mini-subscription can be enabled via the following [[NPC]]s: **Gramps - Eden Group HQ {{navi|moc_para01|29|35}} **VIP Services NPC - Eden Group HQ {{navi|moc_para01|53|34}} **Primo D' Buffer - Eden Group HQ {{navi|moc_para01|26|15}} **Sign - Geffen Field {{navi|gef_fild07|264|286}} Benefits of this mini-subscription include: *All [[Kafra]] Agents, [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/npc/46365/keiki ''Keiki''], [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Juno#Isalei ''Isalei''], and [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Eden_Group#Aperture ''Aperture''] offer teleports to more areas and at a lower cost. *Access to the second [[Storage]] via [[Kafra]] and [[Cool Event]] Agents. *''Primo D' Buffer'' {{navi|moc_para01|26|15}}: **Buffs all [[Stats]] by +7 for 30 minutes. *''VIP Services'' {{navi|moc_para01|53|34}}: ** Can Teleport you to Teleport to [[VIP Summoner|Geffen MVP Summoner]], [[Overlook_Water_Dungeon_Quests|Overlook Dungeon]], or {{map |id=gef_fild14 High Orcs Field Map}} **Offers up to 10 {{Item_List |id=6316 |item=VIP Token of Siegfried |simple=y}} for free. ***These are Character-bound, have no time limit before disappearing but he will only refresh used Tokens every 24 hours, and you can only carry 10 at any time. *[https://irowiki.org/wiki/Gramps_Turn-In_Monsters ''Gramps''] {{navi|moc_para01|29|35}} will give both 400-Monster Hunt Quests at the same time (but he will NOT give the bonus EXP nor ability to combine Base/Job EXP on turn-in with mini-VIP however). == Acquiring == Currently, it is only possible to gain full VIP status by using the in-game item [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/23216/10day-premium-subscription [10-Day] Premium Subscription] or [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/item/23209/1day-premium-subscription-box [1-Day] Premium Subscription Box]. Using any of these items will unlock VIP for your entire account for the specified duration. The 10-Day box can be bought using [[Kafra_Shop|Kafra Points]] or from a [[Vending|player's vending]]. Opening the 10-Day box will give you two items, allowing for 10 days of both [[Offline_Voucher#List_of_Vouchers|offline vending and offline buying]]. The 1-Day box is always a [[Daily_Login|daily login reward]]. You can also gain them by participating in community events like Hide and Seek or by spending Kafra Points during an incentive promotion. The 1-Day boxes can't be traded. [[File:Incorrect warning.jpg|thumb|alt=warpportal incorrectly claims that VIP is bought using WP|This warning is incorrect.]] There is an incorrect warning on the WP to KP conversion webpage, mistakenly claiming that VIP is bought using WP. This is incorrect, so don't be discouraged from converting. {{Navbox_Servers}} [[Category:Servers]]

== Overview ==
The following [[NPC]] can be temporarily found in the Ice Dungeon. They will give the player a choice of how many monsters they wish to hunt at a time. 50, 100, or 150 monsters can be hunted. [[EXP]] rewarded per kill is the same for all three amounts (i.e. Killing 100 monsters gives twice as much experience as killing 50), as well as being the same gained when normally killing a monster (effectively making leveling on the monsters equal to 2x EXP). '''[[Valkyrie]] has rewards equal to 1x, while Ymir has rewards equal to 1.5x.'''

*'''Note:''' ''Each quest '''is repeatable''' so long as the player remains within the level limits.''
*'''Note:''' ''[[Mercenary System|Mercenary]] kills will '''not''' increase your kill count!''

Ask him about Eva '''Meuler'''. You give him a chance to write a letter for his worried fiance. Afterwards, ask him about Patrick. #*Pats was also here but was a cleaner. Marcus says the only place left that the player can look for data about him is at the incineration plant. #*Receive 300,000 [[Base EXP]] and 300,000 [[Job EXP]]. #Talk to the incineration plant '''Worker''' {{Navi|sp_cor|70|263}} who is sorting documents at the northwest corner of the map. #*He doesn't know Patrick Kaufman, only Patrick Young. He mentions any other waste from the lab could've been moved out to an external site, including special cargo that could have been people. #Proceed to the Laboratory Waste Disposal Site, Rudus Dungeon {{Navi|ein_fild05|156|288}}. #:[[File:IRO Wiki Rudus Ent Rebel.png|frameless|Rebel guarding entrance to Rudus]] #Now at Rudus. Not knowing where to start, try searching '''Suspicious Trace''' close by, to the east of the entrance.
