This person turns out to be a researcher whose lab blew up. This coated her in chemicals and disfigured her. She confesses that they have been experimenting on people and that they are connected to the numerous disappearances throughout schwartz. Ask her about Patrick Kaufman. #*Receive 300,000 [[Base EXP]] and 300,000 [[Job EXP]] #Fearing that he may already be dead, go look for Patrick's Test {{Item List 2|id=25666 |item=Subject Identification Card |simple=yes}} bracelet.
Search through suspicious traces around the map (there are 5-6 areas). The location seems random: #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|55|137}} #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|36|46}} #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|221|165}} #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|124|195}} #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|332|235}} #*{{Navi|sp_rudus|364|134}} #Return to '''Kaya Tos''' at {{Navi|sp_cor|136|146}} and show him the bracelet. #*Receive 600,000 [[Base EXP]] and 600,000 [[Job EXP]] and {{Item List|id=25723|item=Cor Core|simple=yes|num=20}} #He asks the player for a favor, and relays them to '''Aas''' === To Rudus === #Talk to '''Aas'''. {{Expert}} == Overview == == Weapon Level 3 and Gear Enchants == :[[File:IRO Wiki Illusion Enchanter.png|frameless|She can enchant Illusion Gear]] Look for '''Illusion Enchanter''' {{navi|prontera|90|115}} at [[Prontera|Prontera City]] to start the enchantment process for the illusion gears (aside from weapon level 4).
Each attempt to enchant costs {{Item List|id=25271|item=Illusion Stones|simple=yes|num=5}} and has a 100% chance to succeed. The item must be '''equipped''' to receive enchants.
=== Resetting Enchants === Resetting Enchants has a chance to fail depending on the option chosen.
The item must be '''equipped''' to reset its enchants. For now, the only available options for resetting is with zeny. Listed below are the available options and their corresponding chances of success: *100,000z - 50% chance *200,000z - 60% chance *300,000z - 70% chance *400,000z - 80% chance *500,000z - 90% chance *1,000,000z - 100% chance '''Warning:''' Failure will result in the destruction of the item. === Armor Enchants === Each attempt will give two random enchants: {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" style="text-align:center;" |- ! colspan=2 |Armor Enchants |- ! title: Illusion Dungeons
wikitext:
''Refers to the small mini-content dungeons. For episodic 17.1-related content, see [[Illusion]].''
== Overview == Illusion Dungeons introduce new single-map dungeons to the game. Each patch usually brings the following features: * New questlines and repeatable daily quests. * New enchantable Illusion gear which can be crafted from old gear. * New cards * Adds new monsters, possibly a new mini-boss, and a new MVP. The [[EXP]] received from illusion monsters are not affected by base level difference. == Illusion Dungeons == === Illusion of Moonlight === :A Moonlight Flower's Dream deep inside Payon Cave. :Base Level Requirement: 100 :Start Point: '''Payon Elder Saniul''' {{navi|payon|164|229}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Moonlight]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Frozen === :A contained time loop deep within the Ice Cave. :Base Level Requirement: 130 :Start Point: '''Ice Dungeon Floor 2''' {{navi|ice_dun02|150|14}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Frozen]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Vampire === :Enter the ancient journal of a Geffen Mage named '''Bomi'''. :Base Level Requirement: 130 :Start Point: '''Grimm''' {{navi|gef_dun01|132|223}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Vampire]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Underwater === :Beneath the tranquil waves, a plea for aid drifts on the breeze. :Base Level Requirement: Floor 1 - 140 :Base Level Requirement: Floor 2 - 180 :Start Point: '''Gein''' {{navi|izlude|132|49}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Underwater]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Abyss Turtle Island === :Venture into the mysterious Illusion of Abyss Turtle Island, where strange happenings are afoot! Gather your courage and your equipment and get ready for a new adventure! :Base Level Requirement: 150 :Start Point: '''Knight Aylvar''' {{navi|alberta|211|28}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Abyss Turtle Island]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Teddy Bear === :Dungeon of the Nasarian Empire :Base Level Requirement: 150 :Start Point: '''Coughing Man''' {{navi|einbroch|149|242}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Teddy Bear]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Luanda === :Base Level Requirement: 160 :Start Point: Statue at the top portal {{navi|beach_dun2|244|251}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Luanda]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Twins === :Base Level Requirement: 160 :Start Point: Yolanda and Mirko {{navi|anthell02|176|189}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Twins]]''' for detailed information.'' === Illusion of Labyrinth === :Base Level Requirement: 170 :Start Point: '''Irene''' {{navi|prt_maze01|98|26}} :''See '''[[Illusion of Labyrinth]]''' for detailed information.'' == Illusion Investigation == {{repeatable|cooldown=reset at 04:00 am}} Daily Hunting Quests that provide great exp can be taken near the entrance of every Illusion Dungeon. *Talk to '''Leader Joel''' inside {{Navi|prontera|47|228}} to register and be able to participate in Illusion Hunting. *''Note that some Illusion NPCs require you to initiate their main quest before you can talk to them.'' :[[File:LeaderJoel.png]] {| class="wikitable" |+ Illusion Hunting |- ! title: Illusion Equipment and Enchants
wikitext:
''Refers to the various equipment available through the [[Illusion]] questline (episode 17.1).''
''For gears related to the smaller mini-content dungeons, see [[Illusion Dungeons]] and their respective subsections.'' =Obtaining= :[[File:IRO Wiki OS Eliumina.png|frameless|Mina-chan]]
Various types of equipment can be exchanged for from '''Eliumina''' {{navi|sp_cor|111|130}}. All of these can be enchanted and can only be equipped by characters level 130 and up.
To call '''Eliumina''', talk to either of the two Rebellion Members near his spot.

'''Note''': The [[Illusion]] (17.1) main questline must be completed before exchanging is available. ==OS Weapons== Requires {{Item List|id=25668|item=Damaged Weapon|simple=yes|num=1}} and {{Item List|id=25669|item=Mysterious Components|simple=yes|num=50}}.
'''Eliumina''' will hand any of these out by random: *{{Item List|id=18180|item=AC-B44-OS|simple=yes|slots=2}}. Shadow Chaser Matk Bow *{{Item List|id=21047|item=Beam Claymore-OS|simple=yes|slots=2}}. Swordman Crit 2H-Sword *{{Item List|id=28136|item=Blasti-OS|simple=yes}}. Mecha EA 2H-Axe *{{Item List|id=32019|item=Boost Lance-OS|simple=yes}}. RG Vanishing Point 1H-Spear *{{Item List|id=1862|item=Burning Knuckle-OS|simple=yes}}. Sura Rampage Blast Knuckle *{{Item List|id=13493|item=Cannon Rapier-OS|simple=yes}}. Fireball/Hell Inferno Autocast 1H-Sword *{{Item List|id=28629|item=Circuit Board-OS|simple=yes}}. Crit Book *{{Item List|id=26164|item=Electric Fox-OS|simple=yes}}. Doram Magic Foxtail *{{Item List|id=28253|item=HR-S55-OS|simple=yes}}. Rebel God's Hammer Rifle *{{Item List|id=28755|item=Kuroiro-OS|simple=yes}}. Ninja Dagger *{{Item List|id=28038|item=Meuchler-OS|simple=yes}}. GX CRS Katar *{{Item List|id=18179|item=MH-P89-OS|simple=yes}}. Performer Severe Rainstorm Bow *{{Item List|id=26151|item=Rutilus Stick-OS|simple=yes}}. Fire Matk 1H-Staff *{{Item List|id=16088|item=Saphir Hall-OS|simple=yes}}. Gene Cart Cannon Mace *{{Item List|id=16089|item=Ultio-OS|simple=yes}}. Archbishop Adoramus Mace *{{Item List|id=18178|item=Virtual Bow-OS|simple=yes}}. Ranger Arrow Storm Bow ==Illusion Armor== Requires {{Item List|id=25723|item=Cor Cores|simple=yes|num=50}}.
The player may choose which Illusion armor to receive among the following: *{{Item List|id=15376|item=Illusion Armor Type A|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +100 Atk Armor *{{Item List|id=15377|item=Illusion Armor Type B|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +100 MAtk Armor *{{Item List|id=20933|item=Illusion Engine Wing Type A|simple=yes|slots=1}}. Garment *{{Item List|id=20934|item=Illusion Engine Wing Type B|simple=yes|slots=1}}. Garment *{{Item List|id=22196|item=Illusion Leg Type A|simple=yes|slots=1}}. Shoes *{{Item List|id=22197|item=Illusion Leg Type B|simple=yes|slots=1}}. Shoes *{{Item List|id=32208|item=Illusion Booster L|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +5% Atk Left-Accessory *{{Item List|id=32207|item=Illusion Booster R|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +5% Atk Right-Accessory *{{Item List|id=32210|item=Illusion Battle Chip L|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +5% MAtk Left-Accessory *{{Item List|id=32209|item=Illusion Battle Chip|simple=yes|slots=1}}. +5% MAtk Right-Accessory ==Grace Equipment== Visit [[Grace Equipment]]. =Enchanting= ==Obtaining== :[[File:IRO Wiki OS ModulesRebellion.png|frameless|The Rebel member that hands out illusion gear modification modules]]
To obtain modules for enchanting Illusion gears, talk to the other '''Rebellion Member''' {{navi|sp_cor|108|130}} beside Eliumina. He provides modules in exchange for the following: *For Weapon Modification Parts, exchange {{Item List|id=25723|item=Cor Cores|simple=yes|num=5}} or 1,000,000 Zeny.
The player may decide between Physical or Magical, but the grade given will be random (Normal, High-Grade, Finest). *For Armor Modification Modules, bring {{Item List|id=25669|item=Mysterious Components|simple=yes|num=30}} and {{Item List|id=25723|item=Cor Core|simple=yes|num=5}}.
The type of armor Modification Modules received are random, check [[Illusion_(17.1)_Equipment_and_Enchants#Armor_Enchants|Armor Enchants]] for details on rates and ranks. *The [[Illusion]] (17.1) main questline must be completed before the exchange is available. ==Weapon Enchants== OS Weapons may be enchanted with options (similar to Vicious Mind Weapons) through the use of https://irowiki.org/images/db/item/23776.png https://irowiki.org/images/db/item/23779.png Weapon Modification Devices.
Weapon enchantments come in two categories, Physical or Magical, and each category is further divided by 3 Grades (Normal, High-Grade, Finest).
Enchanting does not require completing any of the Illusion questline. :[[File:IRO Wiki EnchantUI OSWeap screenThor637.png|frameless|Here you can choose your desired OS Weapon to enchant]] :'''Directions for Use:''' :#Open the unique OS Weapon enchanting UI by using the desired modification consumables in your inventory (The mod parts aren't consumed yet until after the dialogue is confirmed). :#Drag the desired weapon from the eligible weapons list to the center slot of the window. :#Click on "Create" to confirm the enchanting attempt. OS Weapons enchantment process has a 100% success rate and they may be re-enchanted multiple times by using another Weapon Modification Part directly.

He is looking for his friend '''Leiphen''', who had disappeared half a day ago. #:[[File:IRO Wiki Turtle KnightAylvar.png|frameless|Knight Aylvar needs help looking for his friend]] # Choose the option to look intently at the piece to get warped away to the illusion dungeon (illusion maps unlocked). # Talk to the '''Girl''' in front of you and ask if she has seen Leiphen. She doesn't know for sure but she can guess two different locations.
Choose '''But I have some questions''' to receive the coordinates. #* '''An susceptible soldier''' at the northeast side of the dungeon. You notice that his nails have been obsessively nibbled off. The guy doesn't seem ok. #* '''An impatient man''' near the northwest junction on that floor. He's looking for his daughter. # Continue your search through the southeast portal to the next floor. # Talk to a '''Fragile Woman''' at the center of the turtle palace. She seems to be very hungry, saying she has been starving for days. #:[[File:Illusion_of_Abyss_Turtle_Island-NPC-Fragile_Woman.jpg|frameless|150px]] # She gives a clue? Following it finally leads you to '''Archeologist Leiphen''' {{navi|tur_d04_i|26|167}} on the northwest corner of the palace. #:[[File:Illusion_of_Abyss_Turtle_Island-NPC-Illusion_of_Abyss_Turtle_Island-NPC-Archeologist_Leiphen.jpg|frameless|200px]] # Talk to '''Archeologist Leiphen'''. He's relieved to have also finally met a fellow human. You offer to escort him safely out the dungeon but unfortunately, he's also too hungry to move. # Gather 10 pieces of {{Item|id=7564 Rotten Meat}} and hunt 10 each of: #* Ominous Permeter #* Ominous Solider #* Ominous Freezer #* Ominous Heater # Bring them back to '''Professor Leiphen'''. Unfortunately, he can't eat them because all the meat ends up rotten. He wonders if there are others around who can help, so you tell him about the other "people" you encountered, and he asks you to take him to them. # Make your way back to the starving '''Fragile Woman''' and introduce Leiphen to her. At first, '''Leiphen''' can't seem to see her, but things get out of hand when the other "people" suddenly appear and start targeting '''Leiphen'''. You are both rescued by the '''Girl''' you met before and she asks you to meet her back where you first met her. # Head back to the previous floor and talk to the '''Girl'''. # '''Leiphen''' asks the Girl to tell him about the dungeon, which she reluctantly agrees to do. Talk to her again. She introduces herself as "Narin", an Old Ghost. The other residents in the dungeon are spirits bound there by resentment or by different strong obsessions. Narin's obsession is to save everyone. # After you wrap up your talk with '''Narin''', you and '''Leiphen''' agree to leave for now, with a promise to keep coming back for Narin so she won't have to be alone. #* As a parting gift, '''Narin''' will give you 5 {{Item List|id=25271|item=Illusion Stone|simple=yes}}, 3,600,000 [[Base EXP]], and 2,400,000 [[Job EXP]]. #* Leave the dungeon through the red light beside her and you'll find yourself back in Alberta back in front of '''Knight Aylvar''' once again. # Talk to '''Aylvar''' to discuss what happened. #* Daily quest is now available (cooldown already active) #**Cooldown Quest Name: A short break, and a promise = Daily Quests = == A memory that should not be forgotten == {{Quest Info | levelreq = 150 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | classreq2 = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = [[Illusion_of_Abyss_Turtle_Island#Main_Quest|Main Quest]] | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 1,200,000 | jobexpreward = 1,000,000 | itemreward = {{Item List|id=25271|item=Illusion Stone|simple=yes|num=1}} | external = | window = yes }} {{repeatable|cooldown=22 hrs}} '''Cooldown Quest Name:''' A memory that should not be forgotten - title: Imperial Equipment
wikitext:
== Overview == In Clana Nemieri Rebellion Base, talk to '''Imperial trader''' {{navi|rebel_in|99|51}} to exchange [[Schwartz's Honor Token]] for Imperial equipment. She is accessible once you're able to enter the Rebellion Base in the [[Terra Gloria]] questline.
[[File:Imperial_trader_Location.png|250px]]

Each Imperial equipment/upgrade ticket is: * a cost of {{Item List|id=25155|item=Schwartz's Honor Token|num=10|simple=y}} * Character Bound * Weight: 0 * Required Level: 125 The next "free" equipment set is at level 150 with [[Grace Equipment]]. :Previous "free" set was at level 100 with [[Noblesse Equipment]]. '''Tip''': Do not throw away Imperial equips. Instead, use the upgrade ticket to make it +9 and feed it to [[Eat Gear]] for {{Item List|id=6235 |item=Safe to 7 Body Armor |simple=y}}. == Type of Equip for Sale == Imperial trader sells equips only specific to '''your class''', which is either Attack, Magic, or both types.

== Overview ==
''"The Pharos Lighthouse recently collapsed for unknown reasons. There must be something serious happening here. Some of the restorers and guards sent from the royal palace have also gone missing. Rumor has it that monsters dwell here. The locals are afraid of this place; it seems endless to them. They call it the Endless World. However, some have managed to venture in and make a good profit. Would you like to try your luck?"''


The Infinity Space is an [[instance]] with special monsters, called infinity monsters. Participating parties make their way through the 50 rooms, with a special boss encounter every 10th room.  These battles function similar to the [[Endless Tower]], with players being required to defeat all monsters on a particular room before the door to the next can open.  Once on a room, players are unable to go backwards; thus the only ways to leave the infinity space are to die and respawn, use a Butterfly Wing, or walk into a [[Warp Portal]]. 

The following skills are disabled inside the tower:
* [[Teleport]]
* [[Ice Wall]]
* [[Snatch]]
* [[Shield Reflect]]
* [[Fiber Lock]]
* [[Leap]]
* [[Extreme Vacuum]]
* [[Warg Bite]]
* [[Reflect Damage]]
* [[Sheltering Bliss]]

There are no item use limitations, although items that cast one of the restricted skills will fail (such as Fly Wing).  Usage of the [[Kafra Shop]] item Token of Siegfried is still possible within the dungeon.

*{{Item |id=2268 Pipe}}: Reduces damage from Insect monster by 3%.
*{{Item |id=2253 Sunflower}}: Reduces damage from Insect monster by 10%.

title: Instance
wikitext:
An '''Instance''' (also known as '''Memorial Dungeon''') is a type of dungeon in which a specific copy ("instance") is created for each individual party attempting to enter. As such, the server requires a small time period to create the instance, and it can only be used until a certain time limit before it is destroyed. Therefore, each party has the instance to themselves. ==Characteristics== *They involve one-way (no going backwards) progressions in an [[NPC]]-narrated [[quest]]. *They require players to be in a [[Party]], and are "created" uniquely for each party. One party (its members) cannot enter the instance of another party. *They have time limits in which the quest progression must be completed. If the quest is not completed, the instance will be destroyed, and players sent back to their Save Points. *They (may) have cooldown periods, where a player must wait after the time period ends before creating/entering a new instance. *They do not allow the skill [[Teleport]] (or Fly Wings). In a solo party, the player will be sent back to their Save Point when logged out more than 5 minutes inside an instance. *They may restrict certain other skills depending on the instance. *They are restricted to characters of certain [[Base Level]]s. *Some instances have an [[Access Quests|access quest]] that must be done before the players can start entering it. *Instance cooldown only applies to members that enter the instance. *Bringing {{Item List |id=7621 |item=Token Of Siegfried |simple=yes}} is highly suggested. **On iRO, they can be acquired as a [[VIP]] or [[IRO_Servers_Comparison#Mini-VIP|Mini-VIP]] *Players '''cannot''' re-enter the instance if the players happen to: **Exit the instance before the instance is done. **Died and then respawned. **Everyone inside the instance has disconnected for more than 5 minutes. =Instances= == Hourly == {| class="wikitablec prettytable sortable" ! '''Intensive Aim''' (Alt: ''Intensive Aim'') is a 4<sup>th</sup> expanded class active toggle skill available as [[Night Watch]].
==Effect==
* Switches to {{Status Icon|name=Intensive Aim|file=I_Intensive_Aim|link=yes|linkTo=Status_Icons#Expanded_Classes_Status_Icons}} state.
* '''Movement''' is not possible in [[Intensive Aim]] state.
* Activating this skill starts you at 1 '''Aiming Count''' and additional '''Aiming Count''' is accumulated every 0.5 seconds.
* The '''Aiming Count''' can be accumulated up to 10.
* The buff is removed if the caster leaves the standing cell due to certain effects such as being knocked back or teleported.
* The only way to move in this state is [[Fallen Angel]] and moving through this method will not reset '''Aiming Count'''.
* Increases [[ATK]], [[HIT]] and [[Critical]] while your are in [[Intensive Aim]] state.

title: Introduction to Ragnarok Online
wikitext:
{{Update}}
== Overview ==
Ragnarok Online is a Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game (MMORPG). It was created by the Gravity Corporation based in Seoul, South Korea. Ragnarok Online (RO) allows you to create a virtual character, customize it, and partake in epic adventures across exotic lands. RO is a great way to hang out with friends as well as make new ones. With an ever-expanding universe, in-game events, and a large community of users, there are always places to see, things to do, and people to meet in the world of Ragnarok!

== Features ==
*Over 20 [[classes]] in the game for players to choose from! 
*Cute 2D characters with customizable looks! 
*Large and detailed 3D game world that continues to grow! 
*Simple [[Game Mechanics|game mechanics]] that are easy to learn! 
*Battle other players in [[PvP]] arenas! 
*Challenge other guilds in the [[War of Emperium]]! 
*And more!

== Story ==
In a time of strife between God, humans, and demons... 

Scarred during the gruesome war and avoiding total destruction altogether, God, humans, and demons manage to enter into a truce... 

But after 1,000 years of fragile and forged peace in Rune Midgard... 

The lengthy peace eventually led the humans to forget their memories of the scars and hardship from the war. As they forgot faults of the past, selfishness, corruption, and arrogance slowly spread throughout the land... 

Finally, the balance of peace broke and strange occurrences started happening. There came a strange howl from the boundaries that divided God, humans, and demons. Peaceful creatures became aggressive and attacked innocent villagers. Violent earthquakes ripped whole continents apart. Great hail storms drove some species to the brink of extinction... 

The mysterious legend of demons were rediscovered... 

As the fragile peace began to fall apart, stories about the parts of Ymir protecting the peace began to spread among the adventurers. Forgetting the true nature of the ancient relics, people set out to seek the pieces out of selfishness and the promise of wealth that would come with it... 

== Ragnarok Versions ==
:''Main Article: [[Servers]]''
Ragnarok Online is a globalized game. Gravity Corp. (Gravity KR) has licensed the game to different companies in certain countries/regions. For example, Oceanic Ragnarok Online (oRO) was licensed by OnGameNet and was operated for the Australia/New Zealand region (However, this server no longer exists). Many other companies run RO in different parts of the world. The version run in the United States/Canada is called International Ragnarok Online (iRO) and is run by Gravity Interactive, a company controlled and owned by Gravity KR. Most servers require payment from institutions in the area they serve. For example, kRO only accepts payment from banks and cards issued from Korea.

== Account Creation ==
Each version of RO has a different way to create accounts. This wiki covers the iRO version of creating accounts. 

First, [https://www.warpportal.com/account/registration.aspx register] a Warp Portal account, then under Game Accounts, click the "Add New Game Account" button at the bottom of the screen. Select Ragnarok, then fill out the form and submit. (NOTE: Providing untruthful information may lead to missing out on some beneficial things.) An e-mail to confirm the account will be sent. Confirm it and the account will be activated. Account creation itself is free and currently players can create as many accounts as they want. It is possible to have both male and female characters on a single account.

Make sure the ID and password are complex enough so that people won't be able to guess them. Also, sharing account information is not recommended. Doing so may place the account at risk of being compromised.

Differences between the iRO servers can be found [[iRO Servers Comparison|here]].

== VIP/Cash Shop ==
While past version of iRO operated under a pay-to-play payment model, that is no longer true. All accounts may play for free with fairly generous limitations.

'''Note:''' View the benefits of purchasing the {{Item |id=23216 10Day Premium Subscription Box}} on the [[iRO Servers Comparison]] page.

== Game Server Types ==
When RO is started, the patch client will download updates for the game. After the updating is complete, it is time to login. Input the account information. Sharing an account would be detrimental should the account be hacked and restoration be required. It's strongly recommended that account information be kept secret. 

Accounts can only be logged into one server at a time. After logging in, a list of servers will be displayed. All of them are the same except the following: 

=== Sakray Server ===
Many RO servers host a server known as 'Sakray Server'. It is a test server where EXP/JEXP gained may be higher than normal servers. New updates are tested there first, and Sakray server is hence at a higher risk of being subject to serious bugs being introduced by new content. Sakray is also wiped periodically. To access Sakray server, a special separate client is required as the normal game client cannot access this server.

=== PK Server ===

:''Main Article: [[PK Servers]]''

Some RO servers (not iRO, at the time of this writing) allow players to PK in maps outside of PvP. Unique rules are in effect for these servers, which usually include a Mass Murder System. Although popular in past years, PK servers have gradually been phased out, concurrent with the introduction and growth of F2P servers.

=== F2P/Open Server ===

:''Main Articles: [[F2P|F2P Servers]] & [[iRO Servers Comparison]]''

Some versions of RO have special free servers which do not require paid accounts.  However, they have fairly unpleasant mechanics and are supported through item malls.  iRO's Open Servers are ''Chaos'',''Thor'', and ''Freya''.

=== VIP Server ===
:''Main Article: [[iRO Servers Comparison]]''

VIP servers are free to play once you have created any characters but require a VIP subscription in order to make characters. Mechanics for unpaid accounts are almost identical between VIP and Open servers. iRO no longer has a VIP Server.

=== Subscription Server ===
Subscription servers require a subscription in order to access them. There is usually only one level of access/benefits.  Over time, most RO servers have grown away from this model, moving towards entirely [[F2P]] and Freemium (Free access with optional paid subscriptions) servers. 

After selecting a server type, simply create a character [or choose one previously made] and join in! Enjoy Ragnarok Online!

Elly managed to track Bagot and found a route to the northern regions. You all decide to meet Elly at Varmundt's Mansion. However, Suad cannot join as he has to coordinate a parliament meeting with Niren for peace between Grey Wolf Village and Rachel. #Talk to '''Smart Elly''' {{Navi|ba_in01|384|114}} who explains her data collection when tracking Bagot. She says that he went to the northern regions and mentioned the legendary Jörmungandr. The only northern continent associated with Jörmungandr is Issgard. She also explains that the Illusion stole records from the aircraft that has sailed to Issgard. Elly is working on getting an Airship to navigate to Issgard but the technician, Ginger, reports that there is a wall around Issgard of high energy flow which blocks entry. Crux advises to seek help from royal family. The Gaebolg family would have information on Jörmungandr. #Talk to '''Crux''' {{Navi|ba_in01|386|110}} to head back to Prontera Castle with Lazy while Elly and Ginger will address the airship. #Through the portal, talk to '''Crux''' and Nyhill {{Navi|prt_cas|320|270}}. Nyhill recaps that Gaebolg family were cursed by Jörmungandr. When the Jörmungandr Church vanished from Midgard, not everyone died and disappeared. Instead, the former followers were trapped in a land of ice beyond the sea and the land was sealed by an unknown force where guardians protected the seal. Nyhill mentions that some members of the Gaebolg family once traveled to and from Issgard. The queen, Catherine D. Gaebolg, arrives to give further explanation. She mentions that Tristan III has three sisters, two of which resides in Issgard who were entrusted to find a way to break the curse of Jörmungandr. Nyhill mentions that permission is required to enter Issgard and asks you for your reason to enter. You tell Nyhill the story of Illusion and Nyhill agrees with your agenda to stop it. He tells that he can write a special invitation letter. #Go out and turn right. Talk to '''Nyhill''' {{Navi|prt_cas|331|343}} at his desk. Nyhill explains that the ordinary-looking book on his desk is a Guardian's Box. Opening the cover reveals a void in the book which blesses any letter inside of it by the Guardians. Only direct descendants of the seven royal families can use it. The box was left by the First Tristan Gaebolg. Nyhill writes and gives you and your friends a {{Item_List_2|id=1000607|item=Guardian's Invitation|simple=yes}}. You are then teleported back to Varmundt's Mansion. #You meet up with the rest of the team. Ginger {{Navi|ba_maison|186|251}} says the airship is ready for travel to Issgard. #Talk to '''Navigator Ginger''' {{Navi|ba_in01|30|264}} to board the airship. #Talk to '''Navigator Ginger''' on the airship {{Navi|air_if|46|71}} and give her your invitation. Ginger examines the letter and detects a specific wavelength code emitting from the invitation. #Talk to '''Lehar''' and your friends {{Navi|air_if|32|63}}. Lehar introduces himself as a member of the St. Capitolina Abbey. His mother was the sister of the previous king and the youngest princess of Gaebolg. She was concerned about the curse of their family and entrusted him to be raised at the monastery. However, the curse manifested to the direct son of the previous king. The son was determined to break the curse of the family himself and went to Issgard himself. Lehar describes Issgard as a land of only snow, ice, and glaciers. However, there is a castle made of ice, yet it stays warm inside with some kind of magical power. Lazy asks if there is any to worry about since Illusion must've made contact for about 4 months. Lehar only recalls the number of Rgans dramatically increases. Ginger interrupts to announce that the airship will be landing soon and to brace for unexpected shocks. #Talk to '''Navigator Ginger''' {{Navi|air_if|46|71}} to leave the airship into Issgard. #Once landed, listen to '''Lehar''' {{Navi|jor_tail|221|53}} who states that we are close to Ice Castle and should head there. #Travel north then east to '''Lehar''' in the Ice Castle {{Navi|icas_in|141|216}} who introduces Leon Petit and Aurelie Petit. The Petit family have been taking on the role of overseeing the Ice Castle and protecting it. You explain the situation of Illusion and Bagot. Aurelie states that there is a high possibility that the Illusion had interfered with Rgans. Lehar's aunts, Voglinde Gaebolg and Vellgunde Gaebolg, appears and introduces themselves. Voglinde and Vellgunde both are here to study about Jörmungandr and Rgan's magic in attempt to break the curse upon their family. They both go back to their research in one of the Iwin's huts. #Talk to '''Guardian Leon''' {{Navi|icas_in|138|220}} who explains more about Issgard. The land itself is made by the frozen body of Jörmungandr. The Rgans were the main followers of Jörmungandr and are bound here. You ask about the barrier. Leon states that the barrier does not seal Jörmungandr, but rather keeps the Rgans from leaving. Lazy asks about the giant birds around the castle. Aurelie explains that Iwins were originally migratory birds that moved to and from Oreum Mountains. However, once the barrier was placed, the Iwin race was stranded in Issgard. Since then, the Iwins helped guard the Ice Castle and monitor the barrier. Leon would like you to meet with Iwins since they haven't met an outsider since Varmundt. Aurelie decides to give you some Snow Flower Petal stating that it is the main currency in this region. A magical power crystallized into a flower like shape. #*Rewarded with {{Item_List_2|id=1000608|item=Snow Flower Petal|num=40|simple=yes}}, 50 Ice Castle Reputation, 65,304,744 fixed [[Base EXP]], and 20,000,000 [[Job EXP]]. #*At this point you unlocked side quests: [[Issgard_Land_of_Snow_Flowers#Iwin_Patrol|Iwin Patrol]] Instance and [[Issgard_Land_of_Snow_Flowers#Saint_of_Purification|Saint of Purification]]. ===== Iwin Patrol (Instance) ===== Instead of doing all the steps below (the patrol), you can skip it by entering it, talking to the captain to start the patrol (not sure if talking to the captain is even needed), then run straight to the young bald man NPC (Morning) at the top of the map, then taking the portal on the north of the map near that NPC to spawn beside that same NPC outside of the instance which is immediately the next step (to get your first Rgan scroll). You can go back after you've finished your patrol as long as you don't leave the instance. #Find a young bald man who needs help escaping the area. == About Izlude ==
Izlude, the satellite town of [[Prontera]], sits on the eastern edge of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom. Being a port, it features trade and travel routes by air and sea. The marina on the northeastern side of the town offers passage to the trade city of [[Alberta]] and to [[Byalan Island]], where adventurers can venture into the [[Undersea Tunnel]] dungeon. For those looking to travel internationally, the airship station at the southern edge of the town offers a route with destinations to [[Juno]], the capital city of the [[Republic of Schwartzvald]], and [[Rachel]], the capital city of the [[Arunafeltz States]]. There are also Kafra services available, for storage and warping to [[Prontera]]. Izlude offers several services for adventurers. Recently, the Royal Criatura Academy has established itself on the northern side of the town. It offers new adventurers opportunities to train in various skills, discover jobs available to them, and to learn about the world. The [[Swordsman]] association resides on the western side of the town, for those adventurers who are looking to hone their skills and become Swordsmen themselves. Built by King Tristan III to promote friendly competition, the [[Izlude Arena]] quickly became a popular attraction among citizens and adventurers alike. Adventurers gather here to show off their skills and to gain fame, glory, and rewards.

== Story ==
As [[Prontera|Prontera's]] population started swelling, overpopulation became a concern for its citizens. Watcing space become more limited and a need for increased defense grow, officials decided to build the satellite town Izlude. It would help bolster the city's defenses and provide its citizens more room to grow. The [[Swordsman]] association, once within the city's walls, relocated itself to Izlude once the town was established. Many citizens moved and the town began to flourish. Its strategic location gave [[Prontera]] access to a port, increasing possibilities for trade and transportation. Since then, various new features have been added to the town, including the [[Izlude Arena]], the Royal Criatura Academy, and the airship dock.

title: Izlude Arena

{{expert}} {| align="right" hspace="5" vspace="5" | __TOC__ |} ==Overview== The '''Izlude Arena''' is a time attack battle located in the 12 o'clock direction in [[Izlude]]. There are six different courses in the Arena that players may select from, divided between three modes: *''Individual'' mode places the player against a set list of [[monster]]s. *''Party'' mode places a five person party against a set list of monsters. *''Personal Force'' mode is restricted to [[Acolyte]]s and [[Priest]]s and places the player against a set list of monsters that can be killed with Acolyte or Priest skills. The majority of these monsters are of the [[Undead]] element. In all modes, players are given an objective when they enter a room which they must accomplish in order to continue to the next room. Sometimes all monsters must be defeated to advance; sometimes only a few. Still other times the player only needs to run to the exit on the other side of the room. Experience is not awarded for successfully defeating monsters in the Arena and most Arena monsters do not drop items either. Note, however, that experience is '''not''' lost if one dies in the Arena. ==Arena Points== Arena points are prizes awarded for participating in the Arena. 20 points are awarded upon the successful completion of a course. 1 point is awarded as a participation prize if the player fails for any reason. [[Al de Baran Turbo Track]] Points may also be converted into Arena Points. Points may be exchanged for various consumable items or base EXP. To be transported to the exchange room, talk to the Teleporter (arena_room: 106, 93). This is also who you need to speak to if you wish to convert Turbo Track Points to Arena Points. The following are what Arena Points may be used for: *20 Arena Points for 5 {{item |id=518 Honey}} *20 Arena Points for 3 {{item |id=605 Anodyne}} *20 Arena Points for 1 {{item |id=608 Yggdrasil title: Jawaii
wikitext:
=About Jawaii=

[[Image: Jawaii.jpg|center]]

Of the coast of [[Izlude]] lies the small tropical island of Jawaii: Famous vacation and honeymoon spot. Whether it’s drinking and meeting people at the singles bar, or reliving your wedding / honeymoon, Jawaii offers all these and more.

There is an NPC in Izlude that has the uncanny ability to recognize married couples. She will sweep you and your spouse away to lovely Jawaii. There is a 100,000 Zeny fee to be taken there. There are rooms with four different themes where couples can share their intimate moments. Although the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]] prohibits alcoholic beverages, you can have alcohol in the tavern in Jawaii. 

Special Products: “Sweet Memory of Marriage,” a special photo album for couples. Ice Cream which, when shared as a couple, enhances the romantic atmosphere. Jawaii Special Cocktail which is recommended by a handsome bartender. (''Warning: Excessive drinking during your honeymoon can cause you to have a huge fight with your spouse'') 

== Story==
As more and more people were married in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, they longed for a romantic place where they could take a vacation alone with their new husbands and wives. As officiator of wedding ceremonies in Rune-Midgard, Tristan III recognized the need for such a place and ordered for the development of a lover’s paradise, the beautiful, heart-shaped island now known as Jawaii. However, it has also been said that the king has high hopes that this new island will bring much revenue to the Kingdom’s Treasury. Nevertheless, Tristan III is a ruler blessed with kindness, generosity and, perhaps, shrewdness.

== Other ==
=== Single Army Invasion ===

Lonely? Why not visit the Jawaii singles bar and meet new people. Who knows, you might find the love of your life here. And if for some reason you end up getting rejected, head over to the bar and have our bartender prepare something to wash those miseries. Aside from being a top notch bartender, he’s a good listener, and gives very good advice. The Single Army is out to ruin Jawaii's Tavern and all the honeymooning vacationers! If you are single, you too can join their raucousness by meeting up with some customers in Prontera's main Pub. They will offer you drinks and you guys can discuss your lack of a "significant other" (Everyone in the room will say Dazzler Quotes (or possibly Unbarring Octave Quotes)). The drinks will take away some hp, but should you decide to sign their contract and go somewhere "better", your hp will be refilled and you'll be transported to Jawaii's Tavern for no cost. Only restriction is, you can't leave the Tavern. Enjoy ruining all those horrible couples' vacation and drinking away! 

=== Bartender ===
Jawaii is just about the only place where the pub actually sells you alcohol, but everyone knows alcohol is bad for you. The Bartender NPC can sell you different kind of drinks for 100z with special effects, but each time you drink, a portion of your hp is taken away. You can drink yourself to 0 HP though and not "die". However, the Bartender NPC also michieviously offers free drinks now and then. Should you accept this drink, prepare to be lying dead on the floor, "passed out" if you will. If you want to escape this "free drink", you can press Esc and go to character select. When you log back on your character, you will still be at Jawaii's Tavern and not dead. 

=== Honeymoon Rooms ===
Bored at the Jawaii bar? Grab your sweetheart and head over to the Jawaii beach. Take a romantic stroll down Jawaii beach, or spend some quality alone time with your sweetheart at our little Heart-Shaped Island. At the end of they day, you can rent our spacious and luxurious honeymoon suites (all at affordable prices).

These NPCs teleport you inside the four honeymoon rooms. They are basically buildings with no normal entrance. There you can celebrate your marriage in whatever way you want. Just remember that since money is involved, NPCs have no trouble double- or triple-booking rooms.

= Overview = :[[File:Jekyll Genie.png]] [[File:Jekyll art.png]] Visit '''Jekyll the Genie of Keys''' {{Navi|prontera|177|327}} in northern [[Prontera]] to enchant certain Equipment / Reformed Equipment / Shadow Equipment. When you interact with '''Jekyll''', you will be given options on gear groupings that offer the specific enchantments listed in this guide. *If you do not have a piece of gear that matches one of these groupings, it will not generate an option on this list. :[[File:Jekyll1.jpg]] After selecting an option, you will be able to interact with the Enchantment UI to enchant your selected gear. :[[File:Jekyll2.jpg]] *The Left Menu lists the gear you can enchant. Click one to open enchantment selection options in the Center Menu. *The Center Menu shows the UI for enchanting your gear. **Clicking CONFIRM will open the available options to enchant in the Right Menu. **The COMMON tab is where the standard enchant options will appear. **The GROWTH tab is for enchantments that can be upgraded when available. **The RESET tab is for resetting the gear's enchantments when available. *The Right Menu is where the selectable enchant or possible random enchant options will be shown for the selected equipment. After enchanting your gear, it will show in the Center Menu the next time you select it for additional enchantment and new options may become available. :[[File:Jekyll3.jpg]] = [https://iro.ragnarokonline.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=1702 July 2024 Update] = Coming soon. = [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=378 August 2024 Update] = Coming soon. = [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=1748 October 2024 Update] = Coming soon. = [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=394 March 2025 Update] = Visit Jekyll in Prontera to enchant certain new Shadow Equipment. title: Jumping Janeway
wikitext:
{{iRO_Only}} {{Update}} Jumping Janeway Event Work in Progress! =Introduction= Cathy Janeway is a experienced military leader who sails the seas of Rune Midgard to find new lands and new trading opportunities. She periodically visits the Rune-Midgarts kingdom to bring her special brand of extreme training to rapidly level new adventurers up to a high level. You can find her on the bridge connecting Izlude and South Prontera Field.
[[File:JumpingJaneway.png]]
When you speak to her, she will give you a monster hunt mission to complete and teleport you to the location where you can hunt them. When you complete this and speak to her again she will reward you by jumping you up multiple levels and (if you are playing a non extended class character) with appropriate equipment. =Quest= Jumping Janeway is located at {{Navi|izlude.gat|100|100}}. She will offer quests based on your level and teleport you to the related map. If you complete these quests as a Pre-Trans character, she will have these flagged as completed for Trans and jump you through those quests without needing to do the kill objectives a second time. If you are doing Janeway on a 2nd class character who has not completed any of the lower level quests, she may look at your current job level and send you to lower level quests to jump only your job level until you reach the job level she expects you to be for the next turn ins. Example: a level 70/20 Assassin would be asked to kill Zombies and Skeletons to reach job 30, Elder Willows to reach job 40, and then Orcs to reach job 50 before being given Kaphas to reach base 99. The Savages kill quest will be skipped and given when the character reach level 55/50 on transcendent classes. The Quest log numbers for the killing quests will be marked in a (#) beside the quest number below because they have no real proper ordering. Jumping Janeway Request 1 (1) - Kill 5 {{monster |id=1002 Poring}} - Reward: Base and Job 10 ([[Novice]] / [[High Novice]] only) After completing job change and returning to her, she will give you a small amount of job experience for changing classes which should bring you to job 5. Being a Doram will skip this and give you the job exp right away. Jumping Janeway Request 2 (2) - Kill 20 {{monster |id=1015 Zombie}} + Kill 20 {{monster |id=1076 Skeleton}} - Reward: Base 35 Job 30 Jumping Janeway Request 3 (4) - Kill 50 {{monster |id=1033 Elder Willow}} - Reward: Base 45 and Job 40 Jumping Janeway Request 4 (6) - Kill 50 {{monster |id=1023 Orc Warrior}} + Kill 25 {{monster |id=1273 Orc Lady}} - Reward: Base 55 and Job 50 (Summoner will need to click many times to fill in job to job 50 to unlock next quest) Jumping Janeway Request 5 (7) - Kill 100 {{monster |id=1166 Savage}} - Reward: Base 70 Jumping Janeway Request 6 (7) - Kill 100 {{monster |id=1406 Kapha}} - Reward: Base 99 and Job 50 (70 if trans or some expanded classes).

=About Juno= [[Image: Juno.jpg|center]] Juno is the floating city, high in the clouds. It is also the location of the [[Sage]] Headquarters.
To go here on iRO, visit [[Prontera#Keiki|'''Keiki''']] in Prontera or [[Eden_Group#Aperture|'''Aperture''']] in Eden. === Story=== The capital of [[Republic of Schwartzvald]]. Located in the air above El Mes Plateau, Juno is a floating city with three islands – the glorious island Solomon, island of intelligence Sonotora, island of prosperity Mineta. The `Heart of Ymir` is what allows this land to exist. Many come to research the strange powers and ancient civilization. Juno is called the `City of the Wise One` for this reason. Juno is located above the El Mes Plateau, which is north of [[Al De Baran]]. Currently, the airship which used to provide transportation between [[Izlude]] and [[Juno]] is operating, so adventurers that wish to go to this land no longer have to climb through the rough land of the El Mes Plateau. === Quests=== Quests added with the Juno update can be found [[Quests#Juno Quests|here]]. == Guide== *Note: This image is somewhat outdated, as there is now an airport in the middle of the left side, and an Office building at the top center part. The third floor have a level 175 requirement to enter. === {{map|id=juperos_01 Juperos Ruins}} === Underneath El Mes Plateau lies the ruins of the city of Juperos , an ancient but highly advanced civilization. Juperos is well protected by automated guards and security devices to prevent unauthorized entry to prohibited areas. Although many of Juno's [[Scholar]]s have their own speculations on the cause of the fall of such a technologically advanced race, no one is really sure what went wrong. One of the most popular theories is that Vesper Newton, a mad scientist conducting experiments with the famed Heart of Ymir has something to do with it. The entrance to [[Verus]] can be found on the first level of the Ruins. {{Navbox Towns}}

== Overview ==
The Juno Monster Society, a mysterious organization that researches and investigates the ecology of monsters, is recruiting mid-level adventurers to exterminate some monsters. It seems it’s got something to do with the excessive monster population...

[[File:JMS NPC.png|frame|center]]

The '''Juno Monster Society''' is a series of quests intended to help medium level characters to level faster. These quests involve killing 80 monsters in a designated area and while event monsters are excluded from the kill count, plant and mushrooms are not.

All quests reset at 4:00am Server Time but they can be manually reset by bringing {{Item List|id=1000374|item=Sparkling Carbonated Water |simple=yes|num=3}} to one of the Investigators in the field. These can be bought from the ''Sparkling Vending Machine'' next to any of the Assistants in towns for 50,000z (Discount not applicable) and giving {{Item List|id=1000374|item=Sparkling Carbonated Water |simple=yes|num=1}} to them will allow you to teleport to one of the dispatched Investigators.

*The player can take [[Bounty Board Quests]] alongside for double efficiency.
*Weaker characters can kill plants and other low level mobs on the map for the same EXP reward.

1. Meet a sad girl who doesn't stop crying, Euslan {{navi|yuno|111|156}} in [[Juno]], ask why she's sad. She tells you that she misses her boyfriend, Thierry, who is looking for a remedy to cure her sickness. Help her to look for her boyfriend. She tells you that the staff in the [[airship]] station will have some information on this. 

2. Go to the Domestic ([[Juno]]/[[Einbroch]]/[[Lighthalzen]]/[[Hugel]]) [[Airship]] and talk to Hallen {{navi|airplane|235|62}}, he says he's not sure, but you can ask Kaci in the [[airship]] casino for more information. 

3. Talk to Kaci {{navi|airplane|33|69}} and she will inform you that she met with Thierry. However, she is not sure of his whereabouts. She advises you to check with the captain of the [[airship]] by telling the captain your story. She also asks you to send her regards to Euslan. 

4. Look for the Airship Captain {{navi|airplane|236|163}} and tell him your story. He explains that Thierry went to [[Hugel]]. 

5. Return to Euslan to pass her Kaci's regards. She will tell you that her brother Eukran works in the [[Bingo]] game Amusement Park in [[Hugel]]. 

6. Go to the [[Bingo]] House (57,207) and once you enter a dialogue will pop out, <del>the person there tells you that you can only meet the Euslan's brother after playing a game because he is a very busy man.</del> Playing Bingo is no longer necessary for completing the quest.

<del>*Five people are needed to play a game of [[Bingo]], but winning the game is not necessary.</del>

7. After playing a game, you can see Eukran (You will be instantly warped to the room where he works). He says that Thierry went to the Odin Temple to look for the medicine. 

8. Go to Odin Temple and listen around for a Suspicious Man (odin_tem01 135,125 [Walk around this area]), you'll hear 2 people talking about research related topics. After talking, one person leaves and a young man will appear (114, 147 [Walk around this area]). 

9. Talk to the young man and find he is Thierry. Unfortunately he will not leave his research to go back to Euslan. 

10. After you leave Thierry, the stranger that talked to him (odin_tem01 108, 146, right in front of the port in the temple) is talking to someone else, and they are plotting something. 

11. Go back to Thierry and inform him what you heard. He asks for help to gather some ingredient for him. Collect 5 {{item|id=7511 Rune of Darkness}}. When you have the correct amount, Thierry will make the remedy and ask you to pass the remedy to Euslan while he will stay a bit longer to distract the stranger's attention. 

12. Pass the remedy to Euslan. The quest ends here and you will get some [[Base EXP]] and [[Job EXP]].

Once on level two, an intrepid explorer and his party must destroy the 3 Gate Switches located on the "islands" around the perimeter. 2. They will not respawn until all 3 are destroyed, and the spawn is not instant. *1st Gate Switch {{Navi|juperos_02|24|275}} *2nd Gate Switch {{Navi|juperos_02|240|29}} *3rd Gate Switch {{Navi|juperos_02|282|183}} 3. Upon doing this, Vesper's voice will echo over the dungeon, inviting warriors to come meet him. They must then make a mad dash to the center of the map {{Navi|juperos_02|130|149}}, past mobs of Venatu and Apocalips, to a portal which has now been activated. 4. You will now find yourself in an "NPC" room (as in, you cannot change the camera angle or zoom), and going through either portal (the left or right) will cause you to reach a pedestal. 5.Click on the pedestal to automatically insert a Crest Piece found by killing Venatu. Another portal will open. http://db.irowiki.org/image/item/7356.png http://db.irowiki.org/image/item/7357.png http://db.irowiki.org/image/item/7358.png http://db.irowiki.org/image/item/7359.png 6. In the next room, a mob of 4 Venatu and 3 Dimik will spawn. If you're soloing, quickly [[Cloaking|Cloak]] or [[Stalk]] away to a safe part of the room and pick them off one by one. If you're in a party, just go all out. 7. After killing enough (or waiting long enough), you are permitted to enter another crest in another pedestal. 8. Following this are two rooms similar to the last, but with more monsters. 9. After the 3 security rooms, you will reach the "elevator" upon which waves of robots will spawn and attack. You must kill or outlast them all, a task which is nearly impossible without a well-equipped team. 10. Finally you will reach level 3, where {{monster |id=1668 Archdam}}s, [https://db.irowiki.org/db/search/?quick=dimik Dimiks], and the [[MVP]] {{monster |id=1685 Vesper}} will be found. 1. Go inside the [[Juno]] Library, located on the northeast island.

2. In the Juno Library, talk to the Scholar (Fayruz) located in the farthest room {{Navi|yuno_in04|190|125}} and then choose the bottom option.

[[Image:LibraryScholar1.jpg]]

3. On the nearby table, read the "Bundle of Files" {{Navi|yuno_in04|186|125}}. You should be reading through the document "Thesis: The fall of Juperos".

[[Image:FileBundle1.jpg]]

4. Next, you'll need to go through the other books in the library:

* Book {{Navi|yuno_in04|167|127}} 
* Book {{Navi|yuno_in04|188|117}} 
* Paper {{Navi|yuno_in04|188|116}} 
* Book {{Navi|yuno_in04|187|109}} 
* Book {{Navi|yuno_in04|186|104}} 

4. Talk to Fayruz again and choose the second option. She'll ask you to go to Juperos and find some things and bring them to her.

5. Find and talk to the 4 bronze statues near the entrance to the second floor. After you talk to them, your character tells you to go back to Fayruz and tell her about the findings.

[[Image:BronzeStatue1.jpg]]

6. Talk to Feyruz again. She will translate the text you recovered from the statues. She will ask you to take some more documents to her.
 
7. You need to kill Dimiks to get the documents required. There are 4 types of Dimiks that will drop 4 types of {{item|id=7355 Transparent Plates}}. You will need all 4 plates.

[[Image:Transparentplate.jpg]]

8. Each time you bring one of the plates back to Feyruz, she will give you a reward. The quest is over once you bring back all 4 kinds of plates but she will continue to reward you if you give more Transparent Plates.

* You gain 10,000 [[Base EXP]] for the first plate of each kind you turn in. The second time you give her a plate of the same type you have given her, she will give you a {{item|id=666 Gift Box}}.

title: Kafra
wikitext:
__TOC__
[[File:KafraList.png]]

The '''Kafra Corporation''' (or simply '''Kafra''') provides players with certain services. These services include:   

*Teleport Service   
*[[Storage]] Service
*Save Service   
*[[Pushcart|Cart]] Rental Service   
*Location Checking Service   
*Point Checking Service    

Not all of these services are available at every Kafra.

== Services ==
=== Teleport Service ===
The teleport service allows you to pay a small amount of [[zeny]] to instantly travel to another location (usually cities). Some Kafras have teleport services to outside of dungeons. The price for using this service usually depends on this distance between where you are and where you want to go. If you have a {{item |id=7060 Free Ticket for Kafra Transportation}}, you may use this ticket to negate the cost of one teleport. On iRO, teleport prices and destinations are dependent on the game account's [[VIP]] status.

=== Storage Service ===
The Storage service allows you to access your [[storage]] (For that server only, no cross-server storage allowed). By paying 40 [[Zeny]] (on iRO, 500 Zeny for non-[[IRO Servers Comparison|VIP]] accounts), you may transfer (transferable) items to your storage, and take items in your storage out. All of your characters on the same account have access to the same storage. The maximum amount of separate items that your storage can hold is 600 (Slots available on non iRO servers may vary). Those who have [[VIP]] have access to a second storage which also contains 600 slots. You must have the [[Novice]] [[Basic Skill]] level 6 to access your storage. If you have a {{Item |id=7059 Free Ticket for Kafra Storage}} (under level 40 on iRO), you may use this ticket to negate the cost of accessing your storage once. You can store your items without dragging, by holding ALT then right click on the item.

=== Save Service ===
The save service allows you to save your respawn point (where you go after you die) at or close to the Kafra employee. This service is free, and you may use it as many times as you want.
 
=== Cart Rental Service ===
The cart rental service allows you to carry a cart. It is only available to [[Merchant]] and [[Super Novice]] classes with the [[Pushcart]] skill. Once obtained, your cart can be accessed using Alt+W.

The price of the cart rental service varies between towns. Prices are listed below:
*[[Aldebaran]] 600z
*[[Amatsu]] 700z
*[[Kunlun]] 700z
*[[Louyang]] 700z
*[[Geffen]] 750z
*[[Prontera]] 800z
*[[Juno]] 800z
*[[Einbroch]] 800z
*[[Lighthalzen]] 800z
*[[Hugel]] 800z
*[[Rachel]] 800z
*[[Izlude]] 820z
*[[Alberta]] 850z
*[[Payon]] 930z
*[[Morroc]] 930z
*[[Comodo]] 1000z
*[[Archer Village]] 1200z

=== Location Checking Service ===
The location checking service tells you where other Kafra employees on the same map are. This service is free.   

=== Point Checking Service ===
The point checking service tells you how many Kafra Points you have earned. You may redeem these at the Kafra Headquarters in [[Al De Baran]]. This should not be confused with [[Kafra Shop]] Points.     

==Other Services==
The following are not provided directly by Kafra employees.
=== Reward Points System ===
{{expert}}
For every 10 [[Zeny]] spent on Kafra services (excluding dungeon teleports from voting events), 1 Kafra Point (or Special Reserve Point) is earned on the character. In [[Al De Baran]], Kafra Points can be redeemed for a variety of items. There are 5 Lotteries that you can spend points in.   
==== 1,000 Point Lottery ====

* Wooden Mail (1st price)
* Shoes (2nd price)
* 4 Butterfly wings (3rd price)

==== 3,000 Point Lottery ====   
*100 {{item |id=501 Red Potions}} - 50%
*1 {{item |id=2201 Sunglasses}} - 30%
*1 {{item |id=2226 Cap}} - 15%
*3 {{item |id=505 Blue Potions}} - 5%

==== 5,000 Point Lottery ====   
*150 {{item |id=501 Red Potions}} - 70%
*15 {{item |id=645 Concentration Potions}} - 15%
*3 {{item |id=505 Blue Potions}} - 10%
*1 {{item |id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}} - 5%

==== 7,000 Point Lottery ====   
*10 {{item |id=504 White Potions}} - 70%
*15 {{item |id=656 Awakening Potions}} - 15%
*10 {{item |id=657 Berserk Potions}} - 10%
*1 {{item |id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}} & 1 {{item |id=607 Yggdrasilberry}} - 5%

==== 10,000 Point Lottery ====
*30 {{item |id=504 White Potions}} - 70%
*10 {{item |id=505 Blue Potions}} - 15%
*1 {{item |id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}} & 10 {{item |id=526 Royal Jellies}} - 10%
*3 {{item |id=607 Yggdrasilberries}} & 2 {{item |id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}} - 5%

=== Blank Card Rewards ===
{{iRO Only}}
Following the 2009 April Fool's event on iRO, a special Monster Card headgear was released, which added the chance for monsters killed by the wearer to drop Blank Cards. Blank Cards can be redeemed at the Kafra Headquarters for the following rewards:

=== Dungeon Teleport Elections ===
In each major city of the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]], a special Kafra and Cool Event Corp. Employee are found close to each other. Players over level 70 may vote for whom they would like to win. An announcement is occasionally made throughout the entire game informing players the current status of the election. Once a winner is chosen, that NPC will provide warps to certain dungeons. The dungeons that are available depend on when that NPC last won an election and by how large a margin it won the current election.     

Voting is open for 24 hours. If neither side receives at least 20 votes, voting remains open for another 24 hours (repeat until someone has at least 20 votes). Teleport service lasts for 144 game hours (6 days). The mechanism counting time for this is an actual in game NPC, so time does not elapse during server maintenance (or when the zone controlling [[Einbroch]] has crashed).

title: Kafra Shop
wikitext:
== Overview == The Kafra Shop is the iRO version of an Item Mall. To purchase items through the Kafra Shop, users must use Kafra Shop Points. These items are divided into several categories. Current categories in the Kafra Shop include Consumable Items, Headgears, Boxes, Costumes, Rental Weapons and Rental Accessories. == Kafra Shop Points == Kafra Shop Points (also known as ''KP'') can be purchased directly on the [https://www.warpportal.com/account/payment.aspx Warp Portal Website]. Kafra Shop Points can also be obtained by redeeming Gravity Game Prepaid Cards purchased at retail stores like Target. By and large, the more you spend to renew/purchase points, the more points will be earned for the money. As a basic general conversion, $1 USD = 100 Kafra Shop Points. Kafra Shop Points can also be obtained without spending money. The player may fill out surveys and receive points if the survey conditions and requirements are met. The list of available surveys may change from time to time. New surveys may be added and some surveys may be removed if enough participants have successfully completed the survey forms. Therefore, it may be helpful to occasionally recheck the list of available surveys. '''Warning:''' It should be noted that '''many''' surveys disqualify participants before completion of the survey, thus resulting in no points awarded. Most players have found the surveys to be a waste of time. '''Note''': "Kafra Shop Points" are not to be confused with "Kafra Points" earned by spending [[Zeny]] on regular [[Kafra]] Employee services, such as using Storage, Teleporting and renting [[Pushcart|Carts]]. Those points can be used at the Kafra Headquarters in [[Al De Baran]]. == In-Game == Kafra Shop Employees are located on the second floor of the [[Eden Group]] HQ, [[Payon]], and [[Prontera]]. Items available for purchase in the Kafra Shop are all listed in order of when they were added. Older items are at the top, while newer items are at the bottom. If you need to find out how many unused Kafra Shop Points remain, simply click on a Kafra Shop Employee vending items and the total will be displayed at the bottom of the Shop Items list window. [[File:Cashshop.gif|align=right]] A Cash Shop button in the client interface allows direct purchase of Kafra Shop items from anywhere in the game. Items that require an NPC to function (upgrades, Gym Pass training, clothing dye, etc.) must be taken to that NPC. Other related NPCs include: {| class="wikitablec" ! NPC ! Description |- |'''Ripped Callus (Cabus)'''
{{navi|moc_paraup|33|162}}

and can level up their [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] skill up to level 10. |- |'''Dinorah Lacostt'''
{{navi|moc_paraup|33|185}} || [[Kafra Shop#Clothes Dye|Dye clothe]] using {{Item |id=6287 Omni Clothing Dye}}. |- |'''Alora'''

''More info: [[RWC Accessory Enchants]]'' |} In Prontera, the Kafra Shop Employee is located in the building at the southwest end of the main path {{navi|prontera|87|91}}. She sells clothing dye (see Dye section below). == Items == The list of items can be found at the [http://renewal.playragnarok.com/kafrashop/list.aspx Kafra Shop Items Page], which lists items, their prices, and user ratings. [[file:KagerouArt.jpg|250px|right]]
''Kagerou and [[Oboro]] clans were once known as the Right and Left hand of the Feudal Lord in Amatsu. They displayed fearsome prowess, completing every task swiftly with precision. Perhaps due to Kagerou and Oboro's outstanding abilities, they were banished from Amatsu by the Feudal Lord who has grown fearful of them. Betrayed by the Feudal Lord, it is said that Kagerou and Oboro have hidden themselves in the shadows of history.''

Decades have passed since then. 

A new group of clan calling themselves the "Ninja Clan" have appeared in Amatsu, who has steadily gained power over the years. It is rumored that the Jounins of the clan will teach experienced Ninjas, who pass the secret test, the ways of Kagerou and Oboro.

== Job Change Guide==
''See [[Kagerou Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.''

Changing into Kagerou from a [[Ninja]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks:
* Written Test
* A Survival Test
* Test of Weaponry
* Battle Test

After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Kagerou.

== Builds ==
=== Magic ===

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px"
|-
! Stat !! Amount !! Notes

| STR || 1 ~ 80 || 
|-
| AGI || 1 ~ 90 ||

|-
| DEX || 1 ~ 110 || For cast time.
|-
| LUK || 30 ~ 60 || Small bonuses, extra MATK.
|}

This build is similar to Kagerou's predecessor class, [[Ninja]], and utilizes same offensive magic skills and new supportive type magic skills. [[INT]], [[DEX]] and [[LUK]] are the primary stat for Magic build to increase MATK output as well as decrease cast time of skills. One can opt to completely drop the DEX stat in favor of other stats such as [[STR]] and [[AGI]] with the use of Cast Time reduction equipments and [[16th Night]] skill to increase weight capacity as well as increase [[ASPD]]. '''Note: 16th Night skill stacks multiplicatively with all Cast Time reduction skills, equipments, items and stats.'''

Kagerou's primary damage and supportive skills are [[Freezing Spear]], [[First Wind]], [[Flaming Petals]], [[Exploding Dragon]], [[Ninja Aura]], [[Cicada Skin Shed]] and healthy mix of Ninja 2nd tier magic skills such as [[Blaze Shield]]. There are new supportive skills that both Kagerou and Oboro classes can get such as [[16th Night]], [[Pure Soul]], [[Fire-Charm]], [[Ice-Charm]] and [[Wind-Charm]] that directly or indirectly increase throughput.

=== Throwing ===

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px"
|-
! Stat !! Amount !! Notes
|-
| STR || 90 ~ 110 || Base damage.
|-
| AGI || 80 ~ 100 || Present in calculation of Swirling petal.
|-
| VIT || 80 ~ 100 || Overall survivavility.
|-
| INT || 1 ~ 80 || SP pool and SP regeneration rate.
|-
| DEX || 80 ~ 100 || Present in calculation of skills.
|-
| LUK || 1 ~ 80 || Small bonuses, extra ATK.
|}

Throwing builds utilize newly strengthened throwing skills available to Kagerou and Oboro. The main throwing skills that are available are [[Swirling Petal]], [[Kunai Splash]], [[Kunai Explosion]], and [[Rapid Throw]].

With the exception of Rapid Throw, all throwing skills are based on [[STR]] to increase ATK, and [[DEX]] to increase the skill modifier. In the case of Swirling Petal skill, it utilizes the [[AGI]] stat in its skill modifier formula. Having high amounts of DEX and LUK will allow Kagerou to increase HIT and ATK of throwing skills as well as reduce cast time. It's worth noting that [[16th Night]] skill will reduce significant portion of cast time of all skills so it's recommended that players don't focus too much on the [[INT]] stat.

With the combination of old and new supportive skills such as [[Ninja Aura]], [[Cicada Skin Shed]], [[16th Night]], [[Pure Soul]], [[Earth-Charm]], [[Fire-Charm]], [[Ice-Charm]] and [[Wind-Charm]] and Cast Ninja Spell, both Kagerou and Oboro can deal substantial damage to their foes.

=== Killing Stroke ===

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px"

| LUK || 40 ~ 100 || Perfect Dodge, extra ATK.
|}

This build focuses on the Ninja's skill [[Killing Stroke]], a mini-[[Guillotine Fist]] of sorts. [[STR]] and [[VIT]] are the two stats driving Killing Stroke's damage and are thus the main stats for this build. [[DEX]] and [[LUK]] can be used for [[Rapid Throw]] skill in conjunction with [[Killing Stroke]] to significantly increase the chance of killing your target. DEX also helps marginally with ninja skills cast time, but majority of the cast time will be reduced by [[16th Night]] skill. A pure Killing Stroke Ninja may opt to discard some DEX and LUK in favor of additional STR/VIT for Killing Stroke damage but this is not recommended as the damage gained does not justify losing the benefit of Rapid Throw skill.

=== Melee ===

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px"

! Stat !! Amount !! Notes

The least popular build that is focused on auto/ctrl-attacking. This build should only be considered as 'for fun' build, but still viable for leveling (though might be VERY SLOW) and possibly low-tier MvPs. Leftovers can go to INT for [[Silence]] resistance and hybrid magic build, or LUK for more ATK. For more magical offense, INT can be pumped to ~100 and leave STR for leftovers.

Main AoE/leveling/MvPing skill would still be [[Kunai Explosion]] and/or [[Kunai Splash]]. For ctrl-clicking [[Shadow Warrior]] is a must, with options to max [[Right Hand Mastery]] or both hand masteries or just balance both, depending on preference. Hybrid magic build (especially that prefers more INT than STR) can MvP with max [[Flaming Petals]] or [[Freezing Spear]] or both depending on preference. Other skills like [[Pure Soul]], [[16th Night]], and charms are also necessary.

== Equipment ==

Kagerou cannot wear transcendent-only or 3rd class-only equipments. They are limited to equipments that's wearable by all, ninja, kagerou/oboro, and 2nd class equipments. This means that equipments such as Nidhoggur's Shadow Garb, Variant Shoes, Valkyrian Armor cannot be worn by them.

Melee builds should try to achieve a good balance between 193 ASPD and ATK/survivability. Throwing builds should try to achieve a good balance between +% ranged damage modifier and ATK/survivability. Magic builds should try to achieve a good balance between 100% cast time reduction and MATK/survivability. Phen Card is almost necessary for throwing setups without cast reductions.

==Test of Survival==

This test is like a board game where you roll dice, move that number of spaces, and do what that space tells you to do. The twist is you have 100 "life points" (LP) and each roll of the dice costs 1 life point. You need to get to space number 40 without running out of life points.

You can get sent back spaces, get sent ahead spaces, be forced to play "rock, paper, scissors" which can result in getting sent ahead or sent back, get cursed and be unable to continue the game for 2 minutes, forced to spend additional LP to roll a dice, or have to pay an amount of life points to do any of the proceeding things.

==Test of Weaponry==

You will be required to dump metals into one of the three crafting tool areas. When you've input enough metal into the forge, you will be prompted to do additional tasks. 

'''Melting Metal:''' If you are not getting past this point, it is because you are not inputting similar materials or enough of them. Putting in just iron ore for example takes about 20 ores. About 7 steel will do it instead. You can also do a combination of "similar" items such as 6 steel and 3 iron ore and it will continue. 

'''Forging:''' Once you've input enough raw materials in to be melted, you will be asked whether you wish to make a dagger or a shuriken. Next, you will be asked to grind and temper the weapon. You must grind it and then temper it in turn a LOT! If you do not grind or temper it enough, the item will explode when you wish to put the finishing touches on it. It appears to be random (Try 20 Times for both) how many times you have to grind and temper the weapon, sometimes it will work with only one grind and temper. If you fail this step, you will have to go back to the "Melting Metal" step.

* 20 {{item|id=1002 Iron Ore}} is enough to make a weapon.
* 10 {{item|id=998 Iron}} is enough to make a weapon.
* 7 {{item|id=999 Steel}} is enough to make a weapon.
* 7 {{item|id=756 Rough Oridecon}} is enough to make a weapon.
* 7 {{item|id=757 Rough Elunium}} is enough to make a weapon. - ''as of 2015/08/07 even ~100 Rough Elunium doesn't work''
* 20 {{item|id=1010 Phracon}} is enough to make a weapon. (Phracon are purchasable from an NPC in the Prontera refining shop)

'''Refining:''' After forging your weapon, Red Panther Joe will tell you it's not good enough yet. You need to get the weapon to at least +7 before Joe will accept it. Talk to him with the weapon equipped. He will give you the weapon back with your name on it.

* If you chose to make a kunai, you will be awarded a {{Item List |id=13075 |item=Kurenai | simple=yes}} with your name on it after the job change.
* If you chose to make a shuriken, you will be awarded a {{Item List |id=13311 |item=Huuma Shadow | simple=yes}} with your name on it after the job change.

==Test of Battle (Final Test)==

The final test is similar to other job change tests where your goal is to locate a monster named "'''Family Secret'''" and kill it. There are dozens of similarly named monsters. You must kill the properly named one and speak to the instructor Gion to continue. You will be changed to Kagerou/Oboro after completing this task.
'''Reported bug: Family Secret does not spawn. You need to send ticket to GM via support feature.'''
