You'll find the {{Item List |id=7503 |item=Man's Portrait |simple=yes}}. 57. Head back to Kiel Hyre's Mansion {{navi|lighthalzen|188|204}}. Talk to Mitchell {{navi|kh_mansion|20|87}}, and tell her what you found. She sends you to talk with Kiel. 58. Talk to Kiel, and he tells you the whole story. He met Allysia on August 19th; Allysia said that James never betrayed her and then Kiel and Allysia started fighting when she ended up in the river. Kiel then asks for your help to stop his "son" and opens a portal for you to enter, and hands you a {{Item List|id=7504|item=Power Device|simple=yes}}. * '''NOTE:''' '''As of testing the quest Feb 25, 2011, party members were not able to enter the final room where Kiehl was located following the instructions below (entering before the main quest player). This quest may have been changed at some point.''' * '''Note:''' If you need help with this quest and are bringing party members along, they need to have reached at least step 43 (show the Golden Key to the Steward) and it doesn't matter if they have finished the quest earlier in order to follow you in. 59. Enter the portal and you'll enter the first room. 60. Click on the Receiver next to the upper-left bed. This will summon an {{monster | id=1739 Alicel (special)}} and {{monster | id=1740 Aliot (special)}} . After the summoned monsters are dead, a {{item|id=7506 Black Keycard}} will drop from the receiver. You will need one {{item|id=7506 Black Keycard}} now, and three more later. It may be easier to obtain four {{item|id=7506 Black Keycards}} now by clicking on the Receiver additional times, because it’s harder to obtain later on. * '''Note:''' Only one person should activate the Receiver at any time, because the key only spawns when every monster in the room dies regardless of number summoned. {{Item List |id=7506 |item=Black Keycard |simple=yes}} are not transferable. Anybody who picks it up is stuck with it, so make sure the correct person gets it. 61. Click on the Flower Vase in the top left corner, and when prompted, read the message on the bottom (by turning it upside down). 62. Open the Box at the bottom of the room. The password to open it is "'''Open the door'''" or "'''open the door'''". You will receive a {{Item List |id=7505 |item=Toy Key |simple=yes}}. *'''Note:''' If you type in the correct password (case sensitive), and get an incorrect password or unable to get the Toy Key, then you did not get the Power Device from Step 58. 63. Open the door at the end of the room and make your way to the next room. If the door doesn't open, make sure all the monsters are dead before proceeding, and that you have the required keys. * '''Note:''' If teleported back to receiver room, you did not open the box 64. On the way through between rooms, you'll encounter a small number of monsters. In the room, you can open this door by using the {{item|id=7505 Toy Key}}. (Type in "Toy Key") * '''Note:''' If teleported back to receiver room, you did not open the door with the Toy Key 65. Follow the path to the third room. Open this door using the {{item|id=7506 Black Keycard}}. (Type "Black Keycard") * '''Note:''' If teleported back to the room, you did not use the Black Keycard. 66. Make your way to the fourth room {{navi|kh_kiehl01|16|179}}. You will need {{Item List |id=7506 |item=Black Keycard |num=2 |simple=yes}} to open this door. At the left side of the room there will be test tubes that can be used to spawn monsters. Killing them will reveal a {{item|id=7506 Black Keycard}} if it’s needed. (To open the door to the right, type "Black Keycard" into the text box that appears) * '''Note:''' If teleported back to the room, you did not use the Black Keycard. 67. Make your way to the fifth and final room. There will be more monsters here than there were previously {{navi|kh_kiehl01|165|186}}. * '''Note:''' At this point, '''NPC dialog should be initiated by only one player'''. Once {{monster | id=1733 Kiehl}} is defeated, and the first player has received {{item |id=7508 Allysia's ring}} can the others talk to him. It may be required for other players to repeat this portion of the quest with them initiating it. Remember that even if you've completed the quest, you will be able to return later and assist others if needed. Only those actively participating in completing the quest can open the portal to the Toy Room. 68. You'll need to try three times to force the door here open. Each time, two Aliots, and 2 Alicel will attack you. You'll need to kill the monsters before making another attempt on the door. * '''Note:''' Step 69 should be done by one person. If the door is clicked on, then you will need Solid Iron Pieces to open the door. Reason explained below. 69. Once the door is slightly open you'll need to pry it open further to pass. You'll need to make four attempts before you will be able to enter, and each time you'll need to use some kind of metal fragment. Solid Iron Piece is probably the best to use for this. If you do not have {{Item List |id=7507 |item=Solid Iron Pieces |num=4 |simple=yes}}, backtrack a little and kill the monsters here until you get them. * '''Note:''' If you end up teleporting back in place while trying to enter, then you need 4 Solid Iron Pieces in order to get through. 70. Once the door is pried open, anyone you want to assist you in the coming battle will need to enter before you do. Once you enter the portal, the door will close and no one else will be able to enter until you are finished. * '''Note:''' This area has a time limit. After roughly 10 minutes you will be warped out. If you leave and return the quest will continue from roughly the same point for the person who opened the door. 71. When you enter the room a large number of monsters will spawn within a few seconds. Dispatch these and make your way to the center of the room. * '''Note:''' If at any time from this step onwards your party is wiped out, you'll need 3 Black Keycards again to open all the doors you went through earlier, and all previous monsters will respawn. However, the monsters in Steps 68-69 will not respawn unless another person initiates the quest and you do not need any additional Solid Iron Pieces. 72. Upon talking to Kiehl, he will summon more monsters (including the weak constants). After killing these, Kiehl will return. 73. Talk to Kiehl again. After a brief conversation, Kiehl will attack you. You must defeat {{monster | id=1733 Kiehl }} to continue (This is a weaker version of the MVP.) * '''Note:''' There is a chance that if your party fails or unable to defeat Kiehl, you can warp out and go through the path again to continue the quest (to step 74.) 74. After defeating Kiehl, talk to him again. He will explain his plan. In the end he will hand over Allysia's Ring. A portal will appear behind him, and you can use this to leave the room (If you didn't get the ring, talk to Kiehl again before exiting the room). *'''Note: At this point, the other members of the party who have not also completed the quest will find Allysia's Ring when they leave the portal.''' 75. Bring the ring to Kiel Hyre. He will recommend you look for Kiehl in the second level of the factory dungeon. He will give you 2,000,000 [[Base EXP]] (3,000,000 VIP) (in 2 increments), 500,000 [[Job EXP]] (750,000 VIP), an {{Item List |id=616 |item=Old Card Album |simple=yes}}, and a {{Item List |id=7509 |item=Luxurious Keycard |simple=yes}} to gain access to the {{map|id=kh_dun02 Robot Factory 2F}}. At this point the quest is complete, and you can choose to find and battle {{monster | id=1734 Kiel-D-01}} now if you wish. [[Category:Hugel Quests]]

title: Kill Steal
wikitext:
'''Kill Stealing''' (abbr. KSing), or killing a [[monster]] which doesn't belong to the player, or in other words, when someone else is attempting to kill it or the monster is attacking them, is a bannable offense, and looked down upon. 

Gravity Interactive officially categorizes Kill Stealing under Harassment. It is not uncommon for mistakes to happen, and there is a threshold for determining if a behavior was harassment or KSing. A single incident where someone comes up and takes a whack or two at a person's monster is usually not considered KSing. A person who makes a habit of attacking another person's monsters is KSing. To successfully report an incident of KSing one needs to include multiple screenshots of the offender attacking one's monsters on a few different occasions. One should also try and have before and during screenshots so that the GMs can clearly see that the offender was attacking the monster.

title: Knight
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobBase=Swordman |jobType=2-1 |jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Prontera]] Chivalry |skills=10 |skillPoints=76 |questSkills=1 |Skills from Soul Link=1 |str=8 |agi=2 |vit=10 |int=0 |dex=6 |luk=4}} [[Image: Knight.jpg|240px|right]] The Knight class is the primary second job for the [[Swordman]] class. Being a hack and slash type of character, Knights are granted access to a new mastery that will open a new type of weapon to wield aside from the [[Swordman|Swordman's]] swords. They are also allowed to acquire powerful [[AoE]] skills like the famed [[Bowling Bash]] and the [[Spear|spear]] exclusive skill, [[Brandish Spear]]. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Knight Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into a Knight from a [[Swordman]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks: * Item collection * A written test * Battle test * Word association quiz * A test of self control * Personality quiz After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Knight. All this takes place inside the [[Prontera]] Chivalry ([[Prontera]] xx, yy). ==Builds== ===Hybrid=== *STR: 70-90 *AGI: 60-90 *VIT: 60-90 *INT: 1 *DEX: 40-60 *LUK: 1-20 Weapon: [[Spear]]s, [[One Handed Sword]]s, or [[Two Handed Sword]]s These knights try to get the best of both realms. By having a good chemistry of [[AGI]] and [[VIT]] depending on the user's playing style, they gain survivability in some areas while losing it in others. Hybrids are denoted by which stat is the highest. AGI-VIT Knights usually stick with a setup similar to an AGI knight. VIT-AGI Knights, likewise, generally stay with the setup of a VIT Knight. Every Knight should have medium to medium high VIT for surviving against mobs (flee is reduced once more than one monster attacks the player). However, even for pure VIT / AoE builds, AGI is also helpful for less delay between each [[Bowling Bash]] cast. ===SVD=== *STR: 70-90 *AGI: 1-40 *VIT: 80-99 *INT: 1-30 *DEX: 40-60 *LUK: 1-20 Weapon: [[Spear]]s, [[One Handed Sword]]s, or [[Two Handed Sword]]s SVD Knights ([[STR]]/[[VIT]]/[[DEX]]) are a classic, effective Knight build that is still one of the most useful builds. An SVD Knight is great for AoE leveling with [[Bowling Bash]] or [[Brandish Spear]] (Spear weapon only). In single target situations, the SVD Knight is especially effective on [[Large]] sized monsters utilizing [[Pierce]]. [[INT]] is a variable stat, and generally Knights do not rely on SP regen and instead use Equipment or Cards that can leech SP back, like Earth Deleter Card. [[AGI]] is not for defense when being attacked by multiple monsters (due to the [[FLEE]] penalty) and its main purpose is to use [[Bowling Bash]] or [[Pierce]] at a faster rate because of the [[ASPD]]. ===AGI Two-Hand Sword=== *STR: 70-90 *AGI: 80-99 *VIT: 40+ *INT: 1 *DEX: 40-60 *LUK: 1-20 Weapons: [[Element]]al [[Two Handed Sword]]s or [[Card]]ed [[Two Handed Sword]]s [[AGI]] Knights is usually recommended for newer players without funds. They have high [[ASPD]] and [[FLEE]] for quick single target killing, so it uses minimal HP / SP [[Healing Items]]. Their main method of attack is melee-ing single monsters with [[Twohand Quicken]], which increases [[ASPD]] by 30%. When faced with multiple foes, they still have the option of using [[Bowling Bash]]. == Tactics == === Recovering HP or Healing Items === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for [[AoE]] leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. One popular healing item is Fresh Fish due to its cheap cost and low weight. It can be purchased from NPCs off the Chef's Assistant at the docks of Alberta (167, 134) as well as other locations for only 250z each (190z with max [[Discount]]). {{Item List |id=579 |item=Fresh Fish |simple=yes}} For a list of Healing Items, a comparison, and a list of a couple popular Healing Items, please see the main article: [[Healing Items]]. == Equipment == === Eden Group Equipments Quests === :''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'' Eden Group Equipment is free and a great place to start for gear to use. The Spear is a good weapon and generally a good choice for a Knight and their future classes' use, but some may opt for the Two Handed Sword for cheaper single target leveling with [[Two Hand Quicken]]. === General Equipment Recommendations === :''Main article: [[Equipment]]'' The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well. === Third Class Compatible Equipment === :''Main article: [[Rune_Knight#Equipment|Rune Knight Equipment]]'' It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only. === Weapons === After considering what requirement skills have (some skills can only be used with certain weapon types), the Weapon Search tool within the iRO Wiki DB site is very helpful. Generally, for physical classes (both melee and ranged), something with high [[ATK]] is best. For magic classes, something with high [[MATK]] is best. Link to the iRO Wiki DB Weapon Search: http://db.irowiki.org/db/weapon-search/ ==Class Data== ===Skills=== :''See [[Swordsman#Skills|Swordman]] Skills for first class skills.'' :''See [[Skills#Skill_Reset|Skill Reset]] for information about free skill resets.'' {| class="wikitablec sortable" |- ! If you fail, restock on necessary items, restore your HP/SP, and talk to Sir Windsor again to retake the test. :*Before beginning this test, ensure you are fully prepared: :**Full HP/SP :**HP Potions :**There will '''not''' be time to sit and regen HP during the test because of the time limit. :**Especially recommended for those under level 60. 15 {{item|id=502 Orange}}/{{item|id=504 White Potion}}s is ideal, but a large stock of {{item|id=517 Meat}} or the like will suffice. :**{{item|id=506 Green Potion}}s :**{{item|id=656 Awakening Potion}}s (Lvl 40+) / {{item|id=645 Concentration Potions}}} :**SP Restoring Items *Many of the monsters in round 1 are weak to [[Fire]], while some monsters in round 2 are weak to [[Water]]. 6. Talk to '''Lady Amy''' {{Navi|prt_in|69|107}} in the bottom left corner of the Chivalry to begin her quiz. :[[File:Knight-LadyAmy.png|250px]] *Answers: *#Open a Chat Room and Wait or Look for people seeking Knights *#Check out the area and plan ahead or Lead the party slowly at the front *#Keep the monsters from reaching your party or Defend while the party retreats *#Ask your party's Priest to help *#Give it to who deserves it the most or Decide with a party who gets it *#Open a chat room and wait or Inquire if there is anyone that is interested *#Give suggestions for a place to hunt *#Tell the person how to reach the exit or Lead the person to the exit *#Would it be possible to get a heal, please? *#Ask around to find the owner or Simply walk by
7. Next, engage in conversation with '''Sir Edmond''' {{Navi|prt_in|70|99}}. He will teleport the player to a map with {{monster|id=1002 Poring}}s, {{monster|id=1163 Lunatic}}s, and {{monster|id=1011 Chonchons}}. *Do '''not''' attack any of these monsters. If you comply with sparing these innocent creatures' lives, you will be teleported back to the Chivalry after '''5 minutes''', passing the test. So in the meantime, just sit down and wait. :[[File:Knight-SirEdmond.png|250px]]
8. Talk to '''Sir Gray''' {{Navi|prt_in|87|91}}, who gives another quiz. :[[File:Knight-SirGray.png|250px]] *The quickest way to finish his test is with the answers below, however nearly any answer can be selected and he will simply try to persuade the player to answer differently. Just select answers that portray a friendly, altruistic person. *Answers: *#Stronger *#To protect others *#Those waiting for me *#Friends
9. Return to the Chivalry Captain, who changes the player's job to Knight. 7 {{item |id=656 Awakening Potions}} will be rewarded regardless of job level. *Players who are Job Level 50 do not receive any extra items. {{Navbox Knight}} [[Category: Knight]] [[Category: Job Change Guide]]

== Overview == This is designed to be a checklist for the iRO GMs to fix. Please date your listing, and hyperlink to any WP forum that explains it further in detail. When it is fixed, please use a strikethrough using the html <s> text </s> and link to the patch notes of the week it was fixed, or most recent week if found fixed but not mentioned. If it was mentioned exclusively in a user's thread, then link that. Stick to numbering format instead of bullets so that iRO staff or players can easily reference each bug. All listings will remain until a general archival process occurs to clean up the -fixed- bugs. The Last Archive Date will be listed on this page.
Use sub-numbering when there is multiple issues with the same NPC/Item. =About Kunlun=

[[Image: Kunlun.jpg|center]]

The Enchanted Skyland. 
Kunlun is another cultural town off the coast of the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]]. 
Designed in Ancient Taiwanese style. Outside of iRO, it is known as Gonryun. 
In October 2004, Kunlun became the second city in the Global Project to be added to iRO. 
To get there, pay the NPC (alberta, 245, 62) at the docks in Alberta 10,000 Zeny. Kunlun has one [http://ro.amesani.org/db/map-info/gon_fild01/ field map] and [http://ro.amesani.org/db/map-info/gon_dun01/ three dungeon maps]. 

The boat drops you off in the field map.  To get to the town, you have to get to the center of the field map and find the NPC who's near some statues of some kind of beast.  Walk up the stone ramp to the left of the NPC to find the town's entrance.

== Story==
A foreigner who arrives in [[Alberta]] is escorted to [[Prontera]]. After hearing about a civilization, King Tristan III orders a crew to sail and find this place. Despite all the hardships, the crew members finally establish a sea route to this newfound civilization. To this day, many people come and go to this new land. A place known for its stunning tourist attractions, sceneries, deep religious roots and impressive economic conditions. Despite their technological advancements, the people of Kunlun are a rather superstitious lot, worshipping deities known as "Hermits". These Hermits are an absolute power unto themselves, controlling human existence and limitations. Anyone can become a Hermit. The natives of Kunlun strived for perfection, believing that if they are good enough and work hard enough to achieve enlightenment, their souls would someday become one with the Hermits.

Unfortunately, not all who become Hermits remain good. Some are overwhelmed by their divinity, ending up being corrupted by it. They would use their power to do whatever they wish, regardless of how harmful or malicious the acts are. Neighboring cities and villages sometimes fear that these evil beings, now known as Evil Cloud Hermits, might someday upset the balance and cause great disasters for Kunlun.   

=== Mythology===
Kunlun is a mountain range in western China, believed to be a Taoist paradise. Said to be three (or nine) stories high, whoever climbs to Kunlun's top will gain access to the heavens. The mythological "Queen Mother of the West," Xi Wang-mu, associated with peaches and peach trees, resides in this mountain range.

*{{Item_List_2|id=100251|item=Illusion Upgrade Cube|simple=yes}} costs 10,000,000 zeny and refines an Illusion equip.
*{{Item_List_2|id=100252|item=Automatic Upgrade Cube|simple=yes}} costs 30,000,000 zeny and refines an Automatic equip.
The cubes refine the appropriate armor, garment, or shoes in your inventory directly to +7. *It is a 100% success rate. *When the refine is successful, the cube is consumed. *Buying these items are not affected by [[Discount]]. ==Automatic Modules Enchantment== The Automatic equipments can be enchanted by using Automatic Modules. There's 5 categories of Automatic Modules (Normal, Rare, Unique, Legendary, Epic). Each Automatic equipment can hold up to '''3''' modules, in the table below you can check how many of a kind you can enchant in a single piece of gear. The regular modules (Normal, Rare, Unique, Legendary) are obtained and given at '''random''' by exchanging {{Item_List_2|id=1000103|num=90|item=Barmeal Ticket|simple=yes}} to '''Yechung''' {{navi|ba_in01|87|380}}. :[[File:17.2-Dining NPCs-Yechung.png]] Epic modules can be acquired in two different ways: *Exchanging {{Item_List_2|id=1000104|num=300|item=Magical Soapstone|simple=yes}} to '''Spiera''' {{navi|ba_in01|87|373}} for one of your choice. *Complete Hidden Garden H instance and rarely get one at random. To apply the Automatic Modules, equip the Automatic armor and then speak with '''Ryza''' {{navi|ba_in01|87|370}} on the far right. The enchanting process consumes the Automatic Module and never fails. Senior Red Pepper Lambda has only 300M hp. ====Tips for Lambda==== After the 4th job patch in iRO on September 2023, it's said Lambda become stronger. Here are notes copy-pasted from a friend.
New Red Pepper Notes: * As long as Energy Shields are up, whether at "Default Status" or with "Broken Armor boosting shields", Pepper can use a portion of the damage dealt to it to boost its next skill - typically fireball, but i've also seen monstrously powerful firebolts and magnum breaks. This applies regardless of whether the damage dealt is physical, ranged or magical. In addition, the damage reduction by the shields is not taken into account. It will treat the counter damage as if it had received the full damage from the spell. This special effect is not maxpain, but it's still pretty bad. * Once the Energy Shields break (from destroying all 4 armors), you have the remaining amount of time (someone on the forum has suggested anywhere from 20 to 90s) to deal damage to Lambda. If you are attacking when the "Energy Shields have been restored to default status" appears, the person Pepper is attacking will likely die from the counter/damage boost effect shortly afterwards. Strangely, this is not seen in the videos of the instance from kRO and might be unique to iRO, which is annoying. * Even while shields are down, Pepper may still lash out with an extremely painful Critical Slash (this has always been the case since the first version on iRO). You typically need about 70k hp or so to cleanly survive the hit, so just be aware that this might happen because it probably will. It seems like there is some kind of internal hit or damage counter on Pepper every time he performs the armor summon. If you clear all the 4 armors but then exceed the internal hits/damage counter, he'll start to acquire the damage bonus anyway, even if the Energy Shield has yet to return to default. It is said the damage counter is about 50-60M before he'll start to acquire the damage bonus. If you're using an AB alt to tank like me, you can just stop attacking once he punches through prefaetio. On solos, stop attacking as soon as you start taking the big hits and wait for the next wave of armors, though from experience it tends to be tough to stop when you're just going full on dps. {{clear}} =Tartaros Storage= ==Cleaning the Storage (Street Level)== {{Quest Info | levelreq = 160 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = 20 [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/20682 Heart Hunters] | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 4,431,108 | jobexpreward = 3,101,760 | itemreward = {{Item List|id=1000103|item=Barmeal Tickets|simple=yes|num=1}} | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} Cooldown Quest Name: Pending: Cleaning Storage (Street Level) #Talk to Tweet {{Navi|ba_2whs01|151|51}}. #Defeat 20 Heart Hunters. {{clear}} ==Cleaning the Storage (Basement Level)== {{Quest Info | levelreq = 170 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = 20 [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/20637/broken-warehouse-manager] | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 5,974,540 | jobexpreward = 4,182,156 | itemreward = {{Item List|id=1000103|item=Barmeal Tickets|simple=yes|num=1}} | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} Cooldown Quest Name: Pending: Cleaning Storage (Basement) #Talk to Tweet {{Navi|ba_2whs01|151|51}}. #Defeat 20 Beta Itemkeeper robots which are the broken warehouse managers. {{clear}} =Floating Garden= Both versions of the instance and daily quest share the same cooldown.

wikitext:
== Overview == This page lists recommended [[levels|leveling]] spots, with the maps and monsters associated with them. Leveling spots are optimized by only killing [[monsters]] that do not have an EXP penalty at the character's current level. More information on this topic is in the [[Experience]] page. The former page was structured more for pre-renewal. [[Renewal]] leveling is more universal and does not necessarily need to be divided up by each [[class]]. The old page has been relocated [[Leveling_Spots/Old|here]]. Adding suggestions onto the page is highly appreciated. === Zenny Vs EXP === New players might want to focus on building their financial power before building their DPS. Quest and bounty boards are a good way to do this. See the [[Eden Merit Badge]] and [[Bounty Board Quest]]. Players can also level while farming items used for [[Potion Creation]] or [[Create Deadly Poison]]. Many other items are sought after by players. Look for these wanted items by visiting the [[Shopping Board]] of Prontera to search for buyers of specific items such as red herbs, stems, or maneater blossoms. Tip: You can kill two birds with one stone by collecting merit badges from bounty boards for monsters that drop items needed for potion creation. == Quests == [[Quests]] are an alternative to pure grinding, or are complementary to monster kills by giving extra [[EXP]] reward to a set of monster kills. You can also acquire valuable items and useful equipment. === Eden Group Leveling Quests === The [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] are a great place to start. Each character can undertake these quests after joining the [[Eden Group]]. === Weekly Turn Ins (Gramps) === Each week, there are [[Weekly Turn-In Events]] offered. These quests normally require a party to complete with, and often other players will be recruiting for anyone to join their party. These are for level ranges 70-100, 101-125, and 126-150. The Gramps NPC in Eden First Floor offers these quests to each character. Many players, especially ones playing support characters, will do these turn ins all the way to level 150/50. However, this leveling spots page does list some recommendations for more solo oriented characters or players to level at solo or with a small party. Note: Many players seem to believe this is the best place to level. However, that is not always the case. It is highly recommended to try new areas, focusing on bounty boards and spotlights. === Bounty Board Quests === The [[Bounty Board Quests]] offer repeatable quests starting from base level 1 and go up to 175. These quests offer a suitable amount of monster kills for players to both solo or party. Bounty boards are a great way to explore different maps and earn zenny / merit badges in the process. They are also great for staying in a monster's level range without having to do extra research. Tip: You can't start a bounty if you're level is too high but you can still turn it in of the quest is already active. === EXP Quests === Some regular quests also provide EXP reward. Some are repeatable, while others are one time only. For more information, please see the [[Quest Table]] page. == Leveling Tactics == Every character starts off by auto-attacking (ctrl-click, or clicking with /nc activated) monsters. As the character gains job levels to acquire skills with, they can start to utilize new skills for more efficient combat and overall damage. === General Tactics === Newer players often choose an [[AGI]] oriented build for leveling (does not apply to [[Mage]]s of course), as it is more potion-friendly and uses less funds and supplies in general. AGI oriented builds focus on faster [[ASPD]] for meleeing monsters, and relies on some degree of [[FLEE]] to avoid getting damaged altogether. It is recommended for AGI builds to avoid maps with aggressive monsters. NOTE: New players (particularly ones who want to play the Mage, Acolyte class) should build a character that will help financially (Thief, Merchant) before transitioning into their main class. Playing a mage can be difficult and expensive, while playing a thief can be cheap and easy. A thief class is also more versatile and will be able to hunt well in more areas than an inexperienced mage. Conversely, more experienced or well-funded players tend to choose a [[VIT]] oriented build, and will choose to use AoE skills on aggressive monsters. Note that in the higher levels, VIT should not be viewed as the "opposite" of AGI. Many builds can often utilize both [[stat]]s, and higher level characters always utilize VIT for survivability, and AGI becomes more of a offensive / status resist stat instead of a defensive stat, which is still important. === Aggressive Monster Tactics === Aggressive (also referred to as "aggro") monsters are monsters that will automatically target and attack the player. Passive monsters, the opposite of aggro monsters, do not attack the player unless the player hits them or uses a skill on them first. Generally, aggro monsters are good for quick leveling by mobbing them up and using [[AoE]] skills. This leveling tactic is more expensive and will require much use of [[Healing Items]] however, and new players may not be able to afford them. Players can also use {{item | id=601 Fly Wings}} to locate mobs quicker. === Equipment === [[Equipment]] is obviously an important part of improving the effectiveness of a character in battle. [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] are a great place for new players to start off with, as the equipment is free. Once the player is more comfortable with gameplay and has more funds, they can start looking into more advanced gears. Some general gear recommendations are in the [[Equipment]] article. === Memo-able Maps === [[Acolyte]]s are able to memo a map, and warp back to it with the [[Warp Portal]] skill. This lets a player to quickly go back to the leveling area. Non-[[Acolyte]] characters obviously will not be able to do this. However, many veteran players can have a second account with an [[Acolyte]] in it that can memo a particular map, and warp the character they are leveling to the map. Having a map memo-ed is great for when a (low [[Weight Limit]]) character has to restock supplies, or if choosing to use an inn for full HP / SP recovery. Some players may find themselves leveling quick enough that they are already out of the level range of the map before they need to restock however. == Map Recommendations == Map recommendations are sorted by the level a character can '''start''' leveling at a certain map (15 levels below the highest level common monster). title: Levels
wikitext:
== Overview == A character's overall strength is measured by two types of levels: Base Level and Job Level. In order to increase their character's Base or Job Level, the players must earn [[Base Experience]] Points or [[Job Experience]] Points, respectively. The primary way of earning [[Experience]] Points (EXP) is defeating monsters, alongside completing [[quests]] with EXP rewards or [[Hugel_Minigames#Prize_Medal|redeeming Hugel Medals]]. When characters die (reach 0 [[HP]]) they lose an amount of EXP equal to 1% of the EXP needed for their next level, with exceptions for deaths in the PvP arena, inside [[WoE]] castles, in most cities, and in a small assortment of other maps, which are usually quest-related. ('''Note:''' ''As for WoE castles, you DO lose [[EXP]] if you die in Guild Dungeons, even if you are killed by other players''). == Base Level == '''Base Level''', frequently abbreviated to "LV", "LVL", or simply referred to as a character's "level", is the primary and broadest measurement of a character's growth. Characters begin at Base Level 1 and each time they earn a certain amount of [[Base Experience]], their Base Level increases, and the character is given a certain amount of [[Stats#Leveling Up|Status Points]], which is used to [[Stats#Raising Stats|increase]] their [[Stats]]. Each Base Level requires an exponentially greater amount of '''Base Experience''' Points, resulting in an atypically steep growth curve until players reach maximum Base Level — currently 260. After reaching Base Level 200, the character stops earning Status Points and starts earning [[Stats#Talent Stats|Talent Points]]. Since players will not be able to earn any more Status Points after reaching level 200, they must distribute their character's stats carefully. Still, Players can reset their character's skills by a few means: *Anytime and at any level through [[Stats#Stat Reset|Sam Status NPC]] – requires an amount of Magical Stone for each use. *Anytime and at any level through [[Eden Group#Other_First_Floor_NPCs|Mesmerist NPC]] at Eden – free but can only be used once per character. Aside from the Status Points earned with each Base Level, there are a number of other benefits to raising a character's Base Level. For instance: *Each new level increases [[HP]] and [[SP]]. *A character's Base Level is added to their [[HIT]] to determine Accuracy. *A character's Base Level is added to their [[FLEE]] to determine their Dodge rate. *Many skills have their power increased as Base Level increases, like [[Heal]]. *At level 99, a character's sprite will be glorified with an "aura" effect. *At level 200, a character's sprite will be glorified with a big, red "aura" effect. *At level 250, a character's sprite will be glorified with a big, yellow "aura" effect. *Access to many equipable items/gears that have a Base Level prerequisite. *Access to [[quests]] that also have Base Level prerequisites or offer better EXP rewards to higher-leveled characters. *Acesss to [[Places#Dungeons|Dungeons]] that have Base Level prerequisites. See Also: [[Base EXP Chart|Base Experience Chart]] - Lists the amount of Base EXP needed to reach each Base Level. == Job Level == Frequently abbreviated to "JobLV", or simply referred to as a character's "job", '''Job Level''' is the secondary measurement of a character's progression, and is tied to the character's [[Class]]. Each time a character gains a certain amount of [[Job Experience | '''Job Experience''']] (Job EXP), their Job Level increases, and a single skill point is given, which can be used to learn a new Skill or develop a skill they have already learned. Each Job Level requires an exponentially greater amount of Job EXP, and, because many monsters usually give less Job EXP than Base EXP when killed, Job Level growth is often slower than Base Level growth. All characters begin at Job Level 1, and every time a character changes from one Class to another, their Job Level resets to 1. As a [[Novice]] or [[High Novice]], a character can reach Job Level 10, at which point they are ready to change to a First Class or a High First Class. ('''Note:''' ''[[Super Novice]] class is neither a First Class nor a High First Class, but a special class''). After becoming a First Class, the character can change to their Second Class as soon as they reach Job Level '''40''' (Transcendent Second Class always needs Job Level 50). Although, advancing past Job Level 40 and changing Class at Job Level '''50''' has some benefits, including: *An additional Skill Point for each Job Level past 40. *At Job Level 50, exemption from some portions of some Second Class job change quests. (For instance, a Job Level 50 [[Mage]] is not required to collect items as part of the [[Wizard Job Change Guide|Wizard Job Change Quest]].) *At Job Level 50, bonuses or rewards upon completion of the Second Class job change quests. (For instance, a Job Level 50 [[Archer]] can order special instrument-class weapons after completing the [[Bard Job Change Guide|Bard Job Change Quest]].) {| class="wikitable" |
'''Maximum Job Levels'''
|- | First Class || 50 |- | Second Class || 50 |- | Transcendent First Class || 50 |- | Transcendent Second Class || 70 |- | Third Class || 70 |- | Fourth Class || 55 |- | [[Super Novice]] || 99 (+50*) |- | [[Ninja]] and [[Gunslinger]] || 50 |- | [[Kagerou]], [[Oboro]] and [[Rebel]] || 70 |- | [[TaeKwon Kid]], [[TaeKwon Master]], and [[Soul Linker]] || 60 |- | [[Summoner]] || 50 |} ('''*Note:''' ''Super Novice can earn 50 additional Job levels upon completion of [[Super_Novice#Job_Expansion_Quest|Super Novice]] Job Expansion Quest]'').
Because players will not earn any more Skill Points after reaching respective maximum Job Level cap, they must carefully distribute their Skill Points. Still, Players can reset their character's skills by a few means: *Anytime ''before'' reaching '''Base Level 100''' through [[Beginner Skill Resetter]] – free, unlimited and with no class restrictions. *Anytime and at any level through [[Eden Group#Other_First_Floor_NPCs|Mesmerist NPC]] at Eden – free but can only be used once per character. *A Neuralizer item obtained through [[Kafra Shop]] can reset a character's skills – item will be consumed upon use. ('''Note:''' ''The methods above '''will not''' give the character's the extra skill points lost by changing jobs before reaching the maximum Job Level e.g. if changed at [[transcendent]] class job level 50 instead of job level 70, the extra 20 points will not be given upon resetting''). Aside from the Skill Points earned with Job Levels, there are other benefits to raising your Job Level. For instance: *A character receives bonuses to their Stats at certain Job Levels, depending on their Class. *Many gameplay algorithms use Job Level as a factor, including: **[[Alchemist]]s' [[Prepare Potion]] succcess rate: +0.2% per Job Level **[[Blacksmith]]s' [[Forging]] success rate: +0.2% per Job Level **[[Mastersmith]]s' [[Upgrade Weapon]] success rate: +0.5% per Job Level after Job Level 50 **Some Third Class skills get more powerful as your Job level increases like [[Inspiration]]. **Some equipment grants bonus based on Job level, like {{item|id=1181 Tae Goo Lyeon}}. See Also: [[Job EXP Chart|Job Experience Chart]] - Lists the amount of Job EXP needed to reach each Job Level. == Transcending / Rebirthing == After a character reaches Base Level 99 and Job Level 50, they can complete a short [[Rebirth Walkthrough|quest]] in order to "Transcend" or "Rebirth" their character, which will reset the character to Base Level 1 and Job Level 1, reset all [[Stats]] to 1, remove all Skills, and reset the character's job to [[High Novice]]. As a transcendent character, the leveling process begins again, this time requiring significantly more [[EXP]] in order to earn each level. As the reborn character grows, they can eventually reach a maximum Base Level of 99 and, after changing to a transcendent second class, a maximum Job Level of 70. Transcendent characters receive many benefits, including: *A 25% bonus to their maximum [[HP]] and [[SP]]. *Exclusive transcendent second class skills and gears/equipments. *A maximum Job Level on their second class that is 20 levels higher than non-transcendent characters can achieve, therefore: **20 additional Skill Points **Stat bonuses for 20 additional job levels *The aura surrounding the sprite of a level 99 transcendent character is brighter than that of a normal level 99 character, and the bubbles are purple instead of blue. For more information about Transcendent Class and Rebirth guide, please see the article: '''[[Transcendent]]'''. == Leveling == The primary means of gaining [[EXP]] in Ragnarok Online is by killing monsters, although some of the game's [[quests]] offer EXP rewards. There are several [[Leveling Spots]] to choose from, depending upon what type of character you play. {{Navbox Leveling}} [[Category: General Information]]

A '''Lif''' is one of the creatures available through the [[Homunculus System]], summonable by [[Alchemist]] and [[Biochemist]] who have completed the [[Bioethics Quest]].

==About Lif==
Primarily a support type among the four Homunculi, Lif is physically the weakest, and commonly regarded as difficult to level due to her lack of offensive skills and low [[ATK|physical attack]]. She is also the most expensive to maintain, requiring the consumption of {{item|id=537 Pet Food}} for feeding.

===Appearances===
Like all Homunculi, Lif is obtainable in two styles, in this case visually resembling flora based life: one utilizing a leaf motif and the other employing that of a rose. Outside an aesthetic sense, there is ultimately no difference between "Leaf Lif" and "Rose Lif", as they possess the same pool of skills and general stat growth. Transforming Lif from her adolescent appearance into a mature form requires a {{item|id=12040 Stone of Sage}} when she possesses loyal disposition towards her creator.

==Lif and Alchemist Builds==
Given her initial lack of strong offensive attacks, and the prerequisite need of {{item|id=545 Condensed Red Potions}} to utilize her [[Healing Hands]] skill, Lif is optimally suited for Alchemists capable of avoiding or sustaining little damage from attacks. Thus high [[FLEE|Flee Rate]] or [[Perfect Dodge]] builds will find her more viable than other builds. This does not necessarily make Lif useless to others specialists, as use of her [[Urgent Escape]] can prove to be a valuable asset when faced against large mobs or powerful opponents, but the more flexible capabilities other Homunculi provide greatly deters such an investment.

===Pros===
*[[Urgent Escape]] when mastered essentially functions like free {{item |id=12016 Speed Potions}}.
*[[Mental Charge]] is a skill obtained when Lif is evolved and loyal, and does not cause Intimacy loss.

===Cons===
*No offensive skills.
*Most expensive feeds.
*Lowest [[ATK|physical attack]] among all Homunculi.
*Lower [[DEF|defense]] compared to [[Amistr]] and [[Vanilmirth]].
*Lower [[FLEE|Flee Rate]] and [[ASPD|Attack Speed]] compared to [[Filir]] and [[Vanilmirth]].
*{{item|id=545 Condensed Red Potions}} required to use [[Healing Hands]].
*[[Urgent Escape]] can be overshadowed by [[Cart Boost (Geneticist)|Cart Boost]], a [[Geneticist]] skill.

1. Talk to Kazien at lhz_in01 174 258.

2. He tells you that the spirits have still not arrived, so he has returned to do some investigating into the attack from the masked man.

3. Kazien asks you to investigate the employee reports downstairs to see if anyone was dispatched to Niflheim.

4. Go downstairs and talk to the Scattered Reports at lhz_in01 108, 39

5. Return to Kazien and tell him about the report on Anvian. He asks you to talk to Lyozien.

6. Find Lyozien, who is on break, at lhz_in01 36 43

7. You tell him about Anvian, but he doesn't believe you and asks for proof that he works for Rekenber.

8. Head to the building's library and find the employee records around 39, 264

9. You find Anvian's employee information, though it seems pretty new.

10. Show it to Lyozien, who asks you to confront Anvian about this.

11. Talk to Anvian at yuno_in03 43 181 (existing NPC), who shows you a note he found on his desk that morning.

12. You decide that someone is trying to make you doubt eachother, but you don't have any clues on who. Anvian directs you to a famed criminologist who works in Lighthalzen.

13. Talk to Ronnie Litre at lhz_in02 148 201 and ask him to tell you where the note came from.

14. He agrees to help you, but needs you to get some paper for him to compare against:

	1 Oil Paper, 1 Slick Paper, 1 Sharp Paper, 1 Research Chart, 1 Worn Out Page

15. He performs some tests and learns that the note is the same as the Research Chart and came from Rekenber!

16. Return to Anvian who asks you to talk to Lyozien again.

17. Lyozien is glad to know Anvian didn't betray you, but tells you that he hasn't heard from Kazien is awhile.

18. When the player talks to Kazien, he is gone and the player finds a note attached to the wall that directs them to the laboratory.

19. Inside the room to the left in the Laboratory the player finds Kazien in a cage (lhz_in01 269 170)

20. When the player talks to him, they are knocked out and warped into the other cage (lhz_in01 269 163)

21. Talking to Kazien again causes Lyozien to appear at lhz_in01 277 170, who releases the player to lhz_in01 274 163.

22. Talk to Kazien (in the building, not the cage), who tells you he saw a masked man boarding the airship outside before he was attacked. He asks you to check where it's going.

23. Talk to the Airship Pilot at lighthalzen 156, 200

24. He tells you that he's been ferrying some scary looking people to Glast Heim lately.

25. Return to Kazien with this information. He asks you to talk to Rekenber's personal secretary downstairs.

26. Find the Secretary at lhz_in01 111 181, but she refuses to answer your questions because she is dealing with increased monster activity outside of Lighthalzen.

27. Offer to help and she will ask you to kill 30 Rafflesia.

28. When you return, she apologizes but says there is still one other problem, she needs to go to the bank to have some money wired over but is worried about the Mobster attacks.

29. Offer to help her with this and she tells you to inform the bank manager that "Rekenber" sent you.

30. Talk to the Bank Manager at lhz_in02 39 33 and input "Rekenber" when he asks who sent you.

31. He becomes scared and promises the money will be sent over right away.

32. Head back to the Secretary, who thanks you but says she needs to go talk to her boss.

33. Follow her upstairs to Rekenber's office and talk to her from in the hallway (lhz_in01 270 246).

34. You overhear a discussion she is having that deals with you, Kazien, Lyozien and "The Tome".

35. Tell Kazien about what you overheard. He resolves to beat Rekenber to this "Tome" and thanks you for your help with a reward.

Lord Knights are the Transcendent variants of [[Knight]]s. The Lord Knight's skills are a good balance of offense and defense. The Lord Knight is now a master of weapons with a special affinity for Two-handed Swords and Spears. A Lord Knight has formidable attack strength and can crush an opponent's defense with ease. Being a Lord Knight,  they gain vastly improved offensive capabilities and some defensive capabilities. They easily retain their status as the class with the highest [[HP]] Modifier and strongest physical [[AoE]] damage dealer. 

Lord Knights get the most new skills of the Transcendent Classes: two skills that enhance their damage output, and three skills that deal damage and various status effects. If this isn't enough, they also get (beside the +25% HP) a skill that gives them on-par tanking ability to that of [[Crusader]]s in the form of [[Parry]]. Their ability to go Berserk unleashes massive damage while in a state of [[Frenzy]]. A number of defensive skills complement the Lord Knight's combat mastery.

== Job Change Guide==
{{Transcendent Job Change}}

== Builds ==

:''See [[Rune Knight#Builds|Rune Knight Builds]] for build strategies to work towards. See [[Knight#Builds|Knight Builds]] for leveling strategies for just the Lord Knight leveling stages. Leveling a Lord Knight is similar to a regular pre-trans Knight, but with a few new skill additions.''

'''New Skills Overview:'''

[[Clashing Spiral]] is a new powerful single target skill with a relatively low SP cost. Lord Knights may choose to acquire this skill for killing single targets with, to complement any of the common Knight builds.

[[Spear Dynamo]] is actually an extremely useful skill. It has no cooldown compared to [[Endure]], so it can be recast repeatedly. It can also be used for [[HIT]] purposes, as level 5 will add a total of 50 HIT.

== Equipment ==

=== Eden Group Equipments Quests ===

:''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]''

Most transcendent characters will have already completed some Eden Equipment quests already and can reuse the equipment. If the character has not done the quest yet, they can do it as a transcendent character as well. The Spear is a good weapon and generally a good choice for a Knight and their future classes' use, but some may opt for the Two Handed Sword for cheaper single target leveling with [[Two Hand Quicken]].

=== General Equipment Recommendations ===

:''Main article: [[Equipment]]''

The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well.

=== Third Class Compatible Equipment ===

:''Main article: [[Rune_Knight#Equipment|Rune Knight Equipment]]''

It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only.

=== Weapons ===

After considering what requirement skills have (some skills can only be used with certain weapon types), the Weapon Search tool within the iRO Wiki DB site is very helpful. Generally, for physical classes (both melee and ranged), something with high [[ATK]] is best. For magic classes, something with high [[MATK]] is best.

Link to the iRO Wiki DB Weapon Search: http://db.irowiki.org/db/weapon-search/

Lord Knight skills brought only one additional equipment type into use: heavy Spear class weapons. They were generally regarded as useless before. But thanks to Clashing Spiral, that relies on them for most of its damage, they are sought by many as of late. The most notable of them are :

** {{item | id=1484 Cardo (1) }} is the heaviest two-handed spear a Lord Knight can use

** {{item | id=1471 Hellfire }}, a mildly common Lv. 4 weapon obtainable from the God Items Quest

title: Louyang
wikitext:
== About Louyang ==

[[Image: Louyang.jpg|center]]

Known as "The Castle of The Dragon". 
Louyang is a town done in the style of Ancient China and the third city in the Global Project. 
It has a dungeon and one field map, which is very popular for leveling (and Dead Branching). To get to Louyang, you must pay the NPC at the [[Alberta]] docks 10,000 Zeny (alberta, 245,40).
Louyang boasts vast fields and tall mountains. Beyond the grand northern walls of the field lies the glorious Castle of the Dragon, capital of Louyang. Majestic in its size and architecture, this city is guaranteed to awe any visitor (best viewed from Louyang’s sightseeing tower). However, deep beneath the beautiful Castle lies a dark crypt teeming with unspeakable horrors.

== Story ==

After the Japanese themed [[Amatsu]] and the Taiwanese themed [[Kunlun]] comes a new addition to the world of Midgard - Louyang, the Castle of the Dragon. Fashioned after ancient China, it now becomes the stage on which a chivalrous new tale will unfold. Far from the shores of Volsug, the brave adventurers discovered the land of Louyang. With its high mountains, vast fields, and the glorious Castle of the Dragon looming on the horizon, it wasn’t long before the adventurers were captivated by this foreign land’s mystique. Not only was the landscape spectacular, but the citizens were equally interesting. Here they discovered unique artworks, weapons, masterpieces, and products made by skilled native craftsmen; treasures not found in any other land. Rumors also speak of another kind of treasure, a treasure so vast that is was said to compare to the vaults of King Tristan III and those guarded by the Schwartzvald Republic

However, unlike in [[Amatsu]] or [[Kunlun]], foreigners weren’t welcome in Louyang. These people have a strong connection to their culture. The connection of the local folk was so strong that they ostracized outsiders in order to protect their way of life. The country of Louyang was headed by an Emperor who delegated the task of ruling the city’s regions to the federal government. The people of Louyang put their faith and loyalty in the Wu Lin.
The Wu Lin is a martial arts school which acts as the unofficial government of Louyang. Since the Wu Lin does not collect taxes from the people nor compete with the rule of the Emperor, the federal government tolerates their existence. To the eyes of the common people, one’s fists are more powerful than any law and this belief strengthened Wu Lin’s influence and numbers.

;The Legend of Bailong

Long before the Wu Lin was founded, Louyang was victim to frequent invasions by evil creatures. It was because of these vile monsters that a street knight named Bai Long used his strength and leadership to gather many of Louyang’s best warriors to form the Wu Lin. Bai Long’s leadership and the Wu Lin’s courageous efforts defeated the threat of the monster invasion. It was also through the valiant efforts of the Wu Lin that the city of Louyang prospered. Due to his abilities and bravery, Bai Long was made the leader of the people.
Years passed and the glory of Bai Long’s youth faded. The peace enjoyed by Louyang slowly began to crumble. As Bai Long aged, many of the warrior schools began to fight with one another, each seeking to gain dominance over the others, and plotting to take Louyang from Bai Long. With dissention among the schools, monsters once again terrorize Louyang. Lamenting over the crumbling Wu Lin which was now fragmented by the selfishness and greed of the warring schools, Bai Long decided to open Louyang’s walls to the outsiders. So long as they were pure of heart and strong of will, Bai Long welcomed them into Louyang to help battle the fearsome monsters. The people welcomed these foreigners after recognizing the benefits of cultural exchange and foreign trade. They also needed these people to help fend off the creatures that constantly besieged them. However, not all are pleased with Bai Long’s decision. In hushed tones, many of the warrior schools and families of old still plot against Bai Long.

The story does not end here. It is merely a prelude of things to come. As a foreigner and an adventurer, it is YOUR adventure. You alone can decide what fate has in store for you in this new, mystic land!

== Quests ==

Within the city of Louyang you will meet several interesting people. They would be willing to lend their wisdom and knowledge for a small favor or two (quests).

Visitors can help the man in the highest peak of Louyang field, who’ll teach you how to clear your mind if you get him one of the specialty soups from the Louyang restaurant. There is also the Bard who’s seeking to complete his song, learn the secrets of Pharmacy from the Louyang Herbalist, or do errands for the legendary Poison King of Louyang.

By helping these people, not only do you get useful items, but experience (exp) as well.

Quests added with the Louyang update can be found [[Quests#Louyang_Quests|here]].

:[[File:LoversQuest Kaijeta.png]]

7. Talk to Satra in Calla's house, and while talking you find out she wants {{item|id=1003 Coal}}. Bring 40 Coal and talk to her 4x, and each time she will take 10 Coal. After the last batch, she will ask you who you are delivering the Coal from. Type in "Klitzer" in the box, and she will tell you she will invite him over for tea.

:[[File:LoversQuest Satra.png]]

8. Talk to Klitzer's mother Kaijeta again, and she'll tell you that he has no clothes for such a elegant tea, and tell you that they can't afford to get one. Go buy a {{item|id=7170 Tuxedo}} and return to his house. While you have the Tuxedo in your inventory, talk to Klitzer and he'll ask you if he can use that Tuxedo. Give it to him.

* Receive a random Level 4 Weapon Ore

9. Return to Calla and she gives you her thanks and an [[EXP]] award.
*Level 81-90 = 20,000
*Level 91-99 = 30,000

VIP status does not seem to affect exp gain, Battle Manuals still work though.

== Main Quest ==

* Tea Bar Owner, Uncle Sun {{Navi|gonryun|187|110}}
** Help Uncle Sun tending his tea bar by taking customer’s order. 
** There are three NPCs nearby that you should talk to. These are the customers that you are helping.
*** Charming Man {{Navi|gonryun|181|113}}
*** Tea Enthusiast {{Navi|gonryun|195|117}}
*** Martial Artist {{Navi|gonryun|183|111}}
** Talk to Uncle Sun and tell him the customers' orders, selecting their orders from a menu list.
** Quest Reward: 2,000,000 Base EXP, 2,000,000 Job EXP, {{Item List |id=104012 |item=Event Lunar Red Envelope |num=3 |simple=yes}}
* Restaurant Owner, Chef Yao {{Navi|gonryun|197|138}}
** Assist Chef Yao in his cooking by giving him the correct ingredients.
** Chicken Fried Rice
*** Main Ingredients: Rice
*** Choice of Meat: Chicken
*** Additional Ingredients: Eggs
*** Seasonings: Soy Sauce and Oil
** Fish Fried Noodles
*** Main Ingredients: Noodles
*** Choice of Meat: Fish
*** Additional Ingredients: Assorted Vegetables
*** Seasonings: Soy Sauce and Oil
** Wonton Rice Noodles
*** Main Ingredients: Rice Noodles
*** Choice of Meat: Dumplings
*** Additional Ingredients: Assorted Vegetables
*** Seasonings: Mixed Spices and Soup Stock
** Make sure you remember the ingredients for the correct dish to complete the task.
** Quest Reward: 2,000,000 Base EXP, 2,000,000 Job EXP, 3 [Event] Lunar Red Envelope
* After helping 3 of them, return to Wise Snake Lord to receive your reward.
** Quest Reward: 1,500,000 Base EXP, 1,500,000 Job EXP, {{Item List |id=104012 |item=Event Lunar Red Envelope |num=3 |simple=yes}}, {{Item List |id=20169 |item=Costume Long Tongue |num=1 |simple=yes}}

title: Lutie
wikitext:
{{Articles Needing DB Links}}
= About Lutie =

[[Image: Lutie.jpg|center]]

A Town of Eternal Christmas. Lutie is the Christmas town of Ragnarok. NPCs such as Santa and a snowman can be found here, along with winter/Christmas themed monsters and buildings. The entrance to the [[Toy Factory]] can also be found in Lutie.

To get to Lutie, talk to '''Mr. Claus''' {{Navi|aldebaran|223|222}}, who is located in the north-eastern corner of [[Al De Baran]]. He will offer to teleport you to {{Map | id=xmas_fild01 Lutie Field}} at no cost. The field's northern portal leads to the town.

=== Story ===
Lutie was discovered not long ago by a lone adventurer that wandered into an endless land of snow, and stumbled upon this village. For centuries the residents of Lutie have isolated themselves, gathering all they needed from hunting around their small village. Along with hunting, the residents of Lutie work everyday in the Lutie toy factory. Visitors to Lutie have often commented on the singing and soft thump of hammers as the workers cheerfully build toys of every shapes and sizes. Recently, an evil man, Antonio, who was bitter when he lost the election for town mayor, stole all the toys from the factory. Citizens of Lutie, who worked to bring joy to the children, became desperate and contacted the [[Kafra]] Corp who was happy to help and made it possible for Lutie to bring toys to the happy children across the world. Lutie, which can be reached with a Kafra's assistance, has a landscape which can be seen nowhere else.

title: MATK
wikitext:
MATK is the total magical damage output before factoring in [[Skill|Skills]]. It is broken into four parts, [[MATK#StatusMATK|StatusMATK]], [[MATK#WeaponMATK|WeaponMATK]], [[MATK#ExtraMATK|ExtraMATK]] and [[MATK#BuffMATK|BuffMATK]]. == StatusMATK == This is derived from the player's [[Levels#Base Level|Base Level]], [[Stats#INT|INT]], [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] and [[Stats#LUK|LUK]]. === Formula === 
StatusMATK = floor[floor[BaseLevel ÷ 4] + Int + floor[Int ÷ 2] + floor[Dex ÷ 5] + floor[Luk ÷ 3]]
== WeaponMATK == This is derived from a player's equipped [[Weapons|Weapon]]. === Formula === 
WeaponMATK = BaseWeaponDamage + Variance + RefinementBonus + OverUpgradeBonus
''Variance'' 
Variance = (± 0.1 × WeaponLevel) × (BaseWeaponDamage + RefinementBonus)
''RefinementBonus'' * See [[Refinement_System#Effects_Gained|Refinement Effects]]. == ExtraMATK == This refers to sum of EquipMATK, ConsumableMATK and PseudoBuffMATK. === Formula === 
ExtraMATK = EquipMATK + ConsumableMATK + PseudoBuffMATK
== BuffMATK == This is another special kind of MATK that has no elemental properties. This MATK mostly comes from [[:Category:Skills|Skills]] such as [[Chattering]] and [[Odin's Power]]. == S.MATK == This is a final multiplier applied to the total MATK. == Finalizing == This refers to putting the final touches to the MATK calculation to produce a value ready for [[Skill|Skills]]. === Formula === 
MATK = (StatusMATK + WeaponMATK + ExtraMATK + BuffMATK)
Final MATK = MATK × (1 + MATK%) × (1 + SizeMultiplier%) × (1 + TargetPropertyMultiplier%) × (1 + SkillPropertyMultiplier%) × (1 + RaceMultiplier%) × (1 + ClassMultiplier%) × (1 + MonsterMultiplier%) × (1 + SMATK ÷ 100)
* Each step of multiplication undergoes a sequence of rounding and pure multiplication on the value may net you with some error. * SizeReduction, PropertyReduction, RaceReduction and ClassReduction are applied to this in that particular order. ** CometAmpMultiplier and SkillMultiplier is applied after everything. == Notes == * EquipMATK, See {{item|id=4557 Fenrir Card}}. * ConsumableMATK, See {{item|id=12646 Poring Pretzel}}. * PseudoBuffMATK, This hasn't been tested as a skill that fits the requirement hasn't been listed yet. * RaceMultiplier, See {{item|id=4470 Nepenthes Card}}. * SizeMultiplier, See {{item|id=28564 Valkyrie Drop}}. * TargetPropertyMultiplier, See Fruit Pom Spider Card. * MonsterMultiplier, See {{item|id=4291 Kobold Leader Card}}. * MATKMultiplier, See {{item|id=2644 The Sign}}. * SkillPropertyMultiplier, See {{item|id=4577 Elvira Card}}. * BossMATKMultiplier, See {{item|id=28513 Celine's Brooch}}. * RaceReduction, See {{item|id=4058 Thara Frog Card}}. * SizeReduction, See {{item|id=4254 Ogretooth Card}}. * PropertyReduction, See {{item|id=4133 Raydric Card}}. * TargetPropertyReduction, See {{item|id=4442 Tatacho Card}}. * CometAmpMultiplier, See [[Comet]]. {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category: Mechanics]]

title: MDEF
wikitext:
'''Magic Defense''' is the total magical defense that is factored upon magic damage, which is generally based on [[MATK]] as whole or partially. However, there are exceptions. The descriptions used here refer to Hard and Soft MDEF. These names are used for clarity. The vast majority of players do not use these terms in general conversation, and instead refer Armor Mdef (hard) and INT Mdef (soft). Hard MDEF works as a relative reduction, whereas Soft MDEF is a subtractive reduction. To obtain the final damage,apply Hard MDEF first and then apply soft MDEF. It is shown as ''A + B'' in the Status Window, where A represents the Soft MDEF and B represents the Hard MDEF. == Hard MDEF == [[File:Mdef vs dmg.png.png|thumb|Effects of Hard MDEF on incoming damage]] Hard m. defense, also known as "armor" or "equipment" m. defense reduces, incoming magic damage multiplicatively. * '''Damage after Hard MDEF''' = Damage × [(1,000 + HardMDEF) ÷ (1,000 + HardMDEF × 10)] For example, a player with a Hard MDEF of 60 will have incoming m. damage reduced by about ⅓, and a player with a Hard MDEF of 125 will have incoming damage reduced by half. Hard m. defense has a base value of 0, and is increased by [[equipment]], some [[skills]], and [[items]]. Every 1 Hard M.DEF provides resistance vs. the following [[Status Effects]]: * [[Status Effects#Decrease_AGI|Decrease AGI]]: Decreases chance from being inflicted * [[Status Effects#Frozen|Frozen]]: -1% chance from being inflicted * [[Status Effects#Stone|Stone]]: -1% chance from being inflicted === Additive Bonuses === {| class="wikitable sortable" ! Doubles [[Max HP]]. |} == Soft MDEF == {{incomplete}} Soft magic defense, also known as "INT" magic defense, reduces incoming magic damage directly. 
SoftMDEF      = floor((INT + (VIT ÷ 5) + (DEX ÷ 5) + (BaseLv ÷ 4))
TotalSoftMDEF = [(SoftMDEF + BonusA) × (1 + BonusB ÷ 100)]
* '''BonusA''' is the sum of additive bonuses. * '''BonusB''' is the sum of multiplicative bonuses. Monsters use a different SoftMDEF formula. 
SoftMDEF      = floor(BaseLvl ÷ 4) + floor (VIT ÷ 10) + floor(INT ÷ 5)
=== Additive Modifiers === === Multiplicative Modifiers === == Bypassing MDEF == ===Calculation=== '''Final MDEF =''' (Total_Mdef - Sum_MdefReduceValues) × (1 − Sum_MdefBypassPercent ÷ 100) * '''Total_Mdef''' = Total [[MDEF#Hard_MDEF|Hard MDEF]] shown in the Status Window. * '''Sum_MdefReduceValues''' = sum of flat values that reduce MDEF, like [[Odin's Power]]. * '''Sum_MdefBypassPercent''' = sum of modifiers that bypass MDEF by a percent, like [[Expiatio]] and {{item|id=15419 Armor of White Thread [1]}}. *For example, if a player has 25% MDEF Bypass from [[Expiatio]] buff, 70% MDEF Bypass from Armor of White Thread [1], and [[Odin's Power]] Level 2 (-40 MDEF) is casted on an enemy with 100 Hard MDEF, the enemy's final MDEF is calculated as: **Final MDEF = (100 - 40) x (1 - (25+70) ÷ 100)

title: MRES
wikitext: '''MRES''' is another layer of defense that reduces magical damage taken. MRES behaves very similarly to [[DEF#Hard_MDEF|Hard MDEF]] but the value is slightly less effective. MRES is primarily gained from Level 2 Armor and [[Stats#WIS|WIS]] stat. == Formula == Similar to Hard magic defense, MRES reduce magical damage multiplicatively. * '''Damage after MRES''' = Damage × [(2000 + MRES) ÷ (2000 + MRES × 5)] == Bypassing MRES == *The amount bypassed cannot exceed 50%. [[Cardinal]]'s skill [[Argutus Vita]] provides 25% bypass. == See Also == * [[RES]] {{Navbox Game Mechanics}} [[Category: Mechanics]]

title: MVP
wikitext:
{{Update}} '''MVP''' stands for Most Valuable Player, a definition not exclusive to Ragnarok Online. This is a [[monster]] with [[Boss Protocol]] and MVP Protocol. MVPs are much stronger than other normal monsters and appear on an array of maps throughout the game. MVPs only spawn at certain times, anywhere from once per hour to once every 24 hours since the last MVP of that kind was killed. While MVPs can be defeated by a single person (depending on the [[Classes|class]] of the player), they are most often taken down by a party of two or more players. Because of the difficulty of defeating an MVP, they give a high amount of experience and MVP rewards given directly to the player's inventory to the player who tank and deals the most damage to it. If the player get killed as the MVP dies, and there's no one else eligible for the reward on the map, someone is randomly selected on the map and receives it. They are also [[Free for All|free-for-all]], meaning that anyone can attack them, disregarding who found it first or summoned it. First hit on the MVP is only important for loot priority, not the MVP reward. MVPs will also summon slaves or mobs to make defeating the MVP more difficult. The mob will often times consist of three to nine monsters, sometimes all of them the same, sometimes different, depending on the MVP. Unlike normal monster, MVP doesn't show health bar. To check its remaining HP, the player can use [[Sense]]. == Tomb == When killed, MVPs not spawned by a player (e.g. Ktullanux, see Special Spawn section) will leave behind a Tomb at the spot in which they were killed. Speaking to the Tomb yields the MVP's time of death, along with the name of the player who received the MVP award for killing it. The Tomb does not give information as to the time or location the MVP will spawn next time. The time given is in PST. The Tomb will disappear 5 seconds after the MVP have respawned. [[File:Tomb.png]] [[File:Tomb_Info.png]] == Normal MVPs == Normal MVPs spawn on a set amount of time with a variance of 10 minutes after the previous one was defeated. For example, if Amon Ra is defeated at 11:00, it would spawn again between 12:00-12:10. If an MVP spawns in multiple places, the two times are independent of one another and the respawn period may be different. The Maestro class brings a strong support game to the table. A Maestro is ideal or perhaps even mandatory for any large scale [[Endless Tower]] run, or for even just a standard dungeon run as well as for [[WoE]] play. Unfortunately this class is difficult to solo level and is sometimes regarded as a one trick pony ([[Magic Strings]]) of sorts, limiting players to primarily using only one second class skill for the majority of their play, and not being wanted for much else.  While yes, they are primarily used for Magic Strings, they do have several other skills that can be useful for endgame play in MVP and WoE situations. Because their most important role is to use [[Magic Strings]], they are often referred to as "Stringers" or "Strings".

== Job Change Guide ==

''See '''[[Maestro Job Change Guide]]''' for detailed information.''

Changing into a Maestro from a [[Minstrel]] requires the player to track down the legendary 'Minstrel Song' across the world of Rune Midgard. After finding him, the player will be transformed into a Maestro. 

The journey begins near the Alberta docks!

=== Job Change Quest Skip ===

Note that this is one of more tedious Job Change Quests so you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip]

== Alternate Job Sprite ==

At Base Level 170, you can change your Job Sprite to the alternative jRO version by following the instructions found [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Clothes_Dye#Second_Costume_Ticket here].

[[File:JRO Minstel-Wanderer.png]]

She tells you 'Minstrel Song' went to Comodo after he carved the poem in the wall of the Ice Dungeon. #:Since Karian is afraid of airships, you will need to get to [[Comodo]] via the south Veins dock #:''''''Note'''''': You can not take an alternate route. The following step is a requirement. #:[[File:Maestro-OldWoman.png|250px]] # Head 1 map south of Veins and you'll find a boat on an island in the southern part of the map. #:Note:'''This part is a death trap so be cautious'''. #:*Due to the algorithm of the spawns on this map, an over spawn of Drosera and Muscipulars can appear all over the dock and boat and will cause a hit-lock nightmare to any minstrels trying to do this portion of the test (it will make Arrow Vulcan glitch out and unable to cast). #:*It is '''STRONGLY recommended''' to clear out the Drosera/Muscipular spawn before continuing, because the dialogue will lock you out of any actions for quite awhile. #Talk to the '''=Notice=''' {{navi|ve_fild07|131|132}} #:'''Take the kayak''', and when prompted, and '''Throw the water out of the boat'''. #:[[File:Mastero-Notice.png|250px]] # Once you arrive in Comodo, head north and talk to the '''Kayak Master''' {{navi|comodo|192|119}} he suggests asking the hostess at the diner. #:[[File:KayakMaster.png|250px]] # Head to the north end of Comodo and speak to the '''Woman Roasing Meat''' {{navi|comodo|159|316}} #:She tells you 'Minstrel Song' headed somewhere quiet southeast of [[Morroc]]. title: Mage
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobName=Mage |jobBase=Novice |jobType=First (Primary) | jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Geffen]] |skills=13 |skillPoints=121 |questSkills=1 |str=0 |agi=4 |vit=0 |int=8 |dex=3 |luk=3 }} [[file: MageATK.jpeg‎|250px|right]] Mages are those who are naturally imbued with the powers of the elements deep within their souls. Though still learning to hone these powers, they use their knowledge and intelligence learned through intense studying to significantly impact the battlefield. Growing up west of the mystical {{map |id=mjolnir_01 Mt. Mjolnir}}, in the city of magic, [[Geffen]], they have been exposed to such powers all of their lives and use this to their advantage. Mages rely on their magic skills as their main source of damage and protection as heavy weapons and armor only making casting more difficult. They use their knowledge of a monster's [[Element|element]] to know what elemental magic skill to use to deal more damage to them, usually with a powerful spell. Their focus on high [[INT]] gives them a solid [[SP]] pool and high [[MATK]], while a focus on [[DEX]] will reduce their spell's casting time. ==Job Changing== Once you are a Job Level 10 [[Novice]], you have 2 methods of changing into an Mage: #Go to the Mage Guild in northwest [[Geffen]] {{navi|geffen_in|164|124}}. Talk to the ''Mage Guildsman'' in front of the chalkboard at the end of the main chamber and they will change your job to Mage and rewards you with a {{Item List |id=1639 |item=Novice Rod|slots=3 |simple=yes}}. #*Pursuing this method also unlocks the [[Energy Coat]] Skill for free right as you change. #Alternatively, go to the Mage classroom on the 2nd Floor of [[Training Grounds|Criatura Academy]] and speak to the [[NPC]] named ''Mage Chuck'' located at {{navi|iz_ac02|148|110}}. He will warn you that you will not receive the bonus Job Skills listed above if you use this method and thus it is not recommended. == Builds == === I. Fire Bolt / Fire Ball / Fire Wall === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
Since many low level monsters are weak to fire, this build uses [[Fire Bolt]] and [[Fire Ball]] to kill single and groups of monsters respectively, as well as [[Fire Wall]] to protect you from aggressive monsters. Mobbing monsters together using this method, or by running around, and casting [[Fire Ball]] is the most effective leveling strategy. To save SP and reduce cast time, the levels of Bolt skills can be lowered to kill monsters in ''one casting'' of a weaker bolt level depending on your [[MATK]] (boosted by [[INT]]).
*'''Alternative gameplay:''' Adding in [[Stone Curse]] gives you another way to defend yourself, by possibly stopping an enemy in its pursuit of you, as well as making it weaker to Fire Spells in general. However, casting costs 1 {{Item List |id=716 |item=Red Gemstone |simple=yes}} and you cannot petrify [[Undead]] monsters.
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on your preference but the idea is to focus on increasing [[INT]] and [[DEX]] stats as they increase your [[MATK]] and lower your [[Variable Cast Time]]. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 1
*AGI: 1
*VIT: 1
*INT: 53
*DEX: 30
*LUK: 1

=== II. Frost Driver / Lightning Bolt === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build focuses on freezing monsters in place, one at a time, using [[Frost Driver]] and finishing them off with [[Lightning Bolt]]. [[Frost Driver]] will also turn the monster's element to Water regardless of their actual element, making your [[Lightning Bolt]] skill stronger (but note this will not work on [[Undead]] monsters). Ideal targets to kill for this build are passive monsters, such as Willow or Bigfoot, so you do not get mobbed. This build could add in the AOE spell [[Thunderstorm]] if you can consistently freeze your targets within a 5x5 space but might not be worth the effort. To save SP and reduce cast time, the levels of Bolt skills can be lowered to kill monsters in ''one casting'' of a weaker bolt level depending on your [[MATK]] (boosted by [[INT]]).
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on your preference but the idea is to focus on increasing [[INT]] and [[DEX]] stats as they increase your [[MATK]] and lower your [[Variable Cast Time]]. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 1
*AGI: 1
*VIT: 1
*INT: 53
*DEX: 30
*LUK: 1

== Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three suggestions to efficiently level a new character: #First, get gear and experience for your new character by following this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] from the forums (this guide is also listed down below in the [[Mage#Equipment|Mage equipment]] section with additional details). #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. Use any AoE skill available for your class (e.g., [[Magnum Break]], [[Fire Ball]], [[Cart Revolution]], etc.). You may use {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card |simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] if your class does not have an AoE skill. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Willows''' until level 21 and '''Bigfoot''' until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]], kill '''Orcs''', '''Orc Ladies''', and '''Orc Babies''' until level 55 and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Orcs''' and '''Orc Ladies''' until level 60. '''You can stack the quests for Orc and Orc Lady kill counts by having both quests active!''' === Stats Description === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.
*DEX - decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), increases [[Stats | HIT]], [[MATK]], [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons, and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "melee-type" weapons. *LUK - increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]], [[Stats | CRIT]], [[Stats | HIT]], [[Flee]], [[Perfect Dodge]], [[Forging]], [[Potion Creation]], [[Cooking]], and provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Curse]], [[Frozen]], [[Poison]], [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], [[Stone Curse]], and [[Stun]]. ''Melee Weapons - ([[Axe]]s, [[Book]]s, [[Dagger]]s, [[Katar]]s, [[Knuckle]]s, [[Mace]]s, and [[Spear]]s)
Ranged Weapons - ([[Bow]]s, [[Gun]]s, [[Instrument]]s, and [[Whip]]s)'' === Overall Tips and Suggestions === #Your next class is either a [[Wizard]] or a [[Sage]]; you may have to adjust your build accordingly.
#Use [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] and [[Bounty Board Quests]] to find monsters to kill around your level.
#Use [[Stat Reset |Stat Reset]] to reset your stats to maximize your damage.
#Use [[Skill Reset|Skill Reset]] to rest your skills to maximize your damage.
#Use specific elemental bolt to kill monsters weak to a specific [[Element]]. #Use the Archer/Mage/Ninja Sniping Maps in [[Leveling Spots]] to kill monsters from far away
#Useful recovery items. (If using Meat/Fresh Fish, it is advised to RODex it to yourself in smaller portions to keep within your weight limit) #*{{Item List |id=517 |item=Meat |simple=yes}}
