title: RODEX
wikitext:
'''RODEX''' (Alt: ''Ragnarok Online Delivery Express'') is a mail system built into the user interface of the client. It allows players to mail other players with text, items and zeny.

== Access ==
RODEX can be accessed via the icons underneath the Basic Info Window. If your character has unread mail, a notification will appear beside your mini-map.

[[File:RodEx Icon.png]]

You may send a mail by either opening the RODEX window via the basic info window, right clicking a character, or right clicking a character in your friends list or party list. Type in the name of the character you wish to mail, and press ''Check'' to confirm the character exists. The default title for a mail is ''TITLE'' but you can change it. A title must be between 4 to 24 characters long. Optionally, you can also add a short message of 0 to 500 characters long.

== Features and Limitations ==
*To reeeive RODEX mail from people other than friends or guild members, you must opt-in to receive mail from those characters.  Otherwise, those characters get the error  message "Character_name_here is blocking reception." when they attempt to send mail to your character.  To enable receiving mail from all users, click on the Options icon (or press ESC) and select "game settings".  Toggle the checkbox for "RODEX All User Reeived".  If it is already set, toggle it off and then toggle it back on just to be sure the change is registered.  Then click Close and select "Return to game".  If you are wondering why no one ever sends you mail, check that RODEX option because the default is for each character to not receive mail.
*Can send up to 5 different items per mail, as long as the total weight of all the items does not exceed {{tooltip|4000|2000 for non-iRO servers.}} [[Weight]].
**'''iRO''': If the mail contains items with a total amount of weight beyond the character's max weight limit, the player may have to increase their maximum weight limit through [[STR]], or [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] with the use of {{item|id=7776 Gym Passes}}.
*You can't take out an individual item if there are multiple items in one mail. 
*The item cannot be account or character bound. 
*For each item you add, you will be taxed 2,500 [[Zeny]]. The quantity of the item does not get taxed.
*You may also send any amount of Zeny your character has. You will be charged 2% of the amount of Zeny you send in the mail.
*Can mail up to {{tooltip|300|100 for non-iRO servers.}} times per day. 
*Mail only has a 15 day duration. 
*If the mail wasn't deleted by the recipient before the 15 day duration ends, the mail will be returned to the sender.
*If the mail is returned to the sender, they have another 15 days to take out any items or zeny that was left in the mail. 
*Anything left in the returned mail will be deleted and forever lost after the 15 day duration has ended.
*Check button will give information about the receiver's character Job and Level, so you can make sure you are sending mail to the right person.
*Unable to send mail if storage is open.
*Possible to read mail and obtain items from that message while storage is open.
*Unable to write a mail and obtain attached items while [[vending]].

== Interface ==

[[Image:rodex.jpg|RODEX Main Window]][[File:RodExWriteMail.png|WriteMail]]

== Known Bugs ==
*When sending mail, there is a low chance that the delivery will fail, no stamp will be consumed, and '''all attached items will be lost'''. As the only visual difference between a successful delivery and a failed delivery is the message that is displayed, it is vitally important to verify that mail is sent successfully and, upon failure, to submit a support ticket requesting item restoration. According to the GM team, "any consumable items" and "items like the witch starsand [''sic'']" will not be restored.
*:[[File:RodEx Fail.png]]
*After the stamp counter resets at midnight Pacific time, the mailbox must be (re)opened before sending any mail. Failure to do so (for example: accessing RODEX via the friend/party window, or opening the mailbox before midnight and waiting until after midnight; and then sending mail) will cause the player's stamp counter to drop to one.
*Sometimes the ''Next'' button can become stuck. This is a server-side error caused by the server ignoring requests to load the next page despite correctly reporting that there is more mail. This can be fixed by relogging or moving to a different zone server.
*Almost any action--including but not limited to claiming items, checking the addressee's name, deleting mail, and opening mail--can intermittently fail. These server-side errors are harmless and the action can simply be retried.
*:[[File:RoDex ClaimFail.png]]
*If the player clicks on the ''Check Name'' button at the same time the client receives a response to an earlier request, the mail composition window hijacks the mouse and effectively prevents any meaningful mouse interaction with the client. The only remedies are to close the offending window by forcing a teleport--for example, by backsliding into a portal--or to Alt+F4 the game.

== RWC 2012 Accessory Slotting ==

The RWC Enchanter NPC within [[Eden Group]] floor 2 (Goldenthiefberg) can put a slot/socket on your {{Item List |id=2966 |item=RWC 2012 Ring |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=2968 |item=RWC 2012 Pendant |simple=yes}}, but this will erase all of your existing enchants. This is done free of charge and does not require a ticket (despite what playragnarok.com says).

[[File:RWC_Enchanter.png]]

Slotted versions become "Chambered", and are known as {{Item List |id=2967|item=Chambered RWC 2012 Ring |slots=1 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=2969 |item=Chambered RWC 2012 Pendant |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

== RWC 2012 Accessory Enchantment ==

The RWC Enchanter NPC can  place a maximum of four enchants if the RWC item has no socket/slot, or a maximum of three enchants if the RWC item has a socket.

1. The RWC 2012 Ring and RWC 2012 Pendant can be hidden enchanted four times.
* You cannot choose the enchantment option for each enchantment slot
* Quality of the hidden enchant is random
* Slots #0 and #1 hidden enchantment has 25% chance of resetting all enchantments
* You start enchanting from Slot #3 -> #0

2. RWC 2012 Ring and RWC 2012 Pendant can be socket enchanted for a card slot.
* 100% success rate
* If the accessory has already been hidden enchanted, all of the enchants will reset when socketing
* Socket enchanted RWC 2012 Ring/Pendant can be hidden enchanted three times (Slot #3 -> #1)

3. Each individual enchant can be reset using a RWC Enchant Reset Ticket from the [[Kafra Shop]]
* One can acquire the "perfect" accessory this way by resetting each individual enchant until the desired enchant is reached


[[File:RWCgearEnchant.png]]

title: Rachel
wikitext:
== About Rachel == Rachel is the capital of the [[Arunafeltz States]], serving as the nation's center for both politics and religion. Despite the everyday bustle of a heavy populated area, visitors commonly experience an atmosphere of quiet and calm. This sense of serenity is partially attributed to the natural beauty, the savanna fields and green grasslands that surround Rachel, but it is mostly accredited to the centered, gentle demeanor of Rachel's citizenry.
To go here, use the '''Kafra Employee''' in [[Juno]] to teleport here. === Story === The holy words of the goddess Freya brought great change to the lives of the indigenous people living in Rachel: they swore to honor and adore her, erecting an immense temple as her house of worship in their small, simple oasis village. The faith and fervor of Freya's followers in Rachel proved to be infectious, and the entire nation of Arunafeltz eventually converted to this new faith. Religion became central and foremost in the hearts and minds of the people, naturally merging with Arunafeltz culture and government, and Rachel developed into a major, influential city. ==Quest== Quests added with the Rachel update can be found [[Quests#Rachel_Quests|here]]. === Guide === [[Image:Rachel_guide.jpg]] == Structures == === Buildings === *Inn (115 149) === Billboards === === Guild Flags === == NPCs == ==Dungeon== === {{map|id=ra_san01 Rachel Sanctuary}} === Now that Arunafeltz has opened its doors to the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, you'll be able to experience the grace and grandeur of Rachel for yourself. However, unbeknownst to all but the highest ranking officials within Rachel, is the secret {{map|id=ra_san01 Holy Grounds}} below the Chechrumnir Temple. Even the pope herself is unaware of the true purpose of the Holy Grounds. What secrets lie hidden in a nation where its followers are driven mad by faith? See [[Rachel Sanctuary Quest]] for access. === {{map|id=ice_dun01 Ice Dungeon}} === At the northern region of the Arunafeltz lies a vast frozen tundra. This barren land holds little life beyond a handful of carnivorous plants. They say though, hidden somewhere here is a mysterious cave of solid ice. Within the caves are an assortment of ice monsters. Within the deepest depths of the cave lies a great magic seal bound by Thor's everlasting fire, and protected by the great Ice Salamander Ktullanux. What secret might be hidden here? The ice caves dungeon is a three level dungeon populated mostly by water element monsters. Overall the dungeon monsters have low magic defence but medium to high physical defence, making it a great place to level as a magic user with wind magic or as a melee class using specialized equipment or skills to pierce the defence of monsters. The boss monster of the Ice Caves is the Salamander Ktullanux. He protects Thor's Fire Seal should someone try to put out the magic fire. Players must complete a quest in order to summon Ktullanux, which can only be done once per player. If Ktullanux is defeated, portals near the center of the map will open to allow access to the 4th floor of the dungeon for a short period of time. No monsters appear on this 4th floor, however this is the floor where you will find out what Ktullanux is protecting.... After defeating Ktullanux, Thor's Fire will reappear after 2 hours. You cannot summon Ktullanux again until all the 4 fire reappeared. {{Navbox Towns}}

title: Random Option
wikitext:
'''Random Options''' (Korean: 옵션부여, literally "Option Endow") are additional effects that are added to equipment through a variety of processes. Unlike an [[Hidden Enchantment|enchant]] or [[:Category:Cards|card]], they do not require a card slot on the equipment.

Random options appear as additional boxes in between the item window and its card information.

[[File:RandomOptionsExample.png|none|thumb|Example of a weapon with 2 random options attached]]

In ''Zero'' and ''kRO'', equipment with options will produce a pillar of light when dropped on the ground. The colour of the light changes depending on how many options are on the equipment.
[[File:ItemDropLightBeam.gif|thumb|Example of the light beam for a dropped item (Not implemented yet)]]

==Crimson Weapons==
Every Crimson weapon has a random [[Elements|element]] endowed to it upon its drop. Available elements include:

* Neutral
* Fire
* Water
* Wind
* Water
* Dark
* Holy

==Vicious Mind Weapons==
Every Vicious Mind Weapon has 3 random options included upon its drop.

==Geffen Magic Tournament==

==Ghost Palace==

==Dreams and Shadows==

==King's Heel==

==Enemy Drops==

In ''Transcendence'', weapon drops from any monster will have 1~4 random options attached to it. The level and class (eg, normal enemies, or champion or boss type monsters from [[Frenzy Fields]]<ref>[https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/246569-rt-dev-blog-1-2-2020-fever-fields/ WarpPortal Forums]</ref>) of the monster determines the number of options granted, as well as which effects can occur.<ref>[http://roz.gnjoy.com/GameInfo/gameIntroductionSystem.asp#system4 kRO Zero Website]</ref><ref>[https://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/246765-is-there-a-table-for-the-possible-enchants-of-for-weapon-drops/?p=2940366 WarpPortal Website]</ref>

wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobType=3-1 |jobBase=Sniper |jobLevel = 70 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=Turtle Island |skills=22 |skillPoints=105 |questSkills=0 |str=2 |agi=11 |vit=7 |int=9 |dex=8 |luk=3 }} [[Image:Ranger.jpg|240px|right]] The Ranger is the 3rd Job Class of an [[Archer]], after following the [[Hunter]] and [[Sniper]] path, noted for their superior maneuverability with their mount, enhanced Trap options, and the addition of new and powerful Bow-and-Arrow skills. The use of [[Camouflage]] and [[Warg Ride|Warg Riding]] allows Rangers to ambush their target with a massive [[Arrow Storm]] and retreat before the enemy can even counterattack. Rangers are given a huge wolf-like mount and animal companion called a [[Warg Mastery|Warg]] that they can use to ride upon or attack their enemies on command. They also have new and powerful traps at their disposal, from [[Bomb Cluster]] and [[Electric Shock]] traps, to traps that can change an opponent's elemental property when triggered. Rangers can also use a [[Detonator]] to explode their traps on command to inflict maximum damage against their unsuspecting foes. While a Hunter goes to hunt, a Ranger goes to war. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Ranger Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into an [[Ranger]] from a [[Sniper]] requires the player to complete a number of difficult tasks: * A Survival Test on [[Turtle Island]] * An Accuracy Test based on your reflexes * A Trap-based Test using {{Item List |id=12258|item=Bombring Capsules |simple=yes}} * An Animal Companion Test where you command a baby wolf to disarm "egg bombs" After passing the Test, you get redirected to the Ranger Master to change your job. He will check whether you have consumed all of skill points and ask you to remove your falcon. Once you become a Ranger, you will be awarded with x1 {{Item List |id=5748 |item=Sniper Goggle |simple=yes}}, x1 {{Item List |id=2795 |item=Green Apple Ring |simple=yes}}, and x1 {{Item List |id=6124 |item=Wolf Flute|simple=yes}}. === Job Change Quest Skip === Note that this is one of the more difficult Job Change Quests in the game but you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip] == Alternate Job Sprite == At Base Level 170, you can change your Job Sprite to the alternative jRO version by following the instructions found [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Clothes_Dye#Second_Costume_Ticket here]. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px" |- ! Stat !! Level 99 !! Level 125 !! Level 150 !! Level 175 !! Level 250!! |- | STR || 1 || 1 || 25|| 40 ||15/50 |- | AGI || 90 || 100 || 100 || 100 ||100/120 |- | VIT ||40 ||50 ||60 ||100 || 100/120 |- | INT ||1 ||10 ||30||50 ||70/120 |- | DEX ||90 ||100 ||100 ||120 ||120/130 |- | LUK ||30 ||60 ||90 ||120 ||120/126 |} AGI provides [[ASPD]], [[FLEE]], and other bonuses such as [[bleed]] immunity. Flee is mostly only useful in one-on-one situations, or if another player is the primary tank for mobs of monsters. This build is more oriented for MVPing rather than leveling and is optimized with [[ASPD]] and [[CRIT]] gear. The idea of this build is to maintain a safe distance (preferably beyond atk/skill range) from the enemy and hitlock them. Therefore, high [[ASPD]] and [[LUK]] (for Crit and Warg Strike proc rate) are the main points to focus on. It is generally recommended to increase [[LUK]] in multiples of 30, to fully benefit from it (since LUK bonus comes in multiples of 3, 5 and 10). Having high ASPD and Critical Rate will usually enable rangers to hitlock the target, thus preventing the enemy from reaching within melee/casting range to attack back. With a proper enchanted and upgraded White Wing Set and other gear, this build is still capable of performing well for AoE / leveling purposes. [[Camouflage]] will allow the player to avoid damage from monsters that are not [[Demon]], [[Insect]], or [[Boss Protocol]]. But, keep in mind that Camouflage was changed (nerfed) and has to be recast after any attack. The addition of temporal {{Item List |id=2499 |item=Temporal Boots |simple=yes}} from the [[Old_Glast_Heim#temporal_boots.26_Enchants]], [[Old_Glast_Heim]]_instance and bifrost monster cards have made auto-warg builds (and auto-attack builds in general) stronger due to the ability to equip critical damage and attack speed equipment and cards. {{Item List |id=22002 |item=Temporal Agi Boots |simple=yes}} with 120 [[AGI]] or {{Item List |id=22005 |item=Temporal Luk Boots |simple=yes}} with 120 [[LUK]] are the two matching pairs that this build will usually go with. Typically, {{Item List |id=22005 |item=Temporal Luk Boots |simple=yes}} may be preferred if player can obtain 193 [[ASPD]] from other sources, as it can increase critical damage by 30%. Otherwise, {{Item List |id=22002 |item=Temporal Agi Boots |simple=yes}} are usually selected to increase Atk Speed to 193 [[ASPD]]. [http://db.irowiki.org/db/item-info/4595/ Cenere] and [http://db.irowiki.org/db/item-info/4594/ Petal] cards are usually used to complement the 120 stats build, or to strengthen the secondary stats. ====Arrow Storm==== Build suggestion
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px" |- ! Stat !! Level 99 !! Level 125 !! Level 150 !! Level 175 |- | STR || 1 || 1 || 21 || 33 |- | AGI || 1 || 1 || 1 || 1 |- | VIT || 90 || 90 || 105 || 120 |- | INT || 47 || 57 || 70 || 100 |- | DEX || 90 || 120 || 120 || 120 |- | LUK || 30 || 30 || 77 || 80 |} This is the primary build for leveling and / or AoE damage output with [[Arrow Storm]]. This build is optimized for both soloing and partying due to its high AoE damage, survivability, lower cast time, and better [[SP]] pool and regeneration. Lvl 10 Arrow Storm has an 11x11 AoE but lvl 6 Arrow Storm may be adequate to one-shot monsters at the lower levels, and is also the first level of Arrow Storm that gets an increased 9x9 sized AOE. The player may choose to get other skills like [[Camouflage]] first before maxing Arrow Storm. One downside to this build is the lack of ability to quickly autoattack single targets, and may have to resort to using [[Arrow Storm]] even for single targets, or alternatively using [[Warg Bite]] or [[Double Strafe]]. Combined with Camouflage, this is a very effective leveling build and also a great source of AoE DPS for parties. ====Hybrid (Autowarg and Arrow Storm) [Leveling/End-Game build]==== Build suggestion
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px" |- ! Stat !! Level 99 !! Level 125 !! Level 150 !! Level 175 |- | STR || 1 || 1 || 1 || 1 |- | AGI || 80 || 90 || 100+ || 100+ |- | VIT || 40 || 50 || 60 || 60 |- | INT || 40 || 60 || 80 || 90 |- | DEX || 90 || 100 || 100+ || 110+ |- | LUK || 30 || 60 || 90 || 120 |} This is a balance between pure autowarg and arrow storm builds. It benefits from having decent SP pool for [[Arrow Storm]] (AoE), while having high [[Flee]], [[ASPD]] and [[Warg Strike]] Proc rate for single-target killing when required as well. The 30 [[STR]] may come useful to increase weight limit and to certain extent, [[ATK]].

'''Leveling'''
At the early stage, emphasis is given towards [[Arrow Storm]], as it is the best AoE skill for leveling. Given the right gears (such as full white wing set and hunter/elven bows), a lv 100 ranger's [[Arrow Storm]] damage will be sufficiently multiplied to enable 1-hit kill of monsters with a HP range of 10K ([[Arrow Storm]] 1) - 21K ([[Arrow Storm]] 10). Refining the white wing suit and bow, and applying the right elemental converter will further boost the damage.

Due to the low [[VIT]] and [[INT]] nature of this build, SP leeching gears are highly recommended to make up for the low SP pool/regeneration rate (please refer to the gear section for more details). Healing items will also have low efficiency, so investing in a healing gear such as Witch Pumpkin Hat + Alarm Mask or Rudolf Hat will be financially cheaper in the long run. These equipments, however, can be expensive to new players. Therefore, partying at the early level is highly advised to improve survivability and continuity.

'''End-Game'''
At the later stage (lv150+), the focus begins to shift from leveling towards effective [[MVP]]-ing and soloing instances. Therefore, high [[ASPD]] and [[LUK]] (for [[Crit]] and [[Warg Strike]] proc rate) are the main points to focus on. It is generally recommended to increase [[LUK]] in multiples of 30, to fully benefit from it. Having high [[ASPD]] and [[Critical]] Rate will usually enable rangers to hitlock the target, thus preventing the enemy from reaching within melee/casting range to attack back.

'''Recommended skill progression:'''
# [[Aimed Bolt]] 5 (pre-requisite for Arrow Storm) # [[Arrow Storm]] 6 (for 9x9 Area of Effect) # [[Trap Research]] 1 (to increase Max SP by 220 and INT +1, for SP pool) # [[Arrow Storm]] 10 # [[Camouflage]] 5 and [[No Limits]] 5 if oriented towards [[Arrow Storm]], or # [[Warg Mastery]], [[Tooth of Warg]] 10, and [[Warg Strike]] 5 if oriented towards Warg.
'''Pros:'''
* Easier transition from sniper where [[AGI]] and [[LUK]] is required for [[Blitz Beat]] leveling method. * Benefits from having decent [[Flee]] and [[Perfect Dodge]] at early stage to dodge a few monsters. * Eliminates the necessity of stat reset at the late stage of leveling. * Easily achieve 120 [[AGI]] by lv 150 while having decent SP pool for [[Arrow Storm]]. * A flexible build which is really useful in solo-ing instances such as Old Glast Heim Memorial and Hazy Forest where there are mobs and MVPs to clear.
'''Cons:'''
* Compromised on [[VIT]] at the early stage in favour of [[AGI]]. Soloing at early stage may not be viable unless proper SP leeching and healing gears are available. * SP Leeching gears (such as Rideword Hat, Vanagrand Helm, Incubus Pet) are expensive and may not be viable to new players. Pirate Folly, however, is a good low-end SP leeching gear. * Gears can be very expensive as multiple sets have to be acquired (some for AS purpose, while some for auto-warg).
=== Dagger Department === ====Trapper==== Build suggestion
{| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:440px" |- ! Stat !! Level 99 !! Level 125 !! Level 150 !! Level 175 |- | STR || 1 || 50 || 50 || 50 |- | AGI || 1 || 1 || 1 || 1 |- | VIT || 60 || 90 || 110 || 120 |- | INT || 90 || 90 || 90 || 94 |- | DEX || 90 || 90 || 100 || 120 |- | LUK || 1 || 44 || 77 || 77 |} Trapper is a build of ranger which is completely different with the common ranger builds. This build uses dagger and shield to provide more defense. Since the majority of your trap damage comes from your stats (DEX, INT, and little STR), not gears, a trapper can choose many defensive gears without having to worry about significant changes in trap damage due to the gears. This build also relies heavily on VIT and LUK as defensive stats (not AGI), since a trap ranger will be forced to engage the mobs within melee range most of the time. Hence, maximizing HP, soft DEF, and perfect dodge (optional) are your main goals in choosing your gears. Stats breakdown:
'''Dex''' – raises trap damage, and lowers the chance of being stripped.
'''Int''' – raises your trap damage (huge damage increase for hunter trap skills, and adequate damage for ranger trap skills), gives more SP pool and regeneration, and resistance from being silenced.
'''Vit''' – Mainly for HP pool that increases your chances to survive mobs of monsters, HP regeneration and effectiveness of healing items, soft defense and resistance from being stunned, poisoned, or blinded.
'''Luk''' – For extra ATK, perfect dodge, auto-warg strike chance and resistance against being cursed.
'''Agi''' – for evasion-based defense when fighting monsters (note that your AGI won't be effective when you're fighting more than 3 monsters), and resistance against bleeding. take note that high agi wont let you spam fire trap faster, it is capped to 2 fire traps per second no matter how high your agi is.
'''Str''' – Mainly for weight limit and damage when you're forced to poke your dagger on the enemy. Pros and Cons of Trapper
'''PROS'''
- Through specialized traps, you can inflict status ailments to enemies (such as sleep, frozen, freezing, burning, etc.).
- Through another set of specialized traps, you can change a monster's element.
- Can get very defensive due to ability to use shield and not dependent on White Wing set
'''CONS'''
- Damage-dealing traps have a low area coverage (from single-target up to a 5-by-5 cell area).
- Expect yourself to kill enemies slowly.
- This build is very gear-dependent and thus, it is significantly costlier than conventional ranger builds.

=== Arrow Storm Ranger === '''White Wing Set:''' Must wear the full set for maximum Arrow Storm damage. Some players that are able to one-shot monsters within a map without the set may opt for a Raydric Carded garment for more protection however. These gears can also be enchanted in the [[Mora Enchants| Mora Village]] with additional enchant options when the gears are refined to +9 and above. {| class="wikitable sortable" |- ! width="150pt"| Equipment !! width="80pt" | Location |- | {{Item List |id=15042 |item=White Wing Suit |slots=1 |simple=yes}} || style="padding-left:10px" | Armor |- | {{Item List |id=2580 |item=White Wing Manteau |simple=yes}} || style="padding-left:10px" | Garment |- | {{Item List |id=2479 |item=White Wing Boots |slots=1 |simple=yes}} || style="padding-left:10px" | Footwear |- | {{Item List |id=2890 |item=White Wing Brooch |simple=yes}} || style="padding-left:10px" | Accessory |} '''Weapon:''' * {{Item List |id=18110 |item=Big Crossbow |slots=2 |simple=yes}} with {{Item List |id=4094 |item=Archer Skeleton Card |simple=yes}} x2 When upgraded to a high refine, this bow is the strongest for Arrow Storm and can be very expensive. However, the SP cost of Arrow Storm can be doubled or more when using this, depending on refine rate. Big Crossbow (BXB) can also be enchanted, albeit with considerable chance to destroy said weapon, through the [[Biolab Enchants]]. Each Archer Skeleton Card will increase ranged damage by 10%. Other options that do not have increased SP cost: * {{Item List |id=1746 |item=Elven Bow |slots=1 |simple=yes}} + {{Item List |id=1773 |item=Elven Arrow |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=1726 |item=Hunter Bow |slots=1 |simple=yes}} + {{Item List |id=1774 |item=Hunting Arrow |simple=yes}} (Unslotted Hunter Bow is given for free at the [[Hunter]] job change. It can also be NPC bought.) Using Elven Bow with Elven Arrows or Hunter Bow with Hunter Arrows adds a 50% ranged damage bonus. These are good options to use, especially if they can one-shot the monsters already. Both arrows can be purchased in Mora (level 100+ to enter, or find a warp there) '''Accessory Options:''' * {{Item List |id=2724 |item=Medal of Honor (Archer) |simple=yes}} Medal of Honor is a powerful accessory that adds 5% more damage, +300 HP, +60 SP, +1% chance of casting blind on ranged attack, and boosts healing items by 5%. This accessory and other [[KVM]] / Valor equipment is usually acquired by saving up [[Eden Merit Badge]]s and converting into Valor badges. It is also an account bound accessory. For more information, please see [[Battlegrounds]]. * {{Item List |id=2899 |item=Sound Amplifier |slots=1 |simple=yes}} A Sound Amplifier has a very large boost to a performer skill ([[Metallic Sound]]), but can actually be equipped by Rangers as well. The 50% variable cast reduction is very helpful, especially for builds that are not purely Arrow Storm or builds with low [[INT]]. Do note that without a {{Item List |id=4077 |item=Phen Card |simple=yes}}, casting skills such as [[Arrow Storm]] '''can''' be interrupted. If the party has a dedicated tank, and the player is experienced at avoiding monsters, a Phen may not always need to be equipped (hotkeying a Phen accessory is necessary though in case the player does get mobbed with monsters). Another option is to put a Phen Card into the Sound Amplifier accessory of course. '''Other Phen Options:''' * {{Item List |id=2671 |item=Bow Thimble |slots=1 |simple=yes}} with {{Item List |id=4077 |item=Phen Card |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=2790 |item=Bradium Brooch |slots=1 |simple=yes}} with {{Item List |id=4077 |item=Phen Card |simple=yes}}
=== Auto-Warg Ranger === The objective of this build is to ensure 100% critical rate and max aspd (193 ASPD) to hitlock an enemy (that is, to flinch an enemy by attacking at quick and regular intervals so that it can not move towards the attacker). Therefore, equipments that increase [[ASPD]], [[CRIT]] and [[LUK]] are very important for this build. There is a very large selection of [[ASPD]] gear available in the game. And with the addition of new cards and gears, White Wing Set is no longer a necessity for auto warg builds as it will proc double strafe skill which may break the hitlock on an enemy. Some of the gears that may prove useful for this build are as follows:
'''Garments''' * {{Item List |id=2576 |item=Heroic Backpack |slots=1 |simple=yes}} An all rounder garment to increase ASPD, Ranged Damage, Neutral Resistance, Critical Damage when used with 90 AGI/DEX/VIT/LUK respectively. * {{Item List |id=2589 |item=Fallen Angel Wings |slots=1 |simple=yes}} A garment that can be enchanted to greatly raise certain stats. The list of enchants is further explained in [[Fallen Angel Wing Enchants]]
'''Footgears''' * {{Item List |id=22002 |item=Temporal Agility Boots |simple=yes}} A footgear that is very effective at increasing attack speed. Can also be enchanted with various Old Glast Heim [[Enchantment]]. * {{Item List |id=22005 |item=Temporal Luck Boots |simple=yes}} A footgear that is selected to maximize critical damage. Excellent when used with 120 base LUK for +30% critical damage. Can also be enchanted with various Old Glast Heim [[Enchantment]].
'''Accessories''' * {{Item List |id=28433 |item=Luminous Stone |slots=1 |simple=yes}} An accessory that greatly increase your critical damage for a total of 32%. * {{Item List |id=2910 |item=Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo |simple=yes}} An accessory that is very effective at increasing attack speed and damage, with +10% ASPD and +7% damage. Does not have a slot however. * {{Item List |id=28575 |item=Verus Core |slots=1 |simple=yes}} Works like Bakonawa Tattoo, with 10% ASPD, 5% damage to all elements and Perfect Hit +20%. Has slot * {{Item List |id=2772 |item=Glorious Ring |simple=yes}} A good all-rounder purpose to increase +5% ASPD and 10% elemental resist from [[Fire]], [[Earth]], [[Wind]] and [[Water]] element attacks. Obtainable from KVM [[Battlegrounds]] for 1200 KVM points. * {{Item List |id=2790 |item=Bradium Brooch |slots=1 |simple=yes}} Another option for [[ASPD]] and also has a slot. This item can be obtained for free by completing the [[Doha's Secret Orders]] quest. {{Item List|id=2795|item=Green Apple Ring|simple=yes}}
{{Item List|id=6124|item=Wolf Flute|simple=yes}} | qreward = Job Change to [[Ranger]] | window = yes }} # Talk to the '''Survival Instructor''' located near the boat (Island Entrance) back to [[Alberta]]. He will give you further briefing about the job change and check whether you have attained base level 99. #*[[Image:01.jpg]] # He will then instruct you to remove all of your equipment and make your weight 0 (zeny is not included). You will be warped back to Alberta.
# Return and talk to the instructor again. He will give you a survival test of reaching '''Test Instructor''' (Teardrop){{Navi|tur_dun01|91|168}} located at the North-West tip of the island. He will provide you 1 Bow, 500 Arrows and 10 {{item|id=12323 Novice Fly Wings}}. #*[[Image:02.jpg]] #* When you talk to Teardrop while doing Step 3, make sure you drop items left on your inventory (other than the items provided to you by the Survival Instructor) or otherwise he will mark you cheating and warp you back to the starting point (beside the Survival Instructor). However, he will just tell you to remove excess items if you are already on Step 4. # When Test Instructor Teardrop is located, talk and choose "I came here for the test". He will then give you a simple mission of killing 1 {{monster |id=1321 Dragon Tail}} and return with 1 {{item|id=7064 Wing of Dragonfly}} in order to proceed. #* Your falcon will be a great help if you have no more arrows in your inventory. # After passing the initial tests, he will then warp you to the test waiting area. When your turn is in, you will be warped to the first test area. He will provide you with 100 Arrows. #* He will also provide you 100 Arrows when you fail the tests and start again. #*[[Image:ranger03.jpg]] === The Test of Accuracy === #In this mission, you will need to kill a monster from the poring-class family (consists of {{monster |id=1002 Poring}}, {{monster |id=1242 Marin}}, {{monster |id=1031 Poporing}} and {{monster |id=1113 Drops}}) around you. This is somewhat like the [[Hunter Job Change Guide|Hunter Job Change Test]], the only difference is the monsters are poring-class. Instructions will be provided. You need to kill a monster named "Poring". The monsters will be summoned in different locations, types, and names every 5 seconds. It's good if you can find the right "Poring" quickly. Passing score is 15 out of 20. '''Note: There a few updates to the below directions. Two names have been updated:''' :* Podaegi -> Podagi :* Poja -> Poking #*[[Image:ranger04.jpg]] [[Image:Ranger-test-1.png|250px|thumb|right|Guide for the first part of the ranger test]] =====How to determine Poring's location:===== :Always look at the North island (North direction, 12 o' clock). :*If the monster spawned there is called Poring, then just hit it. :*If it's called '''Podaegi''', the Poring is on the northeast island. ('''↗''') :*If it's '''Poporing''', east. ('''→''') :*If it's '''Poja''', southeast. ('''↘''') :*If it's '''Pororing''', south. ('''↓''') :*If it's '''Drops''', southwest. ('''↙''') :*If it's '''Hoing''', west. ('''←''') :*If it's '''Poing''', northwest. ('''↖''') === Trapping Ability Test === In this mission, the aim is to test your trapping skills by killing plant monsters that block your way. After you finish the first test, you will be warped to the 2nd test area, instructions will be broadcast. Stay where you are and wait for the time to start. NPCs and monsters that will appear on the test area indicates the time has started. You will be given 3 minutes to finish the test. # Talk to the representative near you. He will give you 10 Bombring capsules, 100 {{item |id=569 Novice Potions}} and 2k+ bulky report files which will make your weight go to 90%. #*[[Image:ranger05.jpg]] # Using your Bombring capsules, you need to eliminate the plant monsters which block your way through to the next representative. The plant monsters include {{monster |id=1118 Floras}}, {{monster |id=1368 Geographers}}, {{monster |id=1988 Nepenthes}}, {{monster |id=1781 Drosera}}, {{monster |id=1780 Muscipulars}}, {{monster |id=1020 Mandragoras}}, and {{monster |id=1500 Parasites}}. #*Note1 : When a Bombring capsule is used, it will spawn a Bombring that follows you, attack you for 1 second, and then explode 3 seconds after you place them. The explosion encompasses a 5x5 cell area so don't get caught in it or you will die and have to repeat mission 1 (the Accuracy Test). '''You must consume all of the Bombring capsules to proceed'''. #*Note2 : If you still have any leftover arrows from previous tests, you can use them to kill the plants. If you want to use the leftover arrows, do NOT pick the papers first, but walk and kill the plants using your arrows, THEN pick the papers & Bombring capsules from the NPC. Since the plants do not respawn, this actually makes walking through the area becomes easier. Also, since you no longer have any plants to kill, just spam your Bombring capsules while walking (put the capsules in shortcut to make it easier to spam) and keep your distance away from them. When killing the plants using arrows, remember that you have a limited amount of them and a limited amount of time for the test, so focus on killing just the healers and especially Nepenthes, which hits hard and fast (keep your distance, make sure you can hit the Nepenthes while it can't hit you). [[Arrow Repel]] helps in pushing back some of the plants so you can ignore them and not waste your arrows on them. Some plants such as the Floras and Mandragoras cannot even hit you at all assuming you have enough Flee or is in a safe distance, those can be ignored too. # Reach the Test Supervisor Kowsyun at the end of the path, you need not talk to her, just walk near her and the dialogue will activate. After using all the Bombring capsules you have and giving her the report files, she will warp you to the 3rd test area. #*[[Image:ranger06.jpg]] === Using a Wolf Companion === # Talk to the Supervisor and he will give you the instructions for the test. #*[[Image:ranger07.jpg]] # He will provide you with 1 Job Change Flute to summon a mercenary Baby Desert Wolf. # Summon the mercenary and talk to the supervisor to begin the test. # You will be under the {{plainlink |url=http://irowiki.org/wiki/Status_Effects#Stone Stone Curse}} effect which prevents you from moving. You will need to control the mercenary to disarm 20 Egg Bombs that will appear randomly one by one on the map. Passing score is 10 out of 20. #*[[Image:ranger08.jpg]] # After passing the test, you will redirected to the Ranger Master to change your job. He will check whether you have consumed all of skill points and ask you to remove your falcon. You will be awarded with '''1 {{item|id=5748 Sniper Goggle}}, 1 {{item|id=2795 Green Apple Ring}}''', and '''1 {{item|id=6124 Wolf Flute}}'''. #*[[Image:ranger09.jpg]] {{Navbox Hunter}} [[Category:Job Change Guide]] [[Category:Ranger]]

title: Rebel
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job | jobName=Rebel | jobBase=Gunslinger | jobType=Extended 2nd Class | jobLevel=60 | Race=[[Human]] | changesAt=[[Einbroch]] | skills=20 | skillPoints=89 | questSkills=0 | str=3|agi=6|vit=6|int=8|dex=8|luk=5 }} [[file:Rebellion.jpg|250px|right]] Rekenber Corporation, the de facto entity of power of Schwartzvald Republic, have historically used mercenaries to supplement its forces and enforce control. However, disruptive events in the Republic influenced its President for their disbandment, with the mercenaries leading an uprising to express dissent of this decision. The revolt, however, was quashed. Bitter and betrayed, the remaining forces reorganized in Einbech to form a quasi-military group called the "Rebellion", and its members "Rebels". Ever since then, they conducted independent clandestine operations in the region to make a name for themselves, all the while vowing revenge against the President of Rekenber Corporation and his pet unit, the Secret Wings. A tight-knit organization, the Rebellion only recruit through underground connections and contracts, and recognition is given only to those that have contributed to the cause. Despite this, an adventuring gunslinger of high enough experience and skill might just be able to stumble in to their ranks... '''Pros:''' *Multiple powerful skills which do '''upwards of 3,000-5,600%''' damage with additional effects. *'''Much easier''' to gain coin buff via [[Rich's Coin]]. *'''Lots of AoE''' based attacks and secondary effects. *'''Great in parties''' due to extremely high damage output via [[Dragon Tail]], [[God's Hammer]], [[Howling Mine]], and [[Fire Rain]]. *'''More versatile with addition of new bullets:''' Fire/Earth/Wind/Water varieties + Armor-piercing. '''Cons:''' *'''None''' of the skills benefit from the range increase provided by the Gunslinger skill [[Snake Eyes]]. *Crimson Marker can be triggered as far as 21 × 21 range from the caster (all of the screen), but the actual range of Crimson Marker is only 10. This puts you in a '''vulnerable position''' in the instance where you want to use more powerful skills. *'''Expensive''' catalyst materials for many of the stronger skills. Dragon Tail Missiles as an example cost 1500 (pre-discount) and weigh 10 each. Skills that use these materials should be used sparingly due to lack of weight limit and cost of use. == Job Change Guide== ''See [[Rebel Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' == Builds == === Walking Arsenal Build === *STR: 1-50 (for weight capacity) or 120 (if using Tengu Set/Giant's Protection/Modified Str Boots) *AGI: 1+ *VIT: 50+ (For more HP) *INT: 100-120 (for more SP/SP regen, 120 if using Seraphim Coronet) *DEX: 100-120 (for damage) *LUK: 33+ (for cheaper damage when Dex gets too expensive) All damage all the time. You want access to a powerful AoE, a powerful cheap AoE, a powerful Single Target ability, and a cheap AoE. [[Snake Eyes]] doesn't work with Rebellion skills, so expect to be close in combat at all times. Primary skills: *[[Rich's Coin]] Costs 1 skill point, and significantly decreases the amount of time you have to spend spamming [[Coin Flip]] *[[God's Hammer]] Highest damage skill in the Rebellion arsenal but uses up all your coins in order to cast. *[[Quick Draw Shot]] Only use this when wearing a Revolver, so that you can use the natural [[Chain Action]] proc instead of having to invest (waste) points in [[Eternal Chain]]. Good for dealing a lot of damage to enemies that are not necessarily grouped together. *[[Howling Mine]] Great mob-clear AoE skill. Attach it to a few enemies that are grouped near each other, then light it off with [[Flicker]]. *[[Dragon Tail]] Preferably used on only a single target at a time. So only use when there's a single Crimson Marker in place. Big numbers! *[[Fire Rain]] Another good AoE mob clearing skill. Because screw groups of mobs. *[[Flicker]] For fireworks via [[Howling Mine]]. *[[Round Trip]] Great skill for leveling. Has a large AoE around the user. === ASPD Build === *STR: 1-30 (for weight capacity) *AGI: 90-120 (depending on your gear and how much you're willing to spend on consumables) *VIT: 50+ (For more HP) *INT: 50+ (For more SP/SP regen) *DEX: 100-120 (For more damage) *LUK: 33+ (For cheaper atk when Dex is too expensive) With [[Hit Barrel]], Rebels can easily reach max [[ASPD]]. With the use of [[Eternal Chain]] and [[Chain Action]], the player can hitlock monsters to prevent them from reaching getting in range. Bring a Revolver, a Gatling Gun, a Grenade Launcher, and a Rifle. You're going to need them. Also bullets, lots and lots of bullets (and the special ammo, too). == Equipment == Rebellion use the same types of weapons as Gunslingers, including; Revolvers, Rifles, Gatling Guns, Shotguns and Grenade Launchers. The player is mistaken for another person (presumably someone quite androgynous if your character is female). Can now continue to next step or keep talking to select either option to be transported across the map. #*Non-iRO servers: The player may have to walk near the NPC to trigger the dialogue. #:[[File:Rebel-SuspiciousMan.png|250px]] #Head to [[Einbroch]] and talk to the '''Bouncer''' {{Navi|einbroch|54|97}} in the bottom left of the city to enter the building. #*'''Note:''' As of 2018, you cannot re-enter the building once you finish becoming a Rebel, so keep this in mind if you wish to explore the job change venue. This was confirmed not to be a bug. #:[[File:rebel-Bouncer.png|250px]] #Speak with '''Kulbertinov''' behind the counter and select ''"I don't think I have a choice."'' The player will be warped to a next room. #:[[File:ElwinConick-First.png|250px]] #In this new room, speak to '''Elwin Conick''' again and the player will be given a test. #*The player will be transformed into a [http://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/3169 Hunter Cecil] and be given 3 minutes to finish the test. #*The test can be restarted by talking to Elwin again if the 3 minutes have passed. #*'''Elwin will not talk to you if you have any leftover Steel Artifacts after failing the test, so only collect sets of 5 Steel Artifacts to avoid leftovers, otherwise you will have to go out and sell off the Steel Artifacts to an NPC.''' #:[[File:ElwinConick-Second.png|250px]] #Head to the bottom right of the room to turn on the furnace with the '''Furnace Controller''' {{Navi|job_gun|163|18}}. #:[[File:rebel-FurnaceController.png|250px]] #The furnace will begin dispensing two (2) types of Steel Artifacts to the left of the controller. #*You need to collect {{Item List|id=6747|item=Steel Artifact|simple=yes|num=5}} in order to attempt making the gun. #Collect 5 Steel Artifacts, then head to the room near the controller. #Use the '''Auto Anvil''' {{Navi|job_dun|214|38}} to try assembling a {{item|id=13118 Fading Flame}}. #*It is possible that the attempt will fail. #*You can collect multiple sets of the brown artifacts or return to the previous room and collect more if it does fail. #:[[File:rebel-AutoAnvil.png|250px]] #Once the gun has been made, speak to '''Elwin Conick''' near the anvil. 1. Talk to Shede in [[Hugel]] courtyard {{navi|hugel|70|137}}. She will ask you for a random set of items.
* 5 Clam Fleshes: You'll find these clams to the right of the airship in Hugel {{navi|hugel|216|158}}.
* 5 Mok Mushrooms: You'll find the mushrooms located just outside of the city of Hugel {{navi|hu_fild06|169|359}}.
* 5 Mok Shells: Find the Thief Bugs hiding in the bushes just outside of the city of Hugel {{navi|hu_fild06|218|373}}. 

2. Shede tells you to find Mr. Herico in the Hugel Inn {{navi|hugel|104|77}}.

3. Find Herico upstairs in the room next to the stairs {{navi|hu_in01|255|40}}. Talk to him, and he talks about Hugel before asking you to find information about the Airship and Odin's Temple for him.

4. If You've completed the four listed quests, you can continue.

5. Talk to Herico again, and he tells you his story. He then asks you to find a Reporter in Lighthalzen.

6. From exiting the airport, head west to the left side of the map. Enter the house at {{navi|lighthalzen|52|87}}, and talk to Enquro Carson. He says he'll tell you the location of the reporter if you bring him the two drinks from the Private Pub in [[Morroc]].

7. Bring him a {{item|id=12112 Tropical Sograt}} and {{item|id=12113 Vermilion on the Beach}}, and he'll tell you to find Wintzil Trony in Hugel.
*Each drink is 1,000z a piece; unless you're an assassin, then they are 800z a piece. (You can buy it at {{navi|morroc_in|165|76}}. (Inside the building at {{navi|morocc|55|259}})).

8. Go to the house in Hugel near the top {{navi|hugel|150|216}} and talk to the little girl. She tells you her name is Wintzil Trony, and tells you you can find a picture of her father in a bookshelf.

9. Go upstairs and click on the Book in the bookshelf, and go through the journal.

10. Head back to Herico and explain what happened. He asks you to join him in bringing down Rekenber. Accept, and he asks you to go to Lighthalzen to steal a Master Copy of their research.

11. Head to Rekenber HQ in Lighthalzen, and go down to the research levels used by Regenschirm. (Don't forget to wear the {{item|id=2243 Geek Glasses}} and {{item|id=2241 Grampa Beard}}!).

12. Go to the far room across from the portal, find Stack of Files on one of the tables next to {{navi|lhz_in01|213|130}}. Pick out a File Folder of research and an intruder alert will sound; two Remover will spawn. Kill them, and head back to Herico in [[Hugel]].

13. Herico tells you to find a {{item|id=7138 Marine Sphere Bottle}} to help destroy level 2 of Biolabs. Go to Einbech {{navi|einbech|208|123}} and buy a {{item|id=7138 Marine Sphere Bottle}} from him. If you already have a Marine Sphere Bottle, go to step 14.

14. Go Biolabs Level 2 {{navi|lhz_dun02|247|226}} and destroy the Unethical Machine. 

15. Head back to Herico in Hugel, and he asks who could help with his plans. Tell him "President" and he gives you a File Folder to give to him.

* You can now exchange 100 {{item|id=7345 Handcuffs}} for any Level 4 Food Item from Herico. 

16. Go to Juno and visit the president's office {{navi|yuno|157|317}} and give him the File. He reaffirms his commitment to ridding the world of Rekenber, and gives you an {{item|id=617 Old Purple Box}} along with some base experience.

* Receive 200,000 [[Base Experience]]

title: Rebirth
wikitext: '''Rebirth (Alternative: Transcendence)''' [[File:High classes.jpg|600px|thumb|Sprite comparison for High Novice and High First Classes]] Characters who reach Base Level 99 and Job Level 50 as a Primary Second Class get the option to go to [[Juno]] to be reborn, a process which is referred to as "Transcendence". When they are reborn, they will be sent to the town associated with their First Class, lose all of their Stats and Skills, and become a level 1/1 [[High Novice]]. These are more powerful versions of the regular [[Novice]] from which you can progress further into transcended versions of your class prior to rebirth. High Novices and High First Classes are identical to their pre-Transcendence counterparts except for the bonuses outlined below: * Differently-colored sprites. * Access to equipment marked as "Transcendent only". * Automatic access to Novice's Quest Skills [[First Aid]] and [[Play Dead]] without needing to have completed those quests first. * A permanent 25% increase to maximum [[HP]] and [[SP]]. * 100 Stat Points to start off with (as opposed to a regular Novice's 48 Stat Points). * +1 to all of their base Stats, granted incrementally as a High Novice over their Job Levels (following the table below): ::{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" ! Stat\Amount !! +1 |- ! STR | 8 |- ! AGI | 5 |- ! VIT | 6 |- ! INT | 9 |- ! DEX | 3 |- ! LUK | 2 |} As a High Novice, when you reach Job Level 10 you will be able to change into the High First Class matching your original First Class and you will automatically learn your First Class's Quest Skills when changing to it. *For example, if you originally chose to be an [[Archer]], you will be able to change into a [[High Archer]] and automatically obtain the [[Arrow Repel]] and [[Arrow Crafting]] quest skills (even if you did not get them originally). '''NOTE''': If you are a High Novice at Job Level 10 and are unable to change into your High First Class when talking to the proper Guild NPC, you may need to return to Criatura Academy in [[Izlude]] and speak with ''Sprakki'' {{navi|iz_ac01|102|44}} to enable the quest if you did not talk through her dialogue the first time around. After reaching Job Level 50 as a High First Class, you will need to return to the ''Book of Ymir'' in [[Juno]] ([[#Rebirth_Walkthrough|see below]]) to change into the Transcendent Second Class matching your original Second Class. *Following the example above, if you originally chose to become a [[Hunter]], you will be able to become a [[Sniper]], which has access to all of the Skills available to their matching Second Class plus a number of Transcendent-exclusive Skills. Once you reach Base Level 99 and Job Level 70, you will be able to job change into its Third Class, with access to even more Skills as well as a raised Base Level cap of 200 and a Job Level cap of 70. *Continuing the example above, you would be able to change from a Level 99 [[Sniper]] to a Level 99 [[Ranger]] (base level will not reset moving forward). Finally, after all of that, you can change into your Fourth Class, with access to even more powerful Skills as well as a raised Base Level cap of 260 and a Job Level cap of 55. *Finally in this example, you would be able to change from a Level 200 [[Ranger]] to a Level 200 [[Windhawk]]. === Rebirth Walkthrough === # Reach Base Level 99 and Job Level 50 as a Second Class Job. # Head to the '''Sage Castle''' in northwest [[Juno]] (entrance at {{navi|yuno|87|321}}). # Talk to ''Metheus Sylphe'' {{navi|yuno_in02|88|164}} and pay 1,285,000 [[zeny]] as a donation to view the '''Book of Ymir'''. #:[[File:Metheus.png]] #* This fee can be waived by taking a quest from the NPC to hunt a {{monster|id=2414 Runaway Book}} that appears in the fields around [[Juno]] and looting 1 {{Item List 2|id=6586|item=Captured Book|simple=yes}} from it. #: [[File:Runawaybook locations.png]] # When you are approved to, read the ''Book of Ymir'' {{navi|yuno_in02|93|205}}, just to the north of ''Metheus Sylphe''. Choose the option: "Leave your body to it." to be sent to Valhalla. #:[[File:BookOfYmir.png]] # After you've been warped to Valhalla, walk north as far as you can, roughly {{navi|valkyrie|42|82}}, and talk to the ''Valkyrie''. #:[[File:Hall-of-Honor-Valkyrie.png]] #*Before you talk to her, the character must not have any Character Add-ons, such as a [[Pushcart]], [[Falconry Mastery|Falcon]], [[Cute Pet System|Cute Pet]], [[Peco Peco Ride|Peco Peco]] or {{item|id=12622 Halter Lead}}, and must have all of their [[Skill Points]] spent. They must also be carrying less than 500 [[Weight]]. Failure to meet this criteria will cause her to teleport you out of Valhalla. #**''Non-iRO servers may also require 0 Weight and 0 Zeny. Some equipment, despite weighing 0, may also be rejected by the Valkyrie.'' #If you are [[Base Level]] 99 / [[Job Level]] 50, have under 500 [[Weight]], no Character Add-ons, and no unallocated [[Skill Points]] on your character... the ''Valkyrie'' will recognize your power and you'll be reborn into a High Novice. You will then be warped to the town of your original First Class to begin again: #*[[Swordsman]] - [[Izlude]] #*[[Mage]] - [[Geffen]] #*[[Merchant]] - [[Alberta]] #*[[Acolyte]] - [[Prontera]] #*[[Thief]] - [[Morroc]] #*[[Archer]] - [[Payon]] {{Navbox Classes}} [[Category:General Information]] [[Category: Classes]]

title: Refinement System
wikitext:
==Overview== Equipment in Ragnarok Online can be 'upgraded' or 'refined' by upgrade [[NPC]]s in each major [[town]]s to make them more powerful. Upgrading of items should not be confused with [[Item Reform]] which is another way to strengthen equipment. All equipment has a maximum upgrade level of +20, starting from +0. +0 items do not have any prefixes, but once they are upgraded, the number of upgrade levels will be displayed on the equipment - e.g. +5 Stunner. Upgrades above +10 use a [[Refinement_System#Upgrades_beyond_.2B10|different system]], and it is very unusual to see gear upgraded above +15. Also, you can turn in {{item|id=756 Rough Oridecon}} and {{item|id=757 Rough Elunium}} to create single refined {{item|id=984 Oridecon}} and {{item|id=985 Elunium}}, which are needed for upgrading Lv. 3 / Lv. 4 weapons, items and armors, respectively. Additionally you can turn in three of either Oridecon or Elunium to make the respective {{item|id=6224 Bradium}} or {{item|id=6223 Carnium}}. The [[Kafra Shop]] offers the following cash shop variations of those ores: *Enriched ores which increases the chance of successfully upgrading an item. *HD ores which have the same rate as normal ores, but protect an item from breaking (only degrade by 1 refine level instead) in case of upgrade failure. ==Upgrade NPC Locations== *Inside [[Prontera]] {{navi|prt_in|63|60}} *Inside [[Morroc]] {{navi|morocc_in|73|38}} *[[Payon]] {{navi|payon|144|173}} *Inside [[Alberta]] {{navi|alberta_in|29|59}} *Basement of [[Juno]] Armory {{navi|juno|119|137}} *2nd floor of [[Einbroch]] Blacksmith Guild {{navi|einbroch|255|108}} *Basement of [[Lighthalzen]] Weapon Shop {{navi|lighthalzen|194|35}} *[[Malangdo]] {{navi|malangdo|224|172}} ==Upgrade Requirements== [[File:Refine_UI.jpg]] To upgrade equipment, make sure you have the following: *Equipment *Zeny *Reagent (Ores) *Blacksmith Blessing (optional, will preserve upgrade level in case of failure, usable from +7 up to +14) [[File:Refining.gif]] To start refining, drag the items to be refined from inventory to the square box in the middle. The required ore will appear in the blue hexagon at the top. Blacksmith Blessing (when applicable) will appear in the red hexagon next to the ores. Select the ore to be used by clicking on the appropriate hexagon. You will have the option to use Blacksmith Blessing starting at +7 up to +14. The center blue hexagon will display the ore selected. The red hexagon will display Blacksmith Blessing if you chose to use it for this refine. Please note success rate for the refine will appear at the top of the display while the Zeny cost will be shown next to the Zeny icon at the Refine button. {|class=wikitablec !rowspan=2|Upgrade Level!! colspan=2|Blacksmith Blessings Cost |- !Normal |- !+7 -> +8 | 1 |- !+8 -> +9 | 2 |- !+9 -> +10 | 4 |- !+10 -> +11 | 7 |- !+11 -> +12 | 11 |- !+12 -> +13 | 16 |- !+13 -> +14 | 22 |- |} Not all item types can be upgraded. The following item types cannot be upgraded: *Middle and Lower [[Headgears]]. *[[Accessories]]. No longer the case, some accessories are upgradable and gradable now. *Costumes. *Any items that are not equipment. *Any equipment that specifically says it cannot be upgraded. ===Reagents and Cost=== In order to upgrade, you need to provide a reagent in order to upgrade your equipment. Reagent required differs depending on weapon level of the equipment. As for armors, they all take same reagent regardless of type. Money taken also differs depending on weapon level of the [[weapons]]. Following list shows reagent + money required. {|class=wikitablec !Equipment!!Reagent!!Fee |- !Weapon Lv. 1 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=1010|item=Phracon}}|200z from NPC Shop}} |50z |- !Weapon Lv. 2 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=1011|item=Emveretarcon}}|1,000z from NPC Shop}} |200z |- !Weapon Lv. 3 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=984|item=Oridecon}}|Monster Drop}} |5,000z |- !Weapon Lv. 4 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=984|item=Oridecon}}|Monster Drop}} |20,000z |- !Weapon Lv. 5 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=1000332|item=Etherdeocon}}|Monster Drop}} |50,000z |- !Armor Lv. 1 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=985|item=Elunium}}|Monster Drop}} |2,000z |- !Armor Lv. 2 |{{tooltip|{{Item List|id=1000331|item=Ethernium}}|Monster Drop}} |30,000z |- |} '''Notes''': *If the player is using Enriched Oridecon / Enriched Elunium / HD Oridecon / HD Elunium from the [[Kafra Shop]], the fee is 0z. ===Refining Rough Oridecons and Eluniums=== When you collect 5 {{item|id=756 Rough Oridecons}} and {{item|id=757 Rough Eluniums}}, you can convert them into a single {{item|id=984 Oridecon}} or {{item|id=985 Elunium}} by talking to an [[NPC]] in the upgrade shop. *Note that you can make only one pure {{item|id=984 Oridecon}} or {{item|id=985 Elunium}} each time you talk to the NPC. *This service does not cost any [[Zeny]]. *'''Locas''' {{Navi|izlude|155|132}} in Izlude will '''mass'''-convert rough ore into the pure ore. *:[[File:IRO Wiki Locas.png|frameless|Locas can mass-convert rough ores]] ==Effects Gained== ===Weapons=== {{update}} An upgraded weapon will get the following bonuses (for conciseness, only ATK is written, though MATK is upgraded too): *Level 1 - Every +1 upgrade gives 2 ATK, 0~3 ATK for every ''Over Upgrade'' pass the +7 Safety Limit, 16 ''High Upgrade'' ATK from +15 to +16, and 1 ATK for every ''High Upgrade'' pass +16. *Level 2 - Every +1 upgrade gives 3 ATK, 0~5 ATK for every ''Over Upgrade'' pass the +6 Safety Limit, 32 ''High Upgrade'' ATK from +15 to +16, and 2 ATK for every ''High Upgrade'' pass +16. *Level 3 - Every +1 upgrade gives 5 ATK, 0~8 ATK for every ''Over Upgrade'' pass the +5 Safety Limit, 32 ''High Upgrade'' ATK from +15 to +16, and 2 ATK for every ''High Upgrade'' pass +16. *Level 4 - Every +1 upgrade gives 7 ATK, 0~14 ATK for every ''Over Upgrade'' pass the +4 Safety Limit, 48 ''High Upgrade'' ATK from +15 to +16, and 3 ATK for every ''High Upgrade'' pass +16. **A +20 Level 4 weapon has its ATK and MATK increased by 200~424. *Level 5 - Every +1 upgrade gives 8 ATK and 2 [[ATK#P.ATK|P.ATK]]/[[MATK#S.MATK|S.MATK]] and no ''Over Upgrade'' variance. **For Level 5 weapon, the [[Grade]] of the weapon will increase the ATK gained from refine level. ***No Grade - 8 ATK ***Grade D - 8.8 ATK (10% increase) ***Grade C - 10.4 ATK (30% increase) ***Grade B - 12 ATK (50% increase) ***Grade A - 16 ATK (100% increase) '''Notes''': *The ''Over Upgrade'' bonus is random for every hit and gives a minimum of 0. This bonus is not shown on the Status Window or affected by the Maximum ATK from [[Stats#CRIT|Critical Hit Damage]] and [[Maximize Power]] or the Maximum MATK from [[Recognized Spell]]. *All upgrade bonuses are cumulative so refining a Level 4 weapon from +15 to +16 increases ATK & MATK bonus from 105~259 to 160~328 (7 for the upgrade, 0~14 for the ''Over Upgrade'' and 48 for the ''High Upgrade''). {|class="wikitablec mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" !colspan=5|Level 1 Weapons |- style="font-size:smaller;" !rowspan=2|Upgrade Lv. !colspan=4|ATK & MATK Bonuses |- style="font-size:smaller;" !Base Bonus!!Over Upgrade!!High Upgrade!!Overall Total |- ! For armors, it reduces damage the player will take. ==Safety Level== The Safety Level is the maximum level of refinement that can be given to equipment with guaranteed success (0% chance of failure). Anything past the safety level has chance to fail, and failure means your equipment will be permanently destroyed, including any cards and other enchantments it may have had. You won't be refunded Zeny and the ore used to upgrade if it fails. Give careful thought before deciding if you want to upgrade a piece of equipment beyond its safety level. {|class=wikitablec !Equipment!!Safety Level |- !Weapon Lv. 1 | +7 |- !Weapon Lv. 2 | +6 |- !Weapon Lv. 3 | +5 |- !Weapon Lv. 4 |rowspan=3| +4 |- !Armor Lv. 1 |- !Shadow Gear |- !Weapon Lv. 5 |rowspan=2| +3* |- !Armor Lv. 2 |} *Lv. 5 Weapon/Lv. 2 Armor will only be downgraded by 3 or 1 (depend on ores used) refine level when failing upgrades under +10. However, upgrading above +10 and failing will break the equipment. ==Break Protection== The more you get beyond the safety level, the higher are the chances that your equipment gets permanently destroyed, along with its cards or other enchantments. However, Kafra shop items are available that allow you to upgrade items without risk of permanently losing the item. ===HD Oridecon & HD Elunium === During an upgrade attempt using HD Oridecon or HD Elunium, upgrade failure will only degrade the item by 1 refine level instead of breaking. ===Blacksmith Blessing === During an upgrade attempt using Blacksmith Blessing, upgrade failure will preserve upgrade level instead of breaking. Because it can be used with any ores, it is recommended to use with Enriched ores because of its higher success rate. ===Enriched Oridecon & Enriched Elunium + Enriched Refine Event=== Normally, Enriched ores have a chance of breaking the item. But during those events, in the case of upgrade failure the item will only degrade by 1 refine level instead of breaking. ===Refining Certificate=== [[File:Refining_Researcher.png]] With a refining certificate, the player can refine an item straight to the upgrade level written on the certificate. To use the certificate, talk to '''Refining Researcher''' {{Navi|prontera|182|174}} in Prontera. *They can upgrade any Lv 1 armor or Lv 1-4 weapon up to +19 depending on the certificate. *Regardless of the current upgrade level, the item will be refined immediately to upgrade levels specified on the certificate. *Refining certificate have 100% success rate. *The player needs to equip the item which will be refined. ==Refines beyond +10== As of the Renewal update, it is possible to refine an equipment beyond +10, as high as +20. To upgrade beyond +10, the player must start with an item at +10 or higher. *For Lv. 1 armor, the player must have 100,000z and 1 {{Item|id=6223 Carnium}}. *For Lv. 1-4 weapons, the player must have 100,000z and 1 {{Item|id=6224 Bradium}}. In the event of a failed refine attempt, the item may break, but more frequently, will lose three refine levels. The success rates of refining above +10 are very, very low, on the order of 20% for Level 1, 2 and 3 weapons and 10% on Level 4 weapons and armors. The [[Kafra Shop]] sells {{Item|id=6225 HD Carnium}} and {{Item|id=6226 HD Bradium}}, which can be used on any refine NPC. Failing will result in losing one refine level, instead of three levels or breaking. These exchange can be done by talking to '''Dietrich''' {{Navi|prt_in|63|69}} and choosing '''Advanced refining ores'''. {|class="wikitable" !Item!!Zeny Cost!!Materials |- |{{Item List|id=6224 |item=Bradium}} |50,000z |{{Item List|id=984 |item=Oridecon|num=3}} |- |{{Item List|id=6223 |item=Carnium}} |50,000z |{{Item List|id=985 |item=Elunium|num=3}} |- |{{Item List|id=6223 |item=Carnium}} |50,000z |{{Item List|id=6090 |item=Refined Bradium|num=1}} |} ==Refine System for Level 5 Weapon and Level 2 Armor== These exchange can be done by talking to '''Dietrich''' {{Navi|prt_in|63|69}} and choosing '''Ether refining ores'''.

title: Refining
wikitext:
== General ==
[[Blacksmith]]s can refine {{item |id=1002 Iron Ore}} into {{item |id=998 Iron}}, {{item |id=998 Iron}} and {{item |id=1003 Coal}} into {{item |id=999 Steel}}, and Elemental Ores into Elemental Stones. For material requirements, see [[Iron Tempering]], [[Steel Tempering]] and [[Enchantedstone Craft]]. Each attempt to refine material consumes 1 {{item |id=612 Mini Furnace}}.

Alternatively: There is an [[NPC]] in [[Einbroch]] (''Uwe Kleine'') (216,180) who can refine {{item |id=1003 Coal}} at a price of 6 {{item |id=7126 Large Jellopies}}, non-repeatable for non-blacksmiths. For Blacksmiths, 1 {{item |id=1003 Coal}} can be exchanged for 30 {{item |id=7312 Jubilee}} and 4 {{item |id=7126 Large Jellopy}} and is repeatable.

== Process ==
# In order to refine materials into metals, you must have all of the necessary materials in your main inventory (not your [[Pushcart|cart]]). Then you use a furnace. The {{item |id=612 Mini Furnace}} will be consumed even if you quit.
# A list of items you can create will appear. Select the item you wish to refine and continue. 
# A second window will appear detailing which items will be used up by the refining attempt. Even if the refining attempt fails the items on the list will be consumed.
# If the refining is successful the newly created item will appear in your inventory.

== Success Rate ==
* Success Rate is decided by [[Skills]], [[Stats#DEX|DEX]], [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] and [[Levels#Job Level|Job Level]].
* The tempering skills, [[Steel Tempering]], [[Iron Tempering]] and [[Enchantedstone Craft]] improve the Success Rates of refining {{item |id=999 Steel}}, {{item |id=998 Iron}} and Elemental Stones respectively. 
* Each point of [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] and [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] is believed to add 0.1% chance to successfully refining a material. For example, a [[Blacksmith]] with [[Stats#DEX|DEX]] 19 and [[Stats#LUK|LUK]] 1 would gain an additional 2% chance to refine a material, after taking other factors into account. 
* Each [[Levels#Job Level|Job Level]] is believed to add 0.2% to the overall Success Rate.

== Overview ==
Renewal is a comprehensive system-wide revamp of Ragnarok Online. Stats, Skills, EXP, Level limits, monster placement and other mechanics are all modified. Third Class jobs are also added, allowing players to break the Base Level limit of 99 in effect since the game's inception. 

Renewal is currently playable on several servers:
*jRO - Implemented on in July 6, 2010. After poor reception by jRO players, the update was withdrawn and has since been reimplemented with jRO-specific changes.
**Unimplemented: Experience Points / New Monster Spawns / 3rd class job change quest / Eden group(in jRO,"Adventurer's Academy") / Over Enchant System and etc.
*pRO - In early September 2010, renewal was added to Sakray, but was under closed testing until two weeks later. On October 13, 2010, renewal was officially opened on the commercial servers: Valkyrie, Valhalla, and New Chaos.
*iRO - In early September 2010, iRO opened a new server Yggdrasil to test the renewal content. Yggdrasil opened as a premium server on October 7. Renewal was implemented on Ymir on October 14, and Valkyrie on October 21.
*idRO - idRO website has announced episode 13.3 : Renewal and El Dicastes. Renewal will be implemented on all idRO servers on December 15, 2010 including El Dicastes.
*aRO - On September 21, 2011, aRO updated to renewal from episode 9.
*bRO - On February 18, 2011, bRO announced the opening of the servers in the renewal system, after a delay of two days, reporting difficulties in implementing, announced in a statement on February 16.
*ruRO - On September 1, 2011, ruRO started closed testing. On October 5, 2011 was opened renewal new server Phoenix. Server Chaos has no been updated.
*fRO - On June 27, 2012, fRO implemented the Renewal Update on the main server.

title: Replay System
wikitext:
== Overview ==
The Replay system is a function built into the Ragnarok client which allows game data to be saved as a replayable "movie" the user can then view within a Replay version of the game client. 

== Recording ==
#To record a game session, click on the "Replay" button in the upper left below the character information window. 
#:[[File:ReplayRec.png]]
#A recording control panel will appear.
#:[[File:RecCP.jpg]]
#Select what information you wish to include in your recording by clicking the middle Option button. The following pieces of information can be captured:
##Basic Info
##Equipment
##Items
##Skills
##All chat
##Party chat
##Guild chat
##Shortcuts
#You can also choose to specify the name of the replay file yourself, and you want whether the client to prevent a duplicate file from being created, overwriting an older recording.
#Once satisfied with the recording options, hit the Start button and your game session will be recorded. Map changes are recorded, and the recording will only end when the user selects Stop.
#The file will be saved as a .rrf in the user's game directory in the Replay folder. The exact location will appear in the general message window in orange. Replays can be sent to others, copied, and shared.

== Replaying ==
#To replay a recorded session, launch the normal patch client for your server, and choose the "Replay" option. This will launch a special Replay version of the game client.
#:'''Note:''' If your background music, sound effects and/or skill effects have been disabled in your normal game client, they will also be disabled while in the replay client. You must re-enable them in your normal client first before they will work in replay mode. 
#A list of replay files will appear, which the user can select from.
#:[[File:ReplaySelect.jpg]]
#Select a replay file, and the replay session will begin. A control interface will appear in the bottom right corner. The box includes the following functions:
##Begin/Pause replay
##Increase/Decrease Speed (X1/4, X1/2, X1, X2, X4)
##Reset replay
##Return to file section screen (Exit)
#:[[File:ReplayCP.jpg]]

== Limitations ==
To watch a recorded game session, your Ragnarok client must be updated with the same assets (sprites, maps, sounds, etc.) that were used when the replay was originally recorded. Unlike a "normal" video, the visual and audio content is not saved in the replay file, resulting in its very small size. Attempting to watch a replay file in a client with modified or outdated assets may fail to play correctly/accurately. A good rule of thumb is that clients are backwards-compatible with older (asset-wise) replays, and replay files are forwards-compatible with more updated clients, but not vice-versa.

Republic of Schwartzvald
wikitext:
The Republic of Schwartzvald is an adjoining country to the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]]. It seems more technologically advanced than Rune-Midgarts, and it is home to technology-based classes such as the [[Gunslinger]] and [[Blacksmith]] class.

==Location==

The Republic lies to the north of Rune-Midgard. The closest city to the Republic of Schwartzvald is [[Al De Baran]]. It consists of roughly 36 maps and is considerably smaller than Rune-Midgarts. The two other countries in Ragnarok, the [[Arunafeltz States]] and aforementioned Rune-Midgarts Kingdom can be accessed via the International [[Airship]] in [[Juno]].

==Climate==

Schwartzvald's climate is mostly monotonous, a kind of industrial desert as a result of [[Einbroch]] and [[Einbech]]'s mining and industrial operations. The few areas not covered by the desert include Abyss Lake as well as a few maps around Lighthalzen.

==Government==

The Head of State of Schwartzvald is the President, whose office lies in [[Juno]]. Though nominally a Republic, the nature of Schwartzvald's legislative branch is unknown. It is understood that [[Rekenber Corporation]] has great ''de facto'' influence in Schwartzvald politics and has many legislators and has had many past Presidents under its control. The current President was elected under the pledge to eliminate the corruption that plagues the government, but nothing has come of this promise yet.

==Cities and Towns==

*'''[[Juno]]''' is the capital of the Republic of Schwartzvald. It is suspended in the air by the magical Ymir crystals which manifest as blue plumes of light throughout the city.
*'''[[Einbroch]]''' is home to the Gunslinger class and is in the process of an industrial revolution. The huge amount of technology and production creates a lot of smog around the city and leaves the resulting fields around it as far as Juno polluted and sparsely inhabited. Nonetheless, a few monsters have found homes in the surrounding fields, including the Archer's favourite target, the Geographer.
*'''[[Einbech]]''' is a suburban town ajoining Einbroch. It is smaller but has the {{map|id=ein_dun01 Mine Dungeon}} to the north.
*'''[[Lighthalzen]]''' is a city of commerce. Unlike the polluted Einbroch, it is very clean and is populated by wealthy merchants. However, across the city are slums and the tension between the slums and the rest of Lighthalzen is high. Police officers are often patrolling the boundary between the two areas.
*'''[[Hugel]]''' is a small suburban town that is on the outskirts of Yuno. Despite its small gentle atmosphere, nearby are the two of the most difficult dungeons in the game - {{map|id=abyss_01 Abyss Lake}} and {{map|id=tha_t01 Thanatos Tower}}.

title: Rock Ridge
wikitext:
== About Rock Ridge == Rock Ridge was founded on the ideals of innovation, opportunity, and industry. Set against the beautiful backdrop of an arid desert landscape bordering a vast ocean, Rock Ridge transformed into a booming village filled with opportunity - all thanks to the industrious efforts of Pink Rose. :To get there, speak with '''Karem Pucci''' in east Alberta {{Navi|alberta|240|103}}. The first time you talk to him, he will tell you that there's a group of bandits trying to take over the mine and requests your help (beginning of [[Fistful of Zeny]]). === Story === Maritime shipping agency Pink Rose landed upon the shores of Rock Ridge in search of new land to expand their business away from the large monopoly of the Kafra Corporation and Cool Event Corporation. There, Pink Rose discovered an unusual purple ore never before seen in Midgard. Not only did these ores provide potent mana when purified, but they reflected light just as brilliantly as diamonds when cut properly. Pink Rose had hit the jackpot - the new ores were a huge success, selling like hotcakes especially among jewelry collectors and magic practitioners! Emboldened by their initial success and eager to keep it up, Pink Rose recruited miners and volunteers from all over the world and set up a village near its purple ore mine. And thus, Rock Ridge was born! Outside the village of Rock Ridge resides two tribes native to this land - the Cacti and the Taurases. As Rock Ridge grew, the Cacti tribe worked with the newcomers to stabilize the village and aid in their mining efforts. Over time, word of Rock Ridge spread, and people came flocking from Midgard in droves, hoping to start a new life and build a brighter future. Unfortunately, the growing wealth of Rock Ridge did not come without consequence. The Tauras tribe, notorious for pillaging for a living, set their sights on the budding village and sought to take over the source of their wealth. Also known as Buffalo Bandits, these Taurases armed themselves with guns and attacked Rock Ridge and its mine relentlessly. Eventually, they forced their way into the mines and claimed it as their own. == Quests == === Main Quest === *[[Fistful of Zeny]] === Side Quest === *[[Spotty and Her Ring]] *[[Peace of the Family]] === Daily Quest === These quests '''do not''' require quests to be completed first. *[[Contract with the Wealthy Merchant]] *[[New Continent's Food Supplier]] *[[Guardian of Rock Ridge (Normal)]] *[[Guardian of Rock Ridge (Hard)]] *[[Maintain the Colored Pipes]] These quests '''do''' require quests to be completed first. *[[Pipe Cleaning]] *[[Preparing for the Firework Festival]] *[[Collecting Ore Fragments]] *[[Gas! Gas!]] *[[Spotty, No!]] *[[Avenging Spotty]] *[[Hunting Coyotes Again]]
Check out [[Rock Ridge Daily Quests]] for all dailies in one page. == Guide == [[File:RockRidge.png]]

[[Rock Ridge Culvert]] can be accessed in the east side of town through NPCs. == Dungeons == The Rock Ridge Culvert entrance is found at the base of a water storage container {{Navi|harboro1|336|144}}.
