title: Rogue
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobBase=Thief |jobType=2-2 |jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt={{map |id=cmd_fild07 Pharos, Beacon Island}} |skills=20 |skillPoints=131 |questSkills=1 |str=6 |agi=7 |vit=6 |int=4 |dex=7 |luk=0}} [[Image:Rogue.jpg|250px|right]] Rogues are a versatile class, only really lacking in PvM skills but excelling in PvP and WoE. With their strip skills, Rogues can render most classes useless in a PvP environment. With Gank, a Rogue can obtain double the loot another class could gather in the same amount of time. Rogues can wield bows, daggers, or swords and can copy a variety of player skills to help them level, although a Rogue cannot use Intimidate to its full potential like its transcendent counterpart can. On a different note, Rogues can be excellent at soloing things in a PvM environment. Their high dodge, fast attacks, and stealthy nature make them a force to be reckoned with in a dungeon. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Rogue Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into a Rogue from a [[Thief]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks: * A Written Test * Item collection test * Maze test After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Rogue. Most of this takes place inside the Rogue Guild at the Pharos Lighthouse (cmd_fild07). == Builds == === Dagger Gank === Stat Build: * STR: 70-90 * AGI: 60-90 * VIT: 50-80 * INT: 1+ * DEX: 40-70 * LUK: 20-40 Skill Build: * [[Gank]] 10 * [[Mug]] 4 * [[Backstab]] 4 * [[Stalk]] 2 * [[Sightless Mind]] 5 * [[Snatch]] 5 * [[Intimidate]] 10 * [[Sword Mastery]] 9 With max [[Intimidate]], the dagger gank Rogue can level quickly with copied skills ([[Bowling Bash]] and [[Raging Trifecta Blow]] the most common). [[Sword Mastery]] boosts damage with both daggers and one-handed swords, and [[Gank]] doubles loot gain. Those wishing to make zeny can max [[Mug]] in exchange for levels in [[Sword Mastery]] or [[Intimidate]]. Stats-wise, high [[STR]] and high [[AGI]] will guarantee swift and powerful attacks. AGI will provide enough [[FLEE]] to dodge most attacks against single monsters, but [[VIT]] is crucial when tanking multiple monsters due to the FLEE penalty. The dagger gank rogue excels in PvM and will level quickly to achieve [[Stalker]], should PvP or WoE be the ultimate goal. === Bow === Stat Build: * STR: 1-20 * AGI: 50-80 * VIT: 50-80 * INT: 1+ * DEX: 70-90 * LUK: 1 Skill Build: * [[Gank]] 4 * [[Mug]] 4 * [[Backstab]] 4 * [[Stalk]] 2 * [[Vulture's Eye]] 10 * [[Double Strafe]] 5 * [[Sightless Mind]] 5 * [[Snatch]] 5 * [[Intimidate]] 10 Bow rogues can snipe enemies from afar with [[Vulture's Eye]] and [[Double Strafe]], then deal extra damage with a copied skill via [[Intimidate]]. The bow rogue has high DEX and high AGI for quick and devastating damage via bows. Moderate INT ensures a steady SP supply for intimidated skill spamming. While previously the {{item |id=4117 Sidewinder Card}} was preferred for bows used by rogues (because it allows the full level 10 Double Attack to be used with bows), the Kafra Shop {{item |id=5283 Chick Hat}} item which has the same effect, has largely made this obsolete. == Equipment == === Eden Group Equipments Quests === :''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'' Eden Group Equipment is free and a great place to start for gear to use. The Dagger or Bow are good weapons and generally a good choice for a Rogue and their future classes'. === General Equipment Recommendations === :''Main article: [[Equipment]]'' The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well. === Third Class Compatible Equipment === :''Main article: [[Shadow_Chaser#Equipment|Shadow Chaser Equipment]]'' It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only. === Weapons === After considering what requirement skills have (some skills can only be used with certain weapon types), the Weapon Search tool within the iRO Wiki DB site is very helpful. Generally, for physical classes (both melee and ranged), something with high [[ATK]] is best. For magic classes, something with high [[MATK]] is best. | nitemreq = 1 Mask | zenyreq = | questsreq = [[Z-Gang Quest]] | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = 1 Random Level 4 Food, {{Item List |id=644 |item=Gift Box|num=1 |simple=yes}} | qreward = }} #In central [[Prontera]], talk to the Man from Morroc {{Navi|prontera|163|204}}, who says [[Rogue]] agents are infiltrating the Kingdom. #:[[File:Roug invest man.png]] #Go to the Rogue guild at the Pharos Lighthouse {{navi|cmd_fild07|193|117}}, and talk to the Rogue Agent on the first floor (355, 28). He says they've been investigating the recent events, so of course you offer to help him. #Talk to him again, and he tells you to find one of the investigators in [[Al De Baran]]. #Head to Al De Baran, and go to outside of the Super Novice Guild {{navi|aldebaran|114|56}}, and talk to the Agent there. He says the Z-Gang was spreading rumors about a coming war around town, trying to scare people. He hands you a note and asks you to give to another agent in [[Geffen]]. #In Geffen, walk behind the building to the southwest of the central fountain {{navi|geffen|91|36}}. Talk to the agent there, who asks you to bring him back some items from monsters inside the Geffen Tower Dungeon: #:*1 {{item |id=1062 Jack o' Pumpkin}} #:*1 {{item |id=1060 Golden Hair}} #:*1 {{item |id=944 Horseshoe}} #:*1 {{item |id=1038 Little Evil Horn}} #:*1 {{item |id=1059 Fabric}} #Bring him the items, and he thanks you, then tells you to visit the agent in [[Payon]]. #In Payon, go to {{navi|payon|209|44}}, and talk to the agent. At first he asks you to collect Red Herbs, but then changes his mind and asks for a {{item |id=511 Green Herb}}. #Once you have the Green Herb, talk to the agent again, and he says it'll take awhile for it to work. #Talk to him again, and he asks you for 1 {{item |id=970 Alcohol}}. #Bring him the Alcohol, and he thanks you again. #Talk to him again, and he claims he messed up, and needs another Alcohol. #Bring one more Alcohol, and he thanks you again. #Talk to him again, and he gives you a note to give to the agent in [[Comodo]]. #In Comodo, talk to the agent at {{navi|comodo|233|199}}. He asks you to bring 2 Masks. #:*Note:''You only need to bring 1 Mask, and he doesn't take it from you.'' #Talk to him again, and he admits he thought you were a new Rogue trainee. He asks you not to tell anyone about what he asked you to do, and sends you to talk to the [[Morroc]] agent. He also gives you a random Level 4 Food Item. #In Morroc, talk to the agent by a building at {{navi|morroc|116|39}}. He asks you to report back to the Rogue Guild for him. #Return to the Rogue Guild, and talk to the agent again. He asks why they stirred up so much trouble, and thanks you and rewards you with {{Item List |id=644 |item=Gift Box|num=1 |simple=yes}}. [[Category:Comodo Quests]]

title: Rogue Job Change Guide
wikitext:
{{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = 40 | classreq = Thief | partyreq = | itemreq = Varies | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = {{item |id=1097 Worn Out Page}}, {{item |id=1220 Gladius [3]}} (Job 50) -OR-
{{item |id=1219 Gladius [2]}} (Job 40~49) | qreward = Jobchange to [[Rogue]] }} 1. Go to the {{map |id=cmd_fild07 Pharos Lighthouse}} (cmd_fild07). To get there, go to [[Comodo]] or [[Morroc]] and speak to the [[Kafra]] for a warp. (You will have to walk there if you're not [[VIP]], or ask a Priest for a Warp. To get there, Kafra warp to Comodo from Prontera. Then, go east, east, south, east, east, and south. Some of the monsters a long the way are aggressive and can use powerful magic spells, so be sure to bring Fly Wings). 2. You will need to take the portal in the lighthouse {{navi|cmd_fild07|193|117}} downstairs and speak with the Rogue Guildsman {{navi|in_rogue|363|122}}. [[Image:Rogue_Guildsman.jpg]] 3. Markie will ask you one of the following sets of questions (answers given in '''bold'''). You must get at least 9 out of 10 questions correct to pass the test. '''Set 1''' # ''Which monster drops a slotted Gladius?'' '''Kobold''' # ''Which monster drops a slotted Main-Gauche?'' '''Hornet''' # ''Choose the class that is able to create unique potions.'' '''Alchemist''' # ''Choose the weapon that Rogues aren't allowed to use.'' '''Katar''' # ''Choose the property that the Hode monster possesses.'' '''Earth''' # ''Choose the monster that is unable to be tamed for as a Cute Pet.'' '''Creamy''' # ''Choose the monster that receives more damage from a Dagger with the Fire property.'' '''Hammer Goblin''' # ''Choose the town that doesn't have any guild castles.'' '''Alberta''' # ''Choose the plant that drops Blue Herbs.'' '''Blue Plant''' or '''Shining Plant''' # ''Choose the monster that does not have the Undead property.'' '''Familiar''' '''Set 2''' # ''By what percentage is the flee rate increased when a Thief masters the Improve Dodge?'' '''30''' # ''Choose the monster that detects a characters using the Hiding or Cloaking skill.'' '''Argos''' # ''Choose the location where Thieves can change their jobs to Rogues.'' '''Paros Lighthouse''' # ''In which town can Novice change their Jobs to Thieves?'' '''Morroc''' # ''Choose the card that does not affect the DEX stat.'' '''Mummy Card''' # ''So what's cool about being a Rogue?'' '''''any answer is correct''''' # ''When is it possible to change from Thief to Rogue?'' '''At Job Level 40''' or '''At Job Level 50''' # ''You want to dye your hair blue. What town do you go to, and in which directing, with 12 o'clock being North.'' '''Prontera, 7 o'clock''' # ''Choose the mushroom that is required on the Thief job change quest.'' '''Orange Gooey Mushroom''' or '''Orange Net Mushroom''' # ''Choose the card that least benefits the Rogue class.'' '''Elder Willow Card''' '''Set 3''' # ''Choose the skill necessary for learning Stalk.'' '''Hiding''' # ''In comparison to the Merchant's Level 10 Discount skill, how much more of a discount, in terms of percent, can a Rogue get with Level 10 Haggle skill?'' '''1 %''' # ''What is the correct description for the skill, Mug?'' '''Steal Zeny from monsters''' # ''How many Rogues does it require to activate the skill, Slyness?'' '''2 Rogues''' # ''Choose the skill that you can learn at Level 5 Divest Helm.'' '''Divest Shield''' # ''Choose the skill which allows its user to move while hiding.'' '''Stalk''' # ''Choose the card that increases the accuracy rate of its owner.'' '''Mummy Card.''' # ''Choose the monster that receives more damage with its attacked by a weapon with the Vadon card (20 % more damage on Fire property).'' '''Elder Willow''' # ''How much SP does the skill Double Attack require when used with a Dagger?'' '''Passive skill, no SP required.''' # ''Choose the most efficient dagger to use in the Byalan Dungeon.'' '''Wind Main-Gauche''' 4. Once you have passed the written test, you will be sent to Mr. Smith {{navi|in_rogue|376|23}} on the floor above. He will tell you to go collect items. There are a few different sets of items. Listed Below. [[Image:Rogue_Mr._Smith.jpg]] {| class="wikitablec" |- ! Set !! Items |- | Set 1 || 10,000 [[Zeny]], 5 {{item |id=507 Red Herb}}, 5 {{item |id=914 Fluff}}, 5 {{item |id=705 Clover}}, 5 {{item |id=1002 Iron Ore}}, 5 {{item |id=713 Empty Bottle}}, 5 {{item |id=915 Chrysalis}}, 5 {{item |id=908 Spawn}}, 5 {{item |id=913 Tooth of Bat}}, 5 {{item |id=916 Feather of Birds}}, 5 {{item |id=917 Talon}}, 5 {{item |id=528 Monster Feed}}, 5 {{item |id=919 Animal Skin}}, 5 {{item |id=953 Stone Heart}}, 5 {{item |id=904 Scorpion Tail}}, 5 {{item |id=942 Yoyo Tail}}, 5 {{item |id=715 Yellow Gemstone}}, 5 {{item |id=945 Racoon Leaf}} |- | Set 2 || 10,000 Zeny, 10 {{item |id=508 Yellow Herb}}, 10 {{item |id=935 Shell}}, 10 {{item |id=940 Grasshopper's Leg}}, 10 {{item |id=948 Bear's Footskin}} |- | Set 3 || 10,000 Zeny, 10 {{item |id=910 Garlet}}, 10 {{item |id=926 Snake Scale}}, 10 {{item |id=511 Green Herb}}, 10 {{item |id=964 Crab Shell}} |- | Set 4 || 10,000 Zeny, 10 {{item |id=932 Skel-Bone}}, 10 {{item |id=957 Decayed Nail}}, 10 {{item |id=958 Horrendous Mouth}}, 6 {{item |id=510 Blue Herb}} |} 5. After bringing back the correct items, Mr. Smith will send you to look for his partners. He will give you a password in his clue. Make sure you write this password down. *'''Note''': Players who were given Item Set 1 by Mr. Smith will be directed to Hermanthorn Jr. They will be given a much easier maze to traverse. '''Aragham Jr.''' {{map |id=cmd_fild09 Fortress Saint Darmain (South)}} {{navi|cmd_fild09|106|195}} Password: Aragham never hoarded upgrade items. [[Image:Rogue_Aragham_Jr.jpg]] '''Hollgrehenn Jr.''' {{map |id=cmd_fild09 Fortress Saint Darmain (South)}} {{navi|cmd_fild09|335|143}} Password: My father never hoarded upgrade items. [[Image:Rogue_Hollgrehenn_Jr.jpg]] '''Antonio Jr.''' {{map |id=cmd_fild04 Kokomo Beach}} {{navi|cmd_fild04|302|177}} Password: Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items. [[Image:Rogue_Antonio_Jr.jpg]] '''Hermanthorn Jr.''' {{map |id=cmd_fild07 Kokomo Beach}} {{navi|cmd_fild07|349|285}} No password is needed to enter the building. However, to enter the maze, you will be given the code '''3019'''. [[Image:Rogue_Hermanthorn_Jr.jpg]] 6. As soon as you are inside you will be asked if you are ready to enter to maze. (Tip: Hotkey Backslide, Hide and have Authoritative Badges if you have access to them. A pair of Peco Wings will make this a breeze). You will be able to hide from any monster you encounter in the maze. A good tip would be just stay close to the wall. If you fail the first time, just try it until you get it right. The map below represents the maze that Antonio Jr., Hollgrehenn Jr., and Aragham Jr. will send you to. The tiles marked in blue will summon monsters onto the nearby red tiles when you step on them. (Be careful not to touch them if you retreat, touching them more than once will summon more than one mob) [[Image:Rogue Maze.png|200px|center|thumb|Click Image to Enlarge]] · '''Note''': You can wear a Frilldora compounded Garment to be able to use Cloaking along walls without worry. The monsters spawning in the maze cannot detect hidden characters so you can finish the test without any trouble. 7. Once you escape from the maze, talk to the Rogue Guildsman (Markie) and who will promote you to Rogue. * [[Thief|Thieves]] changing into Rogues at Job Level 50 will be given a {{item |id=1220 Gladius [3]}} as a reward; those changing below 50 will receive a {{item |id=1219 Gladius [2]}}. {{Navbox Rogue}} [[Category:Rogue]] [[Category:Job_Change_Guide]]

title: Rogue Skill Quest
wikitext:
== Close Confine Quest == {{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = 35 | classreq = Rogue | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Ability to use [[Close Confine]] }} *'''Note:''' If you have learned this skill as a Rogue and have since transcended, proceed to step 3 and speak to Haijara Greg to regain the skill instantly. 1. Talk to one of the sons to start the quest, recommended is Thor Greg because he is closest to Beacon Island, Pharos. He may be also the only one that spills the hiding place of his father once the player talks to him twice. [[Image:close_confine_1.jpg]] Beacon Island, Pharos (cmd_fild07): 351,286 2. He will say his father, Haijara Greg is being pursued and will mention that the rogue guild leader says the secret hiding place is next to her. [[Image:close_confine_2.jpg]] 3. Visit said Haijara Greg inside the rogue guild, go down the stairs to the rogue job change npc and continue going left. Up towards the beds, there's a secret wall passage. [[Image:close_confine_3.jpg]] 4. Talk to the father and he will ask some questions. Answering with a wrong question leaves the player with 1 HP. Correct answers in order: *I don't mean you any harm! *I came to help you. *No. *Sure! [[Image:close_confine_4.jpg]] 5. He will then ask the player to visit his son, Louis Greg, who happens to be in Hollgrehenn Jr.'s building 1 map east of Paros Lighthouse. [[Image:close_confine_5.jpg]] For those who forget, the password to enter the building: ''My father never hoarded upgrade items.''
On other server it can be however different, like on prime it is: ''My father did not steal refining material.'' 6. He will then ask to talk to his brother Thor Greg, whose location can be found above at the beginning the quest. [[Image:close_confine_6.jpg]] 7. Talking to Thor Greg again, he will ask to talk to his brother Jay Greg, who can be found inside Antonio Jr.'s building. 1 North and 1 West of Paros Lighthouse. [[Image:close_confine_7.jpg]] Kokomo Beach (cmd_fild04): 302,177. For those who forget, the password to enter the building: Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items. 8. Once inside, talking to he will ask to return to his father to tell him that he will receive help. [[Image:close_confine_8.jpg]] 9. His father will then ask to once again visit Thor Greg to receive training for the Close Confine skill. Thor Greg will send the player to a waiting room. The player must enter a chat room and wait for anyone who's in line to finish before him. [[Image:close_confine_9.jpg]] 10. Here is where the fun starts. The players have 5 minutes before they are kicked out. Kienna will appear in one second as the room warns, and the player must walk right up 1 cell next to her before she hides, or she will disappear and the player will be sent back to the middle of the room to repeat. [[Image:close_confine_10.jpg]] 11. Upon successfully walking up to her she will prompt the player. Reminiscent of the battle dwarf of the God Items Quest for level 4 weapons, the player must choose the right option corresponding to the aura Kienna has: Block her from the left when her aura is white, Block her from the right when her aura is yellow, or Block her moving backward when her aura is red. To pass the test, the player must perform above grade C+. Upon success she will return the player to Thor Greg. He will tell the player to go back to his father to finish learning the skill. [[Image:close_confine_11.jpg]] 12. Upon returning to Haijara Greg to master the skill, a thief in the shape of a guard steals his book. The player must once again do the test, doing a similar blocking session, far easier, in which it tells you to watch the auras the thief displays and respond by picking the according direction, doing so successfully will get the book back. Once completed, talk to Haijara, and he will give you Close Confine. [[Image:close_confine_12.jpg]] {{Navbox Rogue}} [[Category: Quests]] [[Category: Skill Quests]] [[Category: Rogue]]

10 [[Honor Token]] (daily) | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} === Walkthrough === #Go to Royal Memory, by either: #*Talk to '''Chamberlain Bell''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|26|30}} and choose ''Call Nillem''. Talk to '''Court Mage Nillem''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|28|28}} and choose ''Move to the Past Memories of the Royal Family'', or #*Talk to '''Overwatcher Terketh''' {{Navi|prt_pri00|55|128}} and choose ''To the Past Memories of the Royal Family''. #Once inside the Royal Memory, talk to '''Mage Nillem''' {{Navi|prt_lib|91|85}} again and a Dimensional Warper appears. #Use the '''Dimension Warper''' to be taken back to the Old Memoir of Royal Family. #Talk to '''Nillem''' {{Navi|prt_lib_q|91|85}} to reserve the instance, then the '''Swaying Space''' to start the instance. #Talk to '''Fenrir''' (1@mir 103,40) at the entrance. #Walk up to the altar and talk to '''Iris''' (1@mir 100,94). They find a Ymir Heart piece, as a small number of mildly weak skeletons appear (12k HP or so). #:There are two waves of Enhanced Skeletons. #:[[File:RoomOfConciousness_enchantedSkeleton.png]][[File:RoomOfConciousness_enchantedArcherSkeleton.png]] #Once the waves of monsters are done, speak with '''Iris''' (1@mir 103,85). #It will spawn a [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/3448/renovated-amdarais '''Renovated Amdarais''']. #* Renovated Amdarais is a non-boss monster, therefore [[Turn Undead]], [[Resurrection]] and {{Item List |id=610 |item=Yggdrasil Leaf |simple=yes}} have a chance to kill it. [[File:Amandaris Resurrection Kill.gif|right|thumb||Renovated Amdarais killed by Yggdrasil Leaf.]] #:[[File:RoomOfConciousness_renovatedAmdarais.png]] #Talk to '''Iris''' once it's defeated, and then {{monster|id=3450 Bijou}} will attack you herself. She'll attack you with a very weak version of herself. Then she will attack again with her normal boss self. #:'''Note:''' You can lure the monsters to Iris and Fenrir, and they will do a small portion of damage (1.5M - 2M) to the bosses. [[Lex Aeterna]] does not affect this damage #:[[File:RoomOfConciousness_bijou.png]] #After defeating '''Bijou''', talk to '''Iris''' (1@mir 100,95) to exit the instance. === Strategy for Weak Players === *Note: Player needs any [[Cute_Pet_System|pet]], such as Poring, following them to make this as easiest as possible. (Homunculus for Geneticist also works) :#During the fights with Renovated Amdarais and Bijou, after hitting the monsters at least once, NPCs Iris and Fenrir may sometimes spawn in the center. :#The player may lure Amdarais or Bijou far away to edge of the instance. :#Player, with a pet, then walks near Iris and Fenrir who may deal a map wide 1,500,000 - 2,000,000 damage attack (not affected by [[Lex Aeterna]]). :#*There is chance to fail dealing damage. :#Then the player waits for NPCs Iris and Fenrir to spawn again, walk near them with your pet again to trigger the map wide attack. :#Keep repeating the above steps until an announcement says monster is out of HP. :#*Renovated Amdarais has no announcement, so hit it every once in a while. :#Attack the monster that has only 10 HP left to kill it. *Renovated Amdarais is a non-boss monster, therefore [[Turn Undead]], [[Resurrection]], and {{Item List |id=610 |item=Yggdrasil Leaf |simple=yes}} have a chance to kill it. *It's possible to avoid Bijou's skill attacks: first lure her to one side of a corner at the base of the platform (to the left or right of the stairs, where one of the torches are), then during her skills that have a long cast time simply walk around the corner and stand there a moment to break line of sight until she finishes casting, and then walk back around the corner to maintain her position so you can repeat rounding the corner to break line of sight whenever she starts a long cast. {{Navbox Instance}} [[Category:Instances]]

A list of Daily Quest for Level 100: {{Repeatable|cooldown=16 hours}} ==The Dress== #Speak to '''Agnes''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|96|184}} inside the Rougenbourg residence. #She will ask for some items. '''Cooldown quest name:''' Still Making It ==Today I Feel== *Player must finish [[The Royal Banquet#Wigner Sidequest: The Maid and the Jewelry Box|Wigner sidequest]] to start this quest *For first-timers: #Catch up with '''Jurgen Wigner''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|94|10}} and the maid comes in hoping to clean. Jurgen becomes infatuated with her and has you deliver a letter to her. #Bring the letter to the '''Maid''' {{Navi|prt_cas|322|216}} in the kitchen. He wants to reuse his gift to his sister, so he wants you to collect {{Item List |id=6927 |item=Sea Stone |num=15 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=748 |item=Witherless Rose |num=1 |simple=yes}}. #*{{Item List |id=6927 |item=Sea Stone | simple=yes}} drop rate is about 25% from {{monster |id=1148 Medusa}} #Give those items to '''Maid''' who appreciates the beauty of the gifts. But just like in a soap opera, the maid isn't the maid from the previous quest; it's her BROTHER! The first maid ran off and he had to cover her job so he became a maid. (Kudos to kRO for implying same-sex love) #Return to '''Jurgen Wigner''' and tell him that the maid hasn't fully accepted his heart. He wants you to return every day to assure the maid of his love. He rewards you with 4 [[Honor Token]], {{tooltip|200,000|300,000 for VIP}} Base EXP & {{tooltip|200,000|300,000 for VIP}} Job EXP. *For repeated runs: #Speak to '''Jurgen Wigner''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|94|10}} in Wigner residence. #Collect {{Item List |id=6927 |item=Sea Stone |num=15 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=748 |item=Witherless Rose |num=1 |simple=yes}}. There is no need to come with more sea stone than required because all of them will be taken by the maid. #Deliver to the '''Maid''' {{Navi|prt_cas|322|216}} in the kitchen. #Return to '''Jurgen Wigner''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|94|10}} to get 4 [[Honor Token]], {{tooltip|200,000|300,000 for VIP}} Base EXP & {{tooltip|200,000|300,000 for VIP}} Job EXP. [[Image:Royal Guard.jpeg|240px|right]]
[[Royal Guard]]s are an elite order of [[Paladin]]s that originally served under King Schmidtz of Glast Heim. King Schmidtz knew that to defend his kingdom from the terrors and chaos of the world he would need a special defense unit that answered only to him. That is how the Griffon-riding Royal Guards came to be. Their name is often abbreviated and then referred to as just "RG".
 
At a glance, this class has relatively good HP pool and an excellent SP pool, when compared to their class counterpart. Unlike [[Rune Knight]]s, which are typically forced into Dragon Breath types of builds, the [[Royal Guard]] has the option of playing with  builds that involve {{Skill List|id=2319|skill=Banding|simple=yes}} two or more Royal Guards together; a Royal Guard can play Defense or Offense very effectively, given proper foresight of his/her skill tree. In addition to gaining new and powerful offensive skills, the Royal Guard can easily draw upon its older skills, such as {{Skill List|id=249|skill=Guard|simple=yes}}, {{Skill List|id=258|skill=Spear Quicken|simple=yes}}, {{Skill List|id=255|skill=Sacrifice|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=480|skill=Rapid Smiting|simple=yes}}. This makes for one very powerful, vastly dynamic, and exciting class.

=== Cannon Spear Build (2024) ===
==== Introduction ====
{{Skill List|id=2307|skill=Cannon Spear|simple=yes}} triggers critical damage. It needs 100+ Crit and does half of Critical Damage. The skill formula relies heavily on STR and hence needs high STR values. Since, it is a ranged skill, Long Range damage modifiers are also very helpful.
It also has 2 Second cooldown which can be reduced by some of the equipment, shadow gear, or costume stone enchant.

==== Skills ====
Mandatory:
* {{Skill List|id=2307|skill=Cannon Spear|simple=yes}}
* {{Skill List|id=2312|skill=Pinpoint Attack|simple=yes}}: For Equipment set
* {{Skill List|id=2325|skill=Inspiration|simple=yes}}: For Equipment set, nice buff skill
* {{Skill List|id=2315|skill=Shield Spell|simple=yes}}: For HP/SP recovery, or Extra ATK/MATK
* {{Skill List|id=258|skill=Spear Quicken|simple=yes}}: For ASPD and CRIT bonus
* {{Skill List|id=64|skill=Cavalier Mastery|simple=yes}}: For walking faster. (Some skills or equipment might be affected by using or not using a mount)

Optional:

=== Genesis Ray / Ray of Genesis Build (2024) ===

==== Introduction ====
{{Skill List|id=2321|skill=Genesis Ray|simple=yes}} is a magical skill build. It depends on MATK and magical damage boosting skills. The skill formula depends on INT so that helps boosting damage further. Since, it is a magical skill, all modifiers that boost magical damage will help this build. Inspiration can be used to change the element of the skill to Neutral.

#: [[File:Malaya-OldLegendTeller.png|250px]]
# Ask him about calming down Bakonawa. After his explanation, offer him for help. He tells you that there is a Slate Piece he left but it is small, damaged, and hard to identify. He tells you that his granddaughter holds the piece. Meet his granddaughter near the harbor.
# Speak the '''Old Man's Granddaughter''' near the harbor {{Navi|malaya|304|100}}. She asks you why would you need something that is barely recognizable. She gives you the Old Slate Piece (not seen in your inventory).

Having absolutely no idea where to start and being trembled of the spirits that haunts the forest, he asks you to visit an immigrant that lives at the north-western part of the forest to gather information about the wandering merchant.
# Find the '''Malaya Immigrant''' {{Navi|ma_fild02|40|240}} at the north-western part of the forest. Speak with him and he tells you that he heard Bakonawa has been threatening the villagers.
#: [[File:Malaya-mf02_MalayaImmigrant.png|250px]]

# After what you've read from the stone. You decide to tell it to the Old Legend Teller.
# Return to the Old Legend Teller and tell him what you read. He asks you if you can defeat Bakonawa. Accept his request and he rewards you with 3 {{Item |id=6499 Ancient Grudge}} as a sign of gratitude. He also tells the Village Chief to grant you access to the lake where Bakonawa resides.

title: Rune Knight
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobType=3-1 |jobBase=Lord Knight |jobLevel = 70 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Glast Heim]] |skills=13 |skillPoints=100 |questSkills=0 |str=6 |agi=6 |vit=7 |int=10 |dex=9 |luk=5 }} [[Image:Rune_Knight.jpg|240px|right]] Rune Knights are the final evolution of the Knight classes. Their name is often abbreviated and referred to as "RK". They have traded in their Pecos for new dragon mounts and are ready to do some serious damage with an arsenal of new powerful attacks while also having the highest HP pool compared to other classes. Rune Knights have a slower startup leveling-wise, but they can become one of the most versatile and powerful classes in the game. Unfortunately, they suffer from a poor skill tree layout, forcing players to have to get 22 job points to max a basic AOE leveling skill ([[Ignition Break]]), or going with a [[Dragon Breath]] build early on, which may not be very strong in the first 20-30 levels. Rune Knights aspiring to have a Dragon Breath end-game build but do not want to use a skill/stat reset may resort to being mainly a party tank for 20-30 base levels until their HP and SP pools are higher for better damage, as that is how the [[Dragon Breath]] skill formula is calculated. The upside is that [[Bowling Bash]] and [[Brandish Spear]] is one of the most powerful non-third class AOEs and can be used until level 110-120 or so, but does require a good weapon. Dragon Breath ignores reductions in PVP / WoE and is one of the main killing skills, but depends on party buffs such as [[Magic Strings]] and [[Sacrament]]. Finally, there are the the runes themselves. Players who choose the Rune Knight class are introduced to a new system of buffs and attacks in the form of rune stones. These consumables provide the user with immensely powerful buffs that range anywhere from a large increase in DEF/MDEF, potting ability, and massive damage increase. Unfortunately, creating runes consumes materials, but their sheer power makes them worth their cost. It is highly recommended that every Rune Knight should get the maximum level of [[Rune Mastery]]. == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Rune Knight Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' This test is very easy, but it is strongly recommended to have high DEX (70 DEX is recommended) or use a high level of [[Twohand Quicken]] and [[Spear Dynamo]] for the final part due to the mobs having such high flee rate. You will be pitted up against three very powerful minibosses. You must time the use of your runes accordingly to allow yourself time to heal/get in hits. === Job Change Quest Skip === Note that you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip] == Alternate Job Sprite == At Base Level 170, you can change your Job Sprite to the alternative jRO version by following the instructions found [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Clothes_Dye#Second_Costume_Ticket here]. Spears|simple=yes}} is a 3rd class offensive skill available as Rune Knight. Deals great damage to a target, also enemies in range. Damage increases as BaseLv and slv of Spiral Pierce increase. It involves a flurry of five consecutive spear thrusts against a single target. There's a chance that after the attack, the skill "Spear Boomerang" will activate, pushing the target back six cells. The skill requires the user to wield a spear-type weapon. Rcommended Refine |- |align=center|{{Item List 2|id=24681|item=Maximum Mammoth Shadow Earring|simple=yes}} |align=center|1 |align=center|10 |- |align=center|{{Item List 2|id=24877|item=Focusing Shadow Earring|simple=yes}} |align=center|200 |align=center|10 |- |align=center|{{Item List 2|id=24661|item=Full Penetration Shadow Earring|simple=yes}} |align=center|1 |align=center|10 |} ==== Costume ==== * {{Item List 2|id=310257|item=Rune Knight Stone II (Garment)|simple=yes}} ** When equipped with {{Item List 2|id=310881|item=Rune Knight Stone (Upper)|simple=yes}}, increases damage by 15%. ** When equipped with {{Item List 2|id=310260|item=Lord Knight Stone II (Lower)|simple=yes}}, increases damage by 15%. * {{Item List 2|id=310325|item=Range Stone (Upper)|simple=yes}} ** Increases long ranged physical damage by 3%. * {{Item List 2|id=310330 |item=Range Stone (Middle)|simple=yes}} ** Increases long ranged physical damage by 3%. * {{Item List 2|id=310326 |item=Range Stone (Lower)|simple=yes}} ** Increases long ranged physical damage by 3%. * {{Item List 2|id=310660 |item=Range Stone (Dual)|simple=yes}} ** Increases long ranged physical damage by 4%. ** Total combo of Range Stone Upper, Middle, Lower and Dual will increases long ranged physical damage by 10%. * {{Item List 2|id=311470|item=Range Physical Attack Stone (Garment)|simple=yes}} ** Increases [[P.ATK]] +3. ** Total combo of Range Stone Upper, Middle, Lower and Range Physical Attack Stone will increases extra [[P.ATK]] +3 and [[CON]] +3. ==== Suggested Runes ==== Some of the runes from [[Rune Mastery]] are very helpful for [[Hundred Spears]] RKs. They are recommended to be used at Lvl 130+. * {{Item List |id=12731 |item=Turisus Runestone |simple=yes}} For extra STR and ATK. * {{Item List |id=12728 |item=Isia Runestone |simple=yes}} For better healing with Syrups * {{Item List |id=22540 |item=Lux Anima Runestone |simple=yes}} Overall one of the best RK Rune. For more HP/SP, ATK and Damage boost. * {{Item List |id=12729 |item=Asir Runestone |simple=yes}} For more ATK and ASPD. * {{Item List |id=12733 |item=Hagalas Runestone |simple=yes}} For extra DEF, increase physical and magical armor. === '''Sonic Wave (2025)''' === ==== Introduction ==== an offshoot of ignition break build which focuses on attacking single targets at a distance, thus not being affected by reflect shield, the stat spread and talents are the same as an IB build with the only difference being the equipment.
early on a sonic wave rune knight can use the peuz set with {{Item List|id=21038|item=Oriental Sword|simple=yes|slots=2}} or the upgraded {{Item List|id=600009|item=Awakened Onimaru|simple=yes|slots=2}} as an autocaster, benefiting from the {{Item List|id=24288|item=Rune Knight Shadow Weapon|simple=yes|slots=}} chance of using ignition break and peuz's chance of using {{Item List|id=12732 |item=Pertz Runestone|simple=yes|slots=}}, the damage of this build takes off after lv170 when they are allowed to equip the edda biolab weapon and helmet combo with zodiac boots which eliminates the cooldown of sonic wave, allowing them to manually cast the skill for greater damage.
==== Equipment ==== *+11 {{Item List|id=21052 |item=Vernan|simple=yes|slots=2}} enchanted with {{Item List|id=29594 |item=Seyren's Memory|simple=yes|slots=}} *+11 {{Item List|id=400078 |item=Biolab Aries Crown|simple=yes|slots=1}} *+11 {{Item List|id=470255 |item=Zodiac Boots (Swordman)|simple=yes|slots=1}} *{{Item List|id=450086|item=Grace Breath Armor|simple=yes|slots=1}} + {{Item List|id=490206|item=Noblesse Oblige|simple=yes|slots=1}} * {{Item List|id=490113|item=Jasper Ring|simple=yes|slots=1}} ==== Shadow Equipment ==== these shadow equipments improve Sonic Wave damage, SP consumption and provide some def bypass, but they are far from being the best. * {{Item List|id=24288|item=Rune Knight Shadow Weapon|simple=yes|slots=}}, {{Item List|id=24440|item=Sonic Shadow Armor|simple=yes|slots=}}, {{Item List|id=24442|item=Sonic Shadow Shoes|simple=yes|slots=}} and {{Item List|id=24441|item=Sonic Shadow Shield|simple=yes|slots=}} note that Vernan's cooldown reduction also works when {{Item List|id=29594 |item=Seyren's Memory|simple=yes|slots=}} is enchanted in {{Item List|id=490614|item=Memory Records of Nostalgia|simple=yes|slots=1}} and {{Item List|id=490615|item=Memory Records of Reminiscences |simple=yes|slots=1}}, although the accessory itself doesn't benefit the build as much. {{Navbox Knight}} {{Navbox Classes}}

title: Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
wikitext:
The Rune-Midgarts Kingdom is the main country in the world of Ragnarok.  With over 50 separate map areas, it is also by far the largest.  With regions ranging from dense jungles to arid deserts to temperate forests, it has a highly varied landscape.  
==Location==

The Republic lies to the south of [[Republic of Schwartzvald]]. The closest city to the Rune-Midgarts being [[Juno]].  It is also to the west of many different foreign lands.  The other two countries in Ragnarok, the [[Arunafeltz States]] and aforementioned Republic of Schwartzvald can be accessed via the International [[Airship]] in [[Izlude]].

==Climate==

The kingdom has many varied and different types of climate, with jungles to the southwest, desert in the south, and forest in the remainder.  There are numerous rivers and mountains, as well as lakes and grasslands. 

==Government==

The Head of State of Rune-Midgarts, is the king, who resides in a castle in the capital city of [[Prontera]].  The king commands a legion of [[Knight]]s and [[Crusader]]s who protect the kingdom from outside forces, though the kingdom does have a peace treaty with its closest neighbor, the [[Republic of Schwartzvald]].

==Cities and Towns==

*'''[[Prontera]]''' is the capital of Rune-Midgarts. It is the economic center of the country, where [[Merchant]]s gather to vend their findings, and citizens chat and gather into [[Party|parties]].  Prontera is home to the [[Acolyte]], [[Knight]], and [[Crusader]] guilds. 
*'''[[Izlude]]''' is a small satellite town of Prontera, home to the [[Swordman]] guild.  The town is known for its battle arena, as well as the airship link to the other two countries in Ragnarok. 
*'''[[Jawaii]]''' can be found off the shores of the mainland.  It is a tropical paradise used by couples for rest and relaxation.  The warm beaches there are sublime, though the hotel accomodations may leave something to be desired.  
*'''[[Geffen]]''' is known as the magic city, which is apt considering it is the base for the [[Mage]] and [[Wizard]] guilds.  Geffen is located to the west of Prontera on and island.  The center of town is dominated by the famous Geffen Tower.
*'''[[Payon]]''' is a quiet Korean-style city located to the southeast of Prontera.  It is home to the [[TaeKwon Kid]] and [[TaeKwon Master]] classes, and its neighbor Archer Village is home to the [[Archer]] class.  The town has a large palace at the northern end of town and is located in the midst of a dense forest.
*'''[[Morroc]]''' resides in the middle of a sprawling desert.  It is home to the [[Soul Linker]] class, and the nearby pyramids house the [[Thief]] guild.  Further to the southeast is the [[Assassin]]'s guild.  The town has a large castle in the center. 
*'''[[Alberta]]''' is a seaside town famous for its light and airy atmosphere.  It is home to the [[Merchant]] guild, and is the gateway to many exciting foreign lands and dungeons.
*'''[[Comodo]]''' is the true party city of the country, with gambling, festivities, and many ways to have fun.  The town is home to the [[Bard]] and [[Dancer]] guilds, and has a large volcano in the center of it.  Comodo is unique in that it is located inside a cave.  
*'''[[Umbala]]''' is a city built up in the high treetops of a jungle.  Gateway to [[Nifflheim]], Umbala is famous for its isolated tribe of people, who speak an entirely different language from that of the rest of the country.  It is governed by a chief.
*'''[[Al De Baran]]''' is the northernmost city in the country, just to the south of the [[Republic of Schwartzvald]].  Home to the [[Alchemist]] guild, it is also the location of the Clock Tower dungeon, and is the gateway to [[Lutie]], the Christmas town.
*'''[[Lutie]]''' can be described as "Christmas every day" in that it has a giganic Christmas tree in the center, along with a Toy Factory dungeon.  Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus can also be found, working away until December 25th.

wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobName=Sage |jobBase=Mage |jobType=2-2 |jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Juno]] |skills=20 |skillPoints=116 |questSkills=2 |str=5 |agi=5 |vit=3 |int=9 |dex=5 |luk=3 }} [[Image:Sage.jpg|240px|right]] Sages are a PvP-oriented class with the role of caster/anti-[[Mage]]. They do not have the offensive abilities of a [[Wizard]], but are a slightly buffed version of Mage with their [[Free Cast]]ing. Sages shine in their defensive abilities, with many builds centered around [[Magnetic Earth]]. [[Dispell]] is also a popular and sought-after spell which is useful for removing buffs from the enemy. Many of their skills can only realistically be used in PvP, making PvM quite difficult, particularly for [[VIT]]/[[DEX]] builds that have difficulty solo levelling. Battle sages are a 'for fun' build which can become a powerful leveling build only if matched with a [[Soul Linker]] (see [[Sage Spirit]] for more info). == Job Change Guide == ''See [[Sage Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.'' Changing into a Sage from a [[Mage]] requires the player to complete a number of tasks: * Item Collection * Written Test * Battle Test * Thesis Composition After completing these tests, the player will be transformed into a Sage. This takes place in [[Juno]]. == Builds == Generally the best two Bolts to max are [[Fire Bolt]] and [[Lightning Bolt]]. The former is pretty much a given and LB is chosen because it is on the opposite side of the elements table. What this means is that having both FB and LB covers all the basic elements with no room for weakness. FB/CB on the other hand is weak to Water, as neither element is effective against it. Leveling skills generally include [[Thunderstorm]], [[Fireball]], and [[Heaven's Drive]] for AoE. All three Bolt skills are not bad for single target damage. It is recommended to skip PvP oriented skills as a Sage, such as [[Stone Curse]] and [[Magnetic Earth]], and only acquire these after rebirth for use at a higher level as a [[Sorcerer]]. Although a single target battle build can be enjoyable, if partied with a [[Priest]] or if using HP [[Healing Items]], a pure PvM caster build yields much faster exp rates (AoE leveling is faster than killing single targets). Their ''endows can be indispensable'' for other classes, hence many Sages are built for slaving purposes only. === Basic Sage Leveling Build === * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 60-80 * INT: 80-99 * DEX: 50-80 * LUK: 10-30 '''Skill build:''' [http://irowiki.org/~himeyasha/skill4/sag.html?10eKaknadxIOagbsrF3eAJy Skill Simulator] Sages start off with decent Magic AoEs with [[Thunderstorm]] and [[Fireball]], and can pick off single targets with bolt spells. Unfortunately towards later levels (after about 85) it may not be possible to one shot monsters anymore with the bolt skills, and Thunderstorm and Fireball may not be reliable or quick enough to use. That is why players should prepare their builds with a decent amount of VIT for survivability to tank the monsters while recasting during solo leveling, or also survivability in party situations. Later levels will be spent either aiding with additional damage and Endow buffs in parties, or finding mobs weak to the Earth element to AoE with Heavens Drive. The rebirthed Sage, the [[Scholar]] gains access to very useful SP giving / recovering support skills with [[Soul Exhale]] and [[Indulge]], and becomes an extremely useful support class. === Hindsight === '''With Soul Linker''' * STR: 1 * AGI: 80-99 * VIT: 50-80 * INT: 80-99 * DEX: 20-40 * LUK: 10-30 '''Without Soul linker''' * STR: 30-50 * AGI: 80-99 * VIT: 50-80 * INT: 80-99 * DEX: 40-60 * LUK: 10-30 '''CRIT Build Without Soul Linker''' (the better of the 2 non-soul linked builds) * STR: 30-50 * AGI: 80-99 * VIT: 50-80 * INT: 80-99 * DEX: 20-40 (ONLY if not at 100 [[CRIT]]) * LUK: 10-30 (if using dagger of counter, little to no LUK will be needed other then for [[MATK]] and [[ATK]] damage boost) CRIT build is the better of the two non-soul linked builds because it offers higher damage hits, and requires little to no DEX to land hits. This means STAT points can be put into other stats such as [[VIT]] or more [[STR]]. Additionally, LUK not only adds CRIT, but also adds MATK, which helps with Hindsight. This build WILL require CRIT gear due to the lack of [[DEX]]. Dagger of Counter or Soldier Skeleton Cards in an Encyclopedia are the best options. '''Skill build:''' [http://irowiki.org/~himeyasha/skill4/sag.html?10GK1IxeAcBakGAgFaf3Jy Skill Simulator] [[Free Cast]] and [[Hindsight]] allows this build to melee with books while raining bolts from above on their foes. Despite being a melee build, their main offensive power does not come from having [[STR]], but rather from the high [[ASPD]] to trigger the moderate damage bolts. Some even prefer to drop their [[STR]] to a marginal amount, and wield a Bazerald dagger for the added [[MATK]] bonus. Coupled with the [[Sage Spirit]] buff of [[Soul Linker]]s, leveling them in Ice Dungeon with [[Lightning Bolt]] is very effective. [[Hindsight]] Sages should not use any shield because using them will lower their [[ASPD]] by a significant amount. '''It is not recommended to play this build without [[FLEE]] gear because [[Mage]]s do not get any extra FLEE bonuses the way [[Thief]] classes do with [[Improve Dodge]]. Mages also tend to have lower HP'''. A Whisper Card and an Alicel Card will help FLEE a lot if no soul linker is available to Kaahi the Sage. With auto-cast and CRIT or attack power boosting gear, players can make a non-soul linked version of this build work, however it is very pricey to do. The non-soul linked version requires points into LUK, DEX or STR to make up for the poor bolt damage to ensure that players hit their target. Relying solely on bolt casts will lead to many deaths. === Hocus-Pocus!! === * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 70 * INT: 130+ * DEX: 70 * LUK: 9 '''Skill build:''' [http://irowiki.org/~himeyasha/skill4/sag.html?10HXakGAdqboeeqPgNkDdGeAJy Skill Simulator] During the early days of the introduction to the Sage class, it was the glory days of the [[Hocus-pocus]] Sages. Sadly the yellow-gem nerf and [[Hocus-pocus]] [[Boss]] nerf meant the end of their era. The build aims at the most [[INT]] possible for a good regen rate, since casting HP repeatedly can drain the SP considerably. It also doesn't go for maxed [[DEX]], but focuses more on [[VIT]] instead to avoid death by random [[Hocus-pocus]] skills. == Equipment == === Eden Group Equipments Quests === :''Main article: [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]]'' Eden Group Equipment is free and a great place to start for gear to use. The Staff or Dictionary are good weapons and generally a good choice for a Sage and their future classes' use. === General Equipment Recommendations === :''Main article: [[Equipment]]'' The Equipment article lists some general all purpose equipment that is useful through the PVM phase and also for endgame use as well. === Third Class Compatible Equipment === :''Main article: [[Sorcerer#Equipment|Sorcerer Equipment]]'' It is recommended to look at the Equipment recommendations for the Third Class job to see what equipment to strive for, rather than to spend a lot of money on a piece of equipment that will not be used in the future as a third class. However, some equipment may have a high level requirement, or are [[transcendent]] only. === Weapons === After considering what requirement skills have (some skills can only be used with certain weapon types), the Weapon Search tool within the iRO Wiki DB site is very helpful. Generally, for physical classes (both melee and ranged), something with high [[ATK]] is best. For magic classes, something with high [[MATK]] is best. Link to the iRO Wiki DB Weapon Search: http://db.irowiki.org/db/weapon-search/ ==== Book ==== {{Item List |id=1564 |item=Encyclopedia |slots=2}} {{Item List |id=1565 |item=Ledger of Death |slots=2}} {{Item List |id=1572 |item=Principles of Magic |slots=2}} Strictly for Magic Attack, The Principles of Magic sets (Principles of Magic, Pocket Watch, Librarian Glove, Monocle) outperforms other gear combinations on a hindsight sage with a Soul Linker slave. Ledger of Death, on the other hand, is a better choice for those who wish to achieve the highest possible attack speed. The Encyclopedia coupled with dmg cards offers a decent replacement for using Dagger of Counter, although Dagger of Counter is still the ideal weapon to use for Hindsight builds. ==== Knife ==== {{Item List |id=1223 |item=Fortune Sword}} {{Item List |id=1237 |item=Grimtooth}} {{Item List |id=1228 |item=Combat Knife}} {{Item List |id=1242 |item=Dagger of Counter}} :[[VIT]]/[[DEX]] Sages can use Fortune Swords, Grimtooths, or Combat Knives for defensive purposes. :Battlesages can use Dagger of Counter for crits. ==== Rod ==== {{Item List |id=1651 |item=Eden Staff II }} This easy to get item is the best weapon a Sage has access to until rebirth. It offers the highest mAtk of all non-trans staffs and is only 1-handed so the Sage can also wear a shield with it for damage reduction. {{Item List |id=1618 |item=Survivor's Rod (Dex)}} {{Item List |id=1620 |item=Survivor's Rod (Int)}} :There is an item called {{item |id=2509 Survivor's Manteau}}, which grants bonuses if a Survivor's Rod is equipped. === Headgear === ==== Top ==== {{Item List |id=5027 |item=Mage Hat}} :All around useful headgear for mage classes. Gives 2 INT and increases SP by 150. * Slotted headgear (Dress Hat, Virgo Diadem, Crown of Deceit, Moon Rabbit Hat, etc) ==== Middle ==== {{Item List |id=5101 |item=Takius Blindfold}} {{Item List |id=5325 |item=Robo Eye}} ==== Bottom ==== * Evolved Pipe
+1 [[VIT]] - Kafra Shop Item Only * {{item |id=2267 Cigarette}} or {{item |id=2268 Pipe }}
3% damage from [[Insect]] race monsters. === Shield === Don't bother with the Mage-class Card combo (Parasite), just go for a racial card. * {{item |id=2102 Guard}}/{{item |id=2121 Memory Book}}
Slotted memory book is very useful for caster sages, it has the same function as a guard with an additional +1 INT. Memory Book is also part of the Pocket Watch set. * {{item |id=2114 Stone Buckler}} Offers -5% damage from Large Sized Monsters. === Accessory === * {{item |id=2607 Clip}}
Clips are good for utility cards, for example Creamy, Phen and Vitata. It is almost essential to get these cards, otherwise it will be significantly harder to level. Once the player reaches level 90 alternatively they can be slotted into Gloves/Rosaries for a small boost in stats and to make switching easier. * {{item |id=2658 Nile Rose}}
A good alternative for Clips. The reason to this is that they take a different hotkey. Cycling between 3 accessories has never been easier with two Clips (Phen and Smokie) and a Nile Rose (Vitata). * {{item |id=2717 Pocket Watch}} and {{item |id=2716 Librarian Glove}}

title: Sage Job Change Guide
wikitext:
{{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = 40 | classreq = Mage | partyreq = | itemreq = Varies (See Tables) | nitemreq = | zenyreq = Varies | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Job change to [[Sage]] | window = yes }} === Starting === 1. Go to the Magician's Academy {{navi|yuno|323|282}} which is located at the north east corner of [[Juno]]. 2. Once inside, to your lefthand side talk to the Staff of the Academy [[NPC]] {{navi|yuno_in03|154|35}} , Metheus Sylphe, in order to register for the Sage test. You will be asked to pay 70,000 Zeny to register. As an alternative, you can give them an {{item |id=1006 Old Magicbook}} and a {{item |id=1007 Necklace of Wisdom}} to bypass the fee. In addition, you can tell the NPC that it's too expensive. He'll give you another requirement in which you can pay with 30,000 [[Zeny]], 50 {{item |id=705 Clovers}}, 50 {{item |id=949 Feathers}}, and 25 {{item |id=1024 Squid Ink}}. If you are Job Level 50, you are exempt from paying the entrance fee. 3. With the fee paid, it's time for the dreaded written test. Pass the first NPC and enter the next room. You should be in a hallway. Take the first left and you'll find the Written Test Professor NPC, Claytos Verdo {{navi|yuno_in03|107|176}}. === Written Exam === 4. Talk to him, and he will ask you a total of 20 questions. For each question that you answer correctly, you will receieve five points. In order to pass this portion of the Sage test, you must have a total of at least 80 points to continue. The questions are grouped by similarity: {| class="wikitablec" |- ! Question Set 1 !! Answer |- | Choose the item that the Magical Tool Merchant in Geffen does not sell. || Mantle |- | Choose the jewel that the Morroc Jewel Merchant does not sell. || Garnet |- | Choose the item that the Gift Merchant in Prontera does not sell. || Bouquet |- ! Question Set 2 !! Answer |- | Choose the city where users cannot purchase a Stiletto from an NPC. || Prontera |- | Choose the city where users cannot purchase Blade from an NPC. || Al De Baran |- | Choose the city where users cannot purchase Monster's Feed from an NPC. || Al De Baran |- ! Question Set 3 !! Answer |- | Choose the closest city to Turtle Island. || Alberta |- | Choose the closest city to Glast Heim. || Geffen |- | Choose the closest city to the Maze. || Prontera |- ! Question Set 4 !! Answer |- | Choose the monster that is a different type than the others. || Aster Marc Marse Marin |- | Choose the monster that is a different type than the others. || Muka Drops Plankton Penomena |- | Choose the monster that is a different type than the others. || Reggler Pest Frilldora Aster |- ! Question Set 5 !! Answer |- | Choose the monster that has a different attribute. || Smokie |- | Choose the monster with a different attribute than the others. || Dokebi Isis Giearth Deviruchi |- | Choose the monster that has a different attribute than the others. || Metaller |- ! Question Set 6 !! Answer |- | Choose the monster that is different sized. || Drake |- | Choose the monster that is different sized than the others. || Thiefbug (Aggressive) Horn Metaller Argos |- | Choose the monster that is different sized than the others. || Raydric |- ! Question Set 7 !! Answer |- | Choose the monster which does not drop "Yggdrasil Leaf". || Marduk |- | Choose the monster which does not drop "Phracon". || Peco Peco Egg |- | Choose the monster which doesn't drop "Alcohol". || Poison Spore |- ! Question Set 8 !! Answer |- | Choose the NPC that is irrelevant to the Priest job change quest. || Sir Windsor |- | Choose the NPC that is irrelevant to the Knight Job change quest. || Thomas Servantes |- | Choose the NPC that is irrelevant to the Blacksmith job change quest. || Barcadi |- ! Question Set 9 !! Answer |- | Choose the NPC that is not a citizen of Morroc. || Antonio |- | Choose the NPC that is not a citizen of Prontera. || Pina |- | Choose the NPC that is not a citizen of Al De Baran. || GOD-POING |- ! Question Set 10 !! Answer |- | Choose the Kafra lady who has gorgeous blue hair. || Pavianne |- | Choose the Kafra lady who is the youngest one among the staff. || Curly Sue |- | Choose the right name for the Kafra lady who wears glasses. || Leilah |- ! Question Set 11 !! Answer |- | How much SP is spent to use lvl 7 Thunderstorm? || 59 |- | Choose the skill that is irrelevant to learning Fire Wall, the Mage skill. || Level 4 Napalm Beat |- | Choose the correct SP consumption and the number of evasions when using Safety Wall lvl 6. || SP 40, 7 Times |- ! Question Set 12 !! Answer |- | Choose the right amount of damage reduction and SP consumption of the Energy Coat skill when the caster's remaining SP is 50%. || Damage - 18% SP 2% |- | How much SP can be restored when learning SP recovery at Level 6 (without being affected by INT)? || 18 |- | Choose the correct amount of magic attack for Napalm Beat lvl 6. || MATK * 1.3 |- ! Question Set 13 !! Answer |- | Choose property that is irrelevant to "Bolt" type skills for the Mage Class. || Earth |- | How many INT points can a Mage receive as a bonus at Job Level 33? || 4 |- | Choose the catalyst stone for Mage Solution no. 4, which is used for the Mage job change quest. || Diamond |- ! Question Set 14 !! Answer |- | Choose the right chance and attack strength for lvl 7 Double Attack, the Thief skill. || 35% / 140% |- | Choose the correct SP consumption and skill duration for Improve Concentration lvl 5 (Archer skill). || 45/80 Sec |- | Choose the correct attack strength and SP consumption for Bash lvl 6 (Swordsman skill). || 280% / 15 |- ! Question Set 15 !! Answer |- | Choose the skill that is irrelevant to learning Claymore Trap, the Hunter skill. || Remove Trap |- | Choose the skill that is irrelevant to learning Magnus Exorcismus, the Priest skill. || Divine Protection |- | Choose skill that is irrelevant to learning Maximize Power, the Blacksmith skill. || Skin Tempering |- ! Question Set 16 !! Answer |- | Choose the correct defense and ability of Wedding Veil. || 0 / MDEF +5 |- | Choose the correct defense and ability of Bunny Band. || 2 / LUK +2 |- | What is the correct defense rate and ability of Cute Ribbon? || 1 / SP +20 |- ! Question Set 17 !! Answer |- | Choose the class that cannot equip Saint Robe. || Thief |- | Choose the class that cannot equip Coat. || Mage (iRO: Novice) |- | Choose the class that cannot equip Padded Armor. || Archer |- ! Question Set 18 !! Answer |- | Choose the item that cures all abnormal status and restores full HP and SP at the same time. || Yggdrasil Berry |- | Choose the abnormal status that cannot be cured by Green Potion. || Curse |- | Choose the item that is not an ingredient for Blue Dyestuffs. || Karvodailnirol |- ! Question Set 19 !! Answer |- | When the world was created by the god Odin, what did he use for the material? || The Heart of Ymir |- | Who rules the Rune-Midgarts kingdom right now? || Tristram the 3rd |- | Choose the correct name for the ancient kingdom that disappeared somewhere in Geffen. || Geffenia |- ! Question Set 20 !! Answer |- | Choose the metal that was rumored to bring fortune and fame to a person with the destiny. || Emperium |- | Choose the correct name for the tree that became the source of life of this world. || Yggdrasil |- | Choose the god of Crusaders. || Odin |} === Practical Exam === 5. Once you've passed the written part of the test, you're off for some combat. Enter the hallway again and enter the room across the hallway {{navi|yuno_in03|187|119}}. This is where the Practical Examination Professor is, Hermes Tris {{navi|yuno_in03|169|178}}. 6. Speak to the professor and you'll enter a waiting room where you must wait your turn to take the fighting test. Enter the chat room to begin. Some skills you may want to hotkey are: * [[Fire Bolt]] (Level 1~4) * [[Fire Wall]] * [[Fire Ball]] 7. Your first enemies will be a group of aggressive {{monster | id=1011 Chonchons}} and {{monster | id=1007 Fabres}} . If you have [[Fire Wall]], this test is a breeze. Fire Wall around yourself and you'll kill them. Even without Fire Wall, the enemies are so weak that you can Bolt them individually or even melee them if you need to. If you're going the melee route, bring potions. Keep in mind that you are timed for three minutes. 8. The next group of foes will be non-aggressive {{monster | id=1063 Lunatics}} . At first, it appears that there are only six, but they quickly multiply to about 30 or so. If you have [[Fire Wall]], you can Fire Wall three of the six groups before they can split, effectively killing about 15 Lunatics. Once they begin to separate, you'll want to [[Fire Ball]] the remaining Lunatics. If there are any left, individually Bolt each Lunatic or stab/hit them with a Dagger/Rod. You'll have three minutes. 9. Your last test is fighting an aggressive {{monster | id=1179 Whisper}} . There will be five Whispers in total, but only attack the center one. You can [[Fire Wall]] it, or use a [[Frost Diver]]/[[Lightning Bolt]] combo. If you have a {{item |id=4077 Phen Card}}, you don't have to worry about it breaking your cast time. Once you kill the Whisper, the others disappear. 10. When you return, talk to the Practical Examination Professor again. === Study with the Professor === 11. At this point, the quest splits three ways. He will '''either''': * "A" Steps - Assign you to study the history of Yggdrasil and will send you to the [[Sage Job Change Guide#History_Professor|History Professor]] * "B" Steps - Tell you to study the elements and will assign you to the [[Sage Job Change Guide#Physics_Professor_-_Aebecee_George|Physics Professor]], Aebecee George {{navi|yuno_in03|240|30}}, * "C" Steps - Send you to study with the [[Sage Job Change Guide#Biology_Professor_-_Lucius_Celsus|Biology Professor]], Lucius Celsus {{navi|yuno_in03|278|291}}. * Depending on which one you get, refer to the appropriate section in the guide. ==== History Professor ==== 11A. '''If you got the ''History Professor''''', exit the room and head over to the room at the end of the hall {{navi|yuno_in03|152|134}}. 12A. Talk to the professor {{navi|yuno_in03|62|176}} , and he will ask that you bring something to him that is related to Yggdrasil. You can bring any item that has the word Yggdrasil in it ({{item|id=610 Yggdrasil Leaf}}, {{item|id=607 Yggdrasil Berry}}, {{item|id=608 Yggdrasil Seed}}) although the leaf is the easiest and cheapest to find since it's sold by NPCs. Once you give it to him, he will begin his lecture. You can choose to pay attention, or simply refer to this guide instead. :Once he finishes the lecture, he will ask you for 5 items in order to write an essay. :* 1 {{item|id=916 Feather of Birds}} :* 1 {{item|id=1019 Trunk}} :* 1 {{item|id=1024 Squid Ink}} :* 1 {{item|id=919 Animal Skin}} :* 1 {{item|id=713 Empty Bottle}} :He will help you write your essay, and you must choose the correct option to finish the essay correctly. It'll look like this when you're done. '''NOTE: The last paragraph has another version depending on what RO server you are in. ''Alternate 1'' being iRO and ''Alternate 2'' for other ROs.''' .... There is a ocean around the continent, The ocean is coiled up by '''''A giant snake Yormungandr'''''. The continent consists of three places such as, '''''Utgard, where the titans live''''', '''''Midgard, where humans live''''', '''''Asgard, where gods live'''''. The continent consists of the three places stated above. '''Alternate 1:''' .... as we studied from the last class, Yggdrasil is... '''''A giant ash tree'''''. The root of Yggdrasil is divided into 3 parts. Those parts reach to 3 places... '''''Asgard, Jotunnheim, Niflheim'''''. One who has a Seed of Yggdrasil, '''''Can restore half of total HP and SP'''''. '''Alternate 2:''' .... as we studied from the last class, Yggdrasil is... A giant ash tree. The root of Yggdrasil is divided into 3 parts. Those parts reach to 3 places... Asgard, Jotunnheim, Niflheim. ''One who has a Fruit of Yggdrasil, Can restore fully HP and SP.'' 13a. Go to step '''14'''. ==== Physics Professor - Aebecee George ==== 11b. '''If you were assigned to the ''Physics Professor''''', head outside then north to the smallest island in Juno {{navi|yuno|282|363}}. You'll find the Biology-Engineering Institute (Also referred by the Practical Examination Professor as the Somatology Laboratory). 12b. Talk to the professor, Aebecee George {{navi|yuno_in03|240|30}}, and he will ask for items before you can start the lecture. He will ask for... :* 30 {{item|id=7049 Stone}} :* He will give you a Wind of Verdure, Green Live, and Crystal Blue and ask for you to craft them into 50 {{item|id=1755 Arrow of Wind}}, 50 {{item|id=1756 Stone Arrow}} and 50 {{item|id=1754 Crystal Arrow}} which you can bring in advance :* 1 {{item|id=523 Holy Water}} :Once you give that to him, he will begin his lecture. You can choose to pay attention, or simply refer to this guide instead. :Once he finishes the lecture, he will ask you for 5 items in order to write an essay. :* 1 {{item|id=916 Feather of Birds}} :* 1 {{item|id=1019 Trunk}} :* 1 {{item|id=1024 Squid Ink}} :* 1 {{item|id=919 Animal Skin}} :* 1 {{item|id=713 Empty Bottle}} :He will help you write your essay, and you must choose the correct option to finish the essay correctly. :NOTE: If you take too long to answer a question, the responses may time out, and you'll need to provide supplies again. :It will look like this when you're done. .... Magic spells are varied into 4 elements such as '''Water, Earth, Fire and Wind.''' Each property has an opposing property. '''Magic with wind property is strong against water''' Magic with earth property is strong against wind However, that does not work on the opposite case. You must apply different types of property by the situation or place. You never know the limits of magic. It is not suggested to be too addicted to magic spells. Only pertinent uses of magic, as well as rest will guarantee you a safe battle. Forming a party with people of different classes is considered the best way to ready for battle. :If finished successfully, he will give you a {{item|id=1550 Book [3]}} 13b. Go to step '''14'''. ==== Biology Professor - Lucius Celsus ==== 11c. '''If you were assigned to the ''Biology Professor''''', go to the Monster Museum as shown on the Juno map. It's located on the same island right next to the Magician Academy {{navi|yuno|278|291}}. Once inside, enter the back room and you'll find the Biology Professor. 12c. Talk to the professor, he will ask for you to get a set of items, the first set being from water property/fish monsters and the second set being from insect monsters. He will randomly ask for each set of items: ::{| class="wikitablec" |- ! Set !! Items |- | Fish Race || 5 {{item|id=950 Mermaid's Heart}}, 5 {{item|id=960 Nippers}}, 5 {{item|id=966 Clam Flesh}}
-'''OR'''-
5 {{item|id=962 Tentacles}}, 5 {{item|id=1052 Single Cells}}, 5 {{item|id=1023 Fish Tails}}
-'''OR'''-
5 {{item|id=1050 Tendon}}, 5 {{item|id=960 Nippers}}, 5 {{item|id=963 Sharp Scale}} |- | Insect Race || 5 {{item|id=1025 Cobwebs}}, 5 {{item|id=935 Shells}}, 5 {{item|id=928 Insect Feelers}}
-'''OR'''-
5 {{item|id=1031 Mantis Scythes}}, 5 {{item|id=955 Insect Peelings}}, 5 {{item|id=1013 Rainbow Shells}}
-'''OR'''-
5 {{item|id=947 Horns}}, 5 {{item|id=946 Snail Shells}}, 5 {{item|id=1057 Moth Dusts}} |} 13c. Once you give the items to him, he will begin his lecture. You can choose to pay attention, or simply refer to this guide instead. :Once he finishes the lecture, he will ask you for 5 items in order to write an essay. :* 1 {{item|id=916 Feather of Birds}} :* 1 {{item|id=1019 Trunk}} :* 1 {{item|id=1024 Squid Ink}} :* 1 {{item|id=919 Animal Skin}} :* 1 {{item|id=713 Empty Bottle}} :In this instance unlike the other two professors, you won't need to choose the options in order to write the essay. Simply keep pressing enter until the professor finishes your essay. == Final Step == 14. '''Once you've finished your essay''', you'll be given a book and will be instructed to show your thesis to the Dean of the Magician Academy. Head over to the Sage Castle, which is situated in the north-west corner of Juno's northern island {{navi|yuno|89|319}}. Walk down the floor to the last room where you will find Dean of the Academy (Kayron Grik) {{navi|yuno_in02|38|61}} and hand him your thesis. He will then change your job to Sage. {{Navbox Sage}} {{Navbox Classes}} [[Category:Sage]] [[Category:Job Change Guide]]

title: Santa Klaus
wikitext:
== Overview ==
'''Santa Klaus''' is an event NPC located in Prontera center {{Navi|prontera|156|194}} who normally comes around Christmas time and gives free services and goods.
:[[File:Christmas Event-Free Reset-Santa Klaus NPC.png]]

== Gifts ==
=== 2022 ===
*The ability to give one reset to your character that will reset '''both''' [[Stat Reset | stats]] and [[Skill Reset | skills]].
**Requires your character to be 0 weight.

=== 2016 ===
One of the following gifts:

*The ability to reset your character's [[Stat Reset | stats]] and [[Skill Reset | skills]].
*A "random" gift set.
*The ability to reset your progress in the [[Seal Quest]].

The gift set contains the following items:

*3 {{Item | id=14582 Yellow Butterfly Wing}}
*5 {{Item | id=668 Red Envelope}}
*3 {{Item | id=7619 Enriched Elunium}}
*3 {{Item | id=7620 Enriched Oridecon}}

You can now teleport to any of the guild dungeons at no cost by talking with Santa Klaus again.

== Notes ==

[[Document Quests]]
[[Doha's Secret Orders]] | external = | window =yes }} #In the New World at the Midgard Camp, talk to '''Expedition Guard Ben''' or '''Expedition Guard Maha''' {{navi|mid_camp|222|246}} and listen in on their conversation. #*The Sapha, a race of giant trees, is reportedly about to visit. Aello at the command center seems to know more.''' #:[[File:ExpeditionGuardBenMaha.png|250px]] #Go inside the large central tent {{navi|mid_camp|214|249}} and talk to '''Guard Aello''' {{navi|mid_campin|93|114}}. #*He tells you the Sapha from Manuk wants to speak with you. #:[[File:GuardAello.png|250px]] #Upstairs, talk to the '''Soldier''' {{navi|mid_campin|111|120}} outside one of the rooms on the right, who lets you inside. #*Note: The player must have the {{Item List|id=2782|item=Ring of the Ancient Wise King|simple=yes}} equipped in order to speak with the Sapha. #*You do not have to have done the quest on that character, only have the ring equipped. #:[[File:MidCamp-Soldier.png|250px]] #Once in the room, speak with '''Sapha from Manuk, Vyhannus'''. #*The Sapha says their race is concerned about humans and their sudden arrival in the New World, but your assistance to the Manuk and Laphine has led them to trust you. #*They have told their leader, Ravail, about your accomplishments. #:[[File:SaphaManuk-Vyhannus.png|250px]] #Speak with '''Vyhannus''' again, who talks about [[El Dicastes]], the Saphas' capital city. Hound is selecting worthy adventurers to send there, and you are one of those chosen. #Talk to Vyhannus once more, who tells you to talk to Avalanche in Manuk. Two east, one south of the Expedition Site. #*Note: At this point, players can start doing [[Doha's Secret Orders]] alongside this quest, Sapha's Visit should be completed first in order to fully complete Doha's Secret Orders. #In southeast Manuk, go inside the building at {{navi|manuk|309|142}} and speak with '''Guard Captain Avalanche''' {{navi|man_in01|315|51}} up the left set of stairs. #*He authorizes you to enter El Dicastes through a tunnel in the mountains. #:[[File:GuardCaptain-Avalanche.png|250px]] #In east Manuk, talk to the '''Entrance Manager''' {{navi|manuk|321|182}}' who lets you into the tunnel. #*Note 1: At this point, You will have access to {{map |id=dic_dun01 Scarab Hole Level 1}}. #*Note 2: If you have already done this quest once before and brought along the {{Item List|id=2844|item=Light of El Dicastes|simple=yes}} accessory, you can use it here and skip directly to Step 11. Make sure you finish Step 8 before doing this (use it inside the 1st floor tunnel). #:[[File:EntranceManager.png|250px]] #Journey through the dungeon to reach El Dicastes Field, and continue on to the top of the map, where the '''Guard''' {{navi|dic_fild01|149|281}} will let you in the city. #Head through the north portal and at the top of the next map {{navi|dicastes02|120|235}} enter the doors. #Inside, talk to the '''Adventure Clerk''' and register, and receive a {{Item |id=2844 Light of El Dicastes}}. #:[[File:AdventurerClerk.png|250px]] # (Optional) '''Kareka''' inside the El Dicastes Factory {{navi|dicastes01|96|257}} will enchant the three hidden slots of the Light of El Dicastes. See [[Light of El Dicastes Enchants]]. [[Category:El Dicastes Quests]]

title: Sara's Memory
wikitext:
{{Repeatable|cooldown=20 hours}} {{Quest Info | levelreq =99 | partyreq =1+ (Need to be in a party) | joblevelreq = | classreq = | itemreq = | questreq = | questcoreq = | baseexpreward = 770,000 Exp (first time)
550,000 Exp (second and following) | jobexpreward = 1,000,000 Job Exp (first time)
550,000 Job Exp (second and following) | itemreward = None }} '''Note 1:''' All the enemies inside this dungeon have the chance to drop Food Items Lv3 to 7 (+7 Foods are only dropped by Doyen Irene) '''Note 2:''' All monsters in this instance are either Demi-Human or Beast, being the first the most common. None of them uses skills: only melee. === Instance Cooldown Quest Name === Memorial dungeon: Sara's Memory == Walkthrough == To start this quest, you have to use the Dimensional Device located on [[Rune Midgard Allied Forces Post]] within the [[New World]]. It will warp you into the Dimensional Gorge. #Talk to '''Leon the Adventurer''' {{Navi|dali|130|107}} in Dimensional Gap to start the quest. #:[[File:DG_LeonTheAdventurer.png|250px]] #Click on Dimensional Device and select "Boot up the dimensional device" to reserve the instance. #When instance is ready, click on Dimensional Device again and select option 2 to enter. You have 1 hour to complete this instance.

#Talk to '''A girl''' (Sara Irene) to start #*(The story starts with conversation taking place between you and Sara Irene, and later Doyen, her father, appears before long. After Sara and Doyen disappears, Strange Oldman A and B conspire plot toward Sara)
#As soon as all the conversations end, walk toward the nearest warp portal on your left and you'll appear on the upper left corner of Payon town. #Talk to '''Sara Irene''' again, she'll disappear and guards/monsters will spawn/appear. Defeat guards and monsters.
#*(It appears there is a scene of great violence. You better make sure Sara runs to safety!) #Continue to look around for Sara Irene and defeat those monsters. You should be moving in direction as below: #*First section: Kill all guards and wolves. The portal to second section will open in upper eastern side. #*Second section: Kill all guards and desert wolves. The portal to third section will open in southern side. #*Third section: Kill all guards, wolves, and desert wolves. The portal to fourth section will open at northern center side. #*Fourth section: Kill all guards. The portal to fifth section will open at upper west side. #*Fifth section: Talk to Doyen Irene, kill all guards, then defeat Doyen Irene. #Talk to Doyen again, then start walking west and south-west until you cross through a portal and see Sara on the bridge with some dark figures who know you're a time traveler. Then the exit portal will open at western side.
#Talk to Leon again. You will get 770k base exp and 1m job exp (non VIP) for first timer; or 550k base exp and 550k job exp for repeats.
*The general route you travel after Sara runs away from the initial scene. :[[File:Sara's Memory route.gif]] == Monster List == All monsters are non-boss type:
*[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2543/payon-town-guard Payon Town Soldier]
*[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2545/a-gentle-guard-dog A Gentle Guard Dog]
*[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2544/soldier Payon Town Solider (Red)]
*[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2546/guard-dog A Fierce Guard Dog]
*[https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/2542/irene-the-wise-elder Doyen Irene]
'''Note:''' Soldiers can drop the Payon Soldier card which gives Atk +5, MAtk +5. If compounded to a Spear +10 or higher, gain additional Atk +20 and MAtk +20. If Spear +14 or higher, gain additional Atk +20 and MAtk +20. == Notes == The following food items dropped may be used for the following: *{{Item List |id=12063 |item=Fruit Mix |simple=yes}} for a [[Terra_Gloria_Daily_Quests#Tea_Time_Snacks|Terra Gloria daily quest]] *{{Item List |id=12048 |item=Honey Herbal Tea |simple=yes}} for a [[Terra_Gloria_Daily_Quests#Tea_Time_Snacks|Terra Gloria daily quest]] *{{Item List |id=12065 |item=Green Salad |simple=yes}} for a [[The_Royal_Banquet#Walther_Sidequest|Royal Banquet side quest]] *{{Item List |id=12055 |item=Spicy Fried Bao |simple=yes}} for a [[The_Royal_Banquet#Walther_Sidequest|Royal Banquet side quest]] {{Navbox Instance}} [[Category:Instances]] [[Category: Dimensional Gap Quests]]

title: Sarah Earring Enchants
wikitext:
After completing [[Sarah and Fenrir]] instance for the first time, talk to '''Professor Bernhard''' to receive a reward. He will offer you a free accessory. You can choose between {{Item List |id=28310 |item=Sarah's Left Earring |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=28311 |item=Sarah's Right Earring |simple=yes}}.

Assistant Professor will offer to sell you a new {{Item List |id=28310 |item=Sarah's Left Earring |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=28311 |item=Sarah's Right Earring |simple=yes}} in exchange for 1 {{Item List |id=6803 |item=Shard of Gigantes |simple=yes}}.

You may instead enchant an earring (of the two types that can be purchased here) you have equipped. Enchantment will cost four (4) {{Item List |id=6803 |item=Shard of Gigantes |simple=yes}}.
