title: Story and story related quests
wikitext:
{{Verify| Story '''Reason:''' Based on memory}} {{Update}} This page attempts to list the story of the protagonist, the order of the events and the associated event quests in chronological order. A distinction is made between the main storyline and the side storyline. ==Main Storyline== ===[[Hugel#Thanatos_Tower|The Climb Of The Thanatos Tower]]=== [[Image:Thanatos_Tower.jpg|right|80px]] After the monster outbreak in Thanatos Tower and its surroundings, triggered by an unknown event in [[Einbroch]], the adventurer was hired by the [[Rekenber Corporation]] to identify and eliminate the cause. Ascending the tower level by level, the adventurer battled creatures that had long slumbered, including fallen angels. Upon reaching the summit, he discovered the remnants of [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/1708/thanatos-phantom| Thanatos], the guardian of the seal imprisoning Satan Morroc. Following a fierce battle, the adventurer defeated Thanatos. However, this victory unknowingly weakened the seal that contained Satan Morroc within his dimensional rift, causing fragments of the demon to begin materializing in the world.
===[[Continental_Guard_Quest_(Resurrection of Satan Morroc)|The Battle For Morroc]]=== [https://www.divine-pride.net/database/monster/1916/satan-morocc| Satan Morroc] began to materialize slowly after the defeat of Thanatos in the destroyed and phase-shifting areas where Thanatos originally defeated him. His fragments started to attack the nearby city of [[Morroc]], spreading chaos and fear. Desperate to fend off these attacks, the city dispatched Continental Messengers to recruit volunteers. These volunteers were needed not only to repel the assaults but also to prevent Satan Morroc from fully materializing or, if possible, to destroy him once and for all. The adventurer encountered one such Messenger in a distant city and decided to volunteer for the mission. Upon arriving in Morroc, the adventurer was met by Chief Balrog, the leader of the guards. Balrog, determined to test the adventurer's abilities and support the soldiers' war efforts, assigned him various tasks to organize resources. Only after completing these errands was the adventurer granted the papers needed to confront Satan Morroc directly. The adventurer then ventured into the heart of the space-time rift, challenging and ultimately defeating Satan Morroc. He returned to Chief Balrog with a piece of Satan Morroc's skin as proof of his victory, along with the information that the demon had retreated into the rift and would not pose a threat for some time. This triumph earned the adventurer the gratitude of Morroc and an official invitation from the royal house of Prontera to join in the celebrations there.
===[[The_Royal_Banquet|Banquet of Heroes]]=== The adventurer accepted the invitation and entered the royal castle of Prontera, where he was greeted as a hero by Morroc for his victory over Satan Morroc. He was provided with a servant, Chamberlain Bell, and a private room for the duration of the celebrations. After showing the adventurer to his quarters, Bell explained that the ceremony was being held to declare a new king after the unexpected death of the old one. The adventurer was invited as a neutral observer and was encouraged to familiarize himself with the noble families. As he mingled with the nobles, the adventurer learned about their concerns and assisted them with small tasks or promised to help in the future. He noticed a dispute within the Heine family and observed that the Nerius family appeared to be on good terms with Nyhill, a son of the Heine family. That night, as the adventurer returned to his chambers, he overheard a conspiratorial conversation between two individuals leaving Nyhill's room. The next day, during the main festivities, he engaged with the guests until Nyhill was suddenly overcome by nausea and retreated to his chambers. Concerned, the adventurer, along with Skia, went to check on Nyhill. They overheard two figures discussing their success in drugging Nyhill and their mission before disappearing. After ensuring Nyhill's safety, the adventurer and Skia returned to their rooms. The following day, the court magician Nillem visited the adventurer and escorted him to the Royal Library, and then to the Coronation Room to witness the declaration of the new king. During the coronation ceremony, chaos erupted when the proclaimed heir to the throne, Peter von Heine, was fatally wounded, and bandits attacked, demanding Ymir's Heart. Though the attackers were repelled, any help for Peter came too late. Konecker Heine dismissed the noble families to investigate the situation. After the incident, Ian Walther accused the adventurer of being involved in the attack, revealing that during the chaos, the Terra Gloria and the Star of Blessing, ancient relics of the royal house of Prontera, had been stolen. Nyhill from the Heine family admitted that he might have revealed the details of the coronation ceremony's place and time while he was drugged, thereby exonerating the adventurer from suspicion. After the last guests of the coronation ceremony departed, the adventurer had a brief interaction with Mage Nillem and his librarian friend Lindt. During their discussion, they discovered that the book chronicling Prontera's history contained blank spaces. Returning to his chambers, the adventurer found an invitation from the Nerius family. He met with the Nerius family to discuss recent events and plan their next steps. After formulating a strategy, the adventurer was tasked with seeking approval from Kronecker G. Heine. Kronecker not only endorsed the plan but also recommended that the adventurer work closely with Mage Nillem. Upon returning to his room, he found Skia and Nihil waiting, ready to discuss the next steps.
===[[Terra Gloria|Investigation and adventures in Schwartzvald]]=== ==Side Storylines== ===[[Sarah Irene]]=== ====[[Sara's Memory]]==== Sarah Irene, also known as Sara Irene and Sarah Erene, is a recurring character encountered during the travelers' adventures into the past. Sarah is a young girl, the daughter of the leader of [[Payon]] [[Doyen Irene]] and a foreign mother. She lived in Payon until the tragic day when her mother was assassinated, and her father was mistakenly blamed by the adventurer for the murder. Due to a misunderstanding and an effort to protect Sarah, her father sent the Payon town guards to attack the adventurer and later confronted the adventurer himself. The adventurer, believing they were trying to harm Sarah, fought back. Amid the chaos, Sarah, clearly traumatized, escaped to the bridge leading out of Payon. There, she was found by two mysterious figures who took her with them and banished the adventurer back to his timeline after he had cleared the misunderstanding and tried to follow Sarah. Sarah remained unseen and unheard of until the dark army of Himmelnez attacked Prontera.
===[[The_Royal_Banquet#Room of Consciousness Instance|The fight for Terra Gloria]]===

 '''WARNING: This quest cannot be completed due to prt_castle being inaccessible.''' 

1. In [[Morroc]], Talk to the Continental Official {{Navi|morocc|176|103}}, and tell him that you want to volunteer. (Or just complete the [[Continental Guard Quest]] up to Step 2.)

2. Find the Messenger in [[Prontera]] on the bridge to the Castle {{Navi|prontera|154|353}}, who says the King has passed away from an illness and needs the help of an adventurer to select a new one.

3. Head into the castle, and talk to the Inspector {{Navi|prt_castle|117|163}}. He needs to test your suitability for the task by giving you a test of strength.  '''If you are below a certain level, he will request you bring him 2 {{item |id=1064 Reins}} first.'''

4. After you pass the quiz, you have become an Adventurer Appraiser.  He then explains how to do your job.  He says there are 7 Prince candidates who are each trying to become king. Due to the resurrection of Satan Morroc, the kingdom is changing the way it picks a new king, and is allowing experienced adventurers to evaluate the candidates.

5. In a room to the right (133, 154), talk to the Guard (175, 170), who lets you in to the room to meet the Princes.

6. Head up the stairs, and go into the first portal along the long hallway (300, 274).  Talk to the Prince, but he apparently isn't very chatty. Talk to the Servant instead, who talks about the Prince.

7. Go to the next room down the hall, and talk to the next Prince, who seems rather full of himself.

8. Once finished, enter the fourth room, and talk to the the Prince inside, and keep going until you get to Poe.

10. The seventh Prince, Poe, who makes you play a guessing game. You must pick a number higher or lower than the one he has in mind twice to pass. You can then ask him questions.

11. Talk to the final Prince, Peter. After questioning him, he tells you about a girl who wrote to him and got him to grow a beard. He then asks you to bring a Bouquet to her in [[Al De Baran]].

12. In [[Al De Baran]], talk to the Girl {{Navi|aldebaran|132|184}} and give her the Bouquet.  

13. Return to Peter, who rewards you with a {{item |id=644 Gift Box}}.

14. Speak to the third Prince (218, 273) again, then to the 5th prince again. Head back to the 3rd prince's room and you overhear Ernst and Ahrum talking about helping each other to become "co-Kings" and that if one becomes corrupt, the other will kill him. Talk to Ahrum again, who says someone from his family who he was expecting to be here hasn't arrived. 

15. Go into the room at (221, 343) where you overhear people plotting to poison Ernst in order to get Ahrum elected king. The Richard and Walter families appear to be conspiring to both gain control of the kingdom!

16. Tell what you found out to Ahrum, and he becomes upset and kicks you out of his room. When you try to go back in, you overhear him talking to himself.  You'll be kicked out again if you try talking to him.  

17. Go speak with Prince Ernst briefly, then attempt to go back in Arhum's room once again, and make sure you get both dialogues on the portal.

18. Return to the Inspector, and you talk to him about your impressions of the Princes.  He says he's worried about Ahrum, and tells you to go talk to some of them again.

19. Watch as Ahrum talks to several of the Princes, going to each room as he yells at them, and observe what happens.

20. After the final confrontation, go into Ernst's room and watch them talk.  

21. After Ahrum leaves, go to his room to see them talking once more.  Ahrum asks Ernst to kill him, as he cannot stand being manipulated.  As Ahrum dies, he makes you promise not to reveal what happened, as he wants Ernst to be king.  

22. Go back to the Inspector and explain what happened. He thanks you and rewards you with some [[Base Experience]].

*Level 80: 30,000 
*Level 81-84：50,000 
*Level 86-90：45,000
*Level 91-95：50,000 
*Level 96-98：55,000 
*Level 99：110,000

In the maze mini-game you must speak to the researcher at {{navi|geffen|56|115}}. He will teleport you to an instance version of kamidal tunnel. There will be another researcher above you that will start the maze for you. In the maze there will be traps on the ground that injure you. There are also treasure boxes. Do not go near them or they will spawn a hoard of monsters. The black puddles in the maze can heal you if you are injured. Along some of the walls are archer skeletons that will shoot you. At the end of each tunnel there will be Relic that summons an MVP. These mvp's do not have drops but are still not so easy to fight. Normally the player will be teleported to the North tunnel where they will have to fight {{monster|id=1087 The Orc Lord}}, after defeating him a '''lost soul''' (Doppleganger) will appear, talk to it, it will teleport the player to the next stage at the middle tunnel. At the middle tunnel, the player will meet {{monster|id=1038 The undead lord}} (verify? Sorry I am not sure of what did they change it's name to), now another '''lost soul''' (Doppleganger) will appear, after talking to it the player will be sent to the last stage where the player meet {{monster|id=1734 Kiel}}. Defeating it leads to the appearance of the last '''lost soul''' which will reward the player with 175 medals and teleport the player out. Sometimes the game send the player to {{monster|id=1734 Kiel}} automatically ((Mostly after dying once or twice)) which means the player dodged two steps and the quest is easier. Speak with the researcher again to obtain another 25 medals.

You can easily upgrade your Champions Wreath from '''Frank''' {{navi|Geffen|61|127}} next to '''Terra Track'''. He will ask you to wear the Wreath and to have another Champion Wreath in your inventory. Every Wreath will upgrade a level.

'''Note:'''
*There is a chance of fail.
*If the upgrade failed, you will keep the Original Wreath but you will lose the Wreath you tried to use to upgrade

title: Summoner
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job | jobName = Summoner | jobType = First ([[Doram]]) | jobLevel = 50 | Race = [[Doram]] | changesAt = [[Lasagna]] | skills = 23 | skillPoints = 75 | questSkills = 0 | str = 0 | agi = 7 | vit = 5 | int = 7 | dex = 10 | luk = 5 }} [[File:Doram-Summoner.jpg|220px|right]] Summoners are feline adventurers, known as [[Doram]], hailing from another continent across the ocean from [[Rune-Midgarts]] called '''Pasta'''. Tied deeply to nature’s rhythm, Summoners draw upon the primal elements of earth, sea, and sky with skills based on the natural forces of Animals, Plants, and the Ocean itself. With a playful curiosity and ancient instinct hidden within, they command powerful strength and magic through song, paw, and spirit. Rather than live a carefree life in their hometown of [[Lasagna]], some Summoners instead join the '''Vigilante Corporation''' to help keep their home safe or even adventure to far off lands. All [[Doram]] begin as the Summoner Class until Level 100, when the Spirits transform them automatically into an [[Advanced Summoner]]. '''NOTE''': This class is not recommended for new players as it is difficult/expensive to play effectively until 100+. While their skilltree is simple, gear can be difficult to obtain on your own until later levels and pre- and post-casting times for the worthwhile leveling skills require specific items that may not be achievable easily for your first character. === Job Progression === :''See [[Advanced Summoner]] if you are looking for information on the Advanced Skills of the Summoner Class unlocked at Base Level 100.'' A [[Doram]] [[Summoner]]'s max [[Job Level]] is 50 prior to [[Base Level]] 100. Once they hit that Level, several new "Advanced" skills (which you might have noticed on your Skill Tree) will unlock and can be obtained with [[Skill Points]] from that point forward. Their max [[Job Level]] also increases to 60 as well. == Job Change Quest == A newly created [[Doram]] character automatically starts as a [[Summoner]] and does not require a Job Change Quest. However, once you’ve created your [[Doram]], you will need to complete a series of introductory quests if you wish to leave [[Lasagna]] and explore the rest of the game world. These quests get you acquainted with the world, the Class and its [[Skills]], plus other aspects of the game. You also receive several starting pieces of [[equipment]] by completing the various requests in this area. *It is recommended for a new player to proceed with these, but they can be bypassed by using another character with the [[Warp Portal]] skill to send your Summoner to [[Rune-Midgarts]]. Should you continue down this route, your journey begins in the picturesque Ravioli Fields just outside the tiny seaport known as [[Lasagna]]. This vibrant village is home to the [[Doram]] race and serves as the starting point for your introduction quests with the '''Vigilante Corporation'''. For a full run-down on these quests and the village, refer to [https://roggh.com/doram-and-lasagna-village-quest-guide/#Main_Quest this guide]. == Builds == Summoners can choose between 3 paths: '''Animal''' (Physical), '''Plant''' (Magical), and '''Seafood''' (Support). Due to the abundance of [[Skill Points]] compared to a single path's [[Skill]]s, you will be able to double-dip somewhat into another path with leftover points, usually choosing one of the offensive paths and then getting the support path's earlier healing/buffing skills. === Physical Builds === ==== Lunatic Carrot Beat & Picky Peck ==== Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 90 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 1 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This build uses the [[Power of Life]] to inflict Ranged Physical Damage on monsters with Animal-based skills. Unlike the [[Archer]] or [[Gunslinger]], Animal Skills are based on [[STR]] for damage with [[DEX]] needed for [[HIT]] (and to reduce [[VCT]] for [[Picky Peck]]). [[VIT]] for survivability is also recommended but you can swap some of the recommended [[DEX]] for more [[VIT]] or [[INT]] if needed. [[INT]] will be for [[SP]] or to help with reducing Picky's cast time. Physical Animal builds can be hard to work with in earlier levels compared to other classes due to the main AOE skill, [[Lunatic Carrot Beat]], having a 1sec [[FCT]] and enormous 6sec [[Cooldown]]. However, their secondary skill, [[Picky Peck]], is a powerful single target attack that deals with [[VCT]], which will reduce with increasing [[Stat]]s, and gets stronger based on an enemy's current [[HP]] and can dual-cast depending on your Base Level. You will want to get used to using both to ensure survival as you level. [[Arclouze Dash]] is a great supportive skill to help with that as it increases [[AGI]] and [[Movement Speed]] and the core skill, [[Hide]], is perfect for getting out of hairy situations. With extra skill points, it's recommended to dip into the Seafood-skills for healing and defensive buffs. [[Tuna Belly]] is an especially effective healing skill and should be picked up to save on healing consumables. For this build, it is highly recommended to try to obtain the following pieces of Shadow Gear (often very cheap in player [[Vending]] Shops), specifically the shield, to help with leveling as it is the only way to reduce LCB's long Cooldown with refines until 100+: * {{Item List |id=24287 |item=Doram physical Shadow Weapon |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=24316 |item=Doram Physical Shadow Shield |simple=yes}} Primary Skills: [[Lunatic Carrot Beat]], [[Picky Peck]] Complementary Skills: [[Arclouze Dash]], [[Hide]] === Magical Builds === ==== Catnip Meteor & Silvervine Stem Spear ==== Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 90 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This build uses the [[Power of Land]] to inflict [[Neutral]] Property Magical AOE Damage on monsters or multi-Element Property Magical Single Target Damage with Plant-based skills. Plant skills are based on [[INT]] for damage with [[DEX]] helping reduce [[VCT]]. [[VIT]] for survivability is also recommended but you can swap some of the recommended [[DEX]] for more [[VIT]] if needed. Magical Plant builds can be hard to work with in earlier levels compared to other classes (or even compared to Physical Doram builds) due to the main AOE skill, [[Catnip Meteor]], having a 1.5sec [[FCT]], 1sec [[VCT]], and enormous 5sec [[Cooldown]]. However, their secondary skill, [[Silvervine Stem Spear]], is a powerful single target attack that can be different Elemental Property Magic Damage and can dual-cast depending on your Base Level. The [[Element]] depends on the Skill Level you are using and can be [[Earth]], [[Fire]], [[Water]], [[Wind]], or [[Ghost]]. You will want to get used to using both to ensure survival as you level. [[Silvervine Root Twist]] is a great defensive skill to help with that as it stops enemies (while dealing damage), [[Catnip Powdering]] will weaken and slow monster movement speed briefly, and the core skill, [[Hide]], is perfect for getting out of hairy situations. [[Catnip Meteor]] is also a bit unique in how it works. It has a fixed 7x7 AOE but it drops meteors in random spots among that 7x7 area that explode in 5x5 bursts, each with delayed timing from the initial cast. Additionally, the damage is not all at once but instead every 1 second over a duration of 5 seconds, meaning you could also cast this and lead more enemies into the AOE over time as you wait out the skill's [[Cooldown]]. With extra skill points, it's recommended to dip into the Seafood-skills for healing and defensive buffs. [[Tuna Belly]] is an especially effective healing skill and should be picked up to save on healing consumables. For this build, it is highly recommended to try to obtain the following pieces of Shadow Gear (often very cheap in player [[Vending]] Shops), specifically the shield, to help with leveling as it is the only way to reduce CN's long Cooldown with refines until 100+: * {{Item List |id=24286 |item=Doram magical Shadow Weapon |simple=yes}} * {{Item List |id=24317 |item=Doram Magical Shadow Shield |simple=yes}} Primary Skills: [[Catnip Meteor]], [[Silvervine Stem Spear]] Complementary Skills: [[Silvervine Root Twist]], [[Catnip Powdering]], [[Hide]] === Support Builds === ==== Tuna Belly & Tuna Party ==== Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 90 * INT: 90 * DEX: 50 * LUK: 1 This build uses the [[Power of Sea]] to heal wounds on your self or your party with Seafood-based skills. :WORK IN PROGRESS == Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three suggestions to efficiently level a new character: #First, get gear and experience for your new character by following this [https://roggh.com/doram-and-lasagna-village-quest-guide/ Lasagna Beginner Quest Guide]. Note that you do not ''need'' to complete all of these quests, but it will make things easier starting out. #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. You will want to use [[Lunatic Carrot Beat]] or [[Catnip Meteor]]. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1012 Roda Frogs}} until level 21(they drop sticky webfeet that you can sell to players or turn in for the level 56-71 [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]]) , then using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1060 Bigfoots}} until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill {{monster | id=1023 Orc Warriors}}, {{monster | id=1273 Orc Ladies}}, and {{monster | id=1686 Orc Babies}} until level 60.
'''You can accept multiple quests at one time, however when turning in do note that you cannot gain more than 1 full level from a single quest, so do try to turn the quests in when you have a low exp percentage or after you've job changed if you're job level 49.''' === Affordable HP Recovery === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for AOE leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. === Stat Descriptions === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.

Sunbear Travel Guide
wikitext:
From Prontera you can teleport to Izlude, Geffen, Payon, Morroc, Alberta, Aldebaran, Comodo, and Umbala for 2,000 Zeny without VIP. (With VIP you get charged 600 zeny for Izlude. 1200 Zeny for Geffen, Payon and Morroc. 1700 Zeny for Orc Dungeon. 1,800 Zeny for Alberta. 2,000 Zeny for Aldebaran. And 3,000 Zeny for Comodo and Umbala

At Prontera 98, 120 there's an NPC named Keiki who will teleport you to Juno for 1,800 Zeny if you don't have VIP (IF you have VIP the options are as follows: Izlude 600z, Geffen, Payon and Morroc for 1,200z. Alberta 1,800z. Aldebaran, Comodo and Umbala 2,200 z and Juno for 1,800 Zeny.)

From Juno you can warp from the Kafra to Einbroch, Lighthalzen, Hugel, and Rachel for 2,000 Zeny without VIP. (With VIP you get Aldebaran, Einbroch, Lighthalzen, Hugel, and Rachel for 1,200 zeny)

At Juno 142, 183 there is an NPC named Isalei that will teleport you back to Prontera for 1,800 zeny without VIP. (IF you have VIP then the price is as follows: Einbroch, Lighthalzen, Hugel, and Rachel for 2,200 zeny and Prontera for 1,800 zeny.)

And from Rachel you can warp to Veins for 2,200 Zeny and Juno for 3,000 Zeny.

From Einbroch you pretty much take a train to Einbech for 200 zeny if you are VIP or NON-VIP.

Additionally, VIP is no longer connected to the website but sold as an item from the Cash Shop called [10 Day] Premium Subscription for 250 Kafra Points, so there's a market for it and it is no longer tied to a website to the account. Just open the box and you got the VIP perks.

wikitext:
{{Infobox Job | jobName = Super Novice | jobBase = Novice | jobType = First (Expanded) | jobLevel = 99 | Race = [[Human]] | changesAt = [[Al De Baran]] | skills = 49 | skillPoints = 413 | questSkills = 0 | str = 5 | agi = 5 | vit = 5 | int = 5 | dex = 5 | luk = 5 }} [[File:Super_Novice_Artwork.png|550px]] [[File:Super_Novice_chibi_art.png|240px|right]] Becoming a Super Novice means finding power in flexibility and the common spirit, embracing limitations to become capable individuals, and seeking "exemplary mediocrity" as they strive for a balanced skill set rather than mastering just one. In the world of [[Rune-Midgarts]], there is none more adaptable and unique than the Super Novice and it is said that their "Common Soul" is protected by a Guardian Angel that is always watching over them on the battlefield. This is a special kind of Class which exploits nearly every First Class Skill in the game; whether offensive or supportive, physical or magical, the Super Novice can learn and utilize it. This makes them the most versatile among all Classes, having "true freedom" in build and skills. The downside to this freedom of skills is very low [[Max HP|HP]] and [[Max SP|SP]], just like a regular [[Novice]]. Super Novices also lose the use of the [[Play Dead]] skill so must use caution when in combat earlier on. Super Novices can only equip anything a normal [[Novice]] would be able to, including specialized [[Novice]]-only equipment, or anything that allows "All Jobs" to wear. Super Novices also have a maximum [[Job Level]] of 99 rather than 50 or 70 like other Classes. Additionally, Super Novices also get access to renting their own unique [[Pushcart]], should they choose to get one, much like the [[Merchant]] Class. However, to rent a Super Novice Cart, they must visit the shady ''Kafra Employee'' behind the '''Kafra Headquarters''' in the northwest corner of [[Al De Baran]] rather than the normal method. With so many options to choose from, where will this path of endless possibilities lead? '''NOTE''': This class is not recommended for new players as it is difficult/expensive to play effectively. The amount of Skills can be overwhelming to those new to the game and Super Novices are much more fragile than other classes despite their flexibility. Additionally, the Job Change Quests can be tedious to complete making the game feel more like a chore then it should. === About Expanded Super Novices === ''See [[Expanded Super Novice]] if you are looking for information on the next Job of the Super Novice Class.'' Once a [[Super Novice]] hits [[Base Level]] 99 and [[Job Level]] 99, they can expand their skillset by becoming an [[Expanded Super Novice]], similar to how a First Class Job would become a Second Class Job but with no changes to their Sprite or Class Name. They will need to go through a tedious Job Change Quest to unlock these new abilities, however. == Job Change Quest == Once you your [[Novice]] is Base Level 45, Job Level 10 you will be qualified to become a Super Novice: {{:Super Novice Job Change Guide}} == Physical Builds == === I. Magnum Break === Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 90 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 90 * INT: 10 * DEX: 50 * LUK: 1 This leveling build will play almost identically to the [[Swordman]]'s [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Swordman#I._Magnum_Break Magnum Break Build], with [[Magnum Break]] and all of the [[Swordman]]'s other Active/Passive Skills being the primary focus. What makes this better, however, is the added bonus of supportive magic to buff yourself in combat with [[Acolyte]] skills like [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Angelus]] (especially nice for this build) and even the [[Archer]]'s [[Improve Concentration]]. You can even sneak in the [[Thief]]'s [[Envenom]] here and there to weaken any enemies you fight one-on-one or avoid them with [[Hiding]]. A Super Novice will also be able to get several utility Skills/Spells for quality of life: [[Teleport]], [[Warp Portal]], [[Pushcart]], and [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] to note a few. With such a large repertoire of options, it might be wise to consider [[Increase SP Recovery]] to make up for any lack of [[SP]] they might suffer from. Physical Super Novices get the standard [[STR]] for damage, then [[VIT]] for survivability (even if they are still squishy overall), and the rest into [[DEX]]. Due to the varying [[SP]] cost of all the available skills, some [[INT]] is often recommended. Primary Skills: [[Magnum Break]], [[Bash]], [[Envenom]], [[Endure]] Complementary Skills: [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Angelus]], [[Improve Concentration]] === II. Auto-Attack === Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 90 * AGI: 90 * VIT: 1 * INT: 10 * DEX: 50 * LUK: 1 This leveling build will play almost identically to the [[Thief]]'s [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Thief#I._Envenom_&_Auto-Attack_/_Dagger_Thief Auto-Attack Build], with [[Double Attack]] and [[Improve Dodge]] being the core skills to defeat monsters one-by-one quickly and taking as little damage as possible, utilizing [[Envenom]] or [[Bash]] for extra firepower when needed. What makes this better, however, is the added bonus of [[Magnum Break]] for clearing monsters that mob you and supportive magic to buff yourself in combat with [[Acolyte]] skills like [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Angelus]] and even the [[Archer]]'s [[Improve Concentration]] (especially nice for this build). A Super Novice will also be able to get several utility Skills/Spells for quality of life: [[Teleport]], [[Warp Portal]], [[Pushcart]], and [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] to note a few. With such a large repertoire of options, it might be wise to consider [[Increase SP Recovery]] to make up for any lack of [[SP]] they might suffer from. Physical Super Novices get the standard [[STR]] for damage, then [[AGI]] for increased [[ASPD]] and [[FLEE]], and the rest into [[DEX]]. Due to the varying [[SP]] cost of all the available skills, some [[INT]] is often recommended. Primary Skills: [[Double Attack]], [[Improve Dodge]], [[Envenom]], [[Bash]] Complementary Skills: [[Magnum Break]], [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Improve Concentration]] == Magical Builds == === I. Fire Bolt / Fire Ball / Fire Wall === Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 90 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This leveling build will play almost identically to the [[Mage]]'s [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Mage#I._Fire_Bolt_/_Fire_Ball_/_Fire_Wall Fire Magic Build], with [[Firebolt]], [[Fireball]], and [[Fire Wall]] being the core skills to defeat and protect yourself from monsters with. What makes this better, however, is the added bonus of supportive magic to buff yourself in combat with [[Acolyte]] skills like [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Angelus]] and even the [[Archer]]'s [[Improve Concentration]] (especially nice for this build). You also have a lot more [[Skill Points]] than a [[Mage]], so you could also take all of the offensive magic spells to cover all elements if you were so inclined. A Super Novice will also be able to get several utility Skills/Spells for quality of life: [[Teleport]], [[Warp Portal]], [[Pushcart]], and [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] to note a few. With such a large repertoire of options, you could also consider defensive options like [[Endure]] or [[Improve Dodge]] as well. Magical Super Novices get the standard [[INT]] for [[MATK]] and [[SP]], then [[DEX]] for reducing [[Variable Cast Time]], followed by [[VIT]] for survivability. Primary Skills: [[Firebolt]], [[Fireball]], [[Fire Wall]] Complementary Skills: [[Stone Curse]], [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Improve Concentration]] === II. Frost Driver / Lightning Bolt === Recommended stats by Base Level 99: * STR: 1 * AGI: 1 * VIT: 50 * INT: 90 * DEX: 90 * LUK: 1 This leveling build will play almost identically to the [[Mage]]'s [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Mage#II._Frost_Driver_/_Lightning_Bolt Wind & Water Magic Build], with [[Frost Driver]] and [[Lightning Bolt]] being the core skills to defeat and protect yourself from monsters with. [[Thunder Storm]] and [[Safety Wall]] may be more viable to grab though, due to the much higher number of [[Skill Points]] a Super Novice gets. What makes this better, however, is the added bonus of supportive magic to buff yourself in combat with [[Acolyte]] skills like [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Angelus]] and even the [[Archer]]'s [[Improve Concentration]] (especially nice for this build). You also have a lot more [[Skill Points]] than a [[Mage]], so you could also take all of the offensive magic spells to cover all elements if you were so inclined. A Super Novice will also be able to get several utility Skills/Spells for quality of life: [[Teleport]], [[Warp Portal]], [[Pushcart]], and [[Enlarge Weight Limit]] to note a few. With such a large repertoire of options, you could also consider defensive options like [[Endure]] or [[Improve Dodge]] as well. Magical Super Novices get the standard [[INT]] for [[MATK]] and [[SP]], then [[DEX]] for reducing [[Variable Cast Time]], followed by [[VIT]] for survivability. Primary Skills: [[Frost Driver]], [[Lightning Bolt]], [[Thunder Storm]], [[Safety Wall]] Complementary Skills: [[Heal]], [[Blessing]], [[Increase Agi]], [[Improve Concentration]] == Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three suggestions to efficiently level a new character: #First, get gear and experience for your new character by following this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] from the forums (this guide is also listed down below in the [[Archer#Equipment|Archer equipment]] section with additional details). Note that you do not ''need'' to complete all of these quests, and simply joining the Academy and getting some gear may be all that you need to start. Using the Job Classrooms on the 2nd Floor to more easily reach your Job Change NPC is helpful as well. #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. As an archer, you will be using [[Arrow Shower]]. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1012 Roda Frogs}} until level 21(they drop sticky webfeet that you can sell to players or turn in for the level 56-71 [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]]) , then using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1060 Bigfoots}} until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill {{monster | id=1023 Orc Warriors}}, {{monster | id=1273 Orc Ladies}}, and {{monster | id=1686 Orc Babies}} until level 60.
'''You can accept multiple quests at one time, however when turning in do note that you cannot gain more than 1 full level from a single quest, so do try to turn the quests in when you have a low exp percentage or after you've job changed if you're job level 49.''' === Super Novice Secrets === Being a Super Novice has its benefits as well as disadvantages, and this class remains to be explored by many adventurers. Here are some of the secrets of Super Novicehood: ;Doridori: Using the command /doridori restores HP/SP two times faster. You need to shake your head approximately 6 times in a 1.5 ~ 3s time period. A Super Novice insists that head-shaking supposedly speeds up his SP recovery. This only applies to HP and SP recovered by the skills [[Increase HP Recovery]] & [[Increase SP Recovery]] (Despite the description on the iRO website, this only affects SP recovery, not HP recovery at all) ;Guardian Angel: A Super Novice has its own Level Up Angel. When leveling-up, this Guardian Angel is different from those of the other classes. The Angel will cast all skills from the following list on the Super Novice: :* {{Skill List |skill=Kyrie Eleison |simple=yes}} :* {{Skill List |skill=Magnificat |simple=yes}} :* {{Skill List |skill=Gloria |simple=yes}} :* {{Skill List |skill=Suffragium |simple=yes}} :* {{Skill List |skill=Impositio Manus |simple=yes}} ;Never give up!: According to hearsay, when a Super Novice's HP reaches 0 when he she is 99.0%-99.9%, their Guardian Angel may appear to refill his HP and cast [[Mental Strength]] on the Super Novice. This will not occur again until you relog or get another level. ;Undying Love: A Super Novice wife will give +1 for every stat when she uses the marriage skill [[Marriage System|Undying Love]] on her husband. Also, the husband's SP recovery will double. However, the wife's [[stats]] will all be reduced by 1. This however only occurs randomly and temporarily. ;The Power of Love: A Super Novice wife will [[Heal]] her husband for 2x the normal amount. ;Really Super Super Novice: If a Super Novice can manage to avoid even a single death until Job 70 and onwards, he/she will get +10 for all [[stats]]. If the Super Novice dies anytime afterwards, that bonus will be lost. This death record can be cleared (and the bonus stats recovered) using [[Super Novice Spirit]]. ;Super Novice's Cart: Super Novices get their own special cart for an extra fee (1900z) in [[Al De Baran]] behind the Kafra Headquarters in the Northwestern corner of the map {{Navi|aldebaran|54|238}}. ;A Novice's Fury: A strange phenomenon when the Super Novice's experience reaches increments of 10% such as, at 10.0%, 20.0% - 80.0%, 90.0%. During these times, the Super Novice has been rumored to summon his Guardian Angel for help. If you change maps or relog, you have to repeat all the steps but otherwise you can just repeat the last 3 lines to get [[Fury]] status again. Type 7 lines of text (or you will be [[Status Effects#Silence|silenced]]) and then type the following phrase to get the [[Fury]] Status ([[Stats#CRIT|CRIT]] +50): :* ''Dear angel, can you hear my voice?'' :* ''I am (your name) SuperNovice~'' :* ''Help me out~ Please~ T_T'' :* ''&'' :'''- OR -''' :* ''Guardian Angel, can you hear my voice? ^^;'' :* ''My name is (your name), and I'm a Super Novice~'' :* ''Please help me~ T.T'' :* ''&'' :& is random text. Sometimes you don't have write one more line after "Help me out" to make the effect activate. ;Life After Level 99: Upon reaching [[Levels#Base Level|Base Level]] 99, a Super Novice has a few new tricks up its sleeves: * At the moment of reaching Base Level 99, a Super Novice gains +2000 [[Max HP]] permanently. This bonus is affected by cards, but not by VIT. * The two Super Novice Secrets which depend on your current % of Base EXP can still be used, but you must continue leveling to gain the EXP required. ** To [[Fury]], you must gain n × 10.0x million EXP (where n = 1,2,3,...). ** In order to use [[Mental Strength]] you must gain an additional 99 million EXP or more after reaching the level cap (99 for Super Novice and 200 for Expanded Super Novices). ** Upon attaining 99,999,999 EXP (as shown on the character Select screen), you will be able to use both the novice chant [[Fury]] and [[Mental Strength]] upon 0 HP. ** In order to go beyond Level 99, you have to complete a [[Super Novice Expansion Quest|Quest]]. === Affordable HP Recovery === When mobbing or tanking groups of monsters, especially for AOE leveling, [[Healing Items]] WILL need to be consumed and often even spammed. Two popular and cheap healing items are Nepeta Cataria and Fresh Fish due to their cheap cost and low weight: *{{Item List |id=11602 |item=Nepeta Cataria |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cat Paw Shrimp Merchant''' in [[Izlude]] {{navi|izlude|117|165}} or [[Prontera]] {{navi|prontera|137|223}} (or in [[Lasagna]] {{navi|lasagna|166|117}} if starting as a [[Doram]]) for only 15z each (11z with max [[Discount]]). *{{Item List |id=579 |item=Fresh Fish |simple=yes}} can be purchased from '''Cooking Merchant''' {{navi|payon|167|134}} in [[Payon]] or '''Chef's Assistant''' {{navi|alberta|167|134}} at the docks of [[Alberta]], as well as other cities, for only 250z each (190z with max [[Discount]]). For a list of Healing Items, a comparison, and a list of a couple popular Healing Items, please see the main article: [[Healing Items]]. === Stat Descriptions === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.
*DEX - decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), increases [[Stats | HIT]], [[MATK]], [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons, and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "melee-type" weapons. *LUK - increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]], [[Stats | CRIT]], [[Stats | HIT]], [[Flee]], [[Perfect Dodge]], [[Forging]], [[Potion Creation]], [[Cooking]], and provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Curse]], [[Frozen]], [[Poison]], [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], [[Stone Curse]], and [[Stun]]. ''Melee Weapons - ([[Axe]]s, [[Book]]s, [[Dagger]]s, [[Katar]]s, [[Knuckle]]s, [[Mace]]s, and [[Spear]]s)
Ranged Weapons - ([[Bow]]s, [[Gun]]s, [[Instrument]]s, and [[Whip]]s)'' == Equipment == Unlike other classes, the Super Novice has a few pieces of equipment that are exclusive to [[Novice]]s. They're all dropped by Mini-[[Boss Protocol]] monsters, and give fairly good stats. The [[Card Sets#Lude & Quve Card also known as Novice Card Set|Novice Card Set]] provides a good amount of [[Max HP]] and [[Max SP]], especially at low [[levels]]. And the commonly known as the Light Gear, are able to be NPC purchased in [[Lighthalzen]], except for the {{item |id=2340 Novice Breastplate}} (Bought in [[Juno]]). Notably, they are cheap, they give more [[element]]al reduction and are some of the few NPC equipments with slots. However, they aren't a true set, so the gear may be swapped out. When Satan Morocc re-emerged, some [[Monk]]s abandoned their duty as loyal servants of God and chose to seclude themselves to further develop their physical prowess. They were looked down upon as "Power Mongers," but these Monks offered no excuses for their actions. In order to control their newfound power, they lost their humanity in the process. But they never forgot their roots and continue to use their power for righteous deeds calling themselves '''Suras''' - also known as Gods of War.

'''Sura''' is the third job for [[Champion]]s. Suras gain skills that [[Monk]]s and [[Champion]]s have been lacking: [[Area of Effect]] attacks. Suras also gain a number of new skills and perks, including the ability to begin a combo at will; unique HP/ATK buffs and recovery skills; a maximum [[Spirit Sphere]] limit of 15 and two powerful skills based on HP: {{Skill List|id=2330|skill=Tiger Cannon|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}}. Their ability to completely incapacitate up to 14 enemies for up to 8 seconds through the use of [[Cursed Circle]] proves formidable, especially in [[WoE]] where Suras are regarded as a core disabling class and necessary in every guild.

== Job Change Guide ==
The Sura Job Change quest is fairly simple and very short. Applicants must:
* Kill 100 {{monster |id=1106 Desert Wolves}}
* Survive a room filled with Monsters for 5 minutes.

''See [[Sura Job Change Guide]] for detailed information.''

=== Job Change Quest Skip ===

Note that you can now skip this quest (for a fee) by following the instructions here: [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Classes#Job_Change_Quest_Skip Job Change Quest Skip]

== Builds ==
''It is recommended to use a leveling skill/stat build first, and resetting after maxing out your level or when intending to build the Sura differently at a higher level. Sura skill trees are somewhat different from other classes in that certain AoE skills are most effective at just certain level ranges, due to [[HP]] / [[SP]], [[Base Level]], and number of spheres available from {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}}, which requires many job levels. Suras are very effective single target killers, so many of their end-game builds are specialized for killing single targets. This is also why Suras opt for a leveling build that is more AoE oriented, and reset for an endgame single target oriented build once they are 175/60.''

=== Sky Blow Build (Leveling Build) ===
* [[STR]]: 80+
* [[AGI]]: 80-100
* [[VIT]]: 95+
* [[INT]]: 40-80
* [[DEX]]: 60+
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

{{Skill List|id=2327|skill=Sky Blow|simple=yes}} is usually best used for leveling around the '''levels 100-120 range'''. However, some players may opt for getting other leveling skills while still having Sky Blow, but this means five skill points from Sky Blow and two extra skill points from {{Skill List|id=2326|skill=Dragon Combo|simple=yes}} would be used up.

This build focuses on using {{Skill List|id=2327|skill=Sky Blow|simple=yes}} as your main leveling skill, accompanied by {{Skill List|id=2332|skill=Rampage Blast|simple=yes}} and Gentle Touch [[Gentle Touch-Convert|Convert]]/[[Gentle Touch-Revitalize|Revitalize]] at later levels. After acquiring {{Skill List|id=2327|skill=Sky Blow|simple=yes}} Level 5, it is recommended to max out {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}}, {{Skill List|id=2332|skill=Rampage Blast|simple=yes}}, and the Gentle Touch skill branch in that order. However, it is also plausible to max out the Gentle Touch skill branch instead of the {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}} skill branch first, allowing for cheaper leveling with [[Gentle Touch-Revitalize|Revitalize]].

=== Rampage Blast / Lightning Ride Build (Leveling Build) ===

* [[STR]]: 80-120
* [[AGI]]: 1
* [[VIT]]: 95+
* [[INT]]: 20-40
* [[DEX]]: 80-100
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

{{Skill List|id=2332|skill=Rampage Blast|simple=yes}} is a powerful AoE skill that has a long cooldown, which is best used for leveling around '''levels 115-150'''. 

This skill is most effectively used to level when it is able to one-shot the targeted monsters. It is also possible to use a weaker spammable AoE (such as {{Skill List|id=2518|skill=Lightning Ride|simple=yes}}) to finish them off if Rampage Blast falls short. Because of its long cooldown, it is best to group up many monsters during the downtime, one-shot them and repeat, while using [[Zen]] and [[Power Absorb]] to regenerate SP in the meantime. 
Rampage Blast absolutely requires a high level of {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}} (maxed preferably) because the number of spheres multiplies directly into the final damage. Rising Dragon in conjunction with Power Absorb is also great for recovering SP, as Rampage Blast does have quite a high SP cost. This is also the reason why it is not an option for newer Suras, as {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}} sits very deep within the skill tree and requires a very high job level to max out.

=== Tiger Cannon Build (Leveling / End-game Build) ===

* [[STR]]: 90+
* [[AGI]]: 1+ for leveling purposes; 60+ for end-game purposes
* [[VIT]]: 100-120
* [[INT]]: 80-100
* [[DEX]]: 90+
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

{{Skill List|id=2330|skill=Tiger Cannon|simple=yes}} is a powerful AoE that doubles its damage when used in a combo. This is generally the most powerful AoE skill a Sura has, and is best for '''leveling from 130-150+'''. Some players who are more experienced or have more funds for supplies and equipment may even opt for this build when starting off as a Sura, and can use it to level up all the way to 150.

Most Tiger Cannon builds will opt to level with {{Skill List|id=5009|skill=Flash Combo|simple=yes}}, which is a much easier and more efficient way for a Sura to level with Tiger Cannon especially at lower levels as it has the added benefit of not consuming copious amounts of HP and SP. Suras who do not wish to reset from a leveling build to an end-game build will find this build a viable leveling option starting from as early as level 100.

Note that using {{Skill List|id=2330|skill=Tiger Cannon|simple=yes}} manually also consumes the Sura's [[HP]] and [[SP]] so it can get quite costly. It is highly recommended to have a high level of {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}} to quickly regenerate SP back by using [[Power Absorb]] with it. Also, the combo timing can be tricky to pull off and requires some practice. High [[VIT]] particularly is necessary to boost [[Max HP]], as well as +VIT or +HP% gear. [[Base Level]] contributes to damage both directly in the formula as well as providing a higher HP and SP pool.

When playing a Tiger Cannon Sura during [[WoE]], you should always attempt to target the character with the lowest demi-human reduction, since the damage that {{Skill List|id=2330|skill=Tiger Cannon|simple=yes}} inflicts is only calculated based on this target and is then applied to all enemies within range. While a {{Item List |id=4302 |item=Tao Gunka Card |simple=yes}} may be necessary to push damage into one-shot territory, a more support-like role can still be played without one through contributing area damage and draining SP (particularly relevant against a [[Mechanic]], as sapping their SP will reduce [[Suicidal Destruction]] damage).

===  Tank Build (Leveling / End-game Build) ===
* [[STR]]: 80+
* [[AGI]]: 1+
* [[VIT]]: 94-120
* [[INT]]: 60-96
* [[DEX]]: 60-80
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

A Sura is the best class for tanking in the game in terms of pure reductions, as they have the [[Monk]] skill, [[Mental Strength]]. A Sura is often used for tanking end-game [[MVP]]s, and can also act as a tank for parties during the PVM phase (while having the sacrifice of slower movement speed). [[Gentle Touch-Energy Gain]] is helpful for regaining spheres while tanking. Suras can even cast [[Gentle Touch-Revitalize]] onto themselves, for more damage reduction and [[Max HP]], and this does stack with [[Mental Strength]]. {{Skill List|id=2338|skill=Rising Dragon|simple=yes}} also increases the Sura's HP and is also helpful for regaining [[SP]] with [[Power Absorb]]. 

Because of how good a Sura is at tanking, some players make their Sura purely for the purpose of tanking. However, increasing [[VIT]] beyond 100 is somewhat a waste, as the extra [[HP]] is not very significant defensively. 100 total VIT (94 base + 6 job bonus at Job Level 60) is already adequate for all tanking purposes as it grants [[Stun]] immunity. Tanking becomes more related to gear rather than purely stats at that point, and stacking more % reduction gear on the Sura is what will help tanking efficiency more so than anything else. [[Healing Items]] are also key to staying alive when tanking very hard hitting MVPs. Note that MVPs or monsters that use [[Dispel]] are usually a tanking Sura's worst enemy as it will remove [[Mental Strength]].

Because a Tank build only has the stat requirement of 94 [[VIT]] (6 from job bonuses), often even a Sura that mostly tanks will opt for skills from other builds, with at least one AoE skill for some situations they may want to kill a group of monsters in. Thus it is almost pointless to make a "pure tank" build and it is completely fine to use any regular Sura build for tanking, provided they have 100 total VIT for stun immunity.

Please see the '''[[Sura#Tanking_Tips:|Sura Tactics (Tanking Tips)]]''' section for more strategies related to tanking.

=== Gates of Hell Build (End-game Build) ===
* [[STR]]: 100+
* [[AGI]]: 60+
* [[VIT]]: 94-120
* [[INT]]: 90+
* [[DEX]]: 80-100
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

This stat build is for dealing maximum damage with {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}}. Damage from Gates of Hell is largely based on four factors: Amount of [[HP]] missing, Max [[SP]], [[Base Level]], and [[ATK]]. Some players choose to invest in more [[STR]], while others choose to invest in more [[VIT]] for [[HP]]. Choosing to invest in [[STR]] helps Gates of Hell do more reliable damage at Max [[HP]], while investing in more [[VIT]] or [[HP]] equipment requires players to take the risk of being at low [[HP]] to deal amazing damage. Generally, unless the Sura is equipped with a {{Item List |id=4302 |item=Tao Gunka Card |simple=yes}}, [[Guillotine Fist]] is still the most reliable killing skill (albeit with much longer downtime). 

94 [[VIT]] is the minimum for [[Stun]] immunity (as at Job Level 60 the Sura will gain a bonus +6 VIT for 100 total) but many Suras opt for up to 120 VIT for the added maximum HP (especially effective when using {{Item List |id=22003 |item=Temporal Vit Boots |simple=yes}}).

If one instead seeks higher DPS with {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}} as opposed to burst damage, an option is to increase [[AGI]] at the cost of other stats to reduce the animation delay ([[ASPD]] reduces animation delay) of {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}} when under [[Magic Strings]] and [[Sacrament]]. With the removal of both aftercast delay and animation delay along with an almost instant cast time, the only limitation faced by this build is the need for the Sura to [[Zen]] after every three {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}} casts.

=== Pure Guillotine Fist Build (End-game Build) ===
* [[STR]]: 120
* [[AGI]]: 1
* [[VIT]]: 80+
* [[INT]]: 100-120
* [[DEX]]: 40-60
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

[[Guillotine Fist]], although a [[Monk]] skill, is still a very powerful single target skill, or perhaps even the single most powerful burst damage skill in the game. A high level Sura benefits from this skill even further due to the higher [[SP]] pool, more stats available for [[STR]] and [[INT]], and more weapons and equipment available. 120 STR is recommended for more [[ATK]] and synergy with {{Item List |id=2894 |item=Sura Gauntlets |simple=yes}}, and also if the player has access to {{Item List |id=2629 |item=Megingjard |simple=yes}} accessories. 

=== Knuckle Arrow Build (End-game Build) ===
* [[STR]]: 80+
* [[AGI]]: 80+
* [[VIT]]: 95+
* [[INT]]: 86-90
* [[DEX]]: 60+
* [[LUK]]: 20-40

'''Note:''' This build is not recommended for the majority of players as {{Skill List|id=2343|skill=Gates of Hell|simple=yes}} provides much higher DPS now. However, if one possesses enough aftercast delay reduction (i.e. two {{Item List |id=4403 |item=Kiel-D-01 Cards |simple=yes}}) this build provides the highest single target DPS of any Sura build by far.

This build is based on abusing {{Skill List|id=2336|skill=Knuckle Arrow|simple=yes}}'s most defining qualities: Range, Damage, and DPS. By itself, {{Skill List|id=2336|skill=Knuckle Arrow|simple=yes}} deals decent burst damage. When accompanied by [[Magic_Strings|Magic Strings]], {{Skill List|id=2336|skill=Knuckle Arrow|simple=yes}} becomes spammable based on the Sura's [[ASPD]], so high [[AGI]] is recommended for this purpose. Its 12 cell range makes it a great skill for interrupting skills with long cast times in [[WoE]], such as [[Urgent Call]]. [[ATK]] increasing equipment is recommended for more damage.

== Tactics ==

=== Tanking Tips: ===

==== Reflect ====

High level monsters tend to change target after they are hit for the first time. Because of this, a tanker Sura is not effective if the killer is not one-shotting the mob. The mob will change targets and will target the killer. Note that this is based on the first hit on the monster. To counter this, a Sura can wear equipment that will reflect damage back to the attacker (the monster). Some examples include:
*{{item|id=4322 High Orc Card}}
*[[Equipment_Sets#Bison_Horn_.26_Thorny_Buckler_Combo_Set|Bison Horn & Thorny Buckler Set]]
*{{item|id=5133 Sheep Hat}}
*{{item|id=5405 Filir Hat}}
*{{item|id=19083 Mask of Hero}}
*{{item|id=19137 Strawberry Mouth Guard}}
With reflect equipment on, once any monster hits the Sura, the Sura will reflect a small amount of damage back to the monster, which does register as the "first hit". Therefore, the monster will not change target to anybody attacking it afterwards, and is "latched" onto the Sura. Boss protocol monsters however do not change target, unless the Sura is moving. This includes [[MVP]]s, and also non-MVP monsters that are still boss protocol such as Salamanders.

==== Knockback ====

When tanking an [[MVP]] with knockback abilities in [[Mental Strength]] without a {{Item List |id=2383 |item=Brynhild |simple=yes}} (or any other means of knockback prevention), to avoid the risk of being knocked around and having the monster change focus to the rest of the party it is recommended to stand against a wall.

Alternatively, the player can choose to enchant with [[Spell (Enchant)|Spell Enchants]] for reducing variable cast time for certain skills.

* {{Item List |id=1546 |item=Glorious Morning Star |simple=yes}}

The weapon of choice against Demi-human targets for highest damage. Obtained via the [[Battlegrounds]].

* {{Item List |id=1827 |item=Glorious Fist |simple=yes}}

Mostly used for its [[Sacrament]]-like effect. Obtained via the [[Battlegrounds]].

* {{Item List |id=1525 |item=Long Mace |simple=yes}}

A purely defensive weapon for its 10% ranged damage reduction, can also be [[Malangdo Enchants|enchanted at Malangdo]] for [[Mdef]] enchants.

* {{Item List |id=16024 |item=Quadrille |slots=2 |simple=yes}}

A superior Carga Mace for MVP purposes. It is a high attack Level 4 weapon and has two slots for {{Item List |id=4140 |item=Abysmal Knight cards |simple=yes}}.

* {{Item List |id=16040 |item=Crimson Mace |slots=2 |simple=yes}}

A new replacement for Carga Mace for MVP/Leveling purposes. Best used at +15 due its high equip atk bonus and has two slots for {{Item List |id=4140 |item=Abysmal Knight cards |simple=yes}}.

* {{Item List |id=16033 |item=Robot's Arm |slots=2 |simple=yes}}

A very superior mace for MVP purposes. At high refine level, this mace is able to beat {{Item List |id=16040 |item=Crimson Mace |slots=2 |simple=yes}} in the term of performance. It is a high attack Level 4 weapon and offers two slots for {{Item List |id=4140 |item=Abysmal Knight cards |simple=yes}}.

=== Shields ===

* {{Item List |id=2115 |item=Valkyrja's Shield |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Most useful all round shield for its 20% reduction from [[Fire]], [[Water]], [[Shadow]], and [[Undead]] element attacks. To be carded with an [[Card Reference#By race|appropriate racial reduction card]].

* {{Item List |id=2114 |item=Stone Buckler |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

A cheaper option for some races where a Valkyrja's Shield is not necessary.

* {{Item List |id=2168 |item=Immune Shield |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Good for neutral reduction and some minor elemental reduction, although its effects require the item to be at +12 to utilise its full potential.

=== Garments ===

* {{Item List |id=20718 |item=Giant Faceworm Snake Skin |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Usually used with high VIT enchants and combined with {{Item List |id=22007 |item=Temporal Vit Boots |slots=1 |simple=yes}} at 120 VIT to boost maximum HP. Can be carded with a {{Item List |id=4303 |item=Giant Whisper card |simple=yes}} for more damage, {{Item List |id=4589 |item=Jejeling card |simple=yes}} for more HP or {{Item List |id=4133 |item=Raydric card |simple=yes}}/{{Item List |id=4334 |item=Noxious card |simple=yes}} for reductions. Wealthier players may use a {{Item List |id=4174 |item=Deviling card |simple=yes}} for higher neutral reduction at the expense of elemental vulnerability.

* {{Item List |id=2554 |item=Nidhoggur's Shadow Garb |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

An affordable all round PVM garment, with some elemental resistance, SP increase and SP leech for leveling purposes.

* {{Item List |id=2589 |item=Fallen Angel Wings |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Can be [[Fallen Angel Wing Enchants|enchanted]] for a total of 250 SP and carded with an {{Item List |id=4402 |item=Aliot card |simple=yes}} to become the best garment for [[Guillotine Fist]] damage, enchanted for a total of 20% Ranged atk and carded with an {{Item List |id=4593 |item=Menblatt card |simple=yes}} to become the best garment for {{Skill List|id=2332|skill=Rampage Blast|simple=yes}} and {{Skill List|id=2518|skill=Lightning Ride|simple=yes}} skills.

* {{Item List |id=2576 |item=Heroic Backpack |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

With an even stat spread this garment provides a number of useful bonuses, and at +9 provides more neutral reduction than any other garment. {{Item List |id=4133 |item=Raydric card |simple=yes}} is a popular card choice, or {{Item List |id=4174 |item=Deviling card |simple=yes}} to stack further neutral resistances.

* {{Item List |id=2587 |item=WoE Muffler |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

One part of the WoE set along with {{Item List |id=15048 |item=WoE Robe |slots=1 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=2485 |item=WoE Shoes |slots=1 |simple=yes}} for maximum Demi-human reductions during PVP/WoE. Recommended cards include either a {{Item List |id=4133 |item=Raydric card |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=4334 |item=Noxious card |simple=yes}}.

=== Footgear ===

* {{Item List |id=22014 |item=Enhanced Variant Shoes |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

When at +9 and carded with a {{Item List |id=4160 |item=Firelock Soldier card |simple=yes}} yields the highest max HP and SP value of any footgear. May also be carded with a {{Item List |id=4100 |item=Sohee card |simple=yes}} for more SP for Guillotine Fist.

* {{Item List |id=22007 |item=Temporal Vit Boots |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

These boots are used in conjunction with a VIT enchanted {{Item List |id=20718 |item=Giant Faceworm Snake Skin |slots=1 |simple=yes}} at 120 VIT for highest maximum HP possible. They may be carded with either a {{Item List |id=4160 |item=Firelock Soldier card |simple=yes}} for a more general use or {{Item List |id=4381 |item=Green Ferus card |simple=yes}} for highly VIT focused builds.

* {{Item List |id=22006 |item=Temporal Str Boots |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

These boots are used in conjunction with a STR enchanted {{Item List |id=20718 |item=Giant Faceworm Snake Skin |slots=1 |simple=yes}} at 120 STR for highest atk power possible. They may be carded with either a {{Item List |id=4160 |item=Firelock Soldier card |simple=yes}} for a more general use or {{Item List |id=4100 |item=Sohee card |simple=yes}} for [[Guillotine Fist]] focused builds.

* {{Item List |id=2485 |item=WoE Shoes |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

One part of the WoE set along with {{Item List |id=15048 |item=WoE Robe |slots=1 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=2587 |item=WoE Muffler |slots=1 |simple=yes}} for maximum Demi-human reductions during PVP/WoE. Usually slotted with a {{Item List |id=4160 |item=Firelock Soldier card |simple=yes}}.

=== Accessories ===

* {{Item List |id=2873 |item=Cat Hand Glove |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Cheap accessory option for carding lower valued cards in. May also be carded with a {{Item List |id=4077 |item=Phen card |simple=yes}} for uninterruptible cast.

* {{Item List |id=2729 |item=Diabolus Ring |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Set bonus with a {{Item List |id=2374 |item=Diabolus Robe |slots=1 |simple=yes}} for ATK and SP for [[Guillotine Fist]]. 

* {{Item List |id=2772 |item=Glorious Ring |simple=yes}}

Useful for its 10% reduction from [[Fire]], [[Earth]], [[Wind]], and [[Water]] element attacks. Obtained via the [[Battlegrounds]].

* {{Item List |id=2722 |item=Medal of Honor (Acolyte) |simple=yes}}

Provides max HP and ATK, with a further physical damage bonus when used with the {{Item List |id=2772 |item=Glorious Ring |simple=yes}}. Obtained via the [[Battlegrounds]].

* {{Item List |id=2967 |item=Chambered RWC 2012 Ring |slots=1 |simple=yes}} and {{Item List |id=2969 |item=Chambered RWC 2012 Pendant |slots=1 |simple=yes}}

Both may be [[RWC Accessory Enchants|enchanted]] with useful attributes such as [[Fighting Spirit]] and [[Spell]]. For WoE and PVP purposes, these are typically carded with a {{Item List |id=4044 |item=Smokie card |simple=yes}}, {{Item List |id=4991 |item=Kafra Blossom card |simple=yes}} for elemental reduction or {{Item List |id=4145 |item=Beelzebub Card |simple=yes}} (luxury card).

title: Swordman
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job | jobName = Swordman | jobBase = Novice | jobType = First (Primary) | jobLevel = 50 | Race = [[Human]] | changesAt = [[Izlude]] | skills = 10 | skillPoints = 70 | questSkills = 3 | str = 7 | agi = 2 | vit = 4 | int = 0 | dex = 3 | luk = 2 }} [[file: SwordsmanATK.jpeg‎|250px|right]] A Swordman is a strong-willed fighter seeking to lead other adventurers with their [[Sword]] and [[Shield]]. Though stubborn like the waves of the sea, a Swordman is able to use their powerful attack skills to change the tide on the battlefield. Growing up in [[Prontera]]'s satellite port town of [[Izlude]], where many skilled instructors work at the local Academy, they have been trained that the best defense is a good offense and protecting others should always be their priority. A Swordman tends to have high [[ATK]] from their high [[STR]] and bonuses with [[One Handed Swords]] and [[Two Handed Swords]], with many of their skills boosting the damage of these weapons, but they are also trained to use [[Spears]], [[Axes]], [[Maces]], and [[Daggers]]. They can also equip heavy armor and shields to boost their [[DEF]] and their high [[HP]] pool from [[VIT]] helps with tanking mobs for their party. == Job Changing == Once you are a Job Level 10 [[Novice]], you have 2 methods of changing into a Swordman: #Go to [[Izlude]] and enter the Swordman Guild on the west side of town at {{Navi|izlude_in |74|168}}. Talk to the ''Swordman'' [[NPC]] in the center room behind the desk who will change your job to Swordman and reward you with a {{Item List |id=13415 |item=Novice Falchion|slots=3 |simple=yes}}. #*Pursuing this method also unlocks the [[Berserk]], [[Fatal Blow]], and [[HP Recovery While Moving]] Skills for free right as you change. #Alternatively, go to the Swordsman Classroom on the 2nd Floor of [[Training Grounds|Criatura Academy]] and speak to the [[NPC]], ''Swordman Trainer'', located at {{Navi|iz_ac02|62|51}}. He will warn you that you will not receive the bonus Job Skills listed above if you use this method and thus it is not recommended. == Builds == === I. Magnum Break === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build requires you to gather mobs of monsters and then kill them all at once using [[Magnum Break]]. You may have to use [[Provoke]] to help attract passive monsters to you. Use gear that increases your [[DEF]] and [[HP]] / [[SP]] pool and using a [[One Handed Sword]] and [[Shield]], with maxed [[Sword Mastery]], is recommended for this build for better survivability. You will use many recovery items or leech gear as you are just starting out, but teaming up with an [[Acolyte]] for [[Heal]]s can help avoid using costly consumables.
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on the monster you are killing, your survivability, skill playing the game, and planned character build later on. The main focus is [[STR]] for [[ATK]] and [[VIT]] for survivability but if you find yourself missing monsters, add more [[DEX]] to give you [[HIT]]. Some [[INT]] is recommended since your main means of leveling is casting your AOE skill over and over on mobs. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 40
*AGI: 1
*VIT: 30
*INT: 16
*DEX: 20
*LUK: 1

=== II. Bash & Auto-Attack === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build focuses on weakening or killing monsters one at a time using [[Bash]] and finishing them off with quick auto-attacks as needed. Using a [[Two Handed Sword]] with [[Two-Handed Sword Mastery]] is recommended for the the higher [[ATK]] bonuses. Ideal targets to kill for this build are passive monsters, such as Willow or Bigfoot, so you do not get mobbed while finishing them off with your increased [[ASPD]]. This type of build isn't recommended for the long term, but is very affordable for new players early on. '''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on the monster you are killing, your survivability, skill playing the game, and planned character build later on. The main focus is [[STR]] for [[ATK]] and [[AGI]] for [[ASPD]] & [[FLEE]], but feel free to add more [[DEX]] to give you [[HIT]] as needed. You can also opt to get a little [[INT]] for enlarging your [[SP]] pool if you feel it is lacking/you want to rapid cast [[Bash]] more. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 26
*AGI: 50
*VIT: 1
*INT: 1
*DEX: 20
*LUK: 1

==Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three suggestions to efficiently level a new character: #First, get gear and experience for your new character by following this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] from the forums (this guide is also listed down below in the [[Swordman#Equipment|Swordman equipment]] section with additional details). #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. Use any AoE skill available for your class (e.g., [[Magnum Break]], [[Fire Ball]], [[Cart Revolution]], etc.). You may use {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card |simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] if your class does not have an AoE skill. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Willows''' until level 21 and '''Bigfoot''' until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]], kill '''Orcs''', '''Orc Ladies''', and '''Orc Babies''' until level 55 and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill '''Orcs''' and '''Orc Ladies''' until level 60. '''You can stack the quests for Orc and Orc Lady kill counts by having both quests active!''' === Stats Description === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.
*DEX - decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), increases [[Stats | HIT]], [[MATK]], [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons, and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "melee-type" weapons. *LUK - increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]], [[Stats | CRIT]], [[Stats | HIT]], [[Flee]], [[Perfect Dodge]], [[Forging]], [[Potion Creation]], [[Cooking]], and provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Curse]], [[Frozen]], [[Poison]], [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], [[Stone Curse]], and [[Stun]]. ''Melee Weapons - ([[Axe]]s, [[Book]]s, [[Dagger]]s, [[Katar]]s, [[Knuckle]]s, [[Mace]]s, and [[Spear]]s)''
''Ranged Weapons - ([[Bow]]s, [[Gun]]s, [[Instrument]]s, and [[Whip]]s)'' === Overall Tips and Suggestions === #Your next class is either an [[Knight]] or a [[Crusader]]; you may have to adjust your build accordingly.
#Use [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] and [[Bounty Board Quests]] to find monsters to kill around your level.
#Use [[Stat Reset |Stat Reset]] to reset your stats to maximize your damage.
#Use [[Skill Reset|Skill Reset]] to rest your skills to maximize your damage.
#Use [[Create Elemental Converter | Elemental Converters]] to increase your damage by changing your weapons element that is strong against the monster's element.
#Use [[ASPD Potion]]s to greatly increase your killing speed at lower levels.

== Equipment == === I. Enchanter Mounds Quest === After creating a [[Novice]] character, follow the section of this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] titled "Enchanter Mounds Quest" which involves [[NPC]] Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}}. This quest will allow you to enchant the {{Item List |id=2302 |item=Cotton Shirt |simple=yes}} that you get the moment you created your [[Novice]] character with the enchantments Max HP+100 and Max SP+50, provided that you complete the step that requires you to speak with [[NPC]] Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}}. This cotton shirt proves itself useful once you change your class and can no longer equip most of the novice gear provided to you when you register at the academy. It is recommended to card this cotton shirt with cards that increase [[HP]] and/or [[SP]] such as {{Item List |id=31016 |item=Decorated Evil Tree Card |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=4003 |item=Pupa Card |simple=yes}}. After providing Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}} with a review of the service they provided during the enchanting quest, you can talk to Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}} to enchant the novice weapon you receive after you change your class from [[Novice]] to [[Swordman]]. The two enchantments provided are random and if you aren’t happy with the result you can enchant it again endlessly. If you were able to enchant the novice rod you would likely use this enchanted weapon until you can do the level 26 [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] which is the first part of that questline which rewards a weapon. Keep in mind Enchanter Almond J won’t enchant the Novice Main Gauche that you get for registering at the academy despite it being a novice weapon. === II. Eden Group Equipments Quests === Starting at level 12 you can complete the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] to obtain free equipment for your class. This equipment is sufficient to get you to level 99. === III. General Weapon Recommendations === The following weapons are sequenced from the ''fastest to the lowest'' [[ASPD]] and ''lowest to the highest'' [[ATK]] generally. '''a. [[Daggers]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage to [[Size|small monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Inflict 50% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
'''b. [[One Handed Swords]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small and large monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
'''c. [[Two Handed Swords]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|large monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small and medium monsters]]
*''Cannot'' be used with a [[Shield]]
'''d. [[Axe]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|large monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Inflict 50% damage on [[Size|small monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
'''e. [[Mace]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|medium and large monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
'''f. One-handed [[Spears]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|large monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small and medium monsters]]
*Has range to attack enemies from afar
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
'''g. Two-handed [[Spears]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|large monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small and medium monsters]]
*Has range to attack enemies from afar
*''Cannot'' be used with a [[Shield]]

'''For the Swordsman Job Change Quest on iRO [[RE:Start]], which is implemented, see the guide [[Swordman_Job_Change_Guide/Restart|here]].'''

1. In [[Izlude]], enter the Swordman Guild on the west side of town (??,??). Talk to the Swordman [[NPC]] in the center room behind the desk, then the guard to the west. This guard will transfer you to a new room. 

2. Talk to the guard here to initiate the test. 

3. ''First Map'': A simple map. Just walk to the other side.  If you fall you will be sent back to the beginning.

4. ''Second Map'': This map involves two parallel bridges. Take your time and be careful not to fall off. You don't have to hold the mouse button down to walk. 

5. ''Third Map'': Similar to the first map except for the upper and lower levels. The lower level has a darker color than the upper level. Take your time and click carefully to get to the lower level. 
~At the point where there is a gap in the top level, simply click on the lower level, and you will jump down. Then do the same to get back up.

6. After exiting the test maps, speak to the large [[Swordman]] in the main room to become a [[Swordman]].
