title: Thanatos Tower Quest/old
wikitext:
{{Not Implemented}}
'''NOTE: THIS IS THE OLD VERISON OF THIS QUEST. FOR THE CURRENT THANATOS QUEST ON iRO, GO TO
[[Thanatos Tower Quest|THIS PAGE]]!'''
{{Quest Info | levelreq = None | joblevelreq = | classreq = | partyreq = 5+ People for Level 3 Access | itemreq = 1 {{item |id=7437 Fragment of Misery}}, 1 {{item |id=7436 Fragment of Agony}}, 1 {{item |id=7438 Fragment of Hatred}}, 1 {{item |id=7439 Fragment of Despair}} | nitemreq = Equippable Level 4 Weapon | zenyreq = | questsreq = Transcendent Class or 95+ Expanded Class characters | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Ability to Summon {{monster |id=1708 Memory of Thanatos}} (Repeatable) }} * Note: ''In order to access floors higher than 6, players must be either a Transcendent class or Expanded class above level 95.'' * Note: ''If you do NOT intend to finish the entire quest at one time, you should be aware that once you obtain the Keys (possibly the stones as well), they cannot be put into storage or dropped. If every amount of weight counts on your character, you would be wise not to do this quest if you don't intend to do it to completion (or at least until you use all of the items).'' 1. On Thanatos Tower 1F you should find a representative NPC (tha_t01 149 78) who is looking for recruits for those wishing to explore the tower. Sign up with her for the quest. [[Image:thaquest01.jpg]] 2. A guide on Thanatos Tower 2F (tha_t02 231 161) blocks the entrance to 3F. You will need to gather 5 or more players will the guide open the door to 3F. Its not required that you be in the same party to enter. If you have not received the quest from step 1, you will not be able to enter this portal. [[Image:thaquest02.jpg]] 3. On 3F (tha_t03 67 70) you'll find a strange mechanism. Using a Lv. 4 weapon, you can pry the device open, obtaining a Red Key. [[Image:thaquest03.jpg]] 4. On 4F (tha_t04 195 195) you'll find another strange mechanism. The mechanism can be opened by solving a puzzle, similar to mastermind if you've ever played it. The machine will guess 3 numbers between 1 and 9 (none repeating), and you will be required to crack the password. Each round you can guess 3 numbers from 1-9 (no repeats), and the machine will inform you how many of the numbers you chose were correct and in the proper location, and how many numbers are correct but not in the right location. You have 5 rounds to guess the correct code or you will be required to restart. When you correctly complete this puzzle, you will obtain a Yellow Key. [[Image:thaquest04.jpg]] 5. On 5F (tha_t05 101 37), there will be a third mechanism. This device is closed so strongly that you can only open it with the strength of many. Attempting to open the mechanism with 3 or more people nearby to help will gain you the Blue Key. [[Image:thaquest05.jpg]] 6. On 6F (tha_t06 43 152), there will be a fourth mechanism. Nearby, there will be 5 wheels which you can turn and adjust. Through trial and error, turn all the wheels so they make till they make the same sound and the machine will activate. Here you will obtain the Green Key. [[Image:thaquest06.jpg]] 7. On the 9th floor (tha_t09 19 168), you will find the last mechanism. In order to open this, you will require either the Red Key or Red Charm Stone, Yellow Key or Yellow Charm Stone, the Blue Key or Blue Charm Stone, and Green Key or Green Charm Stone. With all 4 of these items, enter either "'''Keys'''" or "'''Charms'''" to obtain the Black Key. [[Image:thaquest07.jpg]] 8. Once you've obtained all 5 colored keys you'll need to leave and re-enter the tower (in order to get back to lower floors). Returning to 4F (tha_t04 150 44), you will find a magical seal. When you try to open it, type in "'''Blue Key'''", and you will receive a Blue Charm Stone. [[Image:thaquest08.jpg]] 9. On 5F (tha_t05 218 116) you will find a second magic seal. Enter "'''Red Key'''", and you will receive the Red Charm Stone. [[Image:thaquest09.jpg]] 10. On 6F (tha_t06 226 230) you will find the third magic seal. Enter "'''Black Key'''", and you will receive the Black Charm Stone. [[Image:thaquest10.jpg]] 11. Now on 7F (tha_t07 113 129), you will find the fourth magic seal. Enter "'''Yellow Key'''", and you will receive the Yellow Charm Stone. [[Image:thaquest11.jpg]] 12. On 10F (tha_t10 129 159), you will find the fifth and final magic seal. Enter "'''Green Key'''", and you will receive the Green Charm Stone. [[Image:thaquest12.jpg]] 13. With all the magical jewels, you are now ready to open the pathway to the top of the tower. Make your way to the uppermost floor. On this 12th floor, start by placing the Red Charm Stone into the first statue {{navi|tha_t12|96|58}} in the northwest direction. [[Image:thaquest13.jpg]] 14. Place the Yellow Charm Stone into the second statue {{navi|tha_t12|161|58}} in the northeast direction. [[Image:thaquest14.jpg]] 15. Then place the Blue Charm Stone into the third statue {{navi|tha_t12|104|18}} in the southwest direction. [[Image:thaquest15.jpg]] 16. Place the Black Charm Stone into the fourth statue {{navi|tha_t12|128|86}} in the north direction. 17. Place the Green Charm Stone into the final statue in the southeast direction. The pathway to the top of the tower should now appear in the center of the floor. 18. On the southeast platform you'll find a magic circle {{navi|thana_boss|217|167}}. For this you will need to have a {{item |id=7436 Fragment of Agony}} or you will be unable to proceed. Fragment of Agony is dropped by Dolor of Thanatos. Walk over the magic circle and enter "'''Fragment of Agony'''". At this time, a {{monster |id=1712 Dolor of Thanatos}} will appear. [[Image:thaquest16.jpg]] 19. Once the first wave of monsters is defeated, proceed to the northeast platform {{navi|thana_boss|202|75}}. This time you will need a {{item |id=7437 Fragment of Misery}}. Without this item, you will be unable to proceed. Place the "'''Fragment of Misery'''" in the magic circle, a {{monster |id=1711 Maero of Thanatos}} will appear. [[Image:thaquest17.jpg]] 20. On the northwest platform {{navi|thana_boss|80|76}}, you will need a {{item |id=7439 Fragment of Despair}}. When you place the "'''Fragment of Despair'''", a {{monster |id=1710 Despero of Thanatos}} will appear. [[Image:thaquest18.jpg]] 21. On the southwest platform {{navi|thana_boss|62|171}}, you will need a {{item |id=7438 Fragment of Hatred}}. When you place the "'''Fragment of Hatred'''", an {{monster |id=1709 Odium of Thanatos}} will appear. [[Image:thaquest19.jpg]] 22. With all four fragments in place, you can finally break the seal. On the north platform, there will be a switch {{navi|thana_boss|141|218}}. Activating this seal will summon 1 of each of Thanatos' incarnations. [[Image:thaquest20.jpg]] 23. Once all 4 ghosts have been defeated, {{monster |id=1708 Memory of Thanatos}} will spawn south of the statue on the center platform. [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Noghalt Quests]]

title: Thanatos Tower Revamp
wikitext:
[[File:TTR1.png|frame|center]] = Overview = [[Thanatos Tower]] was revamped on [https://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/updatedetail.aspx?id=360&p=2 January 30th, 2024] in iRO to include new floors, new monsters, new daily quests, new equipment, new ways to access these, and more. = Thanatos Tower Entrance = To gain access to Thanatos Tower, you will need to speak to ''' Gate''', located at {{navi| hu_fild01| 140|163}}, and pay 5000 zeny. *If you sign the Agreement highlighted in the sections below, subsequent visits will only cost you 3000 zeny to enter. [[File:TTR2.png|frame|center]] Since [[Warp Portal]] memo'ing is not accessible inside Thanatos Tower, it is easiest to use the [[Juno Monster Society]] to access the entrance of the Tower via one of the many '''Assistant''' NPCs. = Thanatos Tower Agreement = {{Quest Info | levelreq = 1+ | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Discount on Tower Entrance fee, Access to Elevator, Access to Floors 2-12 (Level dependent), Access to "Blade's Request: Secrets of the Thanatos Tower", Access to Daily Turn-in Quests | external = | window = yes }} Once you have entered the tower, it is recommended to register with the ''' Dice Lapa''' behind the desk at {{navi| tha_t01|149|78}} for access to the Tower's multiple quests, the Tower's Floor Elevator, and higher-level floors during your first visit. [[File:TTR3.png|frame|center]] = Elevator of Thanatos Tower = {{Quest Info | levelreq = Varies: *1+ for access to Floors 2-6 *95+ for access to Floors 7-8 *180+ for access to Floors 9-12 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = 1000 | hunting = | questsreq = Thanatos Tower Agreement | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = | qreward = Quick access to Floors 2-12 | external = | window = yes }} By talking to the ''' Lie Knizier''' at , you can pay 1000 zeny to take an elevator directly to your Floor of choice. Your [[Base Level]] will restrict which floors can be accessed: *1-94 can only access Floors 2-6. *95-180 can additionally access Floors 7-8. *180+ can additionally access Floors 9-12. [[File:TTR5.png|frame|center]] = Blade's Request: Secrets of the Thanatos Tower = {{Quest Info | levelreq = 90+ | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = {{Item List |id=11011 |item=Varmunt's Note |simple=yes}} | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = Thanatos Tower Agreement | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 100,000 | jobexpreward = 100,000 | itemreward = | qreward = Base and Job Experience | external = | window = yes }} This quest is not repeatable. '''Blade Conceed''', a Zonda Service Employee under Rekenber, can be found on the 2nd Floor of Thanatos Tower at {{navi| tha_t02|231|161}}. He headed to the Tower because of Rekenber's obsession with it, but it looks like he needs help digging into the secrets behind its many locked chambers. #Talk to '''Blade''' and select Option 3 to begin this Quest if you are above Base Level 90. #Blade will give you a {{Item List |id=7421 |item=Red Key |simple=yes}} and players must follow modified quest path similar to the original [[Thanatos Tower Quest]]. #Return to '''Blade''' with the final item, {{Item List |id=11011 |item=Varmunt's Note |simple=yes}}, to be rewarded with 100,000 EXP (''Need Confirmation on EXP gained''). ::NOTE: ''Players can utilize this NPC to warp to 3rd Floor with no level restriction by selecting Option 1 if needed.'' Apple 3ea | width="91" height="19" align="center" | 15z | width="155" height="19" align="center" | Fruit Gardener at Lighthalzen General Store |} ==Starting the quest== Make your way to (227,147) in Lighthalzen [[Image:brandos.jpg]] where you will encounter the Brandos. They're all getting ready for Thanksgivin, and need various items. First talk to Mr. Brando. He needs 10 meats [[Image:Meat.png]] and 2 yams [[Image:Yam.png]]. Bring him the items for some EXP. After helping Mr. Brando, turn your attention to Mrs. Brando. She is making Pumpkin Potato Bisque, and needs 5 milk [[Image:519_Milk.png]], 5 pumpkins [[Image:Pumpkin.png]], 10 carrots [[Image:515_Carrot.png]], and 10 potatoes [[Image:Potato.png]]. Bring her the items for some more EXP. After her, you need to help Grandma Brando. The holidays must be a bit too much for her, because she wants you to fetch her a vial of 200-proof alcohol [[Image:970_Alcohol.png]]. She'll reward you with some more EXP. After Grandma, talk to Kipp. He wants 10 trunks [[Image:1019_Trunk.png]] and 3 iron ore [[Image:Iron_Ore.png]], though he'll tell you he only wants 3 trunks. You must bring 10 to complete this part of the quest. Finally, talk to Cherise. She wants 5 Strawberries [[Image:Strawberry.gif]] and 3 apples [[Image:512_Apple.png]] to make some jam. She'll give you some more EXP. After you help Cherise, talk to her once more to receive 2 Yggdrasil Berries [[Image:Yggdrasil Berry.png]]. Now, whenever you talk to one of the Brandos, they'll heal your HP and SP. You may be healed as often as you like, but you cannot get any more Yggdrasil Berries. ==References== * Original guide from the [http://robank.tacorner.com/thx First Bank of iRO] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category: Temporary Event Quests]] [[Category: Base Experience Reward]]

1. Talk to Turpeco in [[Morocc]] {{navi|morocc|193|58}}. He wants to win a contest and asks you to bring him 50 {{item |id=909 Jellopy}}.

:[[File:ThanksgivingQuest2014 Turpeco.jpg]]

2. After you give him {{item |id=909 Jellopy}} he asks you to remove some of the competitors. Kill 30 {{monster |id=1019 Peco Peco}} ({{map |id=moc_fild01 moc_fild01}}: two locs down from [[Prontera]]).

3. Next Turpeco asks you to inform Chief Judge Oda that he is ready for the contest. Find Chief Judge Oda in Morocc Inn nearly Turpeco.

:[[File:ThanksgivingQuest2014 Oda.jpg]]

4. Oda tells you that this isn't a beauty contest, and asks you tell this to Turpeco.

5. Once you tell Turpeco that he is main dish, he asks you bring different ingridients to Oda: 5 {{item |id=517 Meat}}, 5 {{item |id=574 Egg}}, 5 {{item |id=1023 Fish Tail}}, 5 {{item |id=579 Fresh Fish}}, 5 {{item |id=962 Tentacle}}, 5 {{item |id=514 Grape}}, 5 {{item |id=516 Potato}}, 5 {{item |id=578 Strawberry}}.

6. Oda will taste your ingridients one by one and randomly pick up one. Now you can tell Turpeco that he is safe.
*Note: don't insist on giving him always the same item. Your character has been assigned just one set, and you have to guess which one it is.

7. Turpeco thanks you and give you a present and exp. 

* Obtain 1 {{item|id=18660 Indian Feather Headband [1]}}

* '''Note:''' Quest is repeatable on a 4 hour cooldown.  Subsequent runs award random items in addition to exp.

title: The Last Room
wikitext:
{{Repeatable|reset=18 hours}} {{Quest Info | levelreq = 150 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = 1+, need to be in party | itemreq = {{Item|id=6828 Gravity Safety Device}} | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = [[Vestige]] | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = | jobexpreward = | itemreward = 1 {{Item|id=6827 Intact Machine Components}} which can be traded for several equipments | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} '''Notes:'''
- You should have in your possession a total of 2 Gravity Safety Devices (GSD) after completing Vestige and The Last Room for the first time.

- The GSD is meant to be consumed if attempting to take a direct warp into the last room through '''Verity''', and may only be reacquired by completing The Last Room and talking to '''Fruit''' to collect it afterwards.

- Redoing the Vestige quest a second time '''will not''' reward you with another GSD. '''Instance Cooldown Quest Name''': Final Room To start this [[instance]], go to '''Verity''' {{navi|verus01|123|181}} on LAB OPTATIO. Talk to her to open the instance. #You will be warped to the Last Room entrance. Speak with Mark. #Once you're on the pathway, talk to Verity. #As you head north, a security system triggers and monsters will spawn. Kill '''all''' these monsters and then destroy the System Message in the south-west corner of the map. #Go north again and speak to Tamarin. #Keep going north and enter the warp. Take note that a new security system will trigger. #Walk ahead until you meet another batch of monsters and Verity at the end of the hallway. Talk to her and enter the door. #Inside the room, talk to Verity again. As the final protocol begins, T_W_O and System Messages will spawn and attack you. System Messages will spawn as the time goes and start healing her. They are plant protocol and took 1 damage. #*{{monster|id=3254 T_W_O}} has 48m HP, [[Demon]] race and [[Shadow]] 3 element. #*She casts [[Wide Stone Curse]], [[Wide Soul Drain]], and [[Critical Wounds]] so [[Undead]] armor, SP pots, and % recovery items or leech helps a lot here. #*She will drop Mysterious Part when defeated. #After she's defeated, talk to her and you will get warped out of the instance. #Speak to '''Fruit''' {{navi|verus01|151|173}} to get Gravity Device and 1 Intact Machine Components. ===Rewards=== *Fruit {{navi|verus01|151|173}} will exchange 17 Intact Machine Components to {{Item|id=18997 Runaway Chip}}, {{Item|id=28326 Broken Chip 01}} or {{Item|id=28327 Broken Chip 02}} {{Navbox Instance}} [[Category:Instances]]

#Find '''Anvian''' upstairs in the {{map|id=geffen Geffen Inn}} at {{Navi|geffen_in|107|39}}, who tells you that '''Orovan''' has yet to return from Glast Heim. He asks you look around the castle grounds for him.
#Find '''Orovan''' at {{map|id=glast_01 Glast Heim}} {{Navi|glast_01|201|335}}. He asks you to look around the castle grounds for his pocket watch.
#Check the various locations at:
#*Glast Heim {{Navi|glast_01|339|51}} = Southeast Corner
#*Glast Heim {{Navi|glast_01|324|376}} = Northeast Corner
#*Glast Heim {{Navi|glast_01|40|69}} = Southwest Corner
#*Glast Heim {{Navi|glast_01|28|327}} = Northwest Corner
#Once you’ve found it, return to '''Orovan''', who thanks you and tells you about a strange group of statues he found inside.
#Find the statues around {{map|id =gl_cas02 Glast Heim 2F}} {{Navi|gl_cas02|91|89}}.
#*Mini-game: Every few minutes the statues will have a different sequence in which they glow. The player needs to repeat the sequence. The player chooses the appropriate order via the statue chest.  Once the last sequence is entered, the player finds a small key and a tattered page.
#Go back to '''Orovan''' who tells you a bit about the castle’s history. He suggests you look for the lock the key opens on the same floor as where you found it.
#Find the box at {{map|id=gl_cas02 Glast Heim 2F}} {{Navi|gl_cas02|168|12}}. Using the key, you open it and find a tattered note as well as a page out of a book. The note instructs you to find the bull.
#Find the '''Bull’s head''' at {{map|id=gl_cas02 Glast Heim 2F}} {{Navi|gl_cas02|12|8}}. You must test your strength by challenging it.
#*Spawn 1 {{monster|id=1310 Majoruros}} nearby. It must be defeated to continue.
#Once it is defeated, talk to the bull again and the hand opens to reveal another page and a key marked “Fire”.
#Return to '''Orovan''', who tells you about the four values of Glast Heim: Wisdom, Strength, Humility and Courage. Since you have already completed the first two, there must be two more challenges left to complete. He tells you he’ll meet you down further in the dungeon, but suggests you check out the first level of the '''Underprison''' for anything that might show humility towards the prisoners who were kept there.
#Find the bucket of water by the '''guillotine''' at {{map|id=gl_prison Glast Heim Underprison}} {{Navi|gl_prison|109|92}}, where you find another key (Water) but no page. You hear a lion roar in the distance. Since '''Orovan''' was checking the lower level of the Underprison, you decide to check the first level of the sewer.
#Talk to the '''Lion Heads''' in order:
#*Glast Heim Culvert 1 {{Navi|gl_sew01|47|206}} = lion head (top left)
#*Glast Heim Culvert 1 {{Navi|gl_sew01|159|206}} = lion head (top center)
#*Glast Heim Culvert 1 {{Navi|gl_sew01|223|168}} = lion head (right)
#*Glast Heim Culvert 1 {{Navi|gl_sew01|148|168}} = lion head (center)
#They tell you a story about the castle’s fall. When you talk to the last one, you hear a much louder roar from the next floor. You are instructed to talk to the '''large head''' in the top left corner of the second floor of the sewer.
#Find the '''Lion Head''' at {{map|id=gl_sew02 Glast Heim Culvert 2}} {{Navi|gl_sew02|82|251}}, who wishes to test your courage by reaching into its mouth. Reaching in slowly or quickly cause you to lose health, while reaching in confidently allows you to proceed.
#Once you are successful, you receive another key (Earth), but once again there is no page. The lion tells you that he saw an old man pass by earlier, and that he is still on that floor.
#Find '''Orovan''' at {{map|id=gl_sew02 Glast Heim Culvert}} {{Navi|gl_sew02|199|40}}. He asks you if you hear anything coming from the water.
#Talk to the '''Lost Spirit''' at {{map|id=gl_sew02 Glast Heim Culvert}} {{Navi|gl_sew02|210|40}} ('''Note: This NPC is underwater'''). It tells you more about the downfall of Glast Heim.
#Talk to '''Orovan''' again, who suggests you continue down to the lowest level of the dungeon.
#Make your way down to {{map|id=gl_dun02 Glast Heim Cave}} {{Navi|gl_dun02|52|269}} where '''Orovan''' is waiting. He speculates that this must be the “Tome of the Dark Lord”, but tells you many of its pages are missing. You determine the ones you have collected are just some of the missing pages. '''Orovan''' asks you to look around the cave a bit more.
#Talk to these NPCs (in no particular order):
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|55|268}} = The Book
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|49|245}} = The Sword
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|37|164}} = Tent
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|80|190}} = The Book 2
#Walk near the following locations (in no particular order):
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|167|35}} = Tunnel 1 (Fire)
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|275|100}} = Tunnel 2 (Earth)
#*Glast Heim Cave {{Navi|gl_dun02|20|27}} = Tunnel 3 (Water)
#Return to '''Orovan''' (on the same floor), who speculates that the scattered pages you’ve seen throughout Glast Heim probably belong in the book. He is worried about the pages that weren’t with the puzzles as well as the gates and tent you’ve found, but suggests that you speak to '''Kazien''' about them before taking more action. He asks you to return to '''Anvian''' to tell him what you’ve found.
#Collect {{Item List|id=1097 |item=Worn Out Page |simple=yes |num=20}} and talk to '''Orovan''' back outside of Glast Heim.
#Return to '''Anvian'''. You fill him in on the events at Glast Heim, and he thanks you and rewards you with Experience.

title: The Royal Banquet
wikitext:
[[File:Royalmap.jpg|700px|right]] = The Royal Banquet = Another name for the Episode 16.1 updates. This focuses on who will be crowned the new king among the 7 royal families. Three new instances (two of which are repeatable), and two new dungeons were added as part of this update. The city of Prontera, and the castle also got a huge graphical overhaul.
[[Noblesse Equipment]] is also introduced and the selling NPC can be accessed at any time. = Main Quest = '''Reminder''': Clicking the (navi) links and then pasting in game chat window will navigate you to the location! '''Note''': Episode can be skipped, Refer [[Episode#Skip / Clear Tickets|Episode Skip Tickets]] == Learning About the Families == {{Quest Info | levelreq = 100 | joblevelreq = | classreq = | skillreq = | partyreq = | itemreq = | nitemreq = | zenyreq = | hunting = | questsreq = [[Cat_Hand_Services#New_World_Access_Quest|New World Access Quest]] | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = {{tooltip|1,000,000|1,500,000 for VIP}} Base EXP | jobexpreward = {{tooltip|1,000,000|1,500,000 for VIP}} Job EXP | itemreward = 10 [[Honor Token]] | qreward = Access to [[Terra Gloria]],
[[Royal Banquet Daily Quests]],
[[The Royal Banquet#Room of Consciousness Instance|Room of Consciousness Instance]],
[[The Royal Banquet#Sidequests|Royal Family Sidequest]] | external = | window = yes }} *'''Note''' **This quest continues to add to the corruption conspiracy information you obtained from the [[Curse_of_Gaebolg_(Founding_of_the_Nation_Myth_Quest) |Curse of Geoborg]] quest. **You will need to have access to [https://irowiki.org/wiki/Cat_Hand_Services#New_World_Access_Quest New World] before Royal Errand Boy will respond. #Talk to any '''Royal Errand Boy''' that can be found in major city. #*Prontera {{navi|prontera|121|72}}, Geffen {{navi|geffen|123|68}}, Payon {{navi|payon|168|65}}, Morroc {{navi|morocc|152|97}}, Alberta {{navi|alberta|119|59}}, Juno {{navi|yuno|162|132}}, and more. #*Help him, and he will invite you to the Royal Banquet in Prontera Castle. #*He will give you a {{item|id=6933 Banquet Invitation}}. #:[[File:Royal Errand Boy.png|250px]] #Talk with '''Servant Bell''' {{navi|prt_cas|217|150}} at the entrance of Prontera Castle. #:[[File:WaitingServantBell.png]] #Walk to the west wing and into your private room {{Navi|prt_cas_q|130|8}}. Talk to '''Servant Bell''' and find out that a ritual needs to take place to replace the sudden death of the previous king. #:[[File:Chamberlain Bell.png|250px]] #:The following can be done in any order, but is easiest if you do it in the order of this guide (saves on walking): #:*At any time if you do not know which families still need to be talked to, talk to '''Servant Bell''' and he will tell you who's missing. ##'''Heines Family''': Walk to the room just north {{Navi|prt_cas_q|130|32}} of your private room and approach the table. Wait for the conversation to end. ##:[[File:KroneckerHeine.png|250px]] ##*Talk to '''Kronecker G. Heine''' and find out Peter will be the Heine candidate which makes Nyhill jealous. ##*Leave the room and walk a bit north. Nyhill and Skia will start a conversation about being the shadow of Peter and the Heine family. ##:[[File:Skia-OutsideRoom.png|250px]] ##'''Nerius Family''': Travel north to the next room {{Navi|prt_cas_q|130|56}} in the west corridor and talk to '''Spica Nerius'''. ##:[[File:SpicaNerius.png|250px]] ##* Led by women, the Nerius family is not interested in the throne. Erich is the candidate and is hanging out in the banquet hall. ##'''Walther Family''': Walk to the furthest room in the west corridor {{Navi|prt_cas_q|130|80}} and talk to '''Ian Walther'''. ##:[[File:IanWalther.png|250px]] ###Talk to '''Ian Walther''' again and a "Mysterious Person" from the Richards appears and starts a dialog box. He's nervous that someone will find out they're going to kill Ernst, Geoborg candidate. ###Talk to '''Isenhonor Walther''' and he'll tell you about the Guardian Knights. He'll tell you his manor is in Alberta. ###*'''[[The_Royal_Banquet#Walther_Sidequest|Walther Sidequest]]''' is available now. ###*They don't participate in the Royal Assembly because of "unfortunate incident" that Isenarm was killed by the Geoborg (GMs check spelling?) heir. ##'''Wigner Family''': Walk back to the red carpet {{Navi|prt_cas|215|163}} at the entrance and go ''east'' instead this time. ###Go past the horde of NPCs outside the room {{Navi|prt_cas_q|153|119}} and talk to '''Levuiere Wigner'''. ###:[[File:LevuiereWigner.png|250px]] ###Talk to '''Jurgen Wigner''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|95|10}} in the back of the room and he'll introduce you to his siblings. ###:[[File:JugenWigner.png|250px]] ###*'''[[The_Royal_Banquet#Wigner Sidequest: The Maid and the Jewelry Box|Wigner Sidequest]]''' is available now. ###*The Wigner family apparently founded the kingdom of Rune Midgard, and Jurgen is very fashion-conscious. The parents prefer Katrin if she wasn't a girl, and Isaac is the most "Wigner-like." ##'''Richard Family''': Travel to the second room {{Navi|prt_cas_q|153|143}}. ###Speak with '''Butler for the Richards'''. ###:[[File:PoRichardsButler.png|250px]] ###Talk with '''Po Richard''' {{Navi|prt_cas|92|74}} and you can ''choose whether or not'' you've heard of the Richard warrior. ###:[[File:PoRichard.png|250px]] ###Talk to '''Po Richard''' again and choose ''[I'll Try]'' if you want to unlock [[Royal_Banquet_Daily_Quests#Warrior_Discipline|Warrior Discipline]] daily quest. ###* As the military leaders, the Richards have been training to take down Satan Morroc. ##'''Geoborg Family''': Walk north to the middle room {{Navi|prt_cas_q|153|167}} in the east corridor and you'll be stopped by the two bodyguards and the Queen will let you pass. ##:[[File:QueenCatherineGeoborg.png|250px]] ###Talk to '''Queen Catherine D. Geoborg'''. ###*'''[[The_Royal_Banquet#The Geoborgs|Geoborg Sidequest]]''' is available now. ###*Descendants of Tristan I, Ernst now is the candidate for the ritual. ##'''Roegenburg Family''': Travel to the last room in the east corridor {{Navi|prt_cas_q|153|191}}. ###Talk to '''Maximilian Roegenburg'''. ###:[[File:MaximilianRoegenburg.png|250px]] ###Speak to '''Wolf Roegenburg''' {{navi|prt_cas_q|96|186}} and you will be introduced to Agnes and Myer. Myer and Wolf argue. ###:[[File:WolfRoegenburg.png|250px]] ###*'''[[The_Royal_Banquet#Rougenbourg Sidequest: Wolf and Isaac's Dealings|Roegenburg Sidequest]]''' is available now. ###*Helmut is the candidate. There was blue text in the Myer/Wolf argument that may be important. #Return to your private room {{Navi|prt_cas|132|8}} in the far west side and speak with '''Servant Bell''' {{Navi|prt_cas_q|26|30}} to receive 10 [[Honor Token]] and 300,000 [[Base EXP]] and 300,000 [[Job EXP]]. #Proceed to the Banquet Hall at the end of the red carpet {{Navi|prt_cas|216|183}}. {{Item List|id=23533|item=Rose of Choice|simple=yes}} | external= http://renewal.playragnarok.com/news/eventdetail.aspx?id=494&p=1 | window =yes }} = Overview = [[File:The_Royal_Hunt_Main.png|center]] The Royal Families of Rune-Midgarts cordially invite you to participate in their annual Royal Hunt! Every year as winter draws near, monsters descend from Mt. Mjolnir to prepare for hibernation. Along the way, they destroy villages and property, endangering everyone around. Thus, the Seven Royal Families have put together the Royal Hunt to call adventurers from across the land to participate in their hunting competition to help quell the monsters' numbers! = Hunting Quests = #Begin by speaking to the '''Hunt Guide''' at {{Navi|prontera|162|76}} or {{Navi|moc_para01|38|19}}. He'll tell you all about the history of the hunt, and will warp you to their camp grounds when you are ready. #Speak with '''Commander Nadezhda''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|98|171}} to sign up for the Royal Hunt. They're only recruiting strong, capable adventurers, so he'll put you to the test before you can participate in any of the hunts. Hunt down 30 Insect Type Monsters and 30 Beast Type Monsters over Level 50 and return to the Commander once your task is complete. #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerNadezhda.png|frameless|Officer Nadezhda wants to test your abilities]] #*Special event monsters have also appeared in the map, namely Smooth Beetle King, Sleepy Bigfoot, and Starving Coco. There's only a handful of them but they are above lvl 50 and can contribute to the qualifier quest's counts. #Once you pass '''Commander Nadezhda's''' test, you will be able to use the Teleportation Device to move to the hunting hut in the hunting grounds. Another teleportation device is located inside the hut to bring you back to the camping grounds if you need. You wil also be able to complete the monster hunting tasks from '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' and '''Deputy Officer Jang Ha-sung'''! #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt CampPortal.png|frameless|This portal can take you to the event's hunting grounds]] #Speak to '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|97|180}} to receive a series of monster-hunting quests. Each quest can be completed once per day and can be completed by hunting monsters in any map. You can have as many active quests going at the same time, and when you complete them, report back to '''Deputy Officer La Finch''' to receive rewards! #:[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt OfficerLaFinch.png|frameless|Officer La Finch can give you daily tasks to hunt monsters]] #:

Four representatives from the Royal Families are in attendance, and you can vote for them by gifting them with a Rose of Choice. Heine''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|72|193}} #*'''Spica Nerius''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|70|191}} #*'''Agnes Lugenburg''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|69|189}} #*'''Jurgen Wigner''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|71|187}} #If you collect 100 cards of the same person, you can exchange them for a better version of the card that grants special effects when equipped! #After you cast your vote to any of them for the first time, you will receive a {{Item|id=31389 Costume White Bird Rose}} as a token of appreciation. = New Equipment = === Leather Craftsman === In exchange for 1 Rose of Choice, the '''Leather Craftsman''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|95|194}} will allow you to rent the following 3 equipment for 24 hours: :[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt LeatherCraftsman.png|frameless|The Leather Craftsman offers rentable hunting gear]] *{{Item List|id=15247|item=Short-term Hunting Mail|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=20903|item=Short-term Hunting Manteau|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=22169|item=Short-term Hunting Boots|simple=yes}} === Jeweler === Next to the Leather Craftsman is an esteemed '''Jeweler''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|93|196}} who will give you one of the following Rings in exchange for 70 Roses of Choice: :[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt Jeweler.png|frameless|The Jeweler has prepared lots of pretty and useful accessories]] *{{Item List|id=28562|item=True Hunting Physical Ring|slots=1|simple=yes}} *{{Item List|id=28563|item=True Hunting Magical Ring|slots=1|simple=yes}} === Alchemist === Between the other craftsmen and the Royal Family is an '''Alchemist''' {{Navi|prt_fild01|87|198}} who will grant you a 6 hour status buff (increases HP recovery from Potatoes and Meat by 2,000%) in exchange for 1 Rose of Choice. :[[File:IRO Wiki EventHunt Alchemist.png|frameless|The Alchemist has brewed up a special medicine for you to try]] = Monsters List = {| class="wikitable sortable" |- ! 50 {{monster|id=1129 Horong}} | questsreq = [[Lighthalzen Spotlight|Rekenber's Weapon]] | questscoreq = | baseexpreward = 6,000,000 (VIP) 4,000,000 (Non-VIP) | jobexpreward = 4,500,000 (VIP) 3,000,000 (Non-VIP) | itemreward = 10 {{item|id=717 Blue Gemstone}}, 1 Tome of the Dark Lord (Accessory) | qreward = | external = | window = yes }} '''The Spirits Arrive''' Step 1: Speak to the Rekenber Employee in Prontera who tells you that Kazien is looking for you in Nifflheim. Step 2: Travel to Nifflheim and speak to Kazien. He tells you that the spirits have arrived in Nifflheim and asks you to go and talk to them. Step 3, 4 and 5: Find the three spirits at niflheim (257 81), (296 85) and (98 202). None of them can remember the events in Glast Heim. Step 6: Return to Kazien, who suggests you speak to Orovan in Juno about what to do. Step 7: Head to Juno and talk to Orovan, who is working on an experiment and asks for your help. Step 8: Collect 1 Sapphire, 5 Crystal Blue and 3 Star Dust and return to Orovan, who crafts 10 Blue Gemstones and gives them to you (50% chance that he fails and needs another set). He asks you to talk to Anvian. Step 9: Anvian asks if you really think a copy of the Tome could be made and asks for examples. Input either "Megingjard", "Sleipnir", "Brisingamen" or "Mjolnir". Step 10: Return to Orovan who agrees that a copy of the Tome could be dangerous, but he's more concerned about WHY a copy is needed. He asks you to ask the spirits, but you explain the situation. Step 11: Orovan remarks on the boats you saw in the Glast Heim sewers and suggests that there might be relatives of survivors living somewhere. You decide to look for them, and Orovan suggests looking across the bay in Veins. '''The Chancellor''' Step 12: Talk to the Towner at veins (199, 109) who mentions that the little boy by the Oasis is mad at his father again. Step 13: Head to veins (108, 63) and talk to Setz, who is angry because his dad won't tell him about his great-great grandfather, who he knows was an important man. He needs proof to show his dad and asks you to help him. Step 14: Head inside the boy's house near veins (333 230) and make your way to the back room. Walking within 2 cells of the dog near ve_in (197 382) kicks the player out. Walking within 2 cells of the father near ve_in (214 388) kicks the player out. (facing northeast) Step 15: Talk to the Flowerpot at ve_in (222 379) to find a key. Step 16: Talk to the Drawers at ve_in (232 382) and unlock it. Inside you find an exquisite crown. Step 17: Take the crown to Setz, who plans to confront his father. You are warped to ve_in (218 387). Step 18: Talk to to Setz at ve_in (217 390). He argues with his father, who eventually tells Setz to go to the top of a mountain northwest of Veins. Step 19: Talk to Setz at ve_fild05 (157 137) (facing west) by the gravestone at ve_fild05 (154 139) (Facing east) who tells you that he heard his great-great grandfather speak to him. He tells you to find the page he hid nearby first by pointing the three markers towards the mountain, going counter clockwise. Step 20: Find the marker at ve_fild05 (180 57) and face it north. Step 21: Find the marker at ve_fild05 (289 128) and face it west. Step 22: Find the marker at ve_fild05 (163 212) and face it south. You hear a door open to the west. Step 23: Talk to the door at ve_fild05 (93 175). The room is empty except for a single page, which you take. Step 24: Return to Setz on the top of the mountain, who says that there are three more pages to find. Each of the people that fled Glast Heim with his great-great grandfather took one and hid it, so you need to find the descendants and their pages. He suggests Comodo to start with, as it's the next closest town accessible by water. '''The Jester''' Step 25: Talk to Setz at comodo (204 138). He says he's already looked around most of the town, but asks you to check the northeast area. Step 26: Find Pocket at cmd_in01 (127 122), who is depressed because he can't seem to make people laugh like his family has. You ask him about his family, but he refuses to answer unless you make him laugh. Step 27: Talk to Pocket again and tell him a joke (anything). He's not amused and asks you to come up with a better joke before he talks to you. Step 28: Return to Setz, who suggests you talk to some of the performers in Comodo for their jokes. He mentions seeing one by a group of campers. Step 29: Talk to the Clown at comodo (214 315). He's willing to share one of his best jokes with you, but he wants to make sure you're serious about comedy and asks you to wear a Mr. Smile to prove it (Bard and Dancer do not need items to prove themselves). Step 30: Speak to him again wearing a Mr. Smile for his joke: "What did the Mi Gao say to itself? I'm tired of all this bouncing around, let's split!" Step 31: Return to Pocket and tell him the joke. He doesn't like it. Step 32: Talk to Setz, who says he saw an entertainer while in the casino. Step 31: Find the Entertainer at cmd_in02 (74 56). He wants to make sure you can withstand the might of his joke and asks you to kill 30 Megalodons (Bard and Dancer classes can skip). Step 32: Return to the Entertainer, who tells you his joke: "What's a monkey's favorite toy? A Yoyo!" Step 33: Talk to Pocket again and tell him the joke. He's still not impressed. Step 34: Return to Setz, who is getting frustrated... He mentions there's a performer on the stage to the northwest. Step 35: Speak to the Comedian on stage, who will only tell you his best joke if you can best him in a joke match. ***Mini-Game*** Just like the Fencing mini-game. The Comedian will start by beginning a joke, and you need to finish it. He then begins one and you finish it. You learn jokes as you go along. Jokes: 1. Why did the Whisper go into the bar? --> For some boos! 2. What did the Boa say to the Sting? --> Lend me a hand! 3. Why wouldn't the Crab share his toys? --> Because he was shellfish. 4. Why are you so wet? --> Because it's Poring! 5. Why does Arc Angeling always feel rich? --> He hops around with three Carats! 6. Why are Taekwon Kids not afraid to fart in public? --> Because they have Mild Wind! 7. Who did the Zombie take to the prom? --> His Ghoul friend! 8. what do you call two Bathories living together? --> Broommates! 9. What did one bat say to the other? --> You look Familiar! Step 36: After the player has won, the Comedian tells them the joke: "Why couldn't Rideword make it to Deathword's party? His schedule was booked!" Step 37: Return to Pocket and repeat the joke to him. He finds it hysterical and agrees to help you. He tells you his great grandfather was Glast Heim's court jester and agrees to give you the family's page and gives you several keys. Step 38: Head to comodo (64 344) where you dig up a small box with several chains and locks. Using the keys Pocket gave you, you open it and find another page of the Tome. Step 39: Return to Setz, who suggests you move on to the next port town: Alberta. He's heard that a strange man has recently bought a new ship for ferrying people to Izlude and Alberta Island. '''A Wrong Turn''' Step 40: Speak to Setz at alberta (192 161), who says you should ask around the ship. Step 41: On the ship, there are NPCs at alberta (193 167), alb_ship (175 170), and (112 114) that talk about the ship's owner. Speak to him at (84 89). He wants a Vermilion on the Beach. Step 42: Return with it and he thanks you. You ask if he's one of the descendants from Glast Heim. He answers affirmatively and flashes you the page. When you ask for it, however, he kicks you off the ship. Step 43: Talk to Setz again who mentions he heard someone talking in the captain's quarters. Step 44: When you enter the ship at (162, 171) you see a Rekenber Employee talking to the Captain. Noticing you, however, they quickly disappear. Step 45: When you ask the captain about who the man was, he says he doesn't know. You think something suspicious is going on and you decide you need help. You are presented with a choice of Kazien, Lyozien or Anvian. ''Help from Kazien (melee path)'' Step 46a: Talk to Kazien at lhz_in01 (174, 258). You tell him about your suspicions. He agrees it seems odd and says he'll help you fight the crew, but he needs supplies. Step 47a: Bring him 10 Broken Swords, 25 Tough Vines and a Level 4 Weapon to use in the battle. Blacksmiths do not need to bring anything. Step 48a: Once ready, talk to Kazien again to be warped into a copy of alb_ship at (71, 99). Step 49a: Speak to Kazien inside at (80, 99) to spawn monsters: 20 Vanberk at (88, 114) 20 Isilla at (88, 86) 20 Pasana at (100, 99) 10 Echio at (111, 112) 10 Agav at (113, 86) Step 50a: Once all of the monsters have been defeated, the boss spawns: 1 Pharaoh at (126, 99) Step 51a: Once all monsters have been defeated, talk to Kazien who thanks you for the help. He's amazed that Rekenber would go this far and says that the ship must be a distraction. He's not sure what do, though, so you decide to let Setz know what happened. You're warped back to alberta (192 158). Step 52a: Talk to Setz, who suggests that his grandfather might have been leaving clues as to the locations of the escapees via the markers you found before. If you think of the mountain as Veins, the first marker was southeast and pointed to Comodo. The next, as he recalls, was due east of the mountain. ***If the player leaves the instance for any reason, they must go down a different path as Kazien does not think it is safe to attack again.*** ''Help from Lyozien (thief path / last resort)'' Step 46b: Talk to Lyozien at lhz_in01 (36, 43). You tell him about your suspicions. He suggests you look around Rekenber for clues about the ship's crew by doing exactly what you did before, starting with the scattered reports. Step 47b: Talk to the Scattered Reports at lhz_in01 (108, 39). You are warned that Jorjerro might wake up if you search around. If you decide to search, there is a 50% chance that he wakes up and catches you, in which case the player is booted out of headquarters. Thief classes have a 100% chance of success. Step 48b: Return to Lyozien with the reports on the crew in Alberta. He suggests you need more proof for them and asks you to check the Employee Records for their names. Step 49b: Talk to the Employee Records at lhz_in01 (39, 264) but you are stopped by the librarian who appears at lhz_in01 (34, 262) and says they are off-limits. You are given several options to try and charm her. Once you have charmed the employee, she asks for some products to make her even more beautiful. Compliment her Hair Compliment her Clothes Compliment her Perfume Compliment her Makeup ***No matter what is chosen, player has a 50% chance to succeed. If they fail, they are booted out of the building and have to try again.*** Step 50b: Depending on which option they chose, the user needs to gather item sets: Hair: 2 Mixture, 2 Scarlet Dyestuffs, 100 Solid Shell, 10 Elunium and 1 Axe[4] Clothes: 50 Fabric, 3 Skirt of Virgin, 10 Broken Needle, 30 Witch Starsand Perfume: 50 Flower, 5 Illusion Flower, 5 Ment, 30 Empty Bottle, 50 Oil Paper Makeup: 3 Rouge, 3 Scarlet Dyestuffs, 2 Violet Dyestuffs, 1 White Dyestuffs, 30 Yaga's Pestle Step 51b: Once you deliver the items to her she gives you the employee records. Take them to Lyozien, who confirms that the crew is fake. You decide to talk to Setz back on the ship. Step 52b: Talk to Setz, who suggests that his grandfather might have been leaving clues as to the locations of the escapees via the markers you found before. If you think of the mountain as Veins, the first marker was southeast and pointed to Comodo. The next, as he recalls, was due east of the mountain. ''Help from Anvian (magic path)'' Step 46c: Talk to Anvian in the Sage Academy at yuno_in03 (43, 181). You tell him your suspicions, and he suggests you reveal the crew's identities through magic. He asks you to gather a set of items. Step 47c: Return to Anvian with 1 Torn Magic Book, 5 Worn-Out Magic Scrolls, 25 Mould Powder and 25 Yellow Gemstones. Step 48c: Anvian asks you to hone your magic abilities while he works on the potion by killing 50 Horongs. Step 49c: After hunting the Horongs, return to Anvian who gives you a potion that will make the ship's owner tell the truth. The trick, he says, will be getting him to drink it... But he's sure you'll think of something. Step 50c: Return to the ship's owner, who complains about being thirsty again. If you have another Vermilion on the Beach in your inventory, an option appears to add the potion to it. If you do not have a Vermilion on the Beach, there are two options that appear: Leave him alone for now or try to give him the potion. Step 51c: You add the potion before giving him the drink and he begins spewing out truths from his life, including the fact that Rekenber sent him to stall you. He gives you the page, which is a fake. You decide to talk to Setz to decide what to do. Step 52c: Talk to Setz, who suggests that his great great grandfather might have been leaving clues as to the locations of the escapees via the markers you found before. If you think of the mountain as Veins, the first marker was southeast and pointed to Comodo. The next, as he recalls, was due east of the mountain. '''The Advisor''' Step 53: Talk to Setz at geffen (109, 37) who is impressed you figured it out. He tells you he's found the next descendent in the Geffen Inn: the famous writer, Minhir. Step 53: Head to geffen_in (36, 39) and find Mihir, a struggling writer. He wants you to prove you're interested in literature. Step 54: Bring Mihir one of the following books (must be in inventory, but is not consumed): Chef King Orleans Vol.1 Kafra Legend Vol.1 Step 55: Talk to him again and he confides in you that he's been unable to write lately. If you can help him, he says he'll give you the page you're looking for. He asks you to visit his father in Izlude for any story ideas. Step 56: Find Mizidar at izlude (157, 89). When you tell him Mihir's problem, he asks if you've even read any of his son's books. When you say no, he gives you a copy of Adventure Story Vol. 1 to read and asks you to come back when you're ready for a test. Step 57: After reading the book, Mizidar asks you five questions, randomly picked from a total of ten. You must get all five right to continue. 1. What was controlling Aher? He agrees to the trade and asks you to return after your quest is complete. He tells you that the page is behind a building north of the Mage Guild in a barrel. Step 66: Talk to the Barrel at geffen (59, 198) where you find the next page. Step 67: Return to Setz, who says there's only one more descendant to find. As he recalls, the last marker was north of the mountain. '''The Queen''' Step 68: When you arrive at Rachel via teleport, a Rekenber Employee at rachel (119 135) halts you to say that they're looking for a little boy. He was last seen running southwest into the marketplace. Step 69: Find Setz at rachel (78 48), who tells you that Rekenber is on your tail. He tells you to be cautious, but says that he thinks the last person you are looking for is a descendant of Glast Heim's queen. Step 70: Go into the house near rachel (179 217) and talk to Elizabeth Merryweather at ra_in01 (380 385). She is quick to tell you about her fame and fortune. When you ask for the page, she says she will give it to you after you perform a few favors. She says her bath water is cold and asks you to heat it up. Step 71: Talk to the bathtub at ra_in01 (387, 375) to use 10 Live Coal to try and heat the water. Each attempt has a 25% chance to succeed. Step 72: After heating the water, talk to Elizabeth Merryweather again, who says her food is taking too long. She asks you to tell the cooks to hurry. Step 73: Speak to the Cook at ra_in01 (306 388) *facing northeast* and tell him Elizabeth asked you to check up on the food. He is distraught because he does not have enough time or ingredients to make the salad. He asks you to bring a Green Salad. Step 74: Return with the dish. The Cook tells you to take it to Elizabeth. Step 75: Talk to Elizabeth, who is not impressed by your cooking. She tells you that the maid upstairs needs help cleaning. Step 76: Talk to the Maid at ra_in01 (232 381). She asks you to dust, but says you'll need to find two other people to help at the same time or the dust will just keep moving around to other objects. ***Mini-game*** ra_in01 (222, 388): Desk ra_in01 (239, 381): Bookcase ra_in01 (231, 362): Books Players need to find two other people to help with this task. The goal is to simultaneously activate all 3 NPCs. Once activated, they disappear for 5 seconds... But there is a 5 second timer before a player can talk to another NPC, forcing them to find help. When all three have disappeared at the same time, the player can continue. ***Note that anyone should be able to activate them so that friends can help a player if they are doing the quest*** Step 77: Return to the Maid who compliments you on a job well done. She tells you to return to Elizabeth. Step 78: Speak to Elizabeth again, who asks you to get some of her shopping done. You're about ready to rip her throat out when she assures you this is the last task. She asks you to go into town and find a merchant and tell him you want "the usual". Step 79: Find the merchant at rachel (44,44) and when an input box comes up, tell him you want "the usual". He rummages around a bit before returning with a box containing the last page of the Tome of the Dark Lord. Step 80: Return to Setz, but he's not there... You're worried about him but there's nothing you can do. You decide you'd better return the pages you've found to Orovan. '''Beyond the Gates''' Step 81: Talk to Orovan in Juno. You hand over the pages and he compares them to the Tome, informing you that there are only a few pages left to find. He's been thinking, and he believes there is a page behind each gate you found in the lowest level of Glast Heim. Step 82: Meet Orovan in the lowest level of Glast Heim. He hands over the three keys and tells you to be prepared before you go, as there are likely strong monsters guarding the pages. He also says you may need some items from the three elements to get through: 5 Flame Heart, 5 Mystic Frozen and 5 Great Nature Step 83, 84 and 85: Open each of the gates, fight the monsters and receive a page from each one. Fire: que_thor (183 56), spawns around (142, 58) (Need 5 Mystic Frozen to open the door) Earth: cave (76 184), spawns around (24 183) (Need 5 Flame Heart to open the door) Water: cave for the summoner? (Need 5 Great Nature to open the door) Step 86: Return to Orovan with the three pages. He congratulates you on your victories and suggests you leave Glast Heim. He asks you to speak to him in Juno. Step 87: Talk to Orovan in Juno, who says he will work on restoring the pages you have to the book. He asks you to come back in an hour. Step 88: Return in one hour to learn that there are still two pages missing. You remember the missing pages from the Lion Head and Bucket of Water and conclude Rekenber beat you to them. That jogs Orovan's memory, and he tells you Kazien needed you urgently at Headquarters. Step 89: Talk to Kazien, who is not happy at the lack of information you've given him. He says that a message came for you: someone is waiting for you on the roof of the building. The note also says Setz' life is at stake. Step 90: Head outside and onto the roof of Rekenber (lgthalzen x y) where you find the Masked Man. He says he wants to make a trade: Setz for the completed Tome. You tell him it's not complete and he gives you the remaining two pages. Before you go, he warns you not to read the book or your own life might be at risk. Step 91: Return to Kazien, who says he'll try to think of a way out of this mess while you get the book from Orovan. Step 92: Talk to Orovan in Juno and tell him about what's happened. You give him the final two pages and he says he'll need a few minutes to finish the book. Step 93: Speak to him several times and Orovan will hand over the complete book: The Tome of the Dark Lord. He also warns you about reading it, saying that you don't know what might happen if you do. As you leave, you're given an option to read the book, and whether or not you do affects the outcome of the quest. '''Fight to the Finish''' ''The Path of Impulse'' Step 94a: You decide to open the book, recalling what the final Lion head in Glast Heim said about the book bringing forth either salvation or destruction. Step 95a: You're transported to a copy of the Glast Heim Church, where you find Dark Lord in the center and defeat him. Step 96a: Once Dark Lord is defeated, the Masked Man appears. He reveals that he is really the King of Glast Heim, bound with Dark Lord and made immortal by that bond. He was never working for Rekenber, but trying to obtain the tome in order to destroy it. He congratulates you on defeating Dark Lord and thanks you for freeing him before disappearing into the light. Step 97a: Setz appears and thanks you for helping to free Glast Heim from its curse, but acknowledges that there are other dark forces at work in the castle that must be stopped. He asks you to talk to Kazien. Step 98a: Return to Kazien, who states that there's one last thing to do: destroy the book, so that it can never be used to summon Dark Lord again. Step 99a: Bring Kazien 250 Sticky Poisons and 1 Dragon Canine. He stabs the book, destroying it. He rewards you with 2.5 million base EXP and 2 million job EXP and says you should talk to Lyozien. Step 100a: Talk to Lyozien, who thanks you and rewards you with 2.5 million base EXP and 2 million job EXP before telling you that Anvian has something to give you. Step 101a: Talk to Anvian, who gives his thanks and asks to see the tome. Although mostly lifeless, he acknowledges some power left in the book and offers to channel it into an Accessory for you. You receive the Tome of the Dark Lord, an Accessory that has the same 5% damage and magic damage increase of The Sign and pairs with it to offer additional stats (5% elemental resistance, 500 HP, etc.?). ''The Path of Restraint'' Step 94b: You decide not to open the book, but to return it to the Masked Man. Step 95b: When you return to the Masked Man, you're once again given a choice of whether or not to open the book. If you open it, move to step 95a on The Path of Impulse. Step 96b: If you do not open the book, you hand it over to the Masked Man. He thanks you for helping him and reveals that he does not work for Rekenber, but is instead the King of Glast Heim. He asks you to gather 250 Sticky Poison and 1 Dragon Canine to destroy the book. Step 97b: Bring the materials back to the King, who attempts to destroy the book. As he does, however, he screams in anguish and vanishes in a cloud of darkness along with the book. Step 98b: Setz appears and says that the King's soul was tied to Dark Lord: destroying the book destroyed them both. He wishes there was another way it could have ended, but thanks you for your help and says that you should talk to Kazien. Step 99b: Talk to Kazien, who thanks you for your help and rewards you with 2 million base EXP and 1.5 million job EXP. He says Lyozien has something for you as well. Step 100b: Talk to Lyozien, who rewards you with an additional 2 million base EXP and 1.5 million job EXP.

title: Thief
wikitext:
{{Infobox Job |jobName=Thief |jobType=First (Primary) |jobBase=Novice | jobLevel = 50 |Race=[[Human]] |changesAt=[[Pyramid|Morroc Pyramid]] |skills=6 |skillPoints=51 |questSkills=4 |str=4|agi=4|vit=2|int=1|dex=4|luk=3}} [[file: ThiefATK.gif‎|250px|right]] Oftentimes an orphan after Satan Morroc's revival separated many children from their parents, the Thief is hardened though their crude tutelage in fighting and stealing to survive in the backstreets of their decimated hometown. Having to learn the art of deceit and stealth just to get by, they realized these skills also help them in the battlefield. Growing up among the ruins of the desert town of [[Morroc]] and the surrounding Sograt Desert, having witnessed firsthand the [[Morroc | Destruction of Morroc]], they have sworn to learn the shadow arts to always protect what they care about by any means possible... even if those means are morally questionable. Thieves excel in having high [[FLEE]] thanks to [[Improve Dodge]] and deal lots of quick damage through their [[Double Attack]] with their trusty [[Dagger]], both benefitting from a high [[AGI]] stat. They can also hide from monsters with [[Hiding]] and then [[Steal]] loot from these monsters, enabling them to acquire more [[Zeny]] than other classes early on. ==Job Changing== Once you are a Job Level 10 [[Novice]], you have 2 methods of changing into a Thief: #Go to the Thief Guild found inside the [[Pyramid]] northwest of [[Morroc]] {{navi|moc_ruins|58|159}}. Once inside, traverse the maze and go to the middle of the map at {{navi|moc_prydb1|45|130}} to enter the secret guildhall. Afterwards, follow the hallway down and take the left door at {{navi|moc_prydb1|90|115}}. Talk to the ''Thief Guide'' behind the desk who changes your job to Thief and rewards you with a {{Item List |id=13041 |item=Novice Main Gauche|slots=3 |simple=yes}}. #*Pursuing this method also unlocks the [[Back Slide]], [[Find Stone]], [[Stone Fling]], and [[Sand Attack]] Skills for free right as you change. #Alternatively, go to the Thief Classroom on the 2nd Floor of [[Training Grounds|Criatura Academy]] and speak to ''Guest Lecturer Mayssel'' located at {{navi|iz_ac02|52|136}} to undergo some tests before becoming a Thief. She will warn you that you will not receive the bonus Job Skills listed above if you use this method and thus it is not recommended. ==Builds== === I. Envenom & Auto-Attack / Dagger Thief === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This build focuses on poisoning your target with [[Envenom]] to weaken them while avoiding getting hit by monsters using [[Improve Dodge]] and [[Hiding]]. Then, taking advantage of [[Double Attack]] by having high [[AGI]] for increased [[ASPD]], auto-attack weakened monsters one-by-one until they are killed. Unfortunately, the Thief does not have any AOE skills to level with so this is the only option for a new player and it is recommended to focus on passive monsters when starting out. *'''Alternative gameplay:''' Due to lack of AOE skills for this class, it it recommended to get any slotted [[Accessory]] carded with a {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card|simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] on mobs of monsters to level. However, this will not be an option for a brand new player obviously.
'''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on the monster you are killing, your survivability, skill playing the game, and planned character build later on. Primary stats will be [[STR]] for [[ATK]] and [[AGI]] for [[ASPD]] & [[FLEE]], but if you find yourself missing monsters, add more [[DEX]] to give you [[HIT]] and improve your [[Steal]] rate. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 20
*AGI: 52
*VIT: 1
*INT: 1
*DEX: 20
*LUK: 1
=== II. Auto-Attack / Bow Thief === '''a. GAMEPLAY:'''
This is a very niche build that focuses on the ability for the Thief Class to use [[Bow]]-type weapons, like the [[Archer]], but with none of the Skill benefits they get. Using a [[Bow]] gives a slight attack range improvement (5 cells away) so the goal would be to auto-attack your targets with your increased [[ASPD]], one-by-one, and hope to kill them before they reach you, using [[Improve Dodge]] and [[Hiding]] to avoid getting hit by monsters when they do. There are no AOE skills available to use for this build so leveling will be slower and it is recommended to focus on passive monsters when starting out. Two benefits to this build are having more [[DEX]] for a higher success on [[Steal]] rates and the ability to use various kinds of [[Arrows | arrows]], including those imbued with different elements (like Fire, Wind, or Holy) that deal even more damage to monsters based on their [[Element|element]]'s weakness. *'''Alternative gameplay:''' Although [[Double Attack]] does not work with [[Bow]]-type weapons from the base skill, if you can afford equipment or cards that grants [[Double Attack]] then it will apply to any weapon you are using at the level your Thief has learned. That means that using a {{Item List |id=4117 |item=Sidewinder Card|simple=yes}} (which only grants Lv.1) on your Thief with Lv.10 learned, your [[Bow]] will [[Double Attack]] with the rates/bonuses of Lv.10! The most common ways to achieve this are: ** {{Item List |id=4117 |item=Sidewinder Card|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List |id=5283 |item=Chick Hat|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List |id=5388 |item=Snake Head|slots=1|simple=yes}} ** {{Item List |id=25302 |item=Double Attack Stone(Garment)|simple=yes}} '''b. STATS:'''
You may allocate certain status points depending on the monster you are killing, your survivability, skill playing the game, and planned character build later on. Primary stats will be [[DEX]] for [[ATK]] & [[HIT]] and [[AGI]] for [[ASPD]] & [[FLEE]]. ''Base level 40 base status distribution suggestion:'' *STR: 1
*AGI: 43
*VIT: 1
*INT: 1
*DEX: 43
*LUK: 1
== Tips & Tactics == === General Leveling Strategy === Below are three steps to efficiently level a new character: #Get gear and experience for your new character by following this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] from the forums (this guide is also listed down below in the [[Thief#Equipment|Thief equipment]] section with additional details). #Using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, you can level as soon as base level 3-56 in [[Sunken Ship]]. Talk to '''Fisk''' {{Navi|alberta|189|151}} and pay 250z to go to the {{map |id=alb2trea Sunken Ship}}. As a thief, you may use {{Item List |id=4084 |item=Marine Sphere Card |simple=yes}} to use [[Magnum Break]] since you do not have an AoE skill. #''Without'' using {{Item List |id=19163 |item=Catherina Von Blood|slots=1 |simple=yes}}, using the [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1012 Roda Frogs}} until level 21(they drop sticky webfeet that you can sell to players or turn in for the level 56-71 [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]]) , then using the Payon [[Bounty Board Quests]] kill {{monster | id=1060 Bigfoots}} until level 41. Then, using the [[Eden Group Leveling Quests]] and [[Bounty Board Quests | Geffen Bounty Board Quests]], kill {{monster | id=1023 Orc Warriors}}, {{monster | id=1273 Orc Ladies}}, and {{monster | id=1686 Orc Babies}} until level 60.
'''You can accept multiple quests at one time, however when turning in do note that you cannot gain more than 1 full level from a single quest, so do try to turn the quests in when you have a low exp percentage or after you've job changed if you're job level 49.''' === Making More Zeny === By using {{Skill List|skill=Steal}}, extra loot can be obtained from monsters before fighting them, which helps with earning more [[Zeny]] when just starting out. You can even sometimes steal rare items this way, but note it will require a higher [[DEX]] stat than the usual recommended builds to increase its success rate. === Other Suggestions === #Your next class is either an [[Assassin]] or a [[Rogue]]; you may have to adjust your build accordingly.

=== Stat Descriptions === ''It is vital that you understand how each status affects your character to play the game well. Below is a summary but go to the [[Stats#Primary_Stats|Primary Stats]] page for '''detailed information.'''
*STR - increases [[ATK]] of melee weapons, increases [[Weight Limit]], and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons.
*AGI - increases [[Flee]], [[ASPD]], and provides resistance to [[Bleeding]] and [[Sleep]] status effects.
*VIT - increases [[Max HP]], effectiveness of [[Healing Items | Healing]] potions, and resistance to [[Stun]], [[Poison]], [[Deadly Poison]], [[Burning]], and [[Freezing]] status effects.
*INT - increases [[MATK]], [[Max SP]], [[SP Recovery]], and effectiveness of [[Healing Items | SP]] potions, decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Silence]], and [[Chaos]] status effects.
*DEX - decreases Variable [[Cast Time]] (VCT), increases [[Stats | HIT]], [[MATK]], [[ATK]] of "ranged-type" weapons, and slightly increases [[ATK]] of "melee-type" weapons. *LUK - increases [[ATK]], [[MATK]], [[Stats | CRIT]], [[Stats | HIT]], [[Flee]], [[Perfect Dodge]], [[Forging]], [[Potion Creation]], [[Cooking]], and provides resistance to [[Blind]], [[Curse]], [[Frozen]], [[Poison]], [[Silence]], [[Sleep]], [[Stone Curse]], and [[Stun]]. ''Melee Weapons - ([[Axe]]s, [[Book]]s, [[Dagger]]s, [[Katar]]s, [[Knuckle]]s, [[Mace]]s, and [[Spear]]s)
Ranged Weapons - ([[Bow]]s, [[Gun]]s, [[Instrument]]s, and [[Whip]]s)'' ===Equipment === === I. Enchanter Mounds Quest === After creating a [[Novice]] character, follow the section of this [http://forums.warpportal.com/index.php?/topic/144833-new-izlude-tutorial-guide/ Izlude tutorial guide] titled "Enchanter Mounds Quest" which involves [[NPC]] Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}}. This quest will allow you to enchant the {{Item List |id=2302 |item=Cotton Shirt |simple=yes}} that you get the moment you created your [[Novice]] character with the enchantments Max HP+100 and Max SP+50, provided that you complete the step that requires you to speak with [[NPC]] Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}}. This cotton shirt proves itself useful once you change your class and can no longer equip most of the novice gear provided to you when you register at the academy. It is recommended to card this cotton shirt with cards that increase [[HP]] and/or [[SP]] such as {{Item List |id=31016 |item=Decorated Evil Tree Card |simple=yes}} or {{Item List |id=4003 |item=Pupa Card |simple=yes}}. After providing Enchanter Mounds in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|96|125}} with a review of the service they provided during the enchanting quest, you can talk to Enchanter Almond J in [[Izlude]] at {{navi|izlude|108|139}} to enchant the novice weapon you receive after you change your class from [[Novice]] to [[Thief]]. The two enchantments provided are random and if you aren’t happy with the result you can enchant it again endlessly. You will likely use this enchanted weapon until you can do the level 26 [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] which is the first part of that questline which rewards a weapon. Keep in mind Enchanter Almond J won’t enchant the Novice Main Gauche that you get for registering at the academy despite it being a novice weapon. === II. Eden Group Equipments Quests === Starting at level 12 you can complete the [[Eden Group Equipments Quests]] to obtain free equipment for your class. This equipment is sufficient to get you to level 99. === III. General Weapon Recommendations === Thieves can equip various [[Daggers]] and [[Sword]]s, with [[Daggers]] being preferred due to how [[Double Attack]] works. Below is basic information on these weapons. '''a. [[Daggers]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage to [[Size|small monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Inflict 50% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
*Can proc [[Double Attack]] Passive Skill
'''b. [[One Handed Swords]]'''
*Inflict 100% damage on [[Size|medium monsters]]
*Inflict 75% damage on [[Size|small and large monsters]]
*Can be used with a [[Shield]]
*Cannot proc [[Double Attack]] Passive Skill
Thieves can also equip various [[Bows]]. Here is a short list to get you started. *{{Item List |id=1705 |item=Composite Bow|slots=4 |simple=yes}}
*{{Item List |id=1715 |item=Arbalest|slots=2 |simple=yes}}
*{{Item List |id=1716 |item=Gakkung|slots=2 |simple=yes}}
*{{Item List |id=1705 |item=Composite Bow|slots=4 |simple=yes}}

1. Head off to the Pyramids, which is north-west of [[Morroc]].  

2. At the pyramid {{navi|moc_ruins|58|159}}, enter, and head for the middle of the map to the Thief Guild {{navi|moc_prydb1|45|130}}.

3. Once inside, follow the hallway down and take the left gate (90,115). In here you will see two NPCs that will guide you through the quest. 

4. Talk to the one closest to the portal. She will ask you a few questions, then instruct you to find an "Irrelevant Man" somewhere outside the Pyramid {{navi|moc_ruins|140|125}} in order to steal mushrooms from a nearby mushroom farm.

[[Image:thiefmap.JPG]]

5. At the farm, kill the mushrooms and collect the mushrooms that drop.  Aggressive Fabres and Chonchons (and Spores, but they're not aggresive) protect the farm, so you may want to avoid them.  Your mission is to collect at least mushrooms worth of 25 points.

{|class="wikitablec"
|-
! Mushroom !! Point Value
|-
| Orange Goey Mushroom || 1 Point
|-
| Orange Net Mushroom || 3 Points
|}

*'''Note''': If you die, you can talk to Mr. Irrelevant to return to the farm as many times as needed. 

6. After collecting a sufficient amount of Mushrooms, head back to Thief Guild.

7. Talk to NPC farthest from the warp portal. He will count your mushrooms and if you have enough points, he will promote you to a Thief.

He then asks you to learn some new skills. #After getting at least one job level, and the skill point to any of your skills, and then talk to Yierhan again. #*He'll explain how the skill(s) you got work and will offer to explain how others work as well. After telling him you know enough, he'll give you some Base and Job Experience. #*He then tells you to learn some more skills, and come back after. #After learning at least one more new skill (or adding one more point to a skill you already have), talk to Yierhan again. #*He'll send you to Sograt Desert, south of Morroc ({{map |id=moc_fild12 moc_fild12}}), and ask you to collect 10 {{item |id=916 Feather of Birds}}. #After collecting the feathers, go back to '''Yierhan''' (he doesn't take the feathers), who will give you some more Base and Job Experience. #Talk to him again, and he mentions a fight that took place south of town, noting that an Assassin may have taken part in it, due to traces of poison left at the scene. #*He sends you off to investigate, giving you some more experience. #*For low levels, it is recommended to bring some Green Potions or Green Herbs. #Go to the map south of Morroc, ({{map |id=moc_fild12 moc_fild12}}), and right below the portal to town is the first "Trace of Battle" {{navi|moc_fild12|166|369}}. #*Talk to it, and it tells you about the trail, which leads south. #*Note: ''To avoid having to backtrack, make sure you click on each of the Traces until they repeat which direction the battle went.'' #Further south on the same map, find the second '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild12|173|215}} and talk to it. It says the trail continues to the east. #Next to the east portal on the same map, find the third '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild12|276|165}} and talk to it, where you see some footprints. #Head through the portal to the next map ({{map |id=moc_fild11 moc_fild11}}), and locate the '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild11|39|163}} next to the portal, and talk to it. #*Apparently, someone else joined in the battle here. #Go towards the south portal on the same map and talk to the fifth '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild11|205|52}}. #*You need to neutralize the remaining poison here with a {{item |id=506 Green Potion}}. #*After neutralizing it, investigate, and recover a piece of cloth. #Head north to the top of the map, near the portal, and talk to the next '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild11|184|342}}, which says the footprints are definitely heading south. #Go through the south portal to the next map ({{map |id=moc_fild17 moc_fild17}}) and talk to the '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild17|213|358}} just south of the portal. #*Only two people were involved in the battle from this point on. #Farther south on the map, talk to the next '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild17|228|274}}, which says the battle continues westward. #*Keep talking to the trace until it repeats this message. #Near the west portal, talk to the '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild17|34|292}}, which says the combatants grew increasingly desperate at this point, and the trail heads west. #Enter the west portal, and in the next map ({{map |id=moc_fild18 moc_fild18}}), go west from the portal until you see the '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|346|296}} near a tree. #Someone began bleeding here, so the trail will be easier to follow. #Walk southwest until you see the next '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|309|257}}. #*The pursuer got closer to their prey here, and the trail heads north. #Below the north portal is another '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|177|333}}, which says the trail turns southwest. #Go southwest and talk to the '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|111|303}}. #*More people joined in the battle, and the trail goes south. #Farther south is the next '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|109|197}}. #*You will be poisoned multiple times, so be sure you're safe before you interact with the '''Trace''' #Investigating, you use another Green Potion, but nothing happens. #You must have a {{item |id=716 Red Gemstone}} and {{item |id=511 Green Herb}} in order to clean up the poison, and you find another piece of poison stained cloth. #At the bottom end of the map, talk to the last '''Trace''' {{navi|moc_fild18|156|96}}. #*One set of footprints leads off the cliff, while the remaining head back out. #*Whoever was being pursued was apparently finished off. #Head back to '''Yierhan''', and report on what you found. #*He rewards you with some Base Experience, a lot of Job Experience, 5,000 [[Zeny]], and a {{item |id=2307 Mantle}}. {{Navbox Thief}} [[Category:Training Quests]]

title: Town Services
wikitext:
==Town Services==

Each town usually provides services such as save service, teleporting to another town, and storage service.

==Kafra Town Services==

:''Main article: [[Kafra]]''

The Kafra Corporation (or simply Kafra) provides players with certain services and are the most prominent in the [[Rune-Midgarts Kingdom]].

==Cool Event Corporation==

:''Main article: [[Cool Event Corp]]''

Cool Event Corporation employees provide similar services as those of the [[Kafra]] Corporation. However, they are only found in the [[Arunafeltz States]] and some towns in the [[Republic of Schwartzvald]].

==Cat Hand Services==

:''Main article: [[Cat Hand Services]]''

Similar to the functions of [[Kafra]] Corporation and [[Cool Event]] Corporation on the Midgard Continent, Cat Hand Services provides services in the [[New World]].

==Zonda Corporation==

Zonda Corporation employees provide similar services as those of the [[Cool Event]] Corporation. Zonda is found in the [[Verus]] City cooperative excavation project between the Rekenber Corporation of the Schwartzwald Republic and the Eden Group of Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.

== Initial Quest ==
1. Speak with Gatti (dew_fild01, 127 240) near the gate of the Jati Tribe entrance.

2. Gatti doesn't know the name of the place. Answer "Dewata Island" when he asks. After that, he will laugh at you and say you're crazy.

*'''Note''': He will check whether you have been certified by the Jati Tribe. So therefore you need to finish at least step 7 of Dewata Legend Quest. You don't need to have the Shining Feather of Cendrawasih in order to advance further.

3. Gatti will then tell you about an old lost blue print of a traditional weapon he found in Dewata. He will ask you to gather 100 {{item |id=6403 Comodo Leather}} to create it.

4. Speak to him after collecting the required number of item and he will just create a handle of the weapon from the items you gathered. Obtain a Keris Hilt.
* '''Note''': Do not lose the hilt or you will have to repeat step 3.

5. To complete the weapon, talk to him again and he will ask you to bring 100 {{item |id=6403 Comodo Leather}}, 20 {{item |id=999 Steel}} and 10 {{item |id=984 Oridecon}}.

6. Bring the items including the Keris Hilt to Gatti and he will finalize the weapon. Receive a {{item|id=13067 Keris <nowiki>[1]</nowiki>}}.

== Creating Another ==

After you've done the initial quest, you can create as many you as wish. Just to talk to Whitesmith Gatti and bring him the required materials.

1. Talk to him after you've done the initial quest. Tell him you need another weapon.

2. He will then ask you to collect 50 Comodo Leathers and 1 Log to create a new hilt.

3. To finish the weapon, he ask you to collect 70 Comodo Leathers, 20 Steel and 10 Oridecons.

'''Notes''':
* You can make more than 1 hilt as long as you don't have it on your inventory. To finish the weapon, same procedure applies.

== Weapon Enchantment ==
After completing the weapon, you can ask Gatti to further enhance the capabilities of the weapon. He will ask you for 100,000 [[Zeny]] for each enchantment attempt. The same restrictions and guidelines for [[Hidden Enchant]] applies for this one. He can add MATK, ATK, DEF, FLEE, CRIT, MDEF, HP, SP and also Stat bonuses on the 2 hidden slots of the weapon.
